`libs/pisexcompat/include/pisex/players.hpp`:

```hpp
// pisexcompat — the IPlayersApi subset the admin core and its modules use, over s2sdk.
//
// Every call is guarded by pisex::IsGameReady(): s2sdk client queries crash when they run before a
// map exists (the Pisex plugins could call them any time because the engine objects always
// existed). Outside of a map the wrappers return the neutral value (false / 0 / -1 / ""), so a
// ported plugin that asks for a player name in OnPluginStart gets an empty string instead of a
// dead server.
//
// GetPlayerName()/GetSteamID()/GetIpAddress() return a pointer into a per-slot cache, so combining
// two of them in one expression is safe (the Pisex ones returned engine-owned strings with the
// same property).

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <string>

#include <plg/numerics.hpp>

namespace pisex {

// Pisex's OnClientAuthorizedCallback: (slot, steamid64).
using OnClientAuthorizedCallback = std::function<void(int iSlot, uint64_t iSteamID64)>;

// Pisex's IPlayersApi::HookOnClientAuthorized(), on s2sdk's OnClientAuthenticated listener.
// Note the caveat: OnClientAuthenticated does not fire for every client, so a ported plugin
// should keep (or add) a once-per-second reconcile like plugins/perm_connector has. Registering
// the first callback installs the s2sdk listener.
void HookOnClientAuthorized(const OnClientAuthorizedCallback& callback);
// Drops every callback and the s2sdk listener (Shutdown() calls this).
void RemoveAllPlayerHooks();

bool IsFakeClient(int iSlot);
bool IsConnected(int iSlot);
bool IsInGame(int iSlot);
bool IsAuthenticated(int iSlot);
bool IsAlive(int iSlot);

// The precondition every s2sdk client/player export needs: a map is up (pisexcompat's map
// lifecycle gate - between a map end and the next map start s2sdk's client list is torn down and
// any client query crashes), the slot is in range, the client is connected and its controller
// entity exists (bots included; a client that is still connecting has no controller yet).
// pisexcompat's own wrappers check this before they call into s2sdk, so porting code can use it
// to loop slots silently - an s2sdk call on a slot that fails it logs
// "invalid player slot/pawn" (or, for SetClientName, crashes).
bool IsClientReady(int iSlot);

// 0 when the slot has no authenticated player (or no map is running).
uint64_t GetSteamID64(int iSlot);
// "STEAM_1:0:..." style auth string.
const char* GetSteamID(int iSlot);
const char* GetPlayerName(int iSlot);
void SetPlayerName(int iSlot, const char* szName);
const char* GetIpAddress(int iSlot);
const char* GetClientLanguage(int iSlot);

// -1 when no player matches. FindPlayer(steamid) is exact, FindPlayer(name) is a case-insensitive
// match (exact first, then substring).
int FindPlayer(uint64_t iSteamID64);
int FindPlayer(const char* szName);

int GetPlayerHealth(int iSlot);
int GetPlayerArmor(int iSlot);
int GetPlayerMoney(int iSlot);
int GetPlayerTeam(int iSlot); // 0 none, 1 spectator, 2 T, 3 CT
bool IsPlayerBot(int iSlot);

void ChangeTeam(int iSlot, int iNewTeam);
void SwitchTeam(int iSlot, int iNewTeam);
void Respawn(int iSlot);
void CommitSuicide(int iSlot, bool bExplode, bool bForce);
void SetMoveType(int iSlot, int moveType);
void Teleport(int iSlot, const plg::vec3* position, const plg::vec3* angles, const plg::vec3* velocity);
void RemoveWeapons(int iSlot);

// Entity index (1-based) of the player's pawn / controller, 0 when there is none.
int GetPawnEntity(int iSlot);
int GetControllerEntity(int iSlot);
// Player slot that owns an entity (its controller), -1 when it is not a player-owned entity.
int GetOwnerSlot(int iEntity);

// Number of player slots on this server (s2sdk GetMaxClients, 64 when unavailable).
int GetMaxPlayers();
```

`libs/pisexcompat/include/pisex/schema.hpp`:

```hpp
// pisexcompat — entity / schema access helpers.
//
// The Pisex modules reach into hl2sdk typed entities (pPawn->m_iHealth(), pController->m_iTeamNum(),
// ...). Plugify has no schema headers, so those accessors become "class + field" string lookups
// through s2sdk's schema functions. These wrappers add the two things the string API lacks:
//   * one cached offset lookup per class+field pair (the lookups are not cheap),
//   * a null-safe, exception-safe call that returns a default when the field does not exist.
//
// Porting note: schema *getters* are cheap; setters that must reach the client need
// changeState=true (s2sdk then sends the network update), which is the equivalent of Pisex's
// SetStateChanged().
//
// MAP-START WARNING: a typed schema call made one frame after a map load can receive a schema
// field entry whose CSchemaType* is the sentinel -1, which s2sdk then dereferences; the *offset*
// of that entry is fine. Keep schema access (this header, and s2sdk's GetEntSchema*/
// SetEntSchema* directly) off the map-start path: do it from a player/round event, or resolve the
// offset with SchemaOffset() and use s2sdk's raw GetEntData2/SetEntData2 (with the field's real
// width) as plugins/fortnite_emotes does.
//
// Entity ints in this API are ENTITY INDICES (Pisex convention, 0 = none). s2sdk itself works with
// CEntityHandle ints (index | serial << 15); every function here converts internally. Use pisex::EntIndexToEntPointer() /
// pisex::EntPointerToEntIndex() when an API wants the other form.

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

#include <plg/numerics.hpp>

namespace pisex {

// Cached schema offset of <className>::<fieldName> (-1 when the class or field is unknown).
int SchemaOffset(const char* className, const char* fieldName);
// Chain offset (for fields inside a network var chain): -1 when the class is not chained (or the
// binding is missing) - never 0, which s2sdk's SafeNetworkStateChanged() would read as a real
// offset and dereference the object's vtable as a chainer.
int SchemaChainOffset(const char* className);
bool IsSchemaFieldNetworked(const char* className, const char* fieldName);

// --- entity handles --------------------------------------------------------------------------
bool IsValidEntity(int iEntity);
void* EntIndexToEntPointer(int iEntity);
int EntPointerToEntIndex(void* pointer);
int EntIndexToEntHandle(int iEntity);
int EntHandleToEntIndex(int iHandle);
std::string GetEntityClassname(int iEntity);

// --- typed schema access ---------------------------------------------------------------------
int GetEntInt(int iEntity, const char* className, const char* fieldName, int iDefault = 0, int iElement = 0);
float GetEntFloat(int iEntity, const char* className, const char* fieldName, float flDefault = 0.0f,
				  int iElement = 0);
bool GetEntBool(int iEntity, const char* className, const char* fieldName, bool bDefault = false,
				int iElement = 0);
const char* GetEntString(int iEntity, const char* className, const char* fieldName, const char* szDefault = "",
						 int iElement = 0);
plg::vec3 GetEntVector(int iEntity, const char* className, const char* fieldName, int iElement = 0);
plg::vec4 GetEntColor(int iEntity, const char* className, const char* fieldName, int iElement = 0);
// Entity (index) referenced by a handle field (m_hPawn, m_hController, ...); 0 when empty.
int GetEntEntity(int iEntity, const char* className, const char* fieldName, int iElement = 0);

// changeState=true makes s2sdk send the change to the clients (replaces Pisex's SetStateChanged).
```

`libs/pisexcompat/include/pisex/timers.hpp`:

```hpp
// pisexcompat — Pisex timers over s2sdk timers.
//
//   CTimer* t = g_pUtils->CreateTimer(1.0f, [] { ...; return 1.0f; }); // repeat after 1s
//   CTimer* u = g_pUtils->CreateTimer(0.0f, [] { ...; return -1.0f; }); // stop after one run
//
// Semantics kept from Pisex's CTimer: the callback returns the delay (in seconds) until its next
// run, or a negative value to stop and destroy the timer. The timer object is owned by
// pisexcompat and freed when it stops (or at Shutdown()); RemoveTimer() on an already dead handle
// is a safe no-op (Pisex's version would use-after-free).
//
// Delay floor: every delay handed to s2sdk is clamped to one server tick (kMinTimerDelay, 1/64 s).
// The s2sdk timer system re-inserts a repeating timer at
// universalTime + its *stored* delay inside a `while` loop that runs callbacks as long as one is
// due, so a stored delay of 0 makes that loop re-run the callback forever inside a single frame —
// "Server took too long to process (probably infinite loop)" -> FATAL. Pisex's "0 (or negative) =
// run again next frame" is preserved by the clamp: one tick is the earliest the engine can fire
// the timer again.
//
// Implementation notes (why there is a Poll()):
//   * s2sdk timers are single-shot by default; we create them with TimerFlag::Repeat and always
//     call RescheduleTimer with the value the callback returned.
//   * TimerSystem::RunFrame() invokes the callback from inside its own loop (the mutex is
//     recursive and both KillTimer/RescheduleTimer special-case a timer that is *executing*:
//     KillTimer defers the erase, RescheduleTimer ignores the call). OnFire() therefore makes no
//     s2sdk call of its own: the callback only *records* the requested next delay, and
//     pisex::Poll() (game thread, once per frame) performs the reschedule/kill after the engine's
//     loop is done. While a timer waits for that (at most one frame), further fires are ignored,
//     so a callback never runs twice per frame - which is what Pisex's own timer loop guarantees.
//   * Timers survive map changes, exactly like the Pisex ones (the admin core's one-second
//     punishment-expiry timer is expected to keep running across maps). Shutdown() kills them.
//     While no map is up (from OnMapEnd to the next map start - s2sdk's client list is torn down
//     in that window) a timer never invokes its callback: the fire is *postponed* and the timer
//     is re-armed with one tick on the first ready frame, so the callback runs as early as the
//     engine can again but with a live map. The next delay is still whatever the callback
//     returns when it finally runs.

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>

namespace pisex {

// One engine tick at the default 64 tickrate; the same constant s2sdk's TimerSystem uses
// (engineFixedTickInterval). No delay below this is ever passed to the s2sdk timer calls.
constexpr double kMinTimerDelay = 1.0 / 64.0; // 0.015625

// Floors a timer delay at one server tick. Pure logic (unit-tested in tests/pisexcompat_tests.cpp).
// A non-positive, sub-tick or NaN delay all mean "as soon as possible" in Pisex terms - which is
// one tick away, never 0: s2sdk stores the delay and re-inserts a repeating timer at
// universalTime + stored delay, and a stored 0 loops forever inside one RunFrame() call.
inline double ClampTimerDelay(double delay) noexcept {
	// NaN fails both comparisons intentionally: it is treated like 0 ("next frame").
	return delay > kMinTimerDelay ? delay : kMinTimerDelay;
}

class CTimer {
public:
	// Stops and destroys the timer (safe to call with the handle the callback runs in).
	void RemoveTimer();
	bool IsAlive() const { return alive_; }
	// Delay currently scheduled (the value the last callback run returned).
	float GetInterval() const { return interval_; }
	// Applies from the next run onwards.
	void SetInterval(float interval) { interval_ = interval; }

	// pisexcompat internals.
	uint32_t Handle() const { return id_; }

private:
	friend struct TimerAccess; // internal: only timers.cpp uses it

	uint32_t id_ = 0;
	float interval_ = 0.0f;
	bool alive_ = true;
	bool pending_ = false;   // callback ran, waiting for Poll() to reschedule
	bool firing_ = false;    // the callback is on the stack right now (see RemoveTimer in timers.cpp)
	bool postponed_ = false; // fired while no map was up; re-armed with one tick after the next map start
	std::function<float()> fn_;
};

// Internal — not part of the Pisex surface. Exists so the registry in timers.cpp can reach the
// private state of CTimer without making the fields public.
struct TimerAccess {
	static uint32_t& Id(CTimer& timer) { return timer.id_; }
	static float& Interval(CTimer& timer) { return timer.interval_; }
	static bool& Alive(CTimer& timer) { return timer.alive_; }
	static bool& Pending(CTimer& timer) { return timer.pending_; }
	static bool& Firing(CTimer& timer) { return timer.firing_; }
	static bool& Postponed(CTimer& timer) { return timer.postponed_; }
	static std::function<float()>& Fn(CTimer& timer) { return timer.fn_; }
};

// Pisex's IUtilsApi::CreateTimer. Returns nullptr when the s2sdk timer binding is missing.
CTimer* CreateTimer(float flInterval, std::function<float()> fn);
// Pisex's IUtilsApi::RemoveTimer.
void RemoveTimer(CTimer* timer);

// Pisex's IUtilsApi::NextFrame: runs fn once on the next Poll() (next server frame).
void NextFrame(std::function<void()> fn);

// pisexcompat internals, called by pisex::Poll().
void ProcessTimers();
// Kills every timer and drops the next-frame queue (Shutdown()).
void ClearTimers();

} // namespace pisex
```

`libs/pisexcompat/src/commands.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <pisex/commands.hpp>

#include <pisex/compat.hpp>
#include <pisex/output.hpp>
#include <pisex/paths.hpp>

#include <s2sdk/s2sdk.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace pisex {
namespace {

struct CommandEntry {
	std::string name;	  // lookup key: lowercase, chat trigger stripped
	std::string spelling; // what the callback sees as arg[0]
	bool console = false;
	bool chat = false;
	bool server_only = false; // RegServerCommand: no caller slot may reach the callback
	CommandCallback callback;
};

std::vector<CommandEntry> g_commands;
std::unordered_set<std::string> g_s2sdkNames; // names already handed to AddConsoleCommand
std::vector<CommandCallbackPre> g_chatPre;

// The s2sdk settings ship "!" and "/"; the extra characters cover the common Metamod plugins
// that use "." or "$" and are harmless when the server keeps the default settings.
std::vector<char> g_triggers{'!', '/'};
bool g_triggersLoaded = false;

std::string ToLower(std::string_view text) {
	std::string out(text);
	std::transform(out.begin(), out.end(), out.begin(), [](char c) {
		return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
	});
	return out;
}

// "!ban" -> "ban", "ban" -> "ban"; only a leading trigger character is removed.
std::string StripTrigger(std::string_view name) {
	if (!name.empty() && IsChatTrigger(name.front())) {
		return std::string(name.substr(1));
	}
	return std::string(name);
}

std::string JoinArgs(const plg::vector<plg::string>& args, std::size_t from) {
	std::string out;
	for (std::size_t i = from; i < args.size(); ++i) {
		if (!out.empty()) {
			out.push_back(' ');
		}
		out.append(args[i].data(), args[i].size());
	}
	return out;
}

// The callback sees the command name as it was registered, followed by the arguments
// (Pisex passed CCommand::ArgS(): "mm_kick 3 60" / "!ban 3 60 1h").
std::string BuildContent(std::string_view spelling, const plg::vector<plg::string>& args) {
	std::string out(spelling);
	const std::string rest = JoinArgs(args, 1);
	if (!rest.empty()) {
		out.push_back(' ');
		out.append(rest);
	}
	return out;
}

const CommandEntry* FindEntry(std::string_view name, bool forChat) {
	const std::string lowered = ToLower(name);
	const CommandEntry* fallback = nullptr;
	for (auto it = g_commands.rbegin(); it != g_commands.rend(); ++it) {
		if (it->name != lowered) {
			continue;
		}
		if (forChat) {
			if (it->chat) {
				return &(*it);
			}
			continue;
		}
		if (!it->console) {
			continue;
		}
		// A server-only registration wins over a client-executable one for the same name: once a
		// plugin marks a console name server-only, no client caller may reach any of its handlers.
		if (it->server_only) {
			return &(*it);
		}
		if (fallback == nullptr) {
			fallback = &(*it);
		}
	}
	return fallback;
}

s2sdk::ResultType CommandTrampoline(int32_t caller, s2sdk::ConCommandContext context,
									const plg::vector<plg::string>& args) {
	try {
		if (args.empty() || args[0].empty()) {
			return s2sdk::ResultType::Continue;
		}
		const std::string_view name(args[0].data(), args[0].size());
		const bool fromChat = context == s2sdk::ConCommandContext::Chat;
		const CommandEntry* entry = FindEntry(name, fromChat);
		if (!entry) {
			// A chat message that does not belong to any registered chat name (for example
			// "!something") is left alone: s2sdk then falls back to the normal say path.
			return s2sdk::ResultType::Continue;
		}
		if (entry->server_only && caller >= 0) {
			// Server-console-only command: swallow the call without running the handler (the engine
			// entry is registered without ClientCanExecute as well, this covers the chat path).
			return s2sdk::ResultType::Handled;
		}
		const std::string content = BuildContent(entry->spelling, args);
		const CommandCallback callback = entry->callback; // copy: the callback may unregister itself
		const bool handled = callback ? callback(caller, content.c_str()) : false;
		return handled ? s2sdk::ResultType::Handled : s2sdk::ResultType::Continue;
	} catch (const std::exception& ex) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: command callback threw: %s", ex.what());
	} catch (...) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: command callback threw an unknown exception");
	}
	// Never propagate: a throwing handler still owns the command.
	return s2sdk::ResultType::Handled;
}

s2sdk::ResultType ChatTrampoline(int32_t caller, s2sdk::ConCommandContext /*context*/,
								 const plg::vector<plg::string>& args) {
	try {
		if (g_chatPre.empty()) {
			return s2sdk::ResultType::Continue;
		}
		const bool isTeam = !args.empty() && args[0] == "say_team";
		const std::string content = JoinArgs(args, 1);
		bool allow = true;
		// Copy: a listener may unregister itself (or every command, e.g. Shutdown) while it runs.
		const std::vector<CommandCallbackPre> callbacks = g_chatPre;
		for (const CommandCallbackPre& callback : callbacks) {
			if (!callback) {
				continue;
			}
			if (!callback(caller, content.c_str(), isTeam)) {
				allow = false;
			}
		}
		return allow ? s2sdk::ResultType::Continue : s2sdk::ResultType::Handled;
	} catch (const std::exception& ex) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: chat listener threw: %s", ex.what());
	} catch (...) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: chat listener threw an unknown exception");
	}
	return s2sdk::ResultType::Handled;
}

// Engine commands Pisex plugins hook (e.g. AdminTime hooks "jointeam"). They must only get a
// listener: AddConsoleCommand would create our own command with that name when the game has
// not registered its command yet (plugins start before the game's "jointeam"
// exists), which shadows the game command and the client gets "not marked
// FCVAR_CLIENT_CAN_EXECUTE". Listeners that cannot attach yet are retried from Poll().
const std::unordered_set<std::string> kGameCommands = {
	"jointeam", "joingame", "spectate", "teammenu", "kill", "explode", "buy", "drop", "use",
	"callvote", "vote", "say", "say_team", "autobuy", "rebuy",
};
std::unordered_set<std::string> g_gameCommandNames; // registered engine-command names we handle
bool g_globalListener = false;

// Engine commands such as "jointeam"/"vote" are not ConCommands in CS2 (the game parses them in
// its ClientCommand path), so neither AddConsoleCommand (creates a shadowing command) nor a named
// AddCommandListener ("Command jointeam is not exists") works. s2sdk's ClientCommand hook runs
// the GLOBAL listeners for every client command, so one global listener dispatches them by name.
s2sdk::ResultType GameCommandTrampoline(int32_t caller, s2sdk::ConCommandContext context,
										const plg::vector<plg::string>& args) {
	// Registered directly with s2sdk (AddCommandListener), and s2sdk does not wrap listener
	// callbacks: nothing may escape into the engine, not even from the lookup below.
	try {
		if (args.empty() || g_gameCommandNames.empty()) {
			return s2sdk::ResultType::Continue;
		}
		if (g_gameCommandNames.count(ToLower(std::string_view(args[0].data(), args[0].size()))) == 0) {
			return s2sdk::ResultType::Continue;
		}
		return CommandTrampoline(caller, context, args);
	} catch (const std::exception& ex) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: game command dispatch threw: %s", ex.what());
	} catch (...) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: game command dispatch threw an unknown exception");
	}
	// Continue: on a failure the engine's own handling of e.g. "jointeam" proceeds as if we had
	// never listened - safer than swallowing the command.
	return s2sdk::ResultType::Continue;
}

void RegisterS2sdkName(const std::string& name, bool serverOnly) {
	if (name.empty() || g_s2sdkNames.count(name) != 0) {
		return;
	}
	if (kGameCommands.count(name) != 0) {
		g_s2sdkNames.insert(name);
		g_gameCommandNames.insert(name);
		if (!g_globalListener && __s2sdk_AddCommandListener) {
			g_globalListener = s2sdk::AddCommandListener(plg::string(), &GameCommandTrampoline, s2sdk::HookMode::Pre);
		}
		return;
	}
	if (!__s2sdk_AddConsoleCommand) {
		return;
	}
	// Our own commands: Release always, ClientCanExecute for the ones a player may run (Pisex
	// registered every "mm_*" name as a client-executable ConCommand). Server-only commands keep
	// the Metamod FCVAR_NONE behaviour - the client console must not execute them at all. Pre hook
	// so Continue lets the engine go on.
	int64_t flagBits = static_cast<int64_t>(s2sdk::ConVarFlag::Release);
	if (!serverOnly) {
		flagBits |= static_cast<int64_t>(s2sdk::ConVarFlag::ClientCanExecute);
	}
	s2sdk::AddConsoleCommand(name, "pisexcompat", static_cast<s2sdk::ConVarFlag>(flagBits), &CommandTrampoline,
							 s2sdk::HookMode::Pre);
	// A false return also covers "already registered" (duplicate registration): not an error.
	g_s2sdkNames.insert(name);
}

} // namespace

void PollCommandRegistrations() {
	// Engine commands are dispatched through one global listener (see GameCommandTrampoline);
	// nothing to retry.
}

void CommandArgs::Tokenize(const char* text) {
	text_.assign(text ? text : "");
	args_.clear();

	std::size_t i = 0;
	const std::size_t size = text_.size();
	while (i < size) {
		while (i < size && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(text_[i]))) {
			++i;
		}
		if (i >= size) {
			break;
		}
		std::string token;
		if (text_[i] == '"') {
			++i;
			while (i < size && text_[i] != '"') {
				token.push_back(text_[i++]);
			}
			if (i < size) {
				++i; // closing quote
			}
		} else {
			while (i < size && !std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(text_[i]))) {
				token.push_back(text_[i++]);
			}
		}
		args_.push_back(std::move(token));
	}
}

const char* CommandArgs::Arg(int index) const {
	if (index < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(index) >= args_.size()) {
		return nullptr;
	}
	return args_[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)].c_str();
}

void CommandArgs::Reset() {
	text_.clear();
	args_.clear();
}

void AddChatTrigger(char trigger) {
	if (!IsChatTrigger(trigger)) {
		g_triggers.push_back(trigger);
	}
}

bool IsChatTrigger(char c) {
	return std::find(g_triggers.begin(), g_triggers.end(), c) != g_triggers.end();
}

void RefreshChatTriggers() {
	if (g_triggersLoaded) {
		return;
	}
	g_triggersLoaded = true;
	// envs/plugins/s2sdk/settings.jsonc sits next to the configs dir:
	//   <game>/addons/plugify/configs   ->   <game>/addons/plugify/envs/plugins/s2sdk/
	const std::string configs = plg::GetConfigsDir ? std::string(plg::GetConfigsDir()) : std::string();
	if (configs.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	const std::string settings = JoinPath(configs, "../envs/plugins/s2sdk/settings.jsonc");
	bool ok = false;
	const std::string text = ReadFile(settings, &ok);
	if (!ok) {
		return;
	}
	// A minimal scan of the two trigger arrays; anything that does not parse leaves the defaults.
	for (const std::string_view key : {"\"PublicChatTrigger\"", "\"SilentChatTrigger\""}) {
		const std::size_t keyPos = text.find(key);
		if (keyPos == std::string::npos) {
			continue;
		}
		const std::size_t open = text.find('[', keyPos);
		const std::size_t close = open == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : text.find(']', open);
		if (open == std::string::npos || close == std::string::npos) {
			continue;
		}
		for (std::size_t i = open; i < close; ++i) {
			if (text[i] != '"') {
				continue;
			}
			const std::size_t end = text.find('"', i + 1);
			if (end == std::string::npos || end > close) {
				break;
			}
			if (end == i + 2) {
				AddChatTrigger(text[i + 1]); // single-character trigger, all s2sdk supports
			}
			i = end;
		}
	}
}

void RegCommand(const std::vector<std::string>& console, const std::vector<std::string>& chat,
				const CommandCallback& callback) {
	try {
		RefreshChatTriggers();
		for (const std::string& name : console) {
			if (name.empty()) {
				continue;
			}
			CommandEntry entry;
			entry.name = ToLower(name);
			entry.spelling = name;
			entry.console = true;
			entry.callback = callback;
			const std::string lookup = entry.name;
			g_commands.push_back(std::move(entry));
			RegisterS2sdkName(lookup, /*serverOnly=*/false);
		}
		for (const std::string& name : chat) {
			if (name.empty()) {
				continue;
			}
			CommandEntry entry;
			entry.name = ToLower(StripTrigger(name));
			entry.spelling = name;
			entry.chat = true;
			entry.callback = callback;
			const std::string lookup = entry.name;
			g_commands.push_back(std::move(entry));
			RegisterS2sdkName(lookup, /*serverOnly=*/false);
		}
	} catch (const std::exception& ex) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: RegCommand failed: %s", ex.what());
	} catch (...) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: RegCommand failed with an unknown exception");
	}
}

void RegCommand(const char* consoleName, const CommandCallback& callback) {
	std::vector<std::string> names;
	if (consoleName && *consoleName) {
		names.emplace_back(consoleName);
	}
	RegCommand(names, {}, callback);
}

void RegCommand(const std::vector<std::string>& console, const CommandCallback& callback) {
	RegCommand(console, {}, callback);
}

void RegServerCommand(const std::vector<std::string>& console, const CommandCallback& callback) {
	try {
		for (const std::string& name : console) {
			if (name.empty()) {
				continue;
			}
			CommandEntry entry;
			entry.name = ToLower(name);
			entry.spelling = name;
			entry.console = true;
			entry.server_only = true;
			entry.callback = callback;
			const std::string lookup = entry.name;
			g_commands.push_back(std::move(entry));
			RegisterS2sdkName(lookup, /*serverOnly=*/true);
		}
	} catch (const std::exception& ex) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: RegServerCommand failed: %s", ex.what());
	} catch (...) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: RegServerCommand failed with an unknown exception");
	}
}

void RegServerCommand(const char* consoleName, const CommandCallback& callback) {
	std::vector<std::string> names;
	if (consoleName && *consoleName) {
		names.emplace_back(consoleName);
	}
	RegServerCommand(names, callback);
}

void AddChatListenerPre(const CommandCallbackPre& callback) {
	try {
		const bool first = g_chatPre.empty();
		g_chatPre.push_back(callback);
		if (first && __s2sdk_AddCommandListener) {
			for (const char* name : {"say", "say_team"}) {
				if (!s2sdk::AddCommandListener(name, &ChatTrampoline, s2sdk::HookMode::Pre)) {
					ErrorLog("pisexcompat: could not hook '%s' for chat listeners", name);
				}
			}
		}
	} catch (const std::exception& ex) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: AddChatListenerPre failed: %s", ex.what());
	} catch (...) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: AddChatListenerPre failed with an unknown exception");
	}
}

void RemoveAllCommands() {
	if (__s2sdk_RemoveCommand) {
		for (const std::string& name : g_s2sdkNames) {
			if (g_gameCommandNames.count(name) == 0) {
				s2sdk::RemoveCommand(name, &CommandTrampoline);
			}
		}
	}
	if (__s2sdk_RemoveCommandListener && !g_chatPre.empty()) {
		for (const char* name : {"say", "say_team"}) {
			s2sdk::RemoveCommandListener(name, &ChatTrampoline, s2sdk::HookMode::Pre);
		}
	}
	if (g_globalListener && __s2sdk_RemoveCommandListener) {
		s2sdk::RemoveCommandListener(plg::string(), &GameCommandTrampoline, s2sdk::HookMode::Pre);
	}
	g_globalListener = false;
	g_gameCommandNames.clear();
	g_s2sdkNames.clear();
	g_commands.clear();
	g_chatPre.clear();
}

bool HasChatListeners() {
	return !g_chatPre.empty();
}

bool HasCommands() {
	return !g_commands.empty();
}

} // namespace pisex
```

```cpp
#include <pisex/compat.hpp>

#include <pisex/commands.hpp>
#include <pisex/events.hpp>
#include <pisex/menu.hpp>
#include <pisex/output.hpp>
#include <pisex/paths.hpp>
#include <pisex/phrases.hpp>
#include <pisex/players.hpp>

#include <plg/string.hpp>
#include <s2sdk/s2sdk.hpp>

#include <exception>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace pisex {
namespace {

bool g_initialized = false;
bool g_listenersRegistered = false;
bool g_gameReady = false;
bool g_mapStartPending = false;
bool g_mapStartSeen = false; // an OnMapStart arrived (since Init / the last OnMapEnd)
bool g_mapEndSeen = false;   // an OnMapEnd arrived (since Init)
bool g_startupRan = false;
std::string g_mapName;
GlobalVars g_globalVars;

std::vector<std::function<void()>> g_startupCallbacks;
std::vector<std::function<void(const char*)>> g_mapStartCallbacks;
std::vector<std::function<void()>> g_mapEndCallbacks;

std::string ToString(const plg::string& text) {
	return std::string(text.data(), text.size());
}

void RunSafely(const char* what, const std::function<void()>& callback) {
	if (!callback) {
		return;
	}
	try {
		callback();
	} catch (const std::exception& ex) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: %s callback threw: %s", what, ex.what());
	} catch (...) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: %s callback threw an unknown exception", what);
	}
}

// --- s2sdk listeners -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Only ever registered from Init() and removed by Shutdown(). They run on the game thread.

void OnMapStartListener() {
	try {
		g_mapStartPending = true;
		g_mapStartSeen = true;
		if (__s2sdk_GetCurrentMap) {
			g_mapName = ToString(s2sdk::GetCurrentMap());
		}
	} catch (...) {
	}
}

void OnMapEndListener() {
	try {
		// From here on - until the next map start - every s2sdk client query is unsafe: the client
		// list is torn down during the level shutdown (a crash: utils::GetClientBySlot reads
		// m_Clients.Element(slot) on the half-destroyed server and segfaults at address 0). The
		// ready flag needs a *new* map start, not just another Poll, see Poll().
		g_gameReady = false;
		g_mapStartPending = false;
		g_mapStartSeen = false;
		g_mapEndSeen = true;
		g_mapName.clear();
		// The engine has already destroyed the menus of every disconnecting client; dropping our
		// registry entries here keeps no state pointing at them (no client/entity call from map
		// end - the sessions are ended through the menu manager only, see CloseAllMenus).
		CloseAllMenus();
		for (const std::function<void()>& callback : g_mapEndCallbacks) {
			RunSafely("map end", callback);
		}
	} catch (...) {
	}
}

bool BindingsAvailable() {
	// A missing s2sdk plugin leaves every binding null: the library then degrades to a no-op
	// instead of crashing on the first call.
	return __s2sdk_IsClientConnected != nullptr && __s2sdk_IsClientInGame != nullptr &&
		   __s2sdk_GetClientName != nullptr && __s2sdk_PrintToChat != nullptr && __s2sdk_PrintToChatAll != nullptr;
}

void RegisterListeners() {
	if (g_listenersRegistered || !__s2sdk_OnMapStart_Register || !__s2sdk_OnMapEnd_Register) {
		return;
	}
	// The register functions return nothing; a failure shows up as the callback never firing, so
	// nothing to check here (the bindings themselves were checked by BindingsAvailable()).
	s2sdk::OnMapStart_Register(&OnMapStartListener);
	s2sdk::OnMapEnd_Register(&OnMapEndListener);
	g_listenersRegistered = true;
}

void UnregisterListeners() {
	if (!g_listenersRegistered) {
		return;
	}
	g_listenersRegistered = false;
	if (__s2sdk_OnMapStart_Unregister) {
		s2sdk::OnMapStart_Unregister(&OnMapStartListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnMapEnd_Unregister) {
		s2sdk::OnMapEnd_Unregister(&OnMapEndListener);
	}
}

} // namespace

bool Init(std::string_view pluginName) {
	return Init(pluginName, {}, {});
}

bool Init(std::string_view pluginName, std::string_view configDir, std::string_view translationsDir) {
	g_startupRan = false;
	g_gameReady = false;
	g_mapStartPending = false;
	g_mapStartSeen = false;
	g_mapEndSeen = false;
	g_mapName.clear();

	if (!pluginName.empty()) {
		SetPluginName(pluginName);
	}
	if (!configDir.empty()) {
		SetConfigDir(configDir);
	}
	if (!translationsDir.empty()) {
		SetTranslationsDir(translationsDir);
	}

	RefreshChatTriggers();
	RegisterListeners();

	g_initialized = true;
	if (!BindingsAvailable()) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: the s2sdk bindings are not available (is the s2sdk plugin loaded?) - "
				 "pisexcompat runs in no-op mode");
		return false;
	}
	BurnMenuIdZero();
	return true;
}

void Shutdown() {
	try {
		UnregisterListeners();
		RemoveAllCommands();
		RemoveAllEvents();
		RemoveAllPlayerHooks();
		ClearTimers();
		CloseAllMenus();
		g_startupCallbacks.clear();
		g_mapStartCallbacks.clear();
		g_mapEndCallbacks.clear();
		g_mapStartPending = false;
		g_mapStartSeen = false;
		g_mapEndSeen = false;
		g_gameReady = false;
		g_initialized = false;
	} catch (...) {
	}
}

void OnMapStartNotify() {
	OnMapStartListener();
}

void OnMapEndNotify() {
	OnMapEndListener();
}

bool IsGameReady() {
	return g_gameReady;
}

std::string_view CurrentMap() {
	if (g_gameReady && __s2sdk_GetCurrentMap) {
		try {
			g_mapName = ToString(s2sdk::GetCurrentMap());
		} catch (...) {
		}
	}
	return g_mapName;
}

void Poll() {
	// Map lifecycle gate. Client/entity queries are only safe while a map is really up: s2sdk
	// tears its client list down during the level shutdown, so between OnMapEnd and the *next*
	// map start every client call is a crash (utils::GetClientBySlot runs on the half-destroyed
	// server, and Player::SetName dereferences a clientless slot). Granting readiness again on the
	// next Poll would be wrong - the host can pump updates throughout a changelevel - so a new
	// OnMapStart is required. A plugin loaded into an already running map never saw one; its first
	// update is the proof of a running server (the host pumps this from ServerPostSimulate, which
	// only runs with a map up), which is the `!g_mapEndSeen` case.
	if (!g_gameReady && (g_mapStartSeen || !g_mapEndSeen)) {
		g_gameReady = true;
	}
	if (!g_gameReady) {
		// Map change in progress: nothing may touch a client or an entity. The pumps keep
		// running - timers stay parked and are postponed to the first ready frame (timers.cpp),
		// menu requests are dropped/cleared (no client to serve, see CloseAllMenus at map end).
		ProcessMenuRequests();
		ProcessTimers();
		return;
	}

	RefreshGlobalVars();
	PollCommandRegistrations();

	if (!g_initialized) {
		// A plugin that calls Poll() without Init() still gets the timer pump.
		ProcessMenuRequests();
		ProcessTimers();
		return;
	}

	if (!g_startupRan) {
		g_startupRan = true;
		if (__s2sdk_GetCurrentMap) {
			try {
				g_mapName = ToString(s2sdk::GetCurrentMap());
			} catch (...) {
			}
		}
		for (const std::function<void()>& callback : g_startupCallbacks) {
			RunSafely("startup", callback);
		}
		g_mapStartPending = true; // a plugin loaded mid-map gets its map-start hook too
	}

	// Menu changes requested from inside a menu callback (the engine holds the menu manager's lock
	// while it calls us, so they cannot be applied there).
	ProcessMenuRequests();

	if (g_mapStartPending) {
		g_mapStartPending = false;
		// Remove the callbacks registered *by* a map-start callback from the current iteration.
		const std::vector<std::function<void(const char*)>> callbacks = g_mapStartCallbacks;
		for (const std::function<void(const char*)>& callback : callbacks) {
			if (!callback) {
				continue;
			}
			try {
				callback(g_mapName.c_str());
			} catch (const std::exception& ex) {
				ErrorLog("pisexcompat: map start callback threw: %s", ex.what());
			} catch (...) {
				ErrorLog("pisexcompat: map start callback threw an unknown exception");
			}
		}
	}

	ProcessTimers();
}

void RegisterStartupCallback(std::function<void()> callback) {
	if (callback) {
		g_startupCallbacks.push_back(std::move(callback));
	}
}

void RegisterMapStartCallback(std::function<void(const char*)> callback) {
	if (callback) {
		g_mapStartCallbacks.push_back(std::move(callback));
	}
}

void RegisterMapEndCallback(std::function<void()> callback) {
	if (callback) {
		g_mapEndCallbacks.push_back(std::move(callback));
	}
}

GlobalVars* GetCGlobalVars() {
	if (g_globalVars.intervalPerTick == 0.0f) {
		RefreshGlobalVars();
	}
	return &g_globalVars;
}

void RefreshGlobalVars() {
	try {
		if (__s2sdk_GetGameTime) {
			g_globalVars.curtime = s2sdk::GetGameTime();
		}
		if (__s2sdk_GetGameFrameTime) {
			g_globalVars.frametime = s2sdk::GetGameFrameTime();
			g_globalVars.absoluteFrameTime = g_globalVars.frametime;
		}
		if (__s2sdk_GetTickInterval) {
			g_globalVars.intervalPerTick = static_cast<float>(s2sdk::GetTickInterval());
		}
		if (__s2sdk_GetMaxClients) {
			const int maxClients = s2sdk::GetMaxClients();
			if (maxClients > 0 && maxClients <= 64) {
				g_globalVars.maxClients = maxClients;
			}
		}
		if (__s2sdk_GetGameTickCount) {
			g_globalVars.tickcount = s2sdk::GetGameTickCount();
		}
		if (__s2sdk_GetEngineTime) {
			g_globalVars.realtime = s2sdk::GetEngineTime();
		}
	} catch (...) {
	}
}
```

`libs/pisexcompat/src/events.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <pisex/events.hpp>

#include <pisex/output.hpp>

#include <plg/string.hpp>
#include <s2sdk/s2sdk.hpp>

#include <exception>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace pisex {
namespace {

// Lookup by string_view without building a std::string per event fire.
struct EventNameHash {
	using is_transparent = void;
	size_t operator()(std::string_view text) const noexcept { return std::hash<std::string_view>{}(text); }
};
// Each list is immutable once published: (un)hooking publishes a new list, so an event fire keeps
// iterating its snapshot (a callback may hook/unhook events) without copying the callbacks.
using EventHookList = std::shared_ptr<const std::vector<EventCallback>>;
std::unordered_map<std::string, EventHookList, EventNameHash, std::equal_to<>> g_hooks;

// Map lifecycle (deliberate choice): events are still delivered to plugins while no map is up
// (they arrive as data only - slot numbers and values), because dropping e.g. player_disconnect
// during a changelevel would leave plugin state stale (the admin core's disconnect handling).
// Anything a handler then asks *about* a client/entity goes through the pisexcompat wrappers,
// which are gated on the map state (IsGameReady()/IsClientReady()) and answer with defaults in
// that window - no s2sdk client/entity call is made. Timers and NextFrame callbacks are the other
// way round: they are postponed to the first ready frame (timers.cpp), because a ported callback
// is almost always "do something to the players".
s2sdk::ResultType EventTrampoline(const plg::string& name, void* event, bool dontBroadcast) {
	try {
		if (g_hooks.empty()) {
			return s2sdk::ResultType::Continue;
		}
		const std::string_view eventName(name.data(), name.size());
		const auto found = g_hooks.find(eventName);
		if (found == g_hooks.end() || !found->second) {
			return s2sdk::ResultType::Continue;
		}
		// Snapshot (a refcount, no copy): a callback may hook/unhook events.
		const EventHookList callbacks = found->second;
		IGameEvent handle(event);
		for (const EventCallback& callback : *callbacks) {
			if (!callback) {
				continue;
			}
			callback(eventName.data(), &handle, dontBroadcast);
		}
	} catch (const std::exception& ex) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: event callback threw: %s", ex.what());
	} catch (...) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: event callback threw an unknown exception");
	}
	// Pre hooks cannot veto an event through this API (Pisex's old HookEvent could not either).
	return s2sdk::ResultType::Continue;
}

} // namespace

const char* IGameEvent::GetName() const {
	static thread_local std::string name;
	if (!__s2sdk_GetEventName) {
		return "";
	}
	try {
		const plg::string eventName = s2sdk::GetEventName(event_);
		name.assign(eventName.data(), eventName.size());
	} catch (...) {
		name.clear();
	}
	return name.c_str();
}

bool IGameEvent::GetBool(const char* key, bool def) const {
	if (!event_ || !__s2sdk_GetEventBool) {
		return def;
	}
	try {
		return s2sdk::GetEventBool(event_, plg::string(key ? key : ""));
	} catch (...) {
		return def;

void HookEvent(const char* name, const EventCallback& callback) {
	if (!name || !*name || !callback || !__s2sdk_HookEvent) {
		return;
	}
	try {
		EventHookList& callbacks = g_hooks[std::string(name)];
		const bool first = !callbacks || callbacks->empty();
		auto updated = callbacks ? std::make_shared<std::vector<EventCallback>>(*callbacks)
								 : std::make_shared<std::vector<EventCallback>>();
		updated->push_back(callback);
		callbacks = std::move(updated);
		if (first && s2sdk::HookEvent(plg::string(name), &EventTrampoline, s2sdk::HookMode::Pre) !=
						 s2sdk::EventHookError::Okay) {
			ErrorLog("pisexcompat: HookEvent('%s') was rejected by s2sdk", name);
		}
	} catch (const std::exception& ex) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: HookEvent failed: %s", ex.what());
	} catch (...) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: HookEvent failed with an unknown exception");
	}
}

void UnhookEvent(const char* name) {
	if (!name || !*name) {
		return;
	}
	g_hooks.erase(std::string(name));
	if (__s2sdk_UnhookEvent) {
		try {
			s2sdk::UnhookEvent(plg::string(name), &EventTrampoline, s2sdk::HookMode::Pre);
		} catch (...) {
		}
	}
}

void RemoveAllEvents() {
	for (const auto& entry : g_hooks) {
		if (__s2sdk_UnhookEvent) {
			try {
				s2sdk::UnhookEvent(plg::string(entry.first), &EventTrampoline, s2sdk::HookMode::Pre);
			} catch (...) {
			}
		}
	}
	g_hooks.clear();
}

} // namespace pisex
```

```cpp
#include <pisex/keyvalues.hpp>

#include <pisex/paths.hpp>

#include <charconv>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <string>
#include <utility>

namespace pisex {
namespace {

char Lower(char c) {
	return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
}

bool EqualNoCase(std::string_view a, std::string_view b) {
	if (a.size() != b.size()) {
		return false;
	}
	for (std::size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) {
		if (Lower(a[i]) != Lower(b[i])) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

std::string_view Trim(std::string_view text) {
	std::size_t begin = 0;
	std::size_t end = text.size();
	while (begin < end && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(text[begin]))) {
		++begin;
	}
	while (end > begin && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(text[end - 1]))) {
		--end;
	}
	return text.substr(begin, end - begin);
}

// --- tokenizer -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//
// Grammar (the KV1 subset the Pisex files use):
//
//   file    := node* EOF
//   node    := token [ value ] [ '{' node* '}' ]
//   value   := token
//   token   := '"' escaped '"' | raw
//
class Parser {
public:
	explicit Parser(std::string_view text) : text_(text) {}

	bool Parse(KeyValues& root) {
		ok_ = true;
		ParseNodes(root, false);
		return ok_ && !failed_;
	}

private:
	void SkipSpace() {
		while (pos_ < text_.size()) {
			const char c = text_[pos_];
			if (std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))) {
				++pos_;
				continue;
			}
			if (c == '/' && pos_ + 1 < text_.size() && text_[pos_ + 1] == '/') {
				pos_ += 2;
				while (pos_ < text_.size() && text_[pos_] != '\n') {
					++pos_;
				}
				continue;
			}
			if (c == '/' && pos_ + 1 < text_.size() && text_[pos_ + 1] == '*') {
				pos_ += 2;
				while (pos_ + 1 < text_.size() && !(text_[pos_] == '*' && text_[pos_ + 1] == '/')) {
					++pos_;
				}
				pos_ = (pos_ + 1 < text_.size()) ? pos_ + 2 : text_.size();
				continue;
			}
			break;
		}
	}

	// Reads one token. Returns false at end of input (out stays untouched).
	bool ReadToken(std::string& out) {
		SkipSpace();
		if (pos_ >= text_.size() || text_[pos_] == '}') {
			return false;
		}
		out.clear();
		if (text_[pos_] == '"') {
			++pos_;
			while (pos_ < text_.size()) {
				const char c = text_[pos_++];
				if (c == '\\' && pos_ < text_.size()) {
					const char esc = text_[pos_++];
					switch (esc) {
					case 'n': out.push_back('\n'); break;
					case 'r': out.push_back('\r'); break;
					case 't': out.push_back('\t'); break;
					case '"': out.push_back('"'); break;
					case '\\': out.push_back('\\'); break;
					default:
						out.push_back('\\');
						out.push_back(esc);
						break;
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (c == '"') {
					return true;
				}
				out.push_back(c);
			}
			// Unterminated string: keep what we have, the caller decides.
			failed_ = true;
			return true;
		}
		while (pos_ < text_.size()) {
			const char c = text_[pos_];
			if (std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) || c == '{' || c == '}' || c == '"') {
				break;
			}
			if (c == '/' && pos_ + 1 < text_.size() && (text_[pos_ + 1] == '/' || text_[pos_ + 1] == '*')) {
				break;
			}
			out.push_back(c);
			++pos_;
		}
		return true;
	}

	bool PeekIs(char c) {
		SkipSpace();
		return pos_ < text_.size() && text_[pos_] == c;
	}

	void ParseNodes(KeyValues& parent, bool insideBlock) {
		while (true) {
			SkipSpace();
			if (pos_ >= text_.size()) {
				if (insideBlock) {
					// Missing '}' — accept, Valve is equally forgiving with truncated configs.
					failed_ = true;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (text_[pos_] == '}') {
				if (!insideBlock) {
					failed_ = true;
				}
				++pos_;
				return;
			}

			std::string key;
			if (!ReadToken(key)) {
				return;
			}

			// #base / #include / #define: no file inclusion, just skip the line.
			if (!key.empty() && key[0] == '#') {
				while (pos_ < text_.size() && text_[pos_] != '\n') {
					++pos_;
				}
				continue;
			}

			KeyValues* node = parent.AddSubKey(key);

			// An optional value, then an optional block (KV1 allows both on one key).
			if (!PeekIs('{')) {
				std::string value;
				if (ReadToken(value)) {
					node->SetString({}, value);
				}
			}
			if (PeekIs('{')) {
				++pos_;
				ParseNodes(*node, true);
			}
		}
	}

	std::string_view text_;
	std::size_t pos_ = 0;
	bool ok_ = true;
	bool failed_ = false;
};

} // namespace

// --- KeyValues -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

KeyValues::KeyValues(std::string_view name) : name_(name) {}

KeyValues::~KeyValues() = default;

bool KeyValues::LoadFromFile(std::string_view path) {
	Clear();
	const std::string resolved = ResolvePath(path);
	bool ok = false;
	const std::string content = ReadFile(resolved, &ok);
	if (!ok) {
		return false;
	}
	return LoadFromBuffer(content);
}

bool KeyValues::LoadFromBuffer(std::string_view text) {
	Clear();
	Parser parser(text);
	if (!parser.Parse(*this)) {
		// A malformed file must not leave a half-parsed tree behind: the Pisex loaders check the
		// return value and use defaults, and a partial tree would silently override them.
		Clear();
		return false;
	}

	// KV1 files are "RootName" { ... }: Valve's loader merges that single top-level block into the
	// object it parses into, which is why `KeyValues kv("Config"); kv.LoadFromFile(...);
	// kv.GetString("key")` reads a key *inside* the block. Same here (the root name is kept, it is
	// only used for logging/diagnostics).
	if (children_.size() == 1 && children_.front()->HasChildren()) {
		std::unique_ptr<KeyValues> top = std::move(children_.front());
		children_.clear();
		name_ = top->name_;
		if (top->hasValue_) {
			value_ = top->value_;
			hasValue_ = true;
		}
		children_ = std::move(top->children_);
		for (auto& child : children_) {
			child->parent_ = this;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

bool KeyValues::IsEmpty(std::string_view key) const {
	const KeyValues* found = key.empty() ? this : FindKey(std::string(key).c_str());
	if (!found) {
		return true;
	}
	return !found->HasValue() || found->value_.empty();
}

KeyValues* KeyValues::FindKey(const char* key, bool bCreate) {
	if (!key || !*key) {
		return nullptr;
	}
	for (auto& child : children_) {
		if (EqualNoCase(child->name_, key)) {
			return child.get();
		}
	}
	if (bCreate) {
		return AddSubKey(key);
	}
	return nullptr;
}

const KeyValues* KeyValues::FindKey(const char* key) const {
	return const_cast<KeyValues*>(this)->FindKey(key, false);
}

KeyValues* KeyValues::FindKeyWithValue(const char* key) {
	KeyValues* found = FindKey(key, false);
	return (found && found->HasValue()) ? found : nullptr;
}

std::string_view KeyValues::GetStringValue(const char* key, std::string_view def) const {
	if (!key || !*key) {
		return hasValue_ ? std::string_view(value_) : def;
	}
	const KeyValues* found = FindKey(key);
	if (!found || !found->HasValue()) {
		return def;
	}
	return std::string_view(found->value_);
}

const char* KeyValues::GetString(const char* key, const char* def) const {
	if (!key || !*key) {
		return hasValue_ ? value_.c_str() : def;
	}
	const KeyValues* found = FindKey(key);
	if (!found || !found->HasValue()) {
		return def;
	}
	return found->value_.c_str();
}

int KeyValues::GetInt(const char* key, int def) const {
	const std::string_view text = Trim(GetStringValue(key, {}));
	if (text.empty()) {
		return def;
	}
	int value = 0;
	const auto* begin = text.data();
	const auto* end = text.data() + text.size();
	const auto result = std::from_chars(begin, end, value);
	if (result.ec != std::errc{}) {
		// Valve falls back to atoi semantics ("5 // comment", "1.5", "abc" -> 0/partial).
		return std::atoi(std::string(text).c_str());
	}
	return value;
}

float KeyValues::GetFloat(const char* key, float def) const {
	const std::string_view text = Trim(GetStringValue(key, {}));
	if (text.empty()) {
		return def;
	}
	const std::string copy(text);
	char* end = nullptr;
	const float value = std::strtof(copy.c_str(), &end);
	if (end == copy.c_str()) {
		return def;
	}
	return value;
}

bool KeyValues::GetBool(const char* key, bool def) const {
	const std::string_view text = Trim(GetStringValue(key, {}));
	if (text.empty()) {
		return def;
	}
	if (EqualNoCase(text, "true") || EqualNoCase(text, "yes") || EqualNoCase(text, "on")) {
		return true;
	}
	if (EqualNoCase(text, "false") || EqualNoCase(text, "no") || EqualNoCase(text, "off")) {
		return false;
	}
	return GetInt(key, def ? 1 : 0) != 0;
}

void KeyValues::SetString(std::string_view key, std::string_view value) {
	if (key.empty()) {
		value_.assign(value);
		hasValue_ = true;
		return;
	}
	AddSubKey(key)->SetString({}, value);
}

void KeyValues::SetInt(std::string_view key, int value) {
	SetString(key, std::to_string(value));
}

KeyValues* KeyValues::AddSubKey(std::string_view name) {
	auto child = std::make_unique<KeyValues>(name);
	child->parent_ = this;
	children_.push_back(std::move(child));
	return children_.back().get();
}

KeyValues* KeyValues::GetSubKey(std::size_t index) {
	return index < children_.size() ? children_[index].get() : nullptr;
}

const KeyValues* KeyValues::GetSubKey(std::size_t index) const {
	return index < children_.size() ? children_[index].get() : nullptr;
}

bool KeyValues::IsValueNode() const {
	return hasValue_;
}

bool KeyValues::IsBlockNode() const {
	return !children_.empty();
}

KeyValues* KeyValues::GetFirstSubKey() {
	return children_.empty() ? nullptr : children_.front().get();
}

const KeyValues* KeyValues::GetFirstSubKey() const {
	return children_.empty() ? nullptr : children_.front().get();
}

KeyValues* KeyValues::GetNextKey() {
	if (!parent_) {
		return nullptr;
	}
	bool found = false;
	for (auto& sibling : parent_->children_) {
		if (found) {
			return sibling.get();
		}
		if (sibling.get() == this) {
			found = true;
		}
	}
	return nullptr;
}

const KeyValues* KeyValues::GetNextKey() const {
	return const_cast<KeyValues*>(this)->GetNextKey();
}

KeyValues* KeyValues::GetFirstTrueSubKey() {
	for (auto& child : children_) {
		if (child->IsBlockNode()) {
			return child.get();
		}
	}
	return nullptr;
}

const KeyValues* KeyValues::GetFirstTrueSubKey() const {
	return const_cast<KeyValues*>(this)->GetFirstTrueSubKey();
}

KeyValues* KeyValues::GetNextTrueSubKey() {
	if (!parent_) {
		return nullptr;
	}
	bool found = false;
	for (auto& sibling : parent_->children_) {
		if (found && sibling->IsBlockNode()) {
			return sibling.get();
		}
		if (sibling.get() == this) {
			found = true;
		}
	}
	return nullptr;
}

const KeyValues* KeyValues::GetNextTrueSubKey() const {
	return const_cast<KeyValues*>(this)->GetNextTrueSubKey();
}

KeyValues* KeyValues::GetFirstValue() {
	for (auto& child : children_) {
		if (child->IsValueNode()) {
			return child.get();
		}
	}
	return nullptr;
}

const KeyValues* KeyValues::GetFirstValue() const {
	return const_cast<KeyValues*>(this)->GetFirstValue();
}

KeyValues* KeyValues::GetNextValue() {
	if (!parent_) {
		return nullptr;
	}
	bool found = false;
	for (auto& sibling : parent_->children_) {
		if (found && sibling->IsValueNode()) {
			return sibling.get();
		}
		if (sibling.get() == this) {
			found = true;
		}
	}
	return nullptr;
}

const KeyValues* KeyValues::GetNextValue() const {
	return const_cast<KeyValues*>(this)->GetNextValue();
}

std::vector<KeyValues*> KeyValues::GetSubKeyList() {
	std::vector<KeyValues*> out;
	out.reserve(children_.size());
	for (auto& child : children_) {
		out.push_back(child.get());
	}
	return out;
}

void KeyValues::Clear() {
	children_.clear();
	value_.clear();
	hasValue_ = false;
}
```

`libs/pisexcompat/src/menu.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <pisex/menu.hpp>

#include <pisex/compat.hpp>
#include <pisex/output.hpp>

#include <hudmenu/hudmenu.hpp>
#include <plg/string.hpp>
#include <s2sdk/s2sdk.hpp>

#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <exception>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace pisex {
namespace {

constexpr int kSlots = 64;
// cs2-menus shows five items per chat page.
constexpr int kItemsPerPage = 5;

struct OpenMenu {
	s2sdk::MenuId id = 0;
	std::vector<Items> items; // only the items that were added (ITEM_HIDE dropped)
	MenuCallbackFunc callback;
	std::string title;
};

std::array<OpenMenu, kSlots> g_open;
// True while a menu handler is running: the engine calls handlers with the menu manager's lock
// held, so any menu mutation has to be deferred to ProcessMenuRequests().
bool g_inHandler = false;

struct PendingShow {
	int slot = -1;
	Menu menu;
};
std::vector<PendingShow> g_pendingShow;
std::vector<int> g_pendingClose;
std::vector<s2sdk::MenuId> g_pendingDestroy;

// Default menu type: HUD_LAYOUT, which ResolveS2sdkMenuTypeName() maps to the "hud" Panorama
// backend (plugins/hudmenu) when that is registered and to the WASD "button" type otherwise -
// both are on-screen, dead-player-usable presentations. Without an explicit SetMenuType()
// override the players' own "!menu" choice (hudmenu) takes precedence, see the resolver.
MenuType g_defaultType = MenuType::HUD_LAYOUT;
std::array<MenuType, kSlots> g_slotType = [] {
	std::array<MenuType, kSlots> types{};
	types.fill(MenuType::HUD_LAYOUT); // same as g_defaultType; a value-initialized array would be CHAT (0)
	return types;
}();
// Slots with an explicit SetMenuType(slot, ...) override (the plugin forced the type there).
std::array<bool, kSlots> g_slotForced{};
int g_menuTimeout = 60;

void ClearSlot(int slot) {
	g_open[static_cast<std::size_t>(slot)] = OpenMenu{};
}

void DestroySlotMenu(int slot) {
	OpenMenu& state = g_open[static_cast<std::size_t>(slot)];
	const s2sdk::MenuId id = state.id;
	ClearSlot(slot); // forget it first: the engine's Cancel/End callbacks must not re-enter the plugin
	if (id != 0 && __s2sdk_DestroyMenu) {
		try {
			s2sdk::DestroyMenu(id);
		} catch (...) {
		}
	}
}

// The "hud" backend (plugins/hudmenu) is cs2-menus' HUD_LAYOUT: a Panorama on-screen menu
// driven by mouse clicks, usable while dead. Registered only when the game signatures, the
// CUtlString helpers and the click hook all resolved.
bool IsHudTypeRegistered() {
	if (!__s2sdk_IsMenuTypeRegistered) {
		return false;
	}
	try {
		return s2sdk::IsMenuTypeRegistered("hud");
	} catch (...) {
		return false;
	}
}

// The "wasd" backend (plugins/hudmenu) is cs2-menus' CENTER_WASD: the center-HTML menu with
// the W/S/A/D/E/R controls and Pisex's per-frame refresh. Without it s2sdk's own "button"
// type is the closest equivalent.
bool IsWasdTypeRegistered() {
	if (!__s2sdk_IsMenuTypeRegistered) {
		return false;
	}
	try {
		return s2sdk::IsMenuTypeRegistered("wasd");
	} catch (...) {
		return false;
	}
}

// Maps a Pisex MenuType onto an s2sdk type name (used when no player choice applies).
std::string_view MappedMenuTypeName(MenuType type, bool hudTypeRegistered, bool wasdTypeRegistered) {
	switch (type) {
	case MenuType::CHAT: return "chat";
	case MenuType::CENTER: return "centerhtml";
	// Pisex's CENTER_WASD: the hudmenu "wasd" backend; s2sdk's built-in "button" (a WASD-driven
	// center HTML panel) is the fallback while it is not registered.
	case MenuType::CENTER_WASD: return wasdTypeRegistered ? "wasd" : "button";
	case MenuType::HUD_LAYOUT: return hudTypeRegistered ? "hud" : "button"; // without the backend, WASD is the closest
	}
	return "chat";
}

// The player's own "!menu" choice, asked from the hudmenu plugin. Empty when hudmenu is not
// installed (binding null), the slot has no live client or anything went wrong - the caller
// then falls back to the slot's Pisex MenuType.
std::string PlayerTypeChoice(int slot) {
	if (!__hudmenu_GetClientMenuType) {
		return {};
	}
	try {
		const plg::string answer = hudmenu::GetClientMenuType(slot);
		return std::string(std::string_view(answer));
	} catch (...) {
		return {};
	}
}

// An ids display session ended (Cancel or End) and still has to go to s2sdk::DestroyMenu. s2sdk's
// menus guide is explicit about it (call DestroyMenu(id) from your handler's End case, otherwise
// every menu you display leaks for the lifetime of the plugin) and s2sdk does not do it for us:
// its EndClientMenu() only clears the client state and DestroyMenu() is only ever called by a
// plugin. Without this queue every timed-out / exited / disconnected display leaves its MenuData
// in s2sdk's menu table forever.
void QueueMenuDestroy(s2sdk::MenuId id) {
	if (id == 0) {
		return; // s2sdk's "no menu"
	}
	for (const s2sdk::MenuId queued : g_pendingDestroy) {
		if (queued == id) {
			return; // Cancel and End both report the same session end: destroy it once
		}
	}
	g_pendingDestroy.push_back(id);
}

// True while the id is still a slot's registered menu or still displayed to a client. pisexcompat
// creates one menu per display, but s2sdk menus are shared objects: a menu that another session
// still uses must not be destroyed here - that session's own end queues it again.
bool MenuIdStillUsed(s2sdk::MenuId id) {
	for (const OpenMenu& state : g_open) {
		if (state.id == id) {
			return true;
		}
	}
	if (!IsGameReady() || !__s2sdk_GetClientMenu) {
		return false; // no map: nobody can be displaying it
	}
	for (int slot = 0; slot < kSlots; ++slot) {
		try {
			if (s2sdk::GetClientMenu(slot) == id) {
				return true;
			}
		} catch (...) {
		}
	}
	return false;
}

// Runs outside the menu manager's lock (from ProcessMenuRequests()/CloseAllMenus()), never from a
// handler - s2sdk::DestroyMenu re-enters the menu manager and calls the affected handlers.
// An id that another display session still uses stays queued and is re-checked on a later frame
// (dropping it would leak that menu for good: that session's end is not guaranteed to pass through
// our registry). `force` is for the map end / Shutdown path, where every display is over anyway
// and the plugin must not leave s2sdk menus pointing at its handlers.
void DestroyQueuedMenus(bool force) {
	if (g_pendingDestroy.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	std::vector<s2sdk::MenuId> ids = std::move(g_pendingDestroy);
	g_pendingDestroy.clear();
	if (!__s2sdk_DestroyMenu) {
		return;
	}
	for (const s2sdk::MenuId id : ids) {
		if (!force && MenuIdStillUsed(id)) {
			g_pendingDestroy.push_back(id); // still displayed somewhere: retry next frame
			continue;
		}
		try {
			s2sdk::DestroyMenu(id);
		} catch (...) {
		}
	}
}

// A menu that was created but never registered (an exception between CreateMenu and the registry
// write, or a refused display): nothing tracks it, so it is freed right here - this never runs
// inside a handler, so the direct DestroyMenu is safe.
void DestroyUnregisteredMenu(int slot, s2sdk::MenuId id) {
	ClearSlot(slot);
	if (id != 0 && __s2sdk_DestroyMenu) {
		try {
			s2sdk::DestroyMenu(id);
		} catch (...) {
		}
	}
}

// Called by the engine for Start/Select/Cancel/End. No plugin callback may be called with a
// dangling registry entry, and no exception may escape into the engine.
void MenuHandlerTrampoline(s2sdk::MenuId id, s2sdk::MenuAction action, int32_t slot, int32_t param) {
	// Everything a callback does goes through the deferred queue (see g_inHandler). The flag is
	// saved/restored rather than cleared, so a handler that re-enters (SelectMenuItem on the same
	// menu) does not clear it for the outer one.
	struct HandlerScope {
		bool previous;
		HandlerScope() : previous(g_inHandler) { g_inHandler = true; }
		~HandlerScope() { g_inHandler = previous; }
	} scope;
	try {
		if (slot < 0 || slot >= kSlots) {
			return;
		}
		OpenMenu& state = g_open[static_cast<std::size_t>(slot)];
		if (state.id != id) {
			return; // stale (the plugin already closed/replaced it)
		}

		switch (action) {
		case s2sdk::MenuAction::Select: {
			if (param < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(param) >= state.items.size()) {
				return;
			}
			const Items item = state.items[static_cast<std::size_t>(param)];
			if (item.iType != ITEM_DEFAULT) {
				return;
			}
			// s2sdk digits are 1..7 for the page items; Pisex numbers the five items of a page
			// 1..5. The menu is paginated by kItemsPerPage (see DisplayPlayerMenu), so the page
			// offsets are multiples of it and the digit is the remainder plus one - no s2sdk call
			// is needed here (and none may be made, see g_inHandler).
			const int button = (param % kItemsPerPage) + 1;
			const MenuCallbackFunc callback = state.callback; // copy: the callback may redisplay/close
			if (callback) {
				callback(item.sBack.c_str(), item.sText.c_str(), button, slot);
			}
			break;
		}
		case s2sdk::MenuAction::Cancel: {
			const auto reason = static_cast<s2sdk::MenuCancelReason>(param);
			const MenuCallbackFunc callback = state.callback;
			// The display session is over (End follows it, see the End case); the id has to be
			// destroyed or its MenuData leaks for the process lifetime.
			QueueMenuDestroy(id);
			ClearSlot(slot);
			// Pisex's exit/back values; a timeout or a disconnect just drops the menu.
			if (reason == s2sdk::MenuCancelReason::Exit) {
				if (callback) {
					callback("exit", "exit", 9, slot);
				}
			} else if (reason == s2sdk::MenuCancelReason::ExitBack) {
				if (callback) {
					callback("back", "back", 7, slot);
				}
			}
			break;
		}
		case s2sdk::MenuAction::End:
			// Reached for timeout/disconnect/destroyed (Cancel already ran for the first ones; the
			// queue dedupes). The session is fully closed now: hand the menu to the deferred
			// destroy queue (no s2sdk call may happen here - the handler runs under the menu
			// manager's lock).
			QueueMenuDestroy(id);
			ClearSlot(slot);
			break;
		case s2sdk::MenuAction::Start:
			break;
		}
	} catch (const std::exception& ex) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: menu handler threw: %s", ex.what());
	} catch (...) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: menu handler threw an unknown exception");
	}
}

} // namespace

std::string_view ResolveS2sdkMenuTypeName(bool forced, MenuType type, std::string_view playerTypeChoice,
										  bool hudTypeRegistered, bool wasdTypeRegistered) {
	if (!forced && !playerTypeChoice.empty()) {
		// hudmenu's answer: only the known names are accepted, and "hud"/"wasd" only while the
		// matching backend is really registered (a stale/foreign answer falls through to the
		// mapped type).
		if (playerTypeChoice == "chat" || playerTypeChoice == "centerhtml" || playerTypeChoice == "button") {
			return playerTypeChoice;
		}
		if (playerTypeChoice == "hud") {
			return hudTypeRegistered ? "hud" : "button";
		}
		if (playerTypeChoice == "wasd") {
			return wasdTypeRegistered ? "wasd" : "button";
		}
	}
	return MappedMenuTypeName(type, hudTypeRegistered, wasdTypeRegistered);
}

void AddItemMenu(Menu& hMenu, const char* sBack, const char* sText, int iType) {
	// Deliberately *not* escaped: cs2-menus escaped the item text because its Panorama layout is
	// printf- and XML-formatted, the s2sdk backends take plain text. Porting note: drop the
	// escapeString() calls around item texts, or the client sees "&lt;" and "%%".
	AddRawItemMenu(hMenu, sBack, sText, iType);
}

void AddRawItemMenu(Menu& hMenu, const char* sBack, const char* sText, int iType) {
	if (iType == ITEM_HIDE) {
		return; // Pisex drops hidden items before displaying
	}
	Items item;
	item.iType = iType;
	item.sBack = sBack ? sBack : "";
	item.sText = sText ? sText : "";
	hMenu.hItems.push_back(std::move(item));
}

void SetTitleMenu(Menu& hMenu, const char* szTitle) {
	hMenu.szTitle = szTitle ? szTitle : "";
}

void SetExitMenu(Menu& hMenu, bool bExit) {
	hMenu.bExit = bExit;
}

void SetBackMenu(Menu& hMenu, bool bBack) {
	hMenu.bBack = bBack;
}

void SetCallback(Menu& hMenu, MenuCallbackFunc func) {
	hMenu.hFunc = std::move(func);
}

void SetDescriptionMenu(Menu& hMenu, const char* szDescription) {
	hMenu.szDescription = szDescription ? szDescription : "";
}

void DisplayPlayerMenu(Menu& hMenu, int iSlot, bool bClose) {
	DisplayPlayerMenu(hMenu, iSlot, bClose, true);
}

void DisplayPlayerMenu(Menu& hMenu, int iSlot, bool bClose, bool bReset) {
	(void)bClose;
	(void)bReset;
	if (iSlot < 0 || iSlot >= kSlots) {
		return;
	}
	if (!IsGameReady() || !__s2sdk_CreateMenu || !__s2sdk_AddMenuItem || !__s2sdk_DisplayMenu) {
		// No map (yet) means no client to show it to; the display path would also dereference
		// gpGlobals, which s2sdk only fills in on server start.
		return;
	}
	if (g_inHandler) {
		// Called from a menu callback: queue it (the menu manager's lock is held right now).
		g_pendingShow.push_back(PendingShow{iSlot, hMenu});
		return;
	}
	s2sdk::MenuId id = 0;
	try {
		// Replace whatever this client had open (Pisex's bClose/bReset pair behaved the same way
		// for a fresh menu).
		DestroySlotMenu(iSlot);

		// An explicit SetMenuType() override wins; otherwise the player's own choice from
		// hudmenu (no-op when the plugin is not installed). See ResolveS2sdkMenuTypeName.
		const bool forced = g_slotForced[static_cast<std::size_t>(iSlot)];
		const std::string playerChoice = forced ? std::string() : PlayerTypeChoice(iSlot);
		const std::string_view typeName =
			ResolveS2sdkMenuTypeName(forced, g_slotType[static_cast<std::size_t>(iSlot)], playerChoice,
									 IsHudTypeRegistered(), IsWasdTypeRegistered());
		id = s2sdk::CreateMenu(plg::string(hMenu.szTitle), &MenuHandlerTrampoline,
							   plg::string(typeName));
		if (id == 0) {
			ErrorLog("pisexcompat: s2sdk refused to create the menu for slot %d", iSlot);
			return;
		}

		OpenMenu state;
		state.id = id;
		state.callback = hMenu.hFunc;
		state.title = hMenu.szTitle;

		for (const Items& item : hMenu.hItems) {
			const s2sdk::MenuItemStyle style =
				item.iType == ITEM_DISABLED ? s2sdk::MenuItemStyle::Disabled : s2sdk::MenuItemStyle::Default;
			s2sdk::AddMenuItem(id, plg::string(item.sBack), plg::string(item.sText), style);
			state.items.push_back(item); // index-aligned with the s2sdk item list
		}

		if (__s2sdk_SetMenuPagination) {
			s2sdk::SetMenuPagination(id, kItemsPerPage); // chat pages of 5, like cs2-menus
		}
		if (__s2sdk_SetMenuExitButton) {
			s2sdk::SetMenuExitButton(id, hMenu.bExit);
		}
		if (__s2sdk_SetMenuExitBackButton) {
			s2sdk::SetMenuExitBackButton(id, hMenu.bBack);
		}
		if (__s2sdk_SetMenuCloseOnSelect) {
			// Pisex keeps the menu open after a selection; the callback decides what happens next.
			s2sdk::SetMenuCloseOnSelect(id, false);
		}

		g_open[static_cast<std::size_t>(iSlot)] = std::move(state);

		if (!s2sdk::DisplayMenu(id, iSlot, g_menuTimeout)) {
			ErrorLog("pisexcompat: s2sdk could not display the menu on slot %d", iSlot);
			DestroyUnregisteredMenu(iSlot, id);
		}
	} catch (const std::exception& ex) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: DisplayPlayerMenu failed: %s", ex.what());
		// The menu may already exist (an exception after CreateMenu): it is not registered, so
		// nothing else would ever destroy it.
		DestroyUnregisteredMenu(iSlot, id);
	} catch (...) {
		ErrorLog("pisexcompat: DisplayPlayerMenu failed with an unknown exception");
		DestroyUnregisteredMenu(iSlot, id);
	}
}

void ClosePlayerMenu(int iSlot) {
	if (iSlot < 0 || iSlot >= kSlots) {
		return;
	}
	if (g_inHandler) {
		g_pendingClose.push_back(iSlot); // see DisplayPlayerMenu
		return;
	}
	const bool wasOpen = g_open[static_cast<std::size_t>(iSlot)].id != 0;
	DestroySlotMenu(iSlot);
	if (wasOpen && __s2sdk_CancelClientMenu) {
		try {
			s2sdk::CancelClientMenu(iSlot, s2sdk::MenuCancelReason::Exit);
		} catch (...) {
		}
	}
}

void CloseAllMenus() {
	g_pendingShow.clear();
	g_pendingClose.clear();
	if (IsGameReady()) {
		for (int slot = 0; slot < kSlots; ++slot) {
			if (g_open[static_cast<std::size_t>(slot)].id != 0) {
				DestroySlotMenu(slot);
			}
		}
	} else {
		// Map end: no client/entity call may happen from here. DestroyMenu() is only safe for a
		// menu nobody displays - it cancels a viewer through the menu type backend (PrintHtmlCentre,
		// hudmenu's HideForSlot), all of which reach the client layer that is being torn down.
		// Ending the session first with the Disconnect reason is s2sdk's own teardown for a client
		// that is gone: it skips the backend close, clears the manager's state and runs our handler,
		// which only queues the destroy - the drain below then frees the menu with no viewer left.
		for (int slot = 0; slot < kSlots; ++slot) {
			const s2sdk::MenuId id = g_open[static_cast<std::size_t>(slot)].id;
			if (id == 0) {
				continue;
			}
			if (__s2sdk_GetClientMenu && s2sdk::GetClientMenu(slot) == id) {
				if (__s2sdk_CancelClientMenu) {
					try {
						s2sdk::CancelClientMenu(slot, s2sdk::MenuCancelReason::Disconnect);
					} catch (...) {
					}
				}
			} else {
				QueueMenuDestroy(id); // nobody displays it: destroyed below without a backend call
			}
			ClearSlot(slot); // in case the handler did not run (id no longer in the manager)
		}
	}
	// Menus whose display already ended but whose destroy is still queued (map end / Shutdown):
	// without this they would sit in s2sdk's m_menuInsts until the process exits. Forced: the
	// plugin is going away, so nothing may be left pointing at its handlers.
	DestroyQueuedMenus(true);
}

void ProcessMenuRequests() {
	if (g_pendingShow.empty() && g_pendingClose.empty() && g_pendingDestroy.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	// A callback may have queued another request while these are applied, so take a snapshot and
	// keep the rest for the next frame.
	std::vector<PendingShow> shows = std::move(g_pendingShow);
	g_pendingShow.clear();
	std::vector<int> closes = std::move(g_pendingClose);
	g_pendingClose.clear();

	for (const int slot : closes) {
		ClosePlayerMenu(slot); // no longer inside a handler, so it runs immediately
	}
	for (const PendingShow& show : shows) {
		Menu menu = show.menu; // DisplayPlayerMenu may queue another show for the same slot
		DisplayPlayerMenu(menu, show.slot);
	}
	// Sessions that ended since the last frame (timeout, exit, disconnect, End): destroy them
	// here, outside the menu manager's lock and after the replacements above.
	DestroyQueuedMenus(false);
}

bool IsMenuOpen(int iSlot) {
	if (iSlot < 0 || iSlot >= kSlots) {
		return false;
	}
	const s2sdk::MenuId id = g_open[static_cast<std::size_t>(iSlot)].id;
	if (id == 0 || !__s2sdk_GetClientMenu) {
		return false;
	}
	try {
		return s2sdk::GetClientMenu(iSlot) == id;
	} catch (...) {
		return false;
	}
}

std::string escapeString(const std::string& input) {
	std::string escaped;
	escaped.reserve(input.size());
	for (const char c : input) {
		switch (c) {
		case '\\': escaped += "\\\\"; break;
		case '"': escaped += "\\\""; break;
		case '\n': escaped += "\\n"; break;
		case '\r': escaped += "\\r"; break;
		case '\t': escaped += "\\t"; break;
		case '<': escaped += "&lt;"; break;
		case '>': escaped += "&gt;"; break;
		case '%': escaped += "%%"; break;
		default: escaped += c; break;
		}
	}
	return escaped;
}

MenuType GetMenuType(int iSlot) {
	if (iSlot < 0 || iSlot >= kSlots) {
		return g_defaultType;
	}
	return g_slotType[static_cast<std::size_t>(iSlot)];
}

void SetMenuType(int iSlot, MenuType type) {
	if (iSlot < 0 || iSlot >= kSlots) {
		return;
	}
	g_slotType[static_cast<std::size_t>(iSlot)] = type;
	g_slotForced[static_cast<std::size_t>(iSlot)] = true; // explicit override: beats the player's choice
}

void SetDefaultMenuType(MenuType type) {
	g_defaultType = type;
	for (MenuType& slotType : g_slotType) {
		slotType = type;
	}
	g_slotForced.fill(false); // the Pisex original replaced the whole table; overrides reset with it
}

bool IsMenuTypeForced(int iSlot) {
	if (iSlot < 0 || iSlot >= kSlots) {
		return false;
	}
	return g_slotForced[static_cast<std::size_t>(iSlot)];
}

void SetMenuTimeout(int seconds) {
	g_menuTimeout = seconds;
}

int MenuTimeout() {
	return g_menuTimeout;
}

// s2sdk's MenuManager starts ids at 0 but also uses 0 for "no menu" (ClientMenuState::id{}), so
// the first menu created in the process could never be shown/tracked. Create and keep one dummy
// menu if we got id 0 (cheap; done once per process by whichever plugin runs first).
void BurnMenuIdZero() {
	if (!__s2sdk_CreateMenu) {
		return;
	}
	try {
		const s2sdk::MenuId id = s2sdk::CreateMenu(plg::string("pisexcompat:reserved-id-0"), &MenuHandlerTrampoline,
												   plg::string("chat"));
		if (id != 0 && __s2sdk_DestroyMenu) {
			s2sdk::DestroyMenu(id); // id 0 was already taken elsewhere: nothing to keep
		}
	} catch (...) {
	}
}

} // namespace pisex
```

```cpp
#include <pisex/output.hpp>

#include <pisex/compat.hpp>
#include <pisex/paths.hpp>
#include <pisex/phrases.hpp>

#include <plg/plugin.hpp>
#include <s2sdk/s2sdk.hpp>

#include <array>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <ctime>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace pisex {
namespace {

// Pisex formats into char[512]; the admin core occasionally appends a player name and a reason,
// so a little headroom avoids silent truncation. Anything longer is cut here, never in the engine.
constexpr std::size_t kBufferSize = 2048;

bool ValidSlot(int slot) {
	return slot >= 0 && slot < 64;
}

// s2sdk print helpers touch client state, which only exists with a running map.
bool CanPrint() {
	return IsGameReady();
}

std::string Timestamp(const char* format) {
	const std::time_t now = std::time(nullptr);
	std::tm tm{};
	localtime_r(&now, &tm);
	char buffer[64] = {};
	std::strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), format, &tm);
	return std::string(buffer);
}

void AppendLogFile(const std::string& file, const std::string& line) {
	const std::string dir = plg::GetLogsDir ? std::string(plg::GetLogsDir()) : std::string();
	if (dir.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	std::ofstream out(JoinPath(dir, file), std::ios::app);
	if (out) {
		out << line;
	}
}

} // namespace

std::string FormatString(const char* format, ...) {
	std::array<char, kBufferSize> buffer{};
	va_list args;
	va_start(args, format);
	const int written = std::vsnprintf(buffer.data(), buffer.size(), format ? format : "", args);
	va_end(args);
	if (written <= 0) {
		return {};
	}
	return std::string(buffer.data(), static_cast<std::size_t>(written) < buffer.size() - 1
										  ? static_cast<std::size_t>(written)
										  : buffer.size() - 1);
}

	} catch (...) {
	}
}

void PrintToConsole(int iSlot, const char* format, ...) {
	std::array<char, kBufferSize> buffer{};

	va_start(args, format);
	std::vsnprintf(buffer.data(), buffer.size(), format ? format : "", args);
	va_end(args);

	if (!ValidSlot(iSlot)) {
		// Pisex: an out-of-range slot means "server console" (META_CONPRINT). Chat colour tags
		// in a phrase mean nothing there and were printed literally ("{LIGHTRED}mm_kick").

		}
		return;
	}

		return;
	}
	try {
		s2sdk::PrintToConsole(iSlot, plg::string(buffer.data()));
	} catch (...) {
	}

void PrintToAlert(int iSlot, const char* format, ...) {
	std::array<char, kBufferSize> buffer{};
	va_list args;
	va_start(args, format);
	std::vsnprintf(buffer.data(), buffer.size(), format ? format : "", args);
	va_end(args);
	if (!CanPrint() || !ValidSlot(iSlot) || !__s2sdk_PrintAlertText) {
		return;
	}
	try {
		s2sdk::PrintAlertText(iSlot, plg::string(buffer.data()));
	} catch (...) {
	}
}

void PrintToAlertAll(const char* format, ...) {
	std::array<char, kBufferSize> buffer{};
	va_list args;
	va_start(args, format);
	std::vsnprintf(buffer.data(), buffer.size(), format ? format : "", args);
	va_end(args);
	if (!CanPrint() || !__s2sdk_PrintAlertTextAll) {
		return;
	}
	try {
		s2sdk::PrintAlertTextAll(plg::string(buffer.data()));
	} catch (...) {
	}
}

void LogToFile(const char* file, const char* format, ...) {
	std::array<char, kBufferSize> buffer{};
	va_list args;
	va_start(args, format);
	std::vsnprintf(buffer.data(), buffer.size(), format ? format : "", args);
	va_end(args);

	const std::string line = "L " + Timestamp("%m/%d/%Y - %H:%M:%S") + ": " + buffer.data();
	if (plg::Log) {
		plg::Log(std::string_view(line), plg::Severity::Info, plg::source_location::current());
	}
	const std::string name = std::string(file ? file : "log") + ".txt";
	AppendLogFile(name, line + "\n");
}

void ErrorLog(const char* format, ...) {
	std::array<char, kBufferSize> buffer{};
	va_list args;
	va_start(args, format);
	std::vsnprintf(buffer.data(), buffer.size(), format ? format : "", args);
	va_end(args);

	const std::string message = std::string("[Error] ") + buffer.data();
	if (plg::Log) {
		plg::Log(std::string_view(message), plg::Severity::Error, plg::source_location::current());
	}
	const std::string line = "L " + Timestamp("%m/%d/%Y - %H:%M:%S") + ": " + buffer.data();
	AppendLogFile(Timestamp("error_%m-%d-%Y") + ".txt", line + "\n");
}

} // namespace pisex
```
