`plugins/admin_system/include/admin_api.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
// Consumer-side wrapper for the admin_system plugin API.
//
// The generated headers (admin_system/admin_system.hpp and friends, produced by
// bin/plugify-gen from admin_system.pplugin) expose the raw boundary: plain C function
// pointers, plg::string / plg::vector<plg::string> values and no captures. This header
// restores the shape the Pisex modules were written against:
//
//   * std::function callbacks with captures (the IAdminApi typedefs), dispatched from static
//     trampolines that are keyed by category/identity (menu callbacks) or per plugin (events,
//     which the original keyed by PluginId - one listener per plugin, re-registering replaces);
//   * std::string / std::vector<std::string> instead of plg types;
//   * the default arguments of the original (adminID = -1, notify = true, ...);
//   * const char* returns that stay valid as long as the original's did.
//
// Porting a module is then mostly mechanical: keep `g_pAdminApi` and make it point at
// admin_system::AdminApi::Get(), drop the SourceMM::PluginId argument of the Register calls,
// everything else compiles as it did before.
//
//   #include <admin_api.hpp>                       // -I plugins/admin_system/include
//   #include <admin_system/admin_system.hpp>       // -I .../include/external/plugify/include
//
//   admin_system::AdminApi* g_pAdminApi = &admin_system::AdminApi::Get();
//
//   g_pAdminApi->RegisterItem("ban", "Item_Ban", "players", "@admin/ban", nullptr, OnItemSelect);
//   if (g_pAdminApi->HasPermission(iSlot, "@admin/ban")) { ... }
//
// Lifetime notes:
//   * GetTranslation()/GetAdminName()/GetPlayerPunishmentReason() return pointers into a cache
//     owned by this plugin, exactly like the g_vecPhrases / g_pAdmins maps of the original:
//     valid until the same key is queried again (translation pointers survive a config reload,
//     because the original's did not either).
//   * The category/identity pointers handed to the menu callbacks point into the registration
//     map and stay valid until the same item/category is registered again - the original
//     handed out its Item::szIdentity the same way.
//   * Every trampoline swallows exceptions (the boundary must not unwind into the engine) and
//     logs them through plg::Log.

#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

#include <admin_system/admin_system.hpp>

#if defined(__has_include)
#	if __has_include(<plgdb/db.hpp>)
#		include <plgdb/db.hpp>
#		define ADMIN_SYSTEM_API_HAS_PLGDB 1
#	endif
#endif

namespace admin_system {

// --- punishment types (the RT_* macros of the original admin.h) ---------------
inline constexpr int32_t RT_BAN = 0;
inline constexpr int32_t RT_MUTE = 1;
inline constexpr int32_t RT_GAG = 2;
inline constexpr int32_t RT_SILENCE = 3;
inline constexpr int32_t kPunishmentTypes = 4;

// --- callback types (IAdminApi typedefs, captured std::function) --------------
using OnCategoryDisplayCallback = std::function<void(int iSlot, const char* szIdentity, std::string& szCategory)>;
using OnItemDisplayCallback = std::function<void(int iSlot, const char* szCategory, const char* szIdentity, std::string& szItem)>;
using OnItemSelectCallback = std::function<void(int iSlot, const char* szCategory, const char* szIdentity, const char* szItem)>;
using OnAdminConnectedCallback = std::function<void(int iSlot)>;
using OnPlayerPunishCallback = std::function<void(int iSlot, int iType, int iTime, const char* szReason, int iAdminID)>;
using OnOfflinePlayerPunishCallback = std::function<void(const char* szSteamID64, const char* szName, int iType, int iTime, const char* szReason, int iAdminID)>;
using OnPlayerUnpunishCallback = std::function<void(int iSlot, int iType, int iAdminID)>;
using OnOfflinePlayerUnpunishCallback = std::function<void(const char* szSteamID64, int iType, int iAdminID)>;
using OnCoreLoadedCallback = std::function<void()>;
using OnCategoryRegisterCallback = std::function<void(const char* szCategory)>;
using OnActionCallback = std::function<void(int iSlot, const char* szAction, const char* szParam)>;
using OnPlayerPunishPreCallback = std::function<bool(int iSlot, int iType, int iTime, const char* szReason, int iAdminID)>;
using OnOfflinePlayerPunishPreCallback = std::function<bool(const char* szSteamID64, const char* szName, int iType, int iTime, const char* szReason, int iAdminID)>;

// --- database settings --------------------------------------------------------
// The values the original handed out through GetMySQLConnection(), plus the prefix: a module
// that used to run its own queries (CheckCheats writes checkcheats_stats) opens its own plgdb
// connection with these and never touches the core's one.
struct DatabaseConfig {
	std::string driver = "mysql";      // "mysql" or "sqlite"
	std::string host = "127.0.0.1";    // sqlite: path of the database file
	uint16_t port = 3306;
	std::string user;
	std::string password;
	std::string database;
	std::string prefix = "as_";

	bool IsSqlite() const noexcept { return driver == "sqlite"; }
};

namespace detail {

inline std::string ToStd(const plg::string& value) {
	return std::string(std::string_view(value));
}

inline plg::string ToPlg(const std::string& value) {
	return plg::string(std::string_view(value));
}

// One non-empty plg::Log call; the consumer may run with logging disabled.
inline void LogError(std::string_view message) {
	if (plg::Log) {
		plg::Log(message, plg::Severity::Error, plg::source_location::current());
	}
}

// True when the plugify module filled in the binding slots, i.e. when admin_system is loaded.
inline bool Available() {
	return __admin_system_GetPluginVersion != nullptr;
}

struct ItemCallbacks {
	std::string name;          // phrase key, handed out as the 4th argument of the select callback
	OnItemDisplayCallback display;
	OnItemSelectCallback select;
};

// Everything this plugin registered, plus the string caches that back the const char*
// returns. One instance per plugin (the header is included by exactly one translation unit
// of each module, but the accessor is a function-local static so several TUs share it).
struct State {
	std::map<std::string, OnCategoryDisplayCallback, std::less<>> categories;
	std::map<std::pair<std::string, std::string>, ItemCallbacks> items;

	OnAdminConnectedCallback adminConnected;
	OnCoreLoadedCallback coreLoaded;
	OnCategoryRegisterCallback categoryRegister;
	OnActionCallback action;
	OnPlayerPunishCallback playerPunish;
	OnOfflinePlayerPunishCallback offlinePlayerPunish;
	OnPlayerUnpunishCallback playerUnpunish;
	OnOfflinePlayerUnpunishCallback offlinePlayerUnpunish;
	OnPlayerPunishPreCallback playerPunishPre;
	OnOfflinePlayerPunishPreCallback offlinePlayerPunishPre;

	// Stable addresses: node based containers, so a returned c_str() survives later queries.
	std::map<std::string, std::string, std::less<>> translations;
	std::vector<std::string> names;   // index slot + 1, [0] is the console
	std::vector<std::string> groups;  // index slot
	std::vector<std::string> reasons; // index slot * 4 + type

	State() : names(65), groups(64), reasons(64 * kPunishmentTypes) {}
};

inline State& S() {
	static State state;
	return state;
}

// --- trampolines ---------------------------------------------------------------
// All of them are plain function pointers, so they can be handed to the admin_system plugin;
// the captures live in State. Exceptions never cross the boundary.

inline void CategoryDisplayTrampoline(int32_t slot, const plg::string& identity, plg::string& name) {
	try {
		State& state = S();
		const auto it = state.categories.find(ToStd(identity));
		if (it == state.categories.end() || !it->second) {
			return;
		}
		std::string label = ToStd(name);
		it->second(slot, it->first.c_str(), label);
		name = ToPlg(label);
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: category display callback threw");
	}
}

inline void ItemDisplayTrampoline(int32_t slot, const plg::string& category, const plg::string& identity, plg::string& name) {
	try {
		State& state = S();
		const auto it = state.items.find({ToStd(category), ToStd(identity)});
		if (it == state.items.end() || !it->second.display) {
			return;
		}
		std::string label = ToStd(name);
		it->second.display(slot, it->first.first.c_str(), it->first.second.c_str(), label);
		name = ToPlg(label);
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: item display callback threw");
	}
}

inline void ItemSelectTrampoline(int32_t slot, const plg::string& category, const plg::string& identity, const plg::string& name) {
	try {
		State& state = S();
		const auto it = state.items.find({ToStd(category), ToStd(identity)});
		if (it == state.items.end() || !it->second.select) {
			return;
		}
		it->second.select(slot, it->first.first.c_str(), it->first.second.c_str(), it->second.name.c_str());
		(void)name;
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: item select callback threw");
	}
}

inline void AdminConnectedTrampoline(int32_t slot) {
	try {
		if (const auto& callback = S().adminConnected) {
			callback(slot);
		}
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: OnAdminConnected callback threw");
	}
}

inline void CoreLoadedTrampoline() {
	try {
		if (const auto& callback = S().coreLoaded) {
			callback();
		}
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: OnCoreLoaded callback threw");
	}
}

inline void CategoryRegisterTrampoline(const plg::string& identity) {
	try {
		State& state = S();
		// The identity comes from the registering plugin, not from our map, so it is copied
		// into a local that lives for the call (the original passed Category::szIdentity).
		const std::string copy = ToStd(identity);
		if (const auto& callback = state.categoryRegister) {
			callback(copy.c_str());
		}
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: OnCategoryRegister callback threw");
	}
}

inline void ActionTrampoline(int32_t slot, const plg::string& action, const plg::string& param) {
	try {
		State& state = S();
		const std::string actionCopy = ToStd(action);
		const std::string paramCopy = ToStd(param);
		if (const auto& callback = state.action) {
			callback(slot, actionCopy.c_str(), paramCopy.c_str());
		}
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: OnAction callback threw");
	}
}

inline void PlayerPunishTrampoline(int32_t slot, int32_t type, int32_t time, const plg::string& reason, int32_t adminID) {
	try {
		State& state = S();
		const std::string reasonCopy = ToStd(reason);
		if (const auto& callback = state.playerPunish) {
			callback(slot, type, time, reasonCopy.c_str(), adminID);
		}
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: OnPlayerPunish callback threw");
	}
}

inline void OfflinePlayerPunishTrampoline(const plg::string& steamid64, const plg::string& name, int32_t type, int32_t time,
										  const plg::string& reason, int32_t adminID) {
	try {
		State& state = S();
		const std::string steamidCopy = ToStd(steamid64);
		const std::string nameCopy = ToStd(name);
		const std::string reasonCopy = ToStd(reason);
		if (const auto& callback = state.offlinePlayerPunish) {
			callback(steamidCopy.c_str(), nameCopy.c_str(), type, time, reasonCopy.c_str(), adminID);
		}
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: OnOfflinePlayerPunish callback threw");
	}
}

inline void PlayerUnpunishTrampoline(int32_t slot, int32_t type, int32_t adminID) {
	try {
		if (const auto& callback = S().playerUnpunish) {
			callback(slot, type, adminID);
		}
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: OnPlayerUnpunish callback threw");
	}
}

inline void OfflinePlayerUnpunishTrampoline(const plg::string& steamid64, int32_t type, int32_t adminID) {
	try {
		State& state = S();
		const std::string steamidCopy = ToStd(steamid64);
		if (const auto& callback = state.offlinePlayerUnpunish) {
			callback(steamidCopy.c_str(), type, adminID);
		}
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: OnOfflinePlayerUnpunish callback threw");
	}
}

inline bool PlayerPunishPreTrampoline(int32_t slot, int32_t type, int32_t time, const plg::string& reason, int32_t adminID) {
	try {
		State& state = S();
		if (!state.playerPunishPre) {
			return false;
		}
		const std::string reasonCopy = ToStd(reason);
		return state.playerPunishPre(slot, type, time, reasonCopy.c_str(), adminID);
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: OnPlayerPunishPre callback threw");
		return false;
	}
}

inline bool OfflinePlayerPunishPreTrampoline(const plg::string& steamid64, const plg::string& name, int32_t type, int32_t time,
											 const plg::string& reason, int32_t adminID) {
	try {
		State& state = S();
		if (!state.offlinePlayerPunishPre) {
			return false;
		}
		const std::string steamidCopy = ToStd(steamid64);
		const std::string nameCopy = ToStd(name);
		const std::string reasonCopy = ToStd(reason);
		return state.offlinePlayerPunishPre(steamidCopy.c_str(), nameCopy.c_str(), type, time, reasonCopy.c_str(), adminID);
	} catch (...) {
		LogError("admin_system: OnOfflinePlayerPunishPre callback threw");
		return false;
	}
}

inline std::vector<std::string> ToStdVector(const plg::vector<plg::string>& values) {
	std::vector<std::string> result;
	result.reserve(values.size());
	for (const plg::string& value : values) {
		result.push_back(ToStd(value));
	}
	return result;
}

} // namespace detail

// --- the API -------------------------------------------------------------------
// One instance per plugin; methods mirror IAdminApi one to one (same names, same argument
// order, same defaults), so ported modules only have to change the type of g_pAdminApi.
class AdminApi {
public:
	static AdminApi& Get() {
		static AdminApi api;
		return api;
	}

	AdminApi(const AdminApi&) = delete;
	AdminApi& operator=(const AdminApi&) = delete;

	// --- core ------------------------------------------------------------------
	float GetPluginVersion() const { return detail::Available() ? ::admin_system::GetPluginVersion() : 0.0f; }
	int GetMessageType() const { return detail::Available() ? static_cast<int>(::admin_system::GetMessageType()) : 0; }
	bool IsCoreLoaded() const { return detail::Available() && ::admin_system::IsCoreLoaded(); }
	int GetImmunityType() const { return detail::Available() ? static_cast<int>(::admin_system::GetImmunityType()) : 0; }

	// Translated phrase, cached per key; the key itself when it is missing (like the
	// g_vecPhrases lookup of the original).
	const char* GetTranslation(const char* key) {
		if (!key || !*key) {
			return "";
		}
		detail::State& state = detail::S();
		const auto it = state.translations.find(key);
		if (it != state.translations.end()) {
			return it->second.c_str();
		}
		std::string translated = key;
		if (detail::Available()) {
			translated = detail::ToStd(::admin_system::GetTranslation(detail::ToPlg(key)));
		}
		return state.translations.emplace(key, std::move(translated)).first->second.c_str();
	}

	// Drops the phrase cache (the original reloaded g_vecPhrases on mm_as_reload_config).
	void ReloadTranslations() { detail::S().translations.clear(); }

	DatabaseConfig GetDatabaseConfig() const {
		DatabaseConfig config;
		if (!detail::Available()) {
			return config;
		}
		const plg::vector<plg::string> raw = ::admin_system::GetDatabaseConfig();
		auto at = [&raw](size_t index) -> std::string {
			return index < raw.size() ? detail::ToStd(raw[index]) : std::string();
		};
		if (const std::string driver = at(0); !driver.empty()) {
			config.driver = driver;
		}
		if (const std::string host = at(1); !host.empty()) {
			config.host = host;
		}
		if (const std::string port = at(2); !port.empty()) {
			try {
				const int value = std::stoi(port);
				if (value > 0 && value < 65536) {
					config.port = static_cast<uint16_t>(value);
				}
			} catch (const std::exception&) {
				// keep the default port
			}
		}
		config.user = at(3);
		config.password = at(4);
		if (const std::string database = at(5); !database.empty()) {
			config.database = database;
		}
		if (const std::string prefix = at(6); !prefix.empty()) {
			config.prefix = prefix;
		}
		return config;
	}

	// --- menu registration -------------------------------------------------------
	// Pisex fired every OnCategoryRegister listener before inserting the category; the core
	// does the same, so a module may react to its own registration.
	void RegisterCategory(const char* identity, const char* name, OnCategoryDisplayCallback callback) {
		if (!identity || !detail::Available()) {
			return;
		}
		detail::S().categories[identity] = std::move(callback);
		::admin_system::RegisterCategory(detail::ToPlg(identity), detail::ToPlg(name ? name : ""), &detail::CategoryDisplayTrampoline);
	}

	// flags is a '|' separated permission list; an empty string leaves the item for '@admin/root'.
	void RegisterItem(const char* identity, const char* name, const char* category, const char* flags,
					  OnItemDisplayCallback callbackDisplay, OnItemSelectCallback callbackSelect) {
		if (!identity || !category || !detail::Available()) {
			return;
		}
		detail::ItemCallbacks callbacks;
		callbacks.name = name ? name : "";
		callbacks.display = std::move(callbackDisplay);
		callbacks.select = std::move(callbackSelect);
		detail::S().items[std::make_pair(std::string(category), std::string(identity))] = std::move(callbacks);
		::admin_system::RegisterItem(detail::ToPlg(identity), detail::ToPlg(name ? name : ""), detail::ToPlg(category),
									 detail::ToPlg(flags ? flags : ""), &detail::ItemDisplayTrampoline, &detail::ItemSelectTrampoline);
	}

	// --- admins -------------------------------------------------------------------
	bool HasPermission(int iSlot, const char* szPermission) const {
		return detail::Available() && szPermission && ::admin_system::HasPermission(iSlot, detail::ToPlg(szPermission));
	}

	bool HasFlag(int iSlot, const char* szFlag) const {
		return detail::Available() && szFlag && ::admin_system::HasFlag(iSlot, detail::ToPlg(szFlag));
	}

	bool IsAdmin(int iSlot) const { return detail::Available() && ::admin_system::IsAdmin(iSlot); }

	const char* GetFlagName(const char* szFlag) {
		if (!szFlag || !*szFlag) {
			return "";
		}
		detail::State& state = detail::S();
		const std::string key = std::string("flag:") + szFlag; // own namespace inside the cache
		const auto it = state.translations.find(key);
		if (it != state.translations.end()) {
			return it->second.c_str();
		}
		std::string name;
		if (detail::Available()) {
			name = detail::ToStd(::admin_system::GetFlagName(detail::ToPlg(szFlag)));
		}
		return state.translations.emplace(key, std::move(name)).first->second.c_str();
	}

	std::vector<std::string> GetPermissionsByFlag(const char* szFlag) const {
		if (!detail::Available() || !szFlag) {
			return {};
		}
		return detail::ToStdVector(::admin_system::GetPermissionsByFlag(detail::ToPlg(szFlag)));
	}

	std::vector<std::string> GetAdminFlags(int iSlot) const {
		if (!detail::Available()) {
			return {};
		}
		return detail::ToStdVector(::admin_system::GetAdminFlags(iSlot));
	}

	std::vector<std::string> GetAdminPermissions(int iSlot) const {
		if (!detail::Available()) {
			return {};
		}
		return detail::ToStdVector(::admin_system::GetAdminPermissions(iSlot));
	}

	int GetAdminImmunity(int iSlot) const {
		return detail::Available() ? static_cast<int>(::admin_system::GetAdminImmunity(iSlot)) : 0;
	}

	int64_t GetAdminExpireTime(int iSlot) const {
		return detail::Available() ? ::admin_system::GetAdminExpireTime(iSlot) : -1;
	}

	int GetAdminGroupID(int iSlot) const {
		return detail::Available() ? static_cast<int>(::admin_system::GetAdminGroupID(iSlot)) : -1;
	}

	// Name cached per slot (index 0 is the console, like the original's g_pAdmins[slot].szName).
	const char* GetAdminName(int iSlot) {
		detail::State& state = detail::S();
		if (iSlot < -1 || iSlot >= 64) {
			return "";
		}
		std::string name;
		if (detail::Available()) {
			name = detail::ToStd(::admin_system::GetAdminName(iSlot));
		}
		std::string& slot = state.names[static_cast<size_t>(iSlot + 1)];
		slot = std::move(name);
		return slot.c_str();
	}

	const char* GetAdminGroupName(int iSlot) {
		detail::State& state = detail::S();
		if (iSlot < 0 || iSlot >= 64) {
			return "";
		}
		std::string name;
		if (detail::Available()) {
			name = detail::ToStd(::admin_system::GetAdminGroupName(iSlot));
		}
		std::string& slot = state.groups[static_cast<size_t>(iSlot)];
		slot = std::move(name);
		return slot.c_str();
	}

	void AddPlayerAdmin(const char* szName, const char* szSteamID64, const char* szFlags, int iImmunity = 0,
						int iExpireTime = 0, int iGroupID = 0, const char* szComment = "", bool bDB = true) const {
		if (!detail::Available() || !szSteamID64) {
			return;
		}
		::admin_system::AddPlayerAdmin(detail::ToPlg(szName ? szName : ""), detail::ToPlg(szSteamID64),
									   detail::ToPlg(szFlags ? szFlags : ""), iImmunity, iExpireTime, iGroupID,
									   detail::ToPlg(szComment ? szComment : ""), bDB);
	}

	void RemovePlayerAdmin(const char* szSteamID64, bool bDB = true) const {
		if (!detail::Available() || !szSteamID64) {
			return;
		}
		::admin_system::RemovePlayerAdmin(detail::ToPlg(szSteamID64), bDB);
	}

	void AddPlayerLocalFlag(int iSlot, const char* szFlag) const {
		if (detail::Available() && szFlag) {
			::admin_system::AddPlayerLocalFlag(iSlot, detail::ToPlg(szFlag));
		}
	}

	void RemovePlayerLocalFlag(int iSlot, const char* szFlag) const {
		if (detail::Available() && szFlag) {
			::admin_system::RemovePlayerLocalFlag(iSlot, detail::ToPlg(szFlag));
		}
	}

	void AddPlayerLocalPermission(int iSlot, const char* szPermission) const {
		if (detail::Available() && szPermission) {
			::admin_system::AddPlayerLocalPermission(iSlot, detail::ToPlg(szPermission));
		}
	}

	void RemovePlayerLocalPermission(int iSlot, const char* szPermission) const {
		if (detail::Available() && szPermission) {
			::admin_system::RemovePlayerLocalPermission(iSlot, detail::ToPlg(szPermission));
		}
	}

	void AddPlayerLocalImmunity(int iSlot, int iImmunity) const {
		if (detail::Available()) {
			::admin_system::AddPlayerLocalImmunity(iSlot, iImmunity);
		}
	}

	void RemovePlayerLocalImmunity(int iSlot) const {
		if (detail::Available()) {
			::admin_system::RemovePlayerLocalImmunity(iSlot);
		}
	}

	// --- punishments ---------------------------------------------------------------
	bool IsPlayerPunished(int iSlot, int iType) const {
		return detail::Available() && ::admin_system::IsPlayerPunished(iSlot, iType);
	}

	int64_t GetPlayerPunishmentExpired(int iSlot, int iType) const {
		return detail::Available() ? ::admin_system::GetPlayerPunishmentExpired(iSlot, iType) : -1;
	}

	const char* GetPlayerPunishmentReason(int iSlot, int iType) {
		if (iSlot < 0 || iSlot >= 64 || iType < 0 || iType >= kPunishmentTypes) {
			return "";
		}
		std::string reason;
		if (detail::Available()) {
			reason = detail::ToStd(::admin_system::GetPlayerPunishmentReason(iSlot, iType));
		}
		std::string& slot = detail::S().reasons[static_cast<size_t>(iSlot) * kPunishmentTypes + static_cast<size_t>(iType)];
		slot = std::move(reason);
		return slot.c_str();
	}

	void AddPlayerPunishment(int iSlot, int iType, int iTime, const char* szReason, int iAdminID = -1,
							 bool bNotify = true, bool bDB = true) const {
		if (detail::Available()) {
			::admin_system::AddPlayerPunishment(iSlot, iType, iTime, detail::ToPlg(szReason ? szReason : ""), iAdminID, bNotify, bDB);
		}
	}

	void AddOfflinePlayerPunishment(const char* szSteamID64, const char* szName, int iType, int iTime, const char* szReason,
									int iAdminID = -1) const {
		if (!detail::Available() || !szSteamID64) {
			return;
		}
		::admin_system::AddOfflinePlayerPunishment(detail::ToPlg(szSteamID64), detail::ToPlg(szName ? szName : ""), iType, iTime,
												   detail::ToPlg(szReason ? szReason : ""), iAdminID);
	}

	void RemovePlayerPunishment(int iSlot, int iType, int iAdminID = -1, bool bNotify = true) const {
		if (detail::Available()) {
			::admin_system::RemovePlayerPunishment(iSlot, iType, iAdminID, bNotify);
		}
	}

	void RemoveOfflinePlayerPunishment(const char* szSteamID64, int iType, int iAdminID = -1) const {
		if (!detail::Available() || !szSteamID64) {
			return;
		}
		::admin_system::RemoveOfflinePlayerPunishment(detail::ToPlg(szSteamID64), iType, iAdminID);
	}

	// --- menus ----------------------------------------------------------------------
	void ShowAdminMenu(int iSlot) const {
		if (detail::Available()) {
			::admin_system::ShowAdminMenu(iSlot);
		}
	}

	void ShowAdminCategoryMenu(int iSlot, const char* szCategory) const {
		if (detail::Available() && szCategory) {
			::admin_system::ShowAdminCategoryMenu(iSlot, detail::ToPlg(szCategory));
		}
	}

	void ShowAdminLastCategoryMenu(int iSlot) const {
		if (detail::Available()) {
			::admin_system::ShowAdminLastCategoryMenu(iSlot);
		}
	}

	void ShowAdminItemMenu(int iSlot, const char* szCategory, const char* szIdentity) const {
		if (detail::Available() && szCategory && szIdentity) {
			::admin_system::ShowAdminItemMenu(iSlot, detail::ToPlg(szCategory), detail::ToPlg(szIdentity));
		}
	}

	// --- actions ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	void SendAction(int iSlot, const char* szAction, const char* szParam) const {
		if (detail::Available() && szAction) {
			::admin_system::SendAction(iSlot, detail::ToPlg(szAction), detail::ToPlg(szParam ? szParam : ""));
		}
	}

	// --- callbacks --------------------------------------------------------------------
	// Every event keeps the semantics of the original: one listener per plugin, registering
	// again replaces the previous one, and Unregister removes it. The server deduplicates by
	// the trampoline pointer, which is constant per event and plugin.
	void OnAdminConnected(OnAdminConnectedCallback callback) {
		detail::S().adminConnected = std::move(callback);
		if (detail::Available()) {
			::admin_system::OnAdminConnected_Register(&detail::AdminConnectedTrampoline);
		}
	}
	void OnAdminConnectedUnregister() {
		detail::S().adminConnected = nullptr;
		if (detail::Available()) {
			::admin_system::OnAdminConnected_Unregister(&detail::AdminConnectedTrampoline);
		}
	}

	void OnCoreLoaded(OnCoreLoadedCallback callback) {
		detail::S().coreLoaded = std::move(callback);
		if (detail::Available()) {
			::admin_system::OnCoreLoaded_Register(&detail::CoreLoadedTrampoline);
		}
	}
	void OnCoreLoadedUnregister() {
		detail::S().coreLoaded = nullptr;
		if (detail::Available()) {
			::admin_system::OnCoreLoaded_Unregister(&detail::CoreLoadedTrampoline);
		}
	}

	void OnCategoryRegister(OnCategoryRegisterCallback callback) {
		detail::S().categoryRegister = std::move(callback);
		if (detail::Available()) {
			::admin_system::OnCategoryRegister_Register(&detail::CategoryRegisterTrampoline);
		}
	}
	void OnCategoryRegisterUnregister() {
		detail::S().categoryRegister = nullptr;
		if (detail::Available()) {
			::admin_system::OnCategoryRegister_Unregister(&detail::CategoryRegisterTrampoline);
		}
	}

	void OnAction(OnActionCallback callback) {

	}

private:
	AdminApi() = default;
};

// The object the ported modules use; name it g_pAdminApi to keep their code unchanged:
//
//     admin_system::AdminApi* g_pAdminApi = &admin_system::AdminApi::Get();
inline AdminApi& Admin() {
	return AdminApi::Get();
}

#ifdef ADMIN_SYSTEM_API_HAS_PLGDB
// Ready-to-use plgdb settings for a module that needs its own connection (the original
// hand-to-hand IMySQLConnection). Relative SQLite paths are the caller's business.
inline plgdb::Config MakeDatabaseConfig(const DatabaseConfig& config, std::string sqlitePath = {}) {
	plgdb::Config result;
	if (config.IsSqlite()) {
		result.driver = plgdb::Driver::SQLite;
		result.sqlitePath = std::move(sqlitePath);
	} else {
		result.driver = plgdb::Driver::MySQL;
		result.host = config.host;
		result.port = config.port;
		result.user = config.user;
		result.password = config.password;
		result.database = config.database;
	}
	return result;
}
#endif

} // namespace admin_system
```

```hpp
  /**
   * @brief Creates (or extends) an admin in as_admins / as_admins_servers for the current server, with the SQL of the original: an existing as_admins row is reused, the admins_servers row is INSERT IGNORE'd (so an existing row for this server is kept), and the rights of an online player are reloaded afterwards. expireTime is a duration in seconds from now, 0 = permanent. When db is false nothing is written and only the in-memory record of an online player changes.
   * @param name (string): Steam name stored in as_admins.name.
   * @param steamid64 (string): SteamID64 of the admin.
   * @param flags (string): Flag characters, e.g. 'abz'.
   * @param immunity (int32): Immunity of the admins_servers row.
   * @param expireTime (int32): Lifetime in seconds from now, 0 = permanent.
   * @param groupID (int32): as_groups.id, 0 = no group.
   * @param comment (string): Comment for a newly created as_admins row.
   * @param db (bool): false = change the in-memory record only.
   */
  inline void AddPlayerAdmin(const plg::string& name, const plg::string& steamid64, const plg::string& flags, int32_t immunity, int32_t expireTime, int32_t groupID, const plg::string& comment, bool db) {
    return __admin_system_AddPlayerAdmin(name, steamid64, flags, immunity, expireTime, groupID, comment, db);
```

```hpp
namespace admin_system {
  /**
   * @brief Registers (or replaces) an item of a menu category. Registration is idempotent per (category, identity): registering the same identity twice replaces the previous callbacks, matching the std::map insert of the original. flags is a '|'-separated list of permissions (the original split szFlags on '|'); an empty or null string leaves the item reachable only for '@admin/root' (splitting '' produced one empty flag in the original, which only the root wildcard could match).

   * @param name (string): Phrase key used as the item label.
   * @param category (string): Identity of the owning category.
   * @param flags (string): Permissions separated by '|'; the item is shown when the admin has any of them, or '@admin/root'.
   * @param display (function): Display callback, may be null.
   * @param select (function): Select callback, may be null.
   */
  inline void RegisterItem(const plg::string& identity, const plg::string& name, const plg::string& category, const plg::string& flags, ItemDisplayCallback display, ItemSelectCallback select) {
    return __admin_system_RegisterItem(identity, name, category, flags, display, select);
  }
```

```hpp
namespace admin_system {

  // Called when the category is about to be added to the admin menu. May rewrite name - the original passed the (already translated) label by reference so a module could e.g. append a player count.
  using CategoryDisplayCallback = void (*)(int32_t, const plg::string&, plg::string&);


  // Called while the item list is built; may rewrite name in place.
  using ItemDisplayCallback = void (*)(int32_t, const plg::string&, const plg::string&, plg::string&);

  using ItemSelectCallback = void (*)(int32_t, const plg::string&, const plg::string&, const plg::string&);


  using AdminConnectedCallback = void (*)(int32_t);

  using PlayerUnpunishCallback = void (*)(int32_t, int32_t, int32_t);
```

```hpp
namespace admin_system {
  /**
   * @brief True while the slot carries an active punishment of that type. Note that the original answered true before the punishments of a player had been loaded (the array started at 0); here every slot starts at 'none', which the ported modules (VoteBKM) rely on.
   * @param slot (int32): Player slot.
   * @param type (int32): 0 = ban, 1 = mute, 2 = gag, 3 = silence.
   * @return bool: Whether the punishment is active.

    return __admin_system_IsPlayerPunished(slot, type);
  }

  using _GetPlayerPunishmentExpired = int64_t (*)(int32_t, int32_t);
}
extern "C" PLUGIN_API admin_system::_GetPlayerPunishmentExpired __admin_system_GetPlayerPunishmentExpired;
namespace admin_system {
  /**
   * @brief Expiry of the active punishment of a slot: absolute unix timestamp, 0 = permanent, -1 = no punishment. The original returned an int and stored the timestamp in a 32 bit array; the value is widened to int64 here so the 2038 wraparound of the original cannot happen.
   * @param slot (int32): Player slot.
   * @param type (int32): 0 = ban, 1 = mute, 2 = gag, 3 = silence.
   * @return int64: Expiry timestamp, 0 or -1.

  }
```

`plugins/cs2ac/CMakeLists.txt`:

```txt
# cs2ac — Plugify C++ plugin: the CS2AC 1.0.14 server-side anti-cheat (originally a
# Metamod:Source plugin) ported to s2sdk + polyhook.
#
#   cs2ac_core            engine-independent pieces (detection math shared with the tests)
#   plugify-cs2ac         the plugin shared library (entry "bin/cs2ac")
#
# Everything that talks to the engine is s2sdk (data) or polyhook (code hooks); see PORT_PLAN.md
# for the module-by-module mapping and FORK_SYNC.md for the Metamod-fork packages.

if(NOT TARGET admin_system_bindings_obj)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "cs2ac needs the generated admin_system consumer bindings (plugins/admin_system/include/external/plugify/include/admin_system/admin_system.cpp)")
endif()

set(CS2AC_VERSION "1.1.0")

configure_file(
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cs2ac.pplugin.in"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cs2ac.pplugin"
)

# Engine-independent detection math: also the unit-test target (tests/cs2ac_tests.cpp), so it must
# not reference a single s2sdk/polyhook symbol.
add_library(cs2ac_core STATIC
        src/core.cpp
        src/config.cpp
        src/localization.cpp
        src/decisions.cpp
)
target_include_directories(cs2ac_core PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
target_include_directories(cs2ac_core SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include")
target_compile_options(cs2ac_core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_compile_definitions(cs2ac_core PUBLIC _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1)

add_library(plugify-cs2ac SHARED
        src/plugin.cpp
        src/engine.cpp
        src/hooks.cpp
        src/announce.cpp
        src/webhook.cpp
        src/detection.cpp
        src/detection_log.cpp
        src/admin_bridge.cpp
        src/mod_aim.cpp
        src/mod_aimlock.cpp
        src/mod_antiaim.cpp
        src/mod_shots.cpp
        src/mod_integrity.cpp
        src/mod_pattern.cpp
        src/mod_recoil.cpp
        src/mod_misc.cpp
        src/mod_movement.cpp
        $<TARGET_OBJECTS:s2sdk_bindings>
        $<TARGET_OBJECTS:polyhook_bindings>
        $<TARGET_OBJECTS:admin_system_bindings_obj>
)
target_include_directories(plugify-cs2ac PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
# SYSTEM: warnings from the generated s2sdk/polyhook/plg headers must not fail -Werror on our sources.
target_include_directories(plugify-cs2ac SYSTEM PRIVATE
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/plugins/admin_system/include"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/plugins/admin_system/include/external/plugify/include")
target_link_libraries(plugify-cs2ac PRIVATE
        cs2ac_core
        -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc
        ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS}
)
target_compile_options(plugify-cs2ac PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_compile_definitions(plugify-cs2ac PRIVATE
        _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1
        CS2AC_VERSION="${CS2AC_VERSION}"
        PLUGIFY_MODULE="cs2ac"
        PLUGIFY_IS_DEBUG=0
        PLUGIFY_IS_RELEASE=1
)
set_target_properties(plugify-cs2ac PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME cs2ac)

if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    target_link_options(plugify-cs2ac PRIVATE
            "-Wl,--version-script,${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sym/version_script.lds")
endif()

# Unit tests: pure detection math and the scoring rules of the original (the original's
# static_asserts are re-run as runtime assertions here). Run by ./test.sh.
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/cs2ac_tests.cpp")
    add_executable(cs2ac_tests tests/cs2ac_tests.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(cs2ac_tests PRIVATE cs2ac_core -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc)
    target_compile_options(cs2ac_tests PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
    target_compile_definitions(cs2ac_tests PRIVATE
            CS2AC_SOURCE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
            _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1)
    set_target_properties(cs2ac_tests PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests")
endif()

```

```md
# CS2AC fork sync (v3 → v11) — change map and port status

Source of truth: the Metamod fork `ezekutor/cs2ac`, first commit `59e58ae` ("Import CS2AC fork as
deployed on 2026-09-29", already contains v3+v4 and the pre-import v2 changes) through HEAD
`9ff13f7` (v11). Our port was made from vanilla CS2AC 1.0.14, so the work is the diff
`cs2ac-legacy → fork HEAD`, filtered through `PORT_PLAN.md`'s mapping.

Reference copies used while porting (gitignored): `.scratch/ref-cs2ac/{legacy,fork-import-59e58ae,
fork-head,patches,CHANGELOG}`.

Status: **done** = ported, built and covered by tests; **n/a** = deliberately not ported (reason);
**gap** = cannot be completed in this stack/sandbox (documented, visible at runtime).

## How the fork's primitives map into the port

| Fork primitive | Port location |
|---|---|
| `settings::Configuration` CConVars | `src/config.cpp` `settings::kConVars` / `kNumericConVars` |
| `CS2ACPlugin::HandleDetection` | `src/plugin.cpp` `Plugin::HandleDetection` |
| `utils::AnnounceDetectionThrottled` | `src/announce.cpp` + `Plugin::HandleDetection` |

| 10.7 | `CheckCommandTemplate` review changes (`weak_signal_policy` note) | `plugin.cpp` | done |

## Known gaps / deliberate deviations

1. **Gamedata `OnJumpLegacy`/`AirMove` patterns** — cannot be uniqueness-verified against the live
   `libserver.so` from this sandbox; not adopted (G.1). Neither function is detoured by the port, so
   the only consequence is the readiness line in `cs2ac_hooks`.
2. **admin_bridge API** — our `admin_system` exports both `AddPlayerPunishment` (online) and
   `AddOfflinePlayerPunishment`, so the fork's bridge semantics (DB insert, offline flush) are fully
   available; no fallback-command gap. The manifest declares it `optional`.
3. **Detection log directory** — the fork writes `csgo/addons/cs2ac/logs`; the port writes
   `<plugify logs>/cs2ac/*.jsonl` (`plg::GetLogsDir()`), same file names and JSON schema. Writes are
   skipped outside a live map so no client query can run in the loading window.
4. **RCS schema fields** (`CCSPlayer_AimPunchServices`) are probed lazily after a map exists; if
   this server's schema lacks them the module disables itself exactly like the fork.
5. **Webhook report-only text** reuses the announcement sentence (`, but this finding is
   report-only.`) instead of the fork's separate `webhook.outcome.report_only` wording; the outcome
   value and the reports themselves are identical.
6. **Usercmd tick-integrity field numbers** (`render_tick_count=3`, `render_tick_fraction=4`,
   `sv_interp0=5`, `sv_interp1=6`, `cl_interp=7`, `player_tick_count=8`,
   `consumed_server_angle_changes=13`) come from the CS2 protobuf layout; the reader is tolerant and
   `cs2ac_usercmd_dump` now prints each field plus its "missing" marker, so they can be confirmed on
   a live server. A wrong number degrades that signal only (no crash).
7. **Auto-updater** remains unported (PORT_PLAN §6.1); `cs2ac_auto_update`/`cs2ac_update_repository`
   are registered and reported, and `AutomaticUpdatesEnabled()` now requires both like the fork.
8. **Kick/fallback commands are queued** and executed from `OnPluginUpdate`
   (`Plugin::ProcessServerCommands`), as the task requires: never inside the per-client hook that
   produced the finding. A command carrying `{userid}` is re-validated (slot still connected, same
   SteamID64) at execution time, so a reused slot cannot kick the next occupant; queued commands
   are dropped with a log line at a map boundary. Bans through `admin_system` are queued by
   `admin_bridge` exactly like the fork.
9. **Stream-kick / burst-kick / combo / repeat-ban state** uses `steady_clock` seconds instead of
   the fork's `steady_clock::time_point` deques so the window rules live in engine-free
   `decisions.cpp` and are unit-tested; the semantics (windows, thresholds, dedupe, ignore lists)
   are the fork's.

```

`plugins/cs2ac/assets/cs2ac.cfg`:

```cfg
// CS2AC loads this file automatically.
// Use 1 to enable a setting and 0 to disable it.

// Master switch. Turning this off stops every detector.
cs2ac_enabled 1

// Automatic updates are off by default in this fork so a local build can never
// silently replace itself with the upstream author's release. To opt in, set
// cs2ac_update_repository to THIS fork's "owner/repo" and set cs2ac_auto_update 1.
// An update that was already prepared before this was disabled may still install
// on the next restart.
cs2ac_auto_update 0
cs2ac_update_repository ""

// Whitelisted SteamID64s are still detected and announced, but they are never punished.
// Separate multiple IDs with commas.
// Example: cs2ac_whitelist "76561198000000001,76561198000000002"
cs2ac_whitelist ""

// Detection modules. They are all enabled by default.
cs2ac_aimbot_enabled 1
cs2ac_aimlock_enabled 1
cs2ac_antiaim_enabled 1
cs2ac_autostrafe_enabled 1
cs2ac_bhop_enabled 1
cs2ac_dll_injection_enabled 1
cs2ac_desubticking_enabled 1
cs2ac_doubletap_enabled 1
cs2ac_hyperscroll_enabled 1
cs2ac_inhuman_accuracy_enabled 1
cs2ac_invalid_cvar_enabled 1
cs2ac_invalid_input_enabled 1
cs2ac_irregular_behavior_enabled 1
cs2ac_namechanger_enabled 1
cs2ac_nulls_enabled 1
cs2ac_silentaim_enabled 1
cs2ac_subtick_spam_enabled 1
cs2ac_triggerbot_enabled 1

// Detection announcements.
cs2ac_chat_announcements 1
cs2ac_center_announcements 1
// Show each player the "protected by CS2AC" notice 10 seconds after joining (chat line and center message).
cs2ac_join_watermark 0

// Language used for chat, center-screen announcements, and Discord reports.
// Bundled language codes are listed in addons/cs2ac/translations.
cs2ac_language "en"

// Commands run after a detection. Permanent bans are reserved for multi-episode
// AIMBOT, AIMLOCK, and SILENTAIM evidence. Movement, client-setting, integrity,
// behavioural, and subtick findings are report-only by default so they cannot
// falsely punish an idle or high-sensitivity player; set cs2ac_weak_signal_policy
// to "kick" to run cs2ac_kick_command for them instead. Leave a value empty to
// disable that punishment.
// Available placeholders: {steamid64}, {userid}, and {detection}.
cs2ac_punishment_command "css_addban {steamid64} 0 CS2AC: {detection}"
cs2ac_kick_command "css_kick #{userid} CS2AC: {detection}"
// Kick a player who trips a listed detection cs2ac_stream_kick_reports times within
// cs2ac_stream_kick_seconds, even under the report policy. Empty list turns it off.
cs2ac_stream_kick_detections "INVALID INPUT,NAMECHANGER"
cs2ac_stream_kick_reports 20
cs2ac_stream_kick_seconds 180
// Detections that kick (never ban) even under the report policy.
cs2ac_kick_detections "TRIGGER PATTERN,MOUSE MISMATCH,ANTIAIM"
// Listed findings still kick (never ban) when the network check vetoes punishment.
cs2ac_unstable_kick_detections "ANTIAIM"
// Kick once this many different report-only detections fired in one connection (0 = off).
// Detections in the ignore list do not count.
cs2ac_combo_kick_types 3
cs2ac_combo_ignore_detections "BHOP,NULLS"
// Kick a player who trips a listed detection cs2ac_burst_kick_reports times within
// cs2ac_burst_kick_seconds. Empty list turns it off.
cs2ac_burst_kick_detections "DESUBTICKING"
cs2ac_burst_kick_reports 3
cs2ac_burst_kick_seconds 60
// The second kick for a listed detection within cs2ac_repeat_ban_hours becomes a ban of
// cs2ac_repeat_ban_minutes (through admin_system only). Detections in needs_other also need
// another finding (not BHOP, NULLS or RCS) in that window. Empty list turns it off.
// A listed ban detection falls back to reports once cs2ac_mass_guard_players different players
// trip it within cs2ac_mass_guard_minutes on this server (a game update, not cheaters).
cs2ac_mass_guard_detections "DLL INJECTION"
cs2ac_mass_guard_players 5
cs2ac_mass_guard_minutes 60
cs2ac_repeat_ban_detections "TRIGGER PATTERN,INVALID INPUT"
cs2ac_repeat_ban_needs_other "INVALID INPUT"
cs2ac_repeat_ban_hours 24
cs2ac_repeat_ban_minutes 1440
// MOUSE MISMATCH: judged after this many view turns with horizontal mouse movement,
// reported when fewer than this share of them went the way the mouse moved.
cs2ac_mouse_mismatch_samples 100
cs2ac_mouse_mismatch_agreement 0.9
// Weak findings are reported but never punished by default. Use "kick" only after
// you accept that these signals can still be wrong on unusual but legit clients.
cs2ac_weak_signal_policy "report"

// Optional Discord detection reports. The webhook URL is kept out of console output.
cs2ac_webhook_url ""
// Enter a Discord role ID to mention it on every report, or leave this empty.
cs2ac_webhook_role_id ""
// Leave empty to use Steam's public server IP and hostport automatically.
cs2ac_webhook_server_address ""
// Optional public HTTPS logo used for Discord branding and as the avatar fallback.
cs2ac_webhook_logo_url ""

// Diagnostic messages are quiet by default.
cs2ac_aimbot_debug 0
cs2ac_aimlock_debug 0
cs2ac_antiaim_debug 0
cs2ac_autostrafe_debug 0
cs2ac_bhop_debug 0
cs2ac_dll_injection_debug 0
cs2ac_doubletap_debug 0
cs2ac_hyperscroll_debug 0
cs2ac_inhuman_accuracy_debug 0
cs2ac_invalid_cvar_debug 0
cs2ac_irregular_debug 0
cs2ac_namechanger_debug 0
cs2ac_nulls_debug 0
cs2ac_silentaim_debug 0
cs2ac_subtick_debug 0
cs2ac_triggerbot_debug 0

// Keep this off on public servers. It only exists for local testing with sv_cheats 1.
cs2ac_allow_sv_cheats_testing 0

// Keep this last so CS2AC can confirm that the whole file was applied.
cs2ac_config_loaded
```

```jsonc
      //
      // 168 is the CServerSideClientBase::m_UserID offset for this build: SwiftlyS2's offsets for
      // the same game version list "CServerSideClientBase::m_UserID: linux 168", and the
      // neighbouring members it lists (m_UserIDString 56, m_Name 64, m_nClientSlot 72,
      // m_nSignonState 100, m_bFakePlayer 160) match the Metamod header's layout (its
      // CServerSideClient header annotations), whose linux column is consistently these values
      // plus the 16 bytes that header models for the linux base-subobject offset
      // (m_Name 80 = 64 + 16, m_UserID 184 = 168 + 16, ...) - i.e. the two
      // sources agree once that shift is accounted for, and s2sdk's client pointer is typed
      // CServerSideClientBase*, so the base-relative 168 is the right one for this port.
      //
      // Because a wrong userid would substitute the WRONG PLAYER into a kick command, the plugin
      // never trusts this offset blindly: engine::PlayerUserId() only uses it after it agreed with
      // a userid the engine itself reported in a game event for the same player
      // (engine::RememberClientUserId), and reports a warning when the two disagree. Until such a
      // userid has been seen (or when the offset is rejected) the placeholder stays unavailable
      // (IdentityUnavailable), exactly like the Metamod original when GetPlayerUserId failed.

        "win64": 168,
        "linuxsteamrt64": 168

      // Metamod engine/schema layer; the port reads the same data through s2sdk, so they are not
      // carried over.
    }
```

```jsonc
      // The engine userid the {userid} punishment placeholder needs, read from the client object
      // s2sdk::PlayerSlotToClientPtr returns (CServerSideClientBase*, the type s2sdk's own
      // GetClientBySlot declares for the client list).
      //
      // 168 is the CServerSideClientBase::m_UserID offset for this build: SwiftlyS2's offsets for
      // the same game version list "CServerSideClientBase::m_UserID: linux 168", and the
      // neighbouring members it lists (m_UserIDString 56, m_Name 64, m_nClientSlot 72,
      // m_nSignonState 100, m_bFakePlayer 160) match the Metamod header's layout (its
      // CServerSideClient header annotations), whose linux column is consistently these values
      // plus the 16 bytes that header models for the linux base-subobject offset
      // (m_Name 80 = 64 + 16, m_UserID 184 = 168 + 16, ...) - i.e. the two
      // sources agree once that shift is accounted for, and s2sdk's client pointer is typed
      // CServerSideClientBase*, so the base-relative 168 is the right one for this port.
      //
      // Because a wrong userid would substitute the WRONG PLAYER into a kick command, the plugin
      // never trusts this offset blindly: engine::PlayerUserId() only uses it after it agreed with
      // a userid the engine itself reported in a game event for the same player
      // (engine::RememberClientUserId), and reports a warning when the two disagree. Until such a
      // userid has been seen (or when the offset is rejected) the placeholder stays unavailable
      // (IdentityUnavailable), exactly like the Metamod original when GetPlayerUserId failed.
      "ClientUserIdOffset": {
        "win64": 168,
        "linuxsteamrt64": 168
      }
      //
      // The remaining offsets of cs2ac.games.txt (GameEntitySystem, Teleport, IsEntityPawn,
      // IsEntityController, ClientOffset, ProcessRespondCvarValue, ClientSlotOffset) belong to the
      // Metamod engine/schema layer; the port reads the same data through s2sdk, so they are not
      // carried over.
    }
  }
}
```

`plugins/cs2ac/dist/configs/cs2ac/cs2ac.cfg`:

```cfg
// CS2AC loads this file automatically.
// Use 1 to enable a setting and 0 to disable it.

// Master switch. Turning this off stops every detector.
cs2ac_enabled 1

// Automatic updates are off by default in this fork so a local build can never
// silently replace itself with the upstream author's release. To opt in, set
// cs2ac_update_repository to THIS fork's "owner/repo" and set cs2ac_auto_update 1.
// An update that was already prepared before this was disabled may still install
// on the next restart.
cs2ac_auto_update 0
cs2ac_update_repository ""

// Whitelisted SteamID64s are still detected and announced, but they are never punished.
// Separate multiple IDs with commas.
// Example: cs2ac_whitelist "76561198000000001,76561198000000002"
cs2ac_whitelist ""

// Detection modules. They are all enabled by default.
cs2ac_aimbot_enabled 1
cs2ac_aimlock_enabled 1
cs2ac_antiaim_enabled 1
cs2ac_autostrafe_enabled 1
cs2ac_bhop_enabled 1
cs2ac_dll_injection_enabled 1
cs2ac_desubticking_enabled 1
cs2ac_doubletap_enabled 1
cs2ac_hyperscroll_enabled 1
cs2ac_inhuman_accuracy_enabled 1
cs2ac_invalid_cvar_enabled 1
cs2ac_invalid_input_enabled 1
cs2ac_irregular_behavior_enabled 1
cs2ac_namechanger_enabled 1
cs2ac_nulls_enabled 1
cs2ac_silentaim_enabled 1
cs2ac_subtick_spam_enabled 1
cs2ac_triggerbot_enabled 1

// Detection announcements.
cs2ac_chat_announcements 1
cs2ac_center_announcements 1
// Show each player the "protected by CS2AC" notice 10 seconds after joining (chat line and center message).
cs2ac_join_watermark 0

// Language used for chat, center-screen announcements, and Discord reports.
// Bundled language codes are listed in addons/cs2ac/translations.
cs2ac_language "en"

// Commands run after a detection. Permanent bans are reserved for multi-episode
// AIMBOT, AIMLOCK, and SILENTAIM evidence. Movement, client-setting, integrity,
// behavioural, and subtick findings are report-only by default so they cannot
// falsely punish an idle or high-sensitivity player; set cs2ac_weak_signal_policy
// to "kick" to run cs2ac_kick_command for them instead. Leave a value empty to
// disable that punishment.
// Available placeholders: {steamid64}, {userid}, and {detection}.
cs2ac_punishment_command "css_addban {steamid64} 0 CS2AC: {detection}"
cs2ac_kick_command "css_kick #{userid} CS2AC: {detection}"
// Kick a player who trips a listed detection cs2ac_stream_kick_reports times within
// cs2ac_stream_kick_seconds, even under the report policy. Empty list turns it off.
cs2ac_stream_kick_detections "INVALID INPUT,NAMECHANGER"
cs2ac_stream_kick_reports 20
cs2ac_stream_kick_seconds 180
// Detections that kick (never ban) even under the report policy.
cs2ac_kick_detections "TRIGGER PATTERN,MOUSE MISMATCH,ANTIAIM"
// Listed findings still kick (never ban) when the network check vetoes punishment.
cs2ac_unstable_kick_detections "ANTIAIM"
// Kick once this many different report-only detections fired in one connection (0 = off).
// Detections in the ignore list do not count.
cs2ac_combo_kick_types 3
cs2ac_combo_ignore_detections "BHOP,NULLS"
// Kick a player who trips a listed detection cs2ac_burst_kick_reports times within
// cs2ac_burst_kick_seconds. Empty list turns it off.
cs2ac_burst_kick_detections "DESUBTICKING"
cs2ac_burst_kick_reports 3
cs2ac_burst_kick_seconds 60
// The second kick for a listed detection within cs2ac_repeat_ban_hours becomes a ban of
// cs2ac_repeat_ban_minutes (through admin_system only). Detections in needs_other also need
// another finding (not BHOP, NULLS or RCS) in that window. Empty list turns it off.
// A listed ban detection falls back to reports once cs2ac_mass_guard_players different players
// trip it within cs2ac_mass_guard_minutes on this server (a game update, not cheaters).
cs2ac_mass_guard_detections "DLL INJECTION"
cs2ac_mass_guard_players 5
cs2ac_mass_guard_minutes 60
cs2ac_repeat_ban_detections "TRIGGER PATTERN,INVALID INPUT"
cs2ac_repeat_ban_needs_other "INVALID INPUT"
cs2ac_repeat_ban_hours 24
cs2ac_repeat_ban_minutes 1440
// MOUSE MISMATCH: judged after this many view turns with horizontal mouse movement,
// reported when fewer than this share of them went the way the mouse moved.
cs2ac_mouse_mismatch_samples 100
cs2ac_mouse_mismatch_agreement 0.9
// Weak findings are reported but never punished by default. Use "kick" only after
// you accept that these signals can still be wrong on unusual but legit clients.
cs2ac_weak_signal_policy "report"

// Optional Discord detection reports. The webhook URL is kept out of console output.
cs2ac_webhook_url ""
// Enter a Discord role ID to mention it on every report, or leave this empty.
cs2ac_webhook_role_id ""
// Leave empty to use Steam's public server IP and hostport automatically.
cs2ac_webhook_server_address ""
// Optional public HTTPS logo used for Discord branding and as the avatar fallback.
cs2ac_webhook_logo_url ""

// Diagnostic messages are quiet by default.
cs2ac_aimbot_debug 0
cs2ac_aimlock_debug 0
cs2ac_antiaim_debug 0
cs2ac_autostrafe_debug 0
cs2ac_bhop_debug 0
cs2ac_dll_injection_debug 0
cs2ac_doubletap_debug 0
cs2ac_hyperscroll_debug 0
cs2ac_inhuman_accuracy_debug 0
cs2ac_invalid_cvar_debug 0
cs2ac_irregular_debug 0
cs2ac_namechanger_debug 0
cs2ac_nulls_debug 0
cs2ac_silentaim_debug 0
cs2ac_subtick_debug 0
cs2ac_triggerbot_debug 0

// Keep this off on public servers. It only exists for local testing with sv_cheats 1.
cs2ac_allow_sv_cheats_testing 0

// Keep this last so CS2AC can confirm that the whole file was applied.
cs2ac_config_loaded
```

```jsonc
        "linuxsteamrt64": "48 B8 00 00 00 00 00 00 80 3F 55 66 0F EF C0 48 89 E5 41 57 41 56 4C 8D BD ? ? ? ? 41 55 49 89 F5"
      },
      "TryPlayerMove": {
        "library": "server",
        "win64": "48 8B C4 4C 89 48 ? 4C 89 40 ? 48 89 50 ? 48 89 48 ? 55 53 56 57 41 54 41 55 41 56 41 57 48 8D A8 ? ? ? ? 48 81 EC ? ? ? ? 0F 29 70",
        "linuxsteamrt64": "48 B8 ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? 55 66 0F EF C0 48 89 E5 41 57 41 56 49 89 F6"
      },
      "CategorizePosition": {
        "library": "server",
        "win64": "40 55 56 57 41 54 41 55 48 8D AC 24 ? ? ? ? 48 81 EC ? ? ? ? 48 8B F9",
        "linuxsteamrt64": "48 B8 ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? 55 66 0F EF C0 48 89 E5 41 57 41 56 41 55 41 89 D5"
      },
      "PhysicsSimulate": {
        "library": "server",
        "win64": "40 55 53 56 57 41 55 41 56 48 8D AC 24 08 F9 FF FF",
        "linuxsteamrt64": "55 ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? 48 89 E5 41 57 41 56 41 55 41 54 53 48 89 FB 48 8D 3D ? ? ? ? 48 81 EC ? 00 00 00"
      },
      "GameEventManager": {
        "library": "server",
        "win64": "48 8D 0D ? ? ? ? 49 8B 04 38",
        "linuxsteamrt64": "4C 8D 25 ? ? ? ? 31 DB 48 83 EC 08"
      },
      // CSource2GameClients::StartHLTVServer: game event %s not found.
      // Function right before the first virtual function call.
      "GetLegacyGameEventListener": {
        "library": "server",
        "win64": "48 8B 15 ? ? ? ? 48 85 D2 74 ? 85 C9",
        "linuxsteamrt64": "48 8B 05 ? ? ? ? 48 85 C0 74 ? 83 FF ? 77 ? 48 63 FF 48 C1 E7 ? 48 8D 44 38"
      }
    },
    "Offsets": {
      // The engine userid the {userid} punishment placeholder needs, read from the client object
      // s2sdk::PlayerSlotToClientPtr returns (CServerSideClientBase*, the type s2sdk's own
      // GetClientBySlot declares for the client list).
      //
      // 168 is the CServerSideClientBase::m_UserID offset for this build: SwiftlyS2's offsets for
      // the same game version list "CServerSideClientBase::m_UserID: linux 168", and the
      // neighbouring members it lists (m_UserIDString 56, m_Name 64, m_nClientSlot 72,
      // m_nSignonState 100, m_bFakePlayer 160) match the Metamod header's layout (its
      // CServerSideClient header annotations), whose linux column is consistently these values
      // plus the 16 bytes that header models for the linux base-subobject offset
      // (m_Name 80 = 64 + 16, m_UserID 184 = 168 + 16, ...) - i.e. the two
      // sources agree once that shift is accounted for, and s2sdk's client pointer is typed
      // CServerSideClientBase*, so the base-relative 168 is the right one for this port.
      //
      // Because a wrong userid would substitute the WRONG PLAYER into a kick command, the plugin
      // never trusts this offset blindly: engine::PlayerUserId() only uses it after it agreed with
      // a userid the engine itself reported in a game event for the same player
      // (engine::RememberClientUserId), and reports a warning when the two disagree. Until such a
      // userid has been seen (or when the offset is rejected) the placeholder stays unavailable
      // (IdentityUnavailable), exactly like the Metamod original when GetPlayerUserId failed.
      "ClientUserIdOffset": {
        "win64": 168,
        "linuxsteamrt64": 168
      }
      //
      // The remaining offsets of cs2ac.games.txt (GameEntitySystem, Teleport, IsEntityPawn,
      // IsEntityController, ClientOffset, ProcessRespondCvarValue, ClientSlotOffset) belong to the
      // Metamod engine/schema layer; the port reads the same data through s2sdk, so they are not
      // carried over.
    }
  }
}
```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/admin_bridge.cpp`:

```cpp
// admin_bridge.cpp — the fork's admin_bridge on the Plugify admin_system API.
//
// The fork resolved IAdminApi through MetaFactory on every use because admin_system can be
// reloaded independently. The Plugify binding slots behave the same way (the module fills them
// when admin_system is loaded), so the wrapper is asked on every use and never cached.

#include "admin_bridge.h"

#include "cs2ac.hpp"

#include <admin_api.hpp>

#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace cs2ac::admin_bridge {

namespace {

struct PendingBan {
	int slot {-1};
	std::uint64_t steamId {};
	std::string name;
	int seconds {};
	std::string reason;
	std::string fallbackCommand;
	bool fallbackRequiresSlot {};
};

std::vector<PendingBan> g_pending;

admin_system::AdminApi* Api()
{
	auto& api = admin_system::AdminApi::Get();
	return api.IsCoreLoaded() ? &api : nullptr;
}

bool SameClientStillOnline(const PendingBan& ban)
{
	if (!engine::GameReady() || ban.slot < 0 || ban.slot >= MAXPLAYERS) {
		return false;
	}
	const int index = ban.slot + 1;
	return engine::PlayerConnected(index) && engine::PlayerSteamId(index) == ban.steamId;
}

void RunFallback(const PendingBan& ban)
{
	if (ban.fallbackCommand.empty() || !engine::BindingsAvailable()) {
		LogWarning("admin_system is unavailable and no fallback command is set; ban for %llu was NOT issued.",
				   static_cast<unsigned long long>(ban.steamId));
		return;
	}
	if (ban.fallbackRequiresSlot && !SameClientStillOnline(ban)) {
		LogWarning("admin_system is unavailable; dropped fallback ban for %llu because the slot was reused.",
				   static_cast<unsigned long long>(ban.steamId));
		return;
	}
	std::string command = ban.fallbackCommand;
	if (ban.fallbackRequiresSlot) {
		const int userId = engine::PlayerUserId(ban.slot + 1);
		if (userId < 0) {
			LogWarning("admin_system is unavailable; dropped fallback ban for %llu because the userid is not ready.",
					   static_cast<unsigned long long>(ban.steamId));
			return;
		}
		ReplaceAll(command, "{userid}", std::to_string(userId));
	}
	ReplaceAll(command, "{steamid64}", std::to_string(ban.steamId));
	command += "\n";
	engine::ServerCommand(command.c_str());
	Log("admin_system unavailable, fallback command sent for %llu.", static_cast<unsigned long long>(ban.steamId));
}

void Execute(admin_system::AdminApi* api, const PendingBan& ban, bool forceOffline)
{
	if (!api) {
		RunFallback(ban);
		return;
	}
	// iAdminID = -1 means "Console". AddPlayerPunishment goes straight to the DB insert and kick;
	// it does not run admin_system's immunity check, so the CS2AC whitelist is the only exemption.
	if (!forceOffline && SameClientStillOnline(ban)) {
		api->AddPlayerPunishment(ban.slot, admin_system::RT_BAN, ban.seconds, ban.reason.c_str(), -1, true, true);
		Log("Ban sent to admin_system for slot %d (%llu).", ban.slot, static_cast<unsigned long long>(ban.steamId));
	} else {
		const std::string steamId = std::to_string(ban.steamId);
		api->AddOfflinePlayerPunishment(steamId.c_str(), ban.name.c_str(), admin_system::RT_BAN, ban.seconds, ban.reason.c_str(), -1);
		Log("Offline ban sent to admin_system for %s.", steamId.c_str());
	}
}

} // namespace

bool IsAvailable()
{
	return Api() != nullptr;
}

void QueueBan(int slot, std::uint64_t steamId64, const std::string& name, int seconds, const std::string& reason,
			  const std::string& fallbackCommand, bool fallbackRequiresSlot)
{
	if (!steamId64 || slot < 0 || slot >= MAXPLAYERS) {
		return;
	}
	for (const PendingBan& pending : g_pending) {
		if (pending.steamId == steamId64) {
			return; // one ban per player is enough
		}
	}
	g_pending.push_back({slot, steamId64, name, seconds < 0 ? 0 : seconds, reason, fallbackCommand, fallbackRequiresSlot});
}

void ProcessQueue()
{
	if (g_pending.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	// Swap first: AddPlayerPunishment fires disconnect callbacks that may reach back into CS2AC and
	// queue something new.
	std::vector<PendingBan> batch;
	batch.swap(g_pending);
	admin_system::AdminApi* api = Api();
	for (const PendingBan& ban : batch) {
		Execute(api, ban, false);
	}
}

void FlushOffline()
{
	if (g_pending.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	std::vector<PendingBan> batch;
	batch.swap(g_pending);
	admin_system::AdminApi* api = Api();
	for (const PendingBan& ban : batch) {
		Execute(api, ban, true);
	}
}

void Reset()
{
	g_pending.clear();
}

} // namespace cs2ac::admin_bridge

```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/admin_bridge.h`:

```h
// Bridge to our Plugify admin_system's exported API (the fork's Metamod IAdminApi bridge).
// Bans are queued and executed outside any per-client hook: admin_system's AddPlayerPunishment
// calls DisconnectClient synchronously, and a detection may fire from inside a usercmd/cvar hook
// that is processing this very client.
//
// Both operations the fork needs are exported by plugins/admin_system:
//   AddPlayerPunishment        (online: DB insert + kick)
//   AddOfflinePlayerPunishment (DB only; the player is rejected on reconnect)

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

namespace cs2ac::admin_bridge {

// True when admin_system is loaded and its core (DB, config) is ready.
bool IsAvailable();

// seconds == 0 means permanent. fallbackCommand runs via ServerCommand if admin_system disappears
// before the queue is processed (may be empty). Slot is the engine slot (0..63).
void QueueBan(int slot, std::uint64_t steamId64, const std::string& name, int seconds, const std::string& reason,
			  const std::string& fallbackCommand, bool fallbackRequiresSlot);

// Call once per server frame, outside any per-client hook.
void ProcessQueue();

// Map change / unload: never drop a pending ban. Bans are written as offline bans (DB only, no
// kick); admin_system rejects the player on reconnect.
void FlushOffline();

// State cleanup used by the plugin's unload path.
void Reset();

} // namespace cs2ac::admin_bridge

```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/announce.cpp`:

```cpp
// cs2ac — announcements and the punishment command (utils/utils_print.cpp + cs2ac.cpp
// HandleDetection).
//
// The original built TextMsg payloads by hand for chat (with its {red}/{default} colour codes) and
// fired show_survival_respawn_status for the center-screen HTML, re-sending it every 100 ms for the
// duration. s2sdk exposes exactly those two mechanisms (PrintToChatColored* runs the same colour
// conversion, PrintCentreHtml* fires show_survival_respawn_status), so the port keeps the same
// output and the same re-send timer (driven from Plugin::OnUpdate instead of the engine timer).

#include "cs2ac.hpp"

#include <plugin_export.h>
#include <s2sdk/s2sdk.hpp>

namespace cs2ac {
namespace announce {

namespace {

std::string EscapeChatMarkup(const char* text)
{
	// The original prefixed the player name with a raw HUD control byte (0x08) and stripped control
	// characters; the byte is what colours the name inside the TextMsg parameter.
	std::string escaped;
	for (const unsigned char* current = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(text ? text : ""); *current; ++current) {
		if (*current < 0x20 || *current == 0x7f) {
			escaped += ' ';
		} else {
			escaped += static_cast<char>(*current);
		}
	}
	return escaped;
}

std::string EscapeHtml(const char* text)
{
	std::string escaped;
	for (const unsigned char* current = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(text ? text : ""); *current; ++current) {
		switch (*current) {
		case '&': escaped += "&amp;"; break;
		case '<': escaped += "&lt;"; break;
		case '>': escaped += "&gt;"; break;
		case '"': escaped += "&quot;"; break;
		case '\'': escaped += "&#39;"; break;
		default:
			if (*current < 0x20 || *current == 0x7f) {
				escaped += ' ';
			} else {
				escaped += static_cast<char>(*current);
			}
			break;
		}
	}
	return escaped;
}

// utils_print.cpp center-message state.
std::string detectionHtml;
std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point detectionHtmlExpires;
bool detectionHtmlTimerRunning;
bool detectionHtmlIsDetection;
bool detectionHtmlAlwaysVisible;
int detectionHtmlBroadcasts;
int detectionHtmlDuration = 5;
constexpr int maximumDetectionHtmlBroadcasts = 51;
// The original re-sent the center HTML from a 100 ms timer; the port pumps from the frame callback
// and keeps the same period (a per-frame send would be up to 64 broadcasts per second and would
// exhaust the broadcast budget in under a second instead of the intended five).
std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point nextHtmlResend {};
constexpr auto kHtmlResendInterval = std::chrono::milliseconds(100);

// Fork cs2ac_announce_cooldown state.
struct AnnounceThrottleEntry {
	std::string detection;
	DetectionOutcome outcome {DetectionOutcome::PunishmentSent};
	f64 last {};
};
std::unordered_map<u64, AnnounceThrottleEntry> announceThrottle;

f64 AnnounceNowSeconds()
{
	return std::chrono::duration<f64>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}

// Both sends are gated on a live map: the reset paths run on map start/shutdown, where a network
// message must not be posted (there is no client to receive it and the engine is tearing the world
// down).
void SendDetectionHtml(const char* message, int duration)
{
	if (!__s2sdk_PrintCentreHtmlAll || !engine::GameReady()) {
		return;
	}
	s2sdk::PrintCentreHtmlAll(message ? message : "<font></font>", duration);
}

void SendDetectionHtmlTo(int slot, const char* message, int duration)
{
	if (!__s2sdk_PrintCentreHtml || !engine::GameReady()) {
		return;
	}
	s2sdk::PrintCentreHtml(slot, message ? message : "<font></font>", duration);
}

// utils_print.cpp ShowCenterMessage.
void ShowCenterMessage(std::string message, bool isDetection = false, bool alwaysVisible = false, int duration = 5)
{
	const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
	if (!isDetection && detectionHtmlIsDetection && now < detectionHtmlExpires) {
		return;
	}
	detectionHtml = std::move(message);
	detectionHtmlExpires = now + std::chrono::seconds(duration);
	detectionHtmlIsDetection = isDetection;
	detectionHtmlAlwaysVisible = alwaysVisible;
	detectionHtmlDuration = duration;
	SendDetectionHtml(detectionHtml.c_str(), detectionHtmlDuration);
	detectionHtmlBroadcasts = 1;
	detectionHtmlTimerRunning = true;
}

} // namespace

std::string OutcomeText(DetectionOutcome outcome)
{
	switch (outcome) {
	case DetectionOutcome::PunishmentSent:
		return localization::Get("announcement.outcome.punishment_sent", " and sent the punishment.");
	case DetectionOutcome::ReportOnly:
		return localization::Get("announcement.outcome.report_only", ", but this finding is report-only.");
	case DetectionOutcome::Whitelisted:
		return localization::Get("announcement.outcome.whitelisted", ", but they are whitelisted.");
	case DetectionOutcome::PunishmentDisabled:
		return localization::Get("announcement.outcome.punishment_disabled", ", but punishment is disabled.");
	case DetectionOutcome::IdentityUnavailable:
		return localization::Get("announcement.outcome.identity_unavailable", ", but their identity is not ready yet.");
	case DetectionOutcome::AlreadyPunished:
		return localization::Get("announcement.outcome.already_punished", " and the punishment was already sent.");
	case DetectionOutcome::CommandTooLong:
		return localization::Get("announcement.outcome.command_too_long", ", but the punishment command is too long.");
	case DetectionOutcome::CommandServiceUnavailable:
		return localization::Get("announcement.outcome.command_service_unavailable", ", but the server command service is unavailable.");
	case DetectionOutcome::NetworkUnstable:
		return localization::Get("announcement.outcome.network_unstable", ", but no punishment was sent because their connection was unstable.");
	}
	return ".";
}

void AnnounceDetection(const char* detection, const char* playerName, DetectionOutcome outcome)
{
	if (!detection || !playerName) {
		return;
	}

	const std::string outcomeText = OutcomeText(outcome);
	std::string displayDetection = detection;
	for (char& character : displayDetection) {
		character = static_cast<char>(std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(character)));
	}
	if (settings::ShowChatAnnouncements() && __s2sdk_PrintToChatColoredAll && engine::GameReady()) {
		const std::string safeChatDetection = EscapeChatMarkup(displayDetection.c_str());
		const std::string safeChatPlayerName = EscapeChatMarkup(playerName);
		const std::string chatBody = localization::Format("announcement.detected", "detected {detection} on {player}{outcome}",
														  {{"detection", std::string("{lime}") + safeChatDetection + "{default}"},
														   {"player", std::string("{grey}") + safeChatPlayerName + "{default}"},
														   {"outcome", outcomeText}})
										  .localized;
		s2sdk::PrintToChatColoredAll("{red}[CS2AC]{default} " + plg::string(chatBody.c_str()));
	}

	if (!settings::ShowCenterAnnouncements()) {
		return;
	}

	const std::string safeDetection = EscapeHtml(displayDetection.c_str());
	const std::string safePlayerName = EscapeHtml(playerName);
	std::string centerBody = EscapeHtml(localization::Get("announcement.detected", "detected {detection} on {player}{outcome}").c_str());
	ReplaceAll(centerBody, "{detection}", "<span color='#00FF00'>" + safeDetection + "</span>");
	ReplaceAll(centerBody, "{player}", "<span color='#B0B0B0'>" + safePlayerName + "</span>");
	ReplaceAll(centerBody, "{outcome}", EscapeHtml(outcomeText.c_str()));
	ShowCenterMessage("<span class='fontSize-l'><span color='#FF0000'>[CS2AC]</span> <span color='#FFFFFF'>" + centerBody + "</span></span>", true);
}

void AnnounceDetectionThrottled(u64 steamId, const char* detection, const char* playerName, DetectionOutcome outcome, int cooldownSeconds)
{
	if (!detection || !playerName) {
		return;
	}
	if (steamId != 0 && cooldownSeconds > 0) {
		const f64 now = AnnounceNowSeconds();
		auto& entry = announceThrottle[steamId];
		if (entry.detection == detection && entry.outcome == outcome && now - entry.last < static_cast<f64>(cooldownSeconds)) {
			return;
		}
		entry.detection = detection;
		entry.outcome = outcome;
		entry.last = now;
	}
	AnnounceDetection(detection, playerName, outcome);
}

void AnnounceTest()
{
	static constexpr const char* text = "This is a test. No player was detected or punished.";
	const std::string localized = localization::Get("announcement.test", text);
	// The same live-map gate as AnnounceDetection: a `cs2ac_test_announcement` from rcon can land
	// between the map end and the next map start, where s2sdk's client queries (the broadcast
	// walks the client list) crash.
	if (settings::ShowChatAnnouncements() && __s2sdk_PrintToChatColoredAll && engine::GameReady()) {
		s2sdk::PrintToChatColoredAll(plg::string(("{red}[CS2AC]{default} " + localized).c_str()));
	} else {
		ConsoleMessage("The chat test was skipped because chat announcements are disabled.");
	}

	if (settings::ShowCenterAnnouncements()) {
		ShowCenterMessage("<span class='fontSize-l'><span color='#FF0000'>[CS2AC]</span> <span color='#FFFFFF'>" + EscapeHtml(localized.c_str())
						  + "</span></span>");
	} else {
		ConsoleMessage("The center-screen test was skipped because center announcements are disabled.");
	}
	ConsoleMessage("Test announcement finished: %s", text);
}

void AnnounceWatermarkTo(int slot, bool centerOnly)
{
	if (slot < 0 || slot >= MAXPLAYERS) {
		return;
	}
	if (!centerOnly) {
		if (settings::ShowChatAnnouncements() && __s2sdk_PrintToChatColored && engine::GameReady()) {
			const std::string chatBody = localization::Watermark({{"author", "{grey}karola3vax{default}"}}).localized;
			s2sdk::PrintToChatColored(slot, plg::string(("{red}[CS2AC]{default} " + chatBody).c_str()));
		}
		return;
	}

	std::string centerBody = EscapeHtml(localization::Watermark().localized.c_str());
	ReplaceAll(centerBody, "{author}", "<span color='#B0B0B0'>karola3vax</span>");
	const std::string message =
		"<span class='fontSize-l'><span color='#FF0000'>[CS2AC]</span> <span color='#FFFFFF'>" + centerBody + "</span></span>";
	SendDetectionHtmlTo(slot, message.c_str(), 3);
}

void ClearWatermarkFor(int slot)
{
	if (slot >= 0 && slot < MAXPLAYERS) {
		SendDetectionHtmlTo(slot, "<font></font>", 1);
	}
}

bool IsDetectionAnnouncementActive()
{
	return detectionHtmlIsDetection && std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < detectionHtmlExpires;
}

void ResetDetectionAnnouncement()
{
	if (!detectionHtml.empty()) {
		SendDetectionHtml("<font></font>", 1);
	}
	detectionHtml.clear();
	detectionHtmlExpires = {};
	detectionHtmlTimerRunning = false;
	detectionHtmlIsDetection = false;
	detectionHtmlAlwaysVisible = false;
	detectionHtmlBroadcasts = 0;
	nextHtmlResend = {};
	announceThrottle.clear();
}

// The original's StartTimer(ResendDetectionHtml, 0.1, ...) — pumped from OnGameFrame but throttled
// to the same 100 ms period: sending on every frame would be up to 64 broadcasts per second (and
// would burn the 51-broadcast budget in under a second instead of the intended five).
void OnGameFrame()
{
	if (!detectionHtmlTimerRunning) {
		return;
	}
	const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
	if (now < nextHtmlResend) {
		return;
	}
	nextHtmlResend = now + kHtmlResendInterval;
	if (!detectionHtmlAlwaysVisible && !settings::ShowCenterAnnouncements()) {
		detectionHtml.clear();
		detectionHtmlTimerRunning = false;
		detectionHtmlIsDetection = false;
		detectionHtmlAlwaysVisible = false;
		SendDetectionHtml("<font></font>", 1);
		return;
	}
	if (detectionHtml.empty()) {
		detectionHtmlTimerRunning = false;
		return;
	}
	if (now >= detectionHtmlExpires) {
		detectionHtml.clear();
		detectionHtmlTimerRunning = false;
		detectionHtmlIsDetection = false;
		detectionHtmlAlwaysVisible = false;
		SendDetectionHtml("<font></font>", 1);
		return;
	}
	if (detectionHtmlBroadcasts < maximumDetectionHtmlBroadcasts) {
		SendDetectionHtml(detectionHtml.c_str(), detectionHtmlDuration);
		++detectionHtmlBroadcasts;
	}
	// The next 100 ms re-send happens on the following frames (the original used a timer); the
	// pump runs every frame and the broadcast cap keeps the traffic identical.
}

} // namespace announce
} // namespace cs2ac

```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/config.cpp`:

```cpp
// cs2ac — settings: the original's ConVar table (settings.cpp) plus the cs2ac.cfg parser.
//
// The Metamod original registered 31 ConVars and let the engine `exec cs2ac.cfg`; under Plugify the
// plugin registers the same 31 ConVars through s2sdk (so console toggles like `cs2ac_aimbot_debug 1`
// behave identically) and reads configs/cs2ac/cs2ac.cfg itself, applying every `name value` line
// through SetConVar*. The trailing `cs2ac_config_loaded` marker keeps its original meaning: the
// config is only considered complete when the whole file was applied.

#include "core.hpp"

#include <charconv>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <sstream>

namespace cs2ac {

const char* const kDetectionNames[static_cast<size_t>(DetectionType::Count)] = {
	"AIMBOT",    "AIMLOCK",     "ANTIAIM",          "AUTOSTRAFE",   "BHOP",          "DLL INJECTION",      "DESUBTICKING",
	"DOUBLETAP", "HYPERSCROLL", "INHUMAN ACCURACY", "INVALID CVAR", "INVALID INPUT", "IRREGULAR BEHAVIOR", "NAMECHANGER",
	"NULLS",     "SILENTAIM",   "SUBTICK SPAM",     "TRIGGERBOT",
};

namespace settings {

const ConVarSpec kConVars[kConVarCount] = {
	{"cs2ac_enabled", "1", "Enable or disable CS2AC", false},
	{"cs2ac_aimbot_enabled", "1", "Detect damaging visible aim snaps", false},
	{"cs2ac_aimlock_enabled", "1", "Detect unnaturally precise target tracking", false},
	{"cs2ac_antiaim_enabled", "1", "Detect impossible or manipulated view angles", false},
	{"cs2ac_autostrafe_enabled", "1", "Detect automated air strafing", false},
```
