```cpp
// The original's Configuration struct state (the ConVar values live here; the engine side keeps
// its s2sdk ConVars in sync so console access works the same).
struct Configuration {
	std::string enabled {"1"};
	std::string detectionSettings[static_cast<size_t>(DetectionType::Count)]; // "1"/"0"
	std::string chatAnnouncements {"1"};
	std::string centerAnnouncements {"1"};
	std::string joinWatermark {"0"};
	std::string automaticUpdates {"0"};
	std::string updateRepository;
	std::string punishmentCommand {"css_addban {steamid64} 0 CS2AC: {detection}"};
	std::string kickCommand {"css_kick #{userid} CS2AC: {detection}"};
	std::string weakSignalPolicy {"report"};
	std::string banDetections {"AIMBOT,AIMLOCK,SILENTAIM,BACKTRACK,DLL INJECTION"};
	std::string kickDetections {"TRIGGER PATTERN,MOUSE MISMATCH,ANTIAIM"};
	std::string unstableKickDetections {"ANTIAIM"};
	std::string comboIgnoreDetections {"BHOP,NULLS"};
	std::string burstKickDetections {"DESUBTICKING"};
	std::string repeatBanDetections {"TRIGGER PATTERN,INVALID INPUT"};
	std::string repeatBanNeedsOther {"INVALID INPUT"};
	std::string streamKickDetections {"INVALID INPUT,NAMECHANGER"};
	std::string massGuardDetections {"DLL INJECTION"};
	std::string tickIntegrityEnabled {"1"};
	std::string backtrackRequireForged {"1"};
	std::string backtrackInterpReport {"0"};
	std::string triggerPatternEnabled {"1"};
	std::string rcsEnabled {"1"};
	std::string rcsReport {"0"};
	std::string webhookUrl;
	std::string webhookRoleId;
	std::string webhookServerAddress;
	std::string webhookLogoUrl;
	std::string language {"en"};
	std::string whitelist;
	std::string allowSvCheatsTesting {"0"};
	std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> debugValues;
	std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> numericValues;
};

Configuration* configuration {};
std::size_t rejectedWhitelistEntries {};
std::size_t duplicateWhitelistEntries {};
u64 settingsRevision {1};
u64 detectionMask {};
bool detectionMaskDirty {true};
bool pluginEnabled {};

std::vector<u64>& WhitelistedSteamIds()
{
	static std::vector<u64> steamIds;
	return steamIds;
}

void BumpRevisionInternal()
{
	if (++settingsRevision == 0) {
		settingsRevision = 1;
	}
}

bool ToBool(const std::string& value)
{
	return value == "1" || EqualsIgnoreCase(value, "true") || EqualsIgnoreCase(value, "yes");
}

// settings.cpp OnWhitelistChanged
void RebuildWhitelist(const std::string& raw)
{
	auto& steamIds = WhitelistedSteamIds();
	steamIds.clear();
	rejectedWhitelistEntries = 0;
	duplicateWhitelistEntries = 0;
	std::string value = raw;
	std::replace(value.begin(), value.end(), ',', ' ');
	std::replace(value.begin(), value.end(), ';', ' ');
	std::istringstream entries(value);
	for (std::string entry; entries >> entry;) {
		u64 steamId = 0;
		const auto parsed = std::from_chars(entry.data(), entry.data() + entry.size(), steamId);
		if (parsed.ec == std::errc() && parsed.ptr == entry.data() + entry.size() && steamId != 0) {
			steamIds.push_back(steamId);
		} else {
			++rejectedWhitelistEntries;
		}
	}
	std::sort(steamIds.begin(), steamIds.end());
	const std::size_t parsedEntries = steamIds.size();
	steamIds.erase(std::unique(steamIds.begin(), steamIds.end()), steamIds.end());
	duplicateWhitelistEntries = parsedEntries - steamIds.size();
}

const char* DetectionSettingName(DetectionType detection)
{
	switch (detection) {
	case DetectionType::Aimbot: return "cs2ac_aimbot_enabled";
	case DetectionType::Aimlock: return "cs2ac_aimlock_enabled";
	case DetectionType::AntiAim: return "cs2ac_antiaim_enabled";
	case DetectionType::Autostrafe: return "cs2ac_autostrafe_enabled";
	case DetectionType::Bhop: return "cs2ac_bhop_enabled";
	case DetectionType::DllInjection: return "cs2ac_dll_injection_enabled";
	case DetectionType::Desubticking: return "cs2ac_desubticking_enabled";
	case DetectionType::Doubletap: return "cs2ac_doubletap_enabled";
	case DetectionType::Hyperscroll: return "cs2ac_hyperscroll_enabled";
	case DetectionType::InhumanAccuracy: return "cs2ac_inhuman_accuracy_enabled";
	case DetectionType::InvalidCvar: return "cs2ac_invalid_cvar_enabled";
	case DetectionType::InvalidInput: return "cs2ac_invalid_input_enabled";
	case DetectionType::IrregularBehavior: return "cs2ac_irregular_behavior_enabled";
	case DetectionType::NameChanger: return "cs2ac_namechanger_enabled";
	case DetectionType::Nulls: return "cs2ac_nulls_enabled";
	case DetectionType::SilentAim: return "cs2ac_silentaim_enabled";
	case DetectionType::SubtickSpam: return "cs2ac_subtick_spam_enabled";
	case DetectionType::Triggerbot: return "cs2ac_triggerbot_enabled";
	case DetectionType::Count: break;
	}
	return "";
}

bool DetectionSetting(DetectionType detection)
{
	if (!configuration) {
		return false;
	}
	const auto index = static_cast<std::size_t>(detection);
	if (index >= static_cast<std::size_t>(DetectionType::Count)) {
		return false;
	}
	return ToBool(configuration->detectionSettings[index]);
}

} // namespace

void Reset()
{
	// Reset runs on every (re)start; the previous table must not be leaked into the new run.
	delete configuration;
	configuration = new Configuration;
	for (auto& value : configuration->detectionSettings) {
		value = "1";
	}
	for (const auto& spec : kDebugConVars) {
		configuration->debugValues[spec.name] = "0";
	}
	for (const auto& spec : kNumericConVars) {
		configuration->numericValues[spec.name] = spec.defaultValue;
	}
	detectionMaskDirty = true;
	pluginEnabled = false;
	settingsRevision = 1;
	RebuildWhitelist(configuration->whitelist);
}

bool IsPluginEnabled()
{
	GetDetectionMask();
	return pluginEnabled;
}

bool IsDetectionEnabled(DetectionType detection)
{
	const auto index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(detection);
	return index < static_cast<std::uint8_t>(DetectionType::Count) && (GetDetectionMask() & (u64 {1} << index)) != 0;
}

bool IsPlayerWhitelisted(u64 steamId)
{
	const auto& steamIds = WhitelistedSteamIds();
	return steamId != 0 && std::binary_search(steamIds.begin(), steamIds.end(), steamId);
}

std::size_t GetWhitelistCount() { return WhitelistedSteamIds().size(); }
std::size_t GetRejectedWhitelistCount() { return rejectedWhitelistEntries; }
std::size_t GetDuplicateWhitelistCount() { return duplicateWhitelistEntries; }

std::size_t GetEnabledDetectionCount()
{
	const u64 mask = GetDetectionMask();
	std::size_t count = 0;
	for (std::uint8_t index = 0; index < static_cast<std::uint8_t>(DetectionType::Count); ++index) {
		count += (mask >> index) & 1;
	}
	return count;
}

u64 GetDetectionMask()
{
	if (!detectionMaskDirty) {
		return detectionMask;
	}
	detectionMask = 0;
	pluginEnabled = configuration && ToBool(configuration->enabled);
	if (pluginEnabled) {
		for (std::uint8_t index = 0; index < static_cast<std::uint8_t>(DetectionType::Count); ++index) {
			if (DetectionSetting(static_cast<DetectionType>(index))) {
				detectionMask |= u64 {1} << index;
			}
		}
	}
	detectionMaskDirty = false;
	return detectionMask;
}

u64 GetRevision() { return settingsRevision; }
bool ShowChatAnnouncements() { return configuration && ToBool(configuration->chatAnnouncements); }
bool ShowCenterAnnouncements() { return configuration && ToBool(configuration->centerAnnouncements); }
bool ShowJoinWatermark() { return configuration && ToBool(configuration->joinWatermark); }
bool AutomaticUpdatesEnabled()
{
	// A fork must opt in to its own release repository before the updater is allowed to run.
	return configuration && ToBool(configuration->automaticUpdates) && !configuration->updateRepository.empty();
}
bool WeakSignalsKick() { return configuration && EqualsIgnoreCase(configuration->weakSignalPolicy, "kick"); }
const char* GetUpdateRepository() { return configuration ? configuration->updateRepository.c_str() : ""; }
const char* GetPunishmentCommand() { return configuration ? configuration->punishmentCommand.c_str() : ""; }
const char* GetKickCommand() { return configuration ? configuration->kickCommand.c_str() : ""; }

bool BoolSetting(const char* name, bool defaultValue)
{
	if (!configuration || !name) {
		return defaultValue;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_join_watermark")) {
		return ToBool(configuration->joinWatermark);
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_tick_integrity_enabled")) {
		return ToBool(configuration->tickIntegrityEnabled);
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_backtrack_require_forged")) {
		return ToBool(configuration->backtrackRequireForged);
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_backtrack_interp_report")) {
		return ToBool(configuration->backtrackInterpReport);
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_trigger_pattern_enabled")) {
		return ToBool(configuration->triggerPatternEnabled);
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_rcs_enabled")) {
		return ToBool(configuration->rcsEnabled);
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_rcs_report")) {
		return ToBool(configuration->rcsReport);
	}
	// The rest use the live debug/boolean resolver (console changes included).
	return settings::DebugFlag(name);
}

f32 FloatSetting(const char* name, f32 defaultValue)
{
	if (!configuration || !name) {
		return defaultValue;
	}
	const auto found = configuration->numericValues.find(name);
	if (found == configuration->numericValues.end()) {
		return defaultValue;
	}
	char* end = nullptr;
	const f32 value = std::strtof(found->second.c_str(), &end);
	return end != found->second.c_str() && std::isfinite(value) ? value : defaultValue;
}

int IntSetting(const char* name, int defaultValue)
{
	if (!configuration || !name) {
		return defaultValue;
	}
	const auto found = configuration->numericValues.find(name);
	if (found == configuration->numericValues.end()) {
		return defaultValue;
	}
	char* end = nullptr;
	const long value = std::strtol(found->second.c_str(), &end, 10);
	return end != found->second.c_str() ? static_cast<int>(value) : defaultValue;
}
const char* GetWebhookUrl() { return configuration ? configuration->webhookUrl.c_str() : ""; }
const char* GetWebhookRoleId() { return configuration ? configuration->webhookRoleId.c_str() : ""; }
const char* GetWebhookServerAddress() { return configuration ? configuration->webhookServerAddress.c_str() : ""; }
const char* GetWebhookLogoUrl() { return configuration ? configuration->webhookLogoUrl.c_str() : ""; }
const char* GetLanguage() { return configuration ? configuration->language.c_str() : "en"; }
bool AllowSvCheatsTesting() { return configuration && ToBool(configuration->allowSvCheatsTesting); }

bool DebugFlagValue(const char* convarName)
{
	if (!configuration || !convarName) {
		return false;
	}
	const auto found = configuration->debugValues.find(convarName);
	return found != configuration->debugValues.end() && ToBool(found->second);
}

namespace {
std::function<bool(const char*)>& DebugResolver()
{
	static std::function<bool(const char*)> resolver;
	return resolver;
}
} // namespace

void SetDebugResolver(std::function<bool(const char*)> resolver)
{
	DebugResolver() = std::move(resolver);
}

bool DebugFlag(const char* convarName)
{
	// Live ConVar first (console toggles), then the configured value.
	if (DebugResolver() && convarName) {
		return DebugResolver()(convarName);
	}
	return DebugFlagValue(convarName);
}

void MarkConfigReloaded() { BumpRevisionInternal(); }

void BumpRevision()
{
	BumpRevisionInternal();
	detectionMaskDirty = true;
}

void SetDetectionSetting(DetectionType detection, bool value)
{
	if (!configuration) {
		return;
	}
	const auto index = static_cast<std::size_t>(detection);
	if (index < static_cast<std::size_t>(DetectionType::Count)) {
		configuration->detectionSettings[index] = value ? "1" : "0";
		BumpRevision();
	}
}

void SetEnabled(bool value)
{
	if (configuration) {
		configuration->enabled = value ? "1" : "0";
		BumpRevision();
	}
}

void SetAnnouncements(bool chat, bool center)
{
	if (configuration) {
		configuration->chatAnnouncements = chat ? "1" : "0";
		configuration->centerAnnouncements = center ? "1" : "0";
	}
}

void SetWhitelist(const char* value)
{
	if (!configuration) {
		return;
	}
	configuration->whitelist = value ? value : "";
	RebuildWhitelist(configuration->whitelist);
	BumpRevisionInternal();
}

// settings::SetBool / SetString — the config loader's entry points, keyed by ConVar name.
void SetBool(const char* name, bool value)
{
	if (!configuration || !name) {
		return;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_enabled")) {
		SetEnabled(value);
		return;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_chat_announcements")) {
		configuration->chatAnnouncements = value ? "1" : "0";
		return;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_center_announcements")) {
		configuration->centerAnnouncements = value ? "1" : "0";
		return;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_auto_update")) {
		configuration->automaticUpdates = value ? "1" : "0";
		return;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_join_watermark")) {
		configuration->joinWatermark = value ? "1" : "0";
		return;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_tick_integrity_enabled")) {
		configuration->tickIntegrityEnabled = value ? "1" : "0";
		return;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_backtrack_require_forged")) {
		configuration->backtrackRequireForged = value ? "1" : "0";
		return;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_backtrack_interp_report")) {
		configuration->backtrackInterpReport = value ? "1" : "0";
		return;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_trigger_pattern_enabled")) {
		configuration->triggerPatternEnabled = value ? "1" : "0";
		return;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_rcs_enabled")) {
		configuration->rcsEnabled = value ? "1" : "0";
		return;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_rcs_report")) {
		configuration->rcsReport = value ? "1" : "0";
		return;
	}
	if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, "cs2ac_allow_sv_cheats_testing")) {
		configuration->allowSvCheatsTesting = value ? "1" : "0";
		return;
	}
	for (std::uint8_t index = 0; index < static_cast<std::uint8_t>(DetectionType::Count); ++index) {
		if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, DetectionSettingName(static_cast<DetectionType>(index)))) {
			SetDetectionSetting(static_cast<DetectionType>(index), value);
			return;
		}
	}
	for (const auto& spec : kDebugConVars) {
		if (EqualsIgnoreCase(name, spec.name)) {
			configuration->debugValues[spec.name] = value ? "1" : "0";
			return;
		}
	}
}

void SetString(const char* name, const char* value)
{
	if (!configuration || !name) {
		return;
	}
	const std::string text = value ? value : "";

void SetInt(const char* name, int value)
{
	if (!configuration || !name) {
		return;
	}
	for (const auto& spec : kNumericConVars) {
		if (!spec.isFloat && EqualsIgnoreCase(name, spec.name)) {
			configuration->numericValues[spec.name] = std::to_string(value);
			return;
		}
	}
}

void SetFloat(const char* name, f32 value)
{
	if (!configuration || !name) {
		return;
	}
	for (const auto& spec : kNumericConVars) {
		if (spec.isFloat && EqualsIgnoreCase(name, spec.name)) {
			char buffer[32];
			std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%g", static_cast<double>(value));
			configuration->numericValues[spec.name] = buffer;
			return;
		}
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// cs2ac.cfg parser
//
// The engine's exec format: one `name value` per line, `//` comments, optional double quotes around
// strings, values may contain spaces when quoted. The trailing `cs2ac_config_loaded` line has no
// value and is reported as such (name set, value empty) so the caller can treat it as the marker.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

std::vector<ConfigLine> ParseConfigFile(const std::string& contents)
{
	std::vector<ConfigLine> lines;
	std::istringstream stream(contents);
	std::string raw;
	u32 lineNumber = 0;
	while (std::getline(stream, raw)) {
		++lineNumber;
		// Strip trailing CR (the shipped files are CRLF/LF mixed).
		if (!raw.empty() && raw.back() == '\r') {
			raw.pop_back();
		}
		// Trim leading whitespace.
		std::size_t start = raw.find_first_not_of(" \t");
		if (start == std::string::npos) {
			continue;
		}
		// Comments (full-line or trailing, outside quotes).
		bool inQuotes = false;
		std::size_t commentAt = std::string::npos;
		for (std::size_t index = start; index + 1 < raw.size(); ++index) {
			if (raw[index] == '"') {
				inQuotes = !inQuotes;
			} else if (!inQuotes && raw[index] == '/' && raw[index + 1] == '/') {
				commentAt = index;
				break;
			}
		}
		std::string line = raw.substr(start, commentAt == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : commentAt - start);
		while (!line.empty() && (line.back() == ' ' || line.back() == '\t')) {
			line.pop_back();
		}
		if (line.empty()) {
			continue;
		}
		// name [value]
		const std::size_t split = line.find_first_of(" \t");
		ConfigLine entry;
		entry.line = lineNumber;
		entry.name = split == std::string::npos ? line : line.substr(0, split);
		if (split != std::string::npos) {
			std::string value = line.substr(split);
			const std::size_t valueStart = value.find_first_not_of(" \t");
			value = valueStart == std::string::npos ? std::string {} : value.substr(valueStart);
			// Strip one layer of surrounding quotes (the cfg quoting).
			if (value.size() >= 2 && value.front() == '"' && value.back() == '"') {
				value = value.substr(1, value.size() - 2);
			}
			entry.value = value;
		}
		lines.push_back(std::move(entry));
	}
	return lines;
}

// cs2ac.cpp CheckCommandTemplate (identical output).
int CheckCommandTemplate(const char* settingName, const char* commandTemplate, bool requireSteamId)
{
	auto log = [](const std::string& message) { std::printf("%s\n", message.c_str()); };
	if (!commandTemplate || !*commandTemplate) {
		log(FormatString("[CS2AC] Review %s: it is empty, so this punishment is disabled.", settingName));
		return 1;
	}

	int findings = 0;
	bool hasSteamId = false;
	bool hasUserId = false;
	const std::string command = commandTemplate;
	if ((command.rfind("mm_ban", 0) == 0 || command.rfind("!ban", 0) == 0) && command.find("{userid}") != std::string::npos) {
		log(FormatString("[CS2AC] Review %s: mm_ban with {userid} is unsafe - admin_system reads short numbers as a player slot. Use "
						 "{steamid64}.",
						 settingName));
		++findings;
	}
	if (command.front() == '"' || command.back() == '"') {
		log(FormatString("[CS2AC] Review %s: the command itself starts or ends with a quote. Keep only the cfg value's outer quotes.", settingName));
		++findings;
	}
	for (size_t position = 0; position < command.size();) {
		const size_t open = command.find('{', position);
		const size_t close = command.find('}', position);
		if (close != std::string::npos && (open == std::string::npos || close < open)) {
			log(FormatString("[CS2AC] Review %s: it contains an unmatched closing brace.", settingName));
			++findings;
			position = close + 1;
			continue;
		}
		if (open == std::string::npos) {
			break;
		}
		const size_t placeholderEnd = command.find('}', open + 1);
		if (placeholderEnd == std::string::npos) {
			log(FormatString("[CS2AC] Review %s: it contains an unmatched opening brace.", settingName));
			++findings;
			break;
		}

		const std::string placeholder = command.substr(open, placeholderEnd - open + 1);
		hasSteamId |= placeholder == "{steamid64}";
		hasUserId |= placeholder == "{userid}";
		if (placeholder != "{steamid64}" && placeholder != "{userid}" && placeholder != "{detection}") {
			log(FormatString("[CS2AC] Review %s: %s is not a supported placeholder.", settingName, SanitizeConsoleText(placeholder.c_str()).c_str()));
			++findings;
		}
		position = placeholderEnd + 1;
	}

	if (requireSteamId && !hasSteamId) {
		log(FormatString("[CS2AC] Review %s: permanent bans need the {steamid64} placeholder.", settingName));
		++findings;
	}
	if (!requireSteamId && !hasSteamId && !hasUserId) {
		log(FormatString("[CS2AC] Review %s: kicks need either {userid} or {steamid64}.", settingName));
		++findings;
	}

	// The engine's command length limit (CCommand::MaxCommandLength()).
	constexpr size_t kMaxCommandLength = 512;
	std::string expanded = command;
	ReplaceAll(expanded, "{steamid64}", "18446744073709551615");
	ReplaceAll(expanded, "{userid}", "2147483647");
	ReplaceAll(expanded, "{detection}", "IRREGULAR BEHAVIOR");
	if (expanded.size() >= kMaxCommandLength) {
		log(FormatString("[CS2AC] Review %s: its expanded command can exceed the engine limit.", settingName));
		++findings;
	}
	return findings;
}

} // namespace cs2ac

```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/core.cpp`:

```cpp
// cs2ac — engine-free core: math, string helpers, the usercmd protobuf reader and the pure
// scoring helpers the unit tests exercise.
//
// Ported from the original's utils/utils.cpp, detection/detection_system.cpp (the geometry
// helpers), movement_analysis/detection/detectors/{nulls,subtick,strafe_optimizer}.cpp
// and the scoring constants of the detection modules. Nothing here may call into s2sdk.

#include "core.hpp"

#include <cctype>
#include <charconv>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <sstream>

namespace cs2ac {

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Math (utils/utils.cpp)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

f32 NormalizeDeg(f32 value)
{
	// fmod instead of the original's subtract-until-in-range loops: a client can send an absurd
	// (but finite) angle, and the loop would then take effectively forever on the game thread.
	if (!std::isfinite(value)) {
		return value;
	}
	f32 normalized = std::fmod(value, 360.0f);
	if (normalized > 180.0f) {
		normalized -= 360.0f;
	} else if (normalized < -180.0f) {
		normalized += 360.0f;
	}
	return normalized;
}

f32 GetAngleDifference(f32 source, f32 target, f32 circle, bool relative)
{
	f32 difference = std::fmod(target - source, circle * 2.0f);
	if (difference > circle) {
		difference -= circle * 2.0f;
	} else if (difference < -circle) {
		difference += circle * 2.0f;
	}
	return relative ? difference : std::fabs(difference);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// String helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

void ReplaceAll(std::string& value, const std::string_view placeholder, const std::string_view replacement)
{
	if (placeholder.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	for (size_t position = 0; (position = value.find(placeholder, position)) != std::string::npos; position += replacement.size()) {
		value.replace(position, placeholder.size(), replacement);
	}
}

std::string SanitizeConsoleText(const char* value)
{
	std::string safe = value ? value : "<unknown>";
	for (char& character : safe) {
		const auto byte = static_cast<unsigned char>(character);
		if (byte < 32 || byte == 127) {
			character = '?';
		}
	}
	return safe;
}

bool IsNumeric(const char* str)
{
	if (!str || !*str) {
		return false;
	}
	char* end = nullptr;
	const double value = std::strtod(str, &end);
	return end && *end == '\0' && std::isfinite(value);
}

std::string FormatStringV(const char* format, va_list arguments)
{
	va_list copy;
	va_copy(copy, arguments);
	const int needed = std::vsnprintf(nullptr, 0, format, copy);
	va_end(copy);
	if (needed <= 0) {
		return {};
	}
	std::string result(static_cast<size_t>(needed), '\0');
	va_list second;
	va_copy(second, arguments);
	std::vsnprintf(result.data(), result.size() + 1, format, second);
	va_end(second);
	return result;
}

std::string FormatString(const char* format, ...)
{
	va_list arguments;
	va_start(arguments, format);
	std::string result = FormatStringV(format, arguments);
	va_end(arguments);
	return result;
}

std::string ToLower(std::string value)
{
	for (char& character : value) {
		character = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(character)));
	}
	return value;
}

std::string ToUpper(std::string value)
{
	for (char& character : value) {
		character = static_cast<char>(std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(character)));
	}
	return value;
}

bool EqualsIgnoreCase(std::string_view first, std::string_view second)
{
	if (first.size() != second.size()) {
		return false;
	}
	for (size_t index = 0; index < first.size(); ++index) {
		if (std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(first[index])) != std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(second[index]))) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

namespace {
char ConvertColorStringToByte(const char* str, size_t length)
{
	switch (length) {
	case 3:
		if (!std::memcmp(str, "red", length)) {
			return 7;
		}
		break;
	case 4:
		if (!std::memcmp(str, "lime", length)) {
			return 6;
		}
		if (!std::memcmp(str, "grey", length)) {
			return 8;
		}
		break;
	case 7:
		if (!std::memcmp(str, "default", length)) {
			return 1;
		}
		break;
	}
	return 0;
}
} // namespace

// utils/utils_print.cpp utils::CFormat (byte-for-byte the original).
bool CFormat(char* buffer, u64 bufferSize, const char* text)
{
	if (!buffer || bufferSize == 0 || !text) {
		return false;
	}
	char* result = buffer;
	char* const resultEnd = buffer + bufferSize;
	const auto hasEnoughSpace = [&](uintptr_t space) { return static_cast<uintptr_t>(resultEnd - result) > space; };
	if (!hasEnoughSpace(1)) {
		return false;
	}
	*result++ = ' ';
	const char* current = text;
	while (*current) {
		if (*current == '{' && *(current + 1) == '{') {
			if (!hasEnoughSpace(1)) {
				return false;
			}
			current += 2;
			*result++ = '{';
			continue;
		}
		if (*current == '{') {
			const char* start = current + 1;
			const char* end = start;
			while (*end && *end != '}') {
				++end;
			}
			if (*end == '}') {
				const char color = ConvertColorStringToByte(start, static_cast<size_t>(end - start));
				if (color) {
					if (!hasEnoughSpace(1)) {
						return false;
					}
					*result++ = color;
					current = end + 1;
					continue;
				}
			}
			// Not a colour tag: fall through and copy the '{' literally.
		}
		if (!hasEnoughSpace(1)) {
			return false;
		}
		*result++ = *current++;
	}
	if (!hasEnoughSpace(1)) {
		return false;
	}
	*result = '\0';
	return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Usercmd protobuf reader
//
// CSGOUserCmdPB (cs_usercmd.proto) embedded at PlayerCommand+16 (sdk/usercmd.h: vptr + cmdNum +
// 4 unknown bytes, then the message). Field numbers are the wire values of the current layout:
//   CSGOUserCmdPB            base=1  input_history=2  attack1_start_history_index=6
//   CBaseUserCmdPB           command_number=1 client_tick=2 buttons_pb=3 viewangles=4 mousedx=11
//                            mousedy=12 consumed_server_angle_changes=13 subtick_moves=18
//   CSubtickMoveStep         button=1 pressed=2 when=3 analog_forward_delta=4 analog_left_delta=5
//                            pitch_delta=6 yaw_delta=7
//   CSGOInputHistoryEntryPB  view_angles=2 render_tick_count=3 render_tick_fraction=4
//                            sv_interp0=5 sv_interp1=6 cl_interp=7 player_tick_count=8
//   SVInterpInfo/CLInterpInfo src_tick=1 dst_tick=2 frac=3
//   CInButtonStatePB         buttonstate1=1 buttonstate2=2 buttonstate3=3
//   CMsgQAngle               x=1 y=2 z=3
// The tick-integrity fields (render time, interp windows, player tick) are what fork v5-v11 reads;
// cs2ac_usercmd_dump prints whether each was present so the numbers can be confirmed live.
// The reader reports what it actually saw (UsercmdView::fieldsSeen) so cs2ac_usercmd_dump can be
// used to confirm the layout on a running server; unknown fields are skipped by wire type.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

namespace {

// bits of UsercmdView::fieldsSeen
enum : u32 {
	kSeenBase = 1u << 0,
	kSeenClientTick = 1u << 1,
	kSeenViewAngles = 1u << 2,
	kSeenButtons = 1u << 3,
	kSeenSubtick = 1u << 4,
	kSeenHistory = 1u << 5,
	kSeenAttackIndex = 1u << 6,
	kSeenMouse = 1u << 7,
	kSeenTickIntegrity = 1u << 8,
};

class ProtoReader {
public:
	ProtoReader(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) : cursor(data), end(data + size) {}

	[[nodiscard]] bool Eof() const { return cursor >= end; }
	[[nodiscard]] size_t Remaining() const { return static_cast<size_t>(end - cursor); }

	bool Varint(u64& value)
	{
		value = 0;
		for (int shift = 0; shift <= 63; shift += 7) {
			if (cursor >= end) {
				return false;
			}
			const uint8_t byte = *cursor++;
			value |= static_cast<u64>(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
			if ((byte & 0x80) == 0) {
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	bool Bytes(const uint8_t*& data, size_t& length)
	{
		u64 size = 0;
		if (!Varint(size) || size > Remaining()) {
			return false;
		}
		data = cursor;
		length = static_cast<size_t>(size);
		cursor += size;
		return true;
	}

	bool Fixed32(u32& value)
	{
		if (Remaining() < 4) {
			return false;
		}
		std::memcpy(&value, cursor, 4);
		cursor += 4;
		return true;
	}

	bool Float(f32& value)
	{
		u32 raw = 0;
		if (!Fixed32(raw)) {
			return false;
		}
		std::memcpy(&value, &raw, 4);
		return true;
	}

	bool Skip(u32 wireType)
	{
		switch (wireType) {
		case 0: {
			u64 ignored = 0;
			return Varint(ignored);
		}
		case 1:
			if (Remaining() < 8) {
				return false;
			}
			cursor += 8;
			return true;
		case 2: {
			const uint8_t* ignoredData = nullptr;
			size_t ignoredLength = 0;
			return Bytes(ignoredData, ignoredLength);
		}
		case 5:
			if (Remaining() < 4) {
				return false;
			}
			cursor += 4;
			return true;
		default:
			return false; // groups / invalid
		}
	}

private:
	const uint8_t* cursor;
	const uint8_t* end;
};

bool ParseQAngle(const uint8_t* data, size_t size, QAngle& out)
{
	ProtoReader reader(data, size);
	out = {};
	while (!reader.Eof()) {
		u64 tag = 0;
		if (!reader.Varint(tag)) {
			return false;
		}
		const u32 field = static_cast<u32>(tag >> 3);
		const u32 wireType = static_cast<u32>(tag & 0x7);
		if (wireType == 5) {
			f32 value = 0.0f;
			if (!reader.Float(value)) {
				return false;
			}
			if (field == 1) {
				out.x = value;
			} else if (field == 2) {
				out.y = value;
			} else if (field == 3) {
				out.z = value;
			}
		} else if (!reader.Skip(wireType)) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

// SVInterpInfo / CLInterpInfo: src_tick=1 dst_tick=2 frac=3.
bool ParseInterpInfo(const uint8_t* data, size_t size, InterpInfo& out)
{
	ProtoReader reader(data, size);
	out = {};
	while (!reader.Eof()) {
		u64 tag = 0;
		if (!reader.Varint(tag)) {
			return false;
		}
		const u32 field = static_cast<u32>(tag >> 3);
		const u32 wireType = static_cast<u32>(tag & 0x7);
		if (wireType == 0) {
			u64 value = 0;
			if (!reader.Varint(value)) {
				return false;
			}
			if (field == 1) {
				out.hasSrcTick = true;
				out.srcTick = static_cast<i32>(value);
			} else if (field == 2) {
				out.hasDstTick = true;
				out.dstTick = static_cast<i32>(value);
			}
		} else if (wireType == 5) {
			f32 value = 0.0f;
			if (!reader.Float(value)) {
				return false;
			}
			if (field == 3) {
				out.hasFrac = true;
				out.frac = value;
			}
		} else if (!reader.Skip(wireType)) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

bool ParseButtons(const uint8_t* data, size_t size, UsercmdView& view)
{
	ProtoReader reader(data, size);
	while (!reader.Eof()) {
		u64 tag = 0;
		if (!reader.Varint(tag)) {
			return false;
		}
		const u32 field = static_cast<u32>(tag >> 3);
		const u32 wireType = static_cast<u32>(tag & 0x7);
		if (wireType == 0) {
			u64 value = 0;
			if (!reader.Varint(value)) {
				return false;
			}
			if (field == 1) {
				view.buttonState1 = value;
			} else if (field == 2) {
				view.buttonState2 = value;
			} else if (field == 3) {
				view.buttonState3 = value;
			}
		} else if (!reader.Skip(wireType)) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenButtons;
	return true;
}

bool ParseSubtickMove(const uint8_t* data, size_t size, SubtickMove& move)
{
	ProtoReader reader(data, size);
	while (!reader.Eof()) {
		u64 tag = 0;
		if (!reader.Varint(tag)) {
			return false;
		}
		const u32 field = static_cast<u32>(tag >> 3);
		const u32 wireType = static_cast<u32>(tag & 0x7);
		switch (wireType) {
		case 0: {
			u64 value = 0;
			if (!reader.Varint(value)) {
				return false;
			}
			if (field == 1) {
				move.hasButton = true;
				move.button = value;
			} else if (field == 2) {
				move.pressed = value != 0;
			}
			break;
		}
		case 5: {
			f32 value = 0.0f;
			if (!reader.Float(value)) {
				return false;
			}
			switch (field) {
			case 3:
				move.when = value;
				break;
			case 4:
				move.hasAnalogForwardDelta = true;
				move.analogForwardDelta = value;
				break;
			case 5:
				move.hasAnalogLeftDelta = true;
				move.analogLeftDelta = value;
				break;
			case 6:
				move.hasPitchDelta = true;
				move.pitchDelta = value;
				break;
			case 7:
				move.hasYawDelta = true;
				move.yawDelta = value;
				break;
			default:
				break;
			}
			break;
		}
		default:
			if (!reader.Skip(wireType)) {
				return false;
			}
			break;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

bool ParseBaseUserCmd(const uint8_t* data, size_t size, UsercmdView& view)
{
	ProtoReader reader(data, size);
	bool ok = true;
	while (!reader.Eof() && ok) {
		u64 tag = 0;
		if (!reader.Varint(tag)) {
			return false;
		}
		const u32 field = static_cast<u32>(tag >> 3);
		const u32 wireType = static_cast<u32>(tag & 0x7);
		if (wireType == 0) {
			u64 value = 0;
			if (!reader.Varint(value)) {
				return false;
			}
			if (field == 1) {
				view.commandNumber = static_cast<i32>(value);
			} else if (field == 2) {
				view.hasClientTick = true;
				view.clientTick = static_cast<i32>(value);
				view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenClientTick;
			} else if (field == 11) {
				view.hasMouseDx = true;
				view.mouseDx = static_cast<i32>(value);
				view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenMouse;
			} else if (field == 12) {
				view.hasMouseDy = true;
				view.mouseDy = static_cast<i32>(value);
				view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenMouse;
			} else if (field == 13) {
				view.hasConsumedServerAngleChanges = true;
				view.consumedServerAngleChanges = static_cast<u32>(value);
				view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenTickIntegrity;
			}
		} else if (wireType == 2) {
			const uint8_t* payload = nullptr;
			size_t length = 0;
			if (!reader.Bytes(payload, length)) {
				return false;
			}
			if (field == 3) {
				ok = ParseButtons(payload, length, view);
			} else if (field == 4) {
				QAngle angles;
				if (ParseQAngle(payload, length, angles)) {
					view.hasViewAngles = true;
					view.viewAngles = angles;
					view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenViewAngles;
				}
			} else if (field == 18) {
				SubtickMove move;
				if (ParseSubtickMove(payload, length, move)) {
					view.subtickMoves.push_back(move);
					view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenSubtick;
				}
			}
		} else if (!reader.Skip(wireType)) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	view.hasBase = true;
	view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenBase;
	return true;
}

} // namespace

bool ParseUserCmdMessage(const void* message, size_t available, UsercmdView& view)
{
	view = UsercmdView {};
	if (!message || available == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	// The reader is bounded by the caller's byte count: a message shorter than the object it is
	// embedded in stops at the invalid tag it meets next, and a message at the very end of an array
	// can never read past it.
	const auto* data = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(message);
	ProtoReader reader(data, available);
	bool ok = true;
	while (!reader.Eof() && ok) {
		u64 tag = 0;
		if (!reader.Varint(tag)) {
			break; // ran into padding after the message: stop, keep what we parsed
		}
		const u32 field = static_cast<u32>(tag >> 3);
		const u32 wireType = static_cast<u32>(tag & 0x7);
		if (wireType == 0) {
			u64 value = 0;
			if (!reader.Varint(value)) {
				break;
			}
			if (field == 6) {
				view.attack1StartHistoryIndex = static_cast<i32>(value);
				view.hasAttack1StartHistoryIndex = true;
				view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenAttackIndex;
			}
		} else if (wireType == 2) {
			const uint8_t* payload = nullptr;
			size_t length = 0;
			if (!reader.Bytes(payload, length)) {
				break;
			}
			if (field == 1) {
				ok = ParseBaseUserCmd(payload, length, view);
			} else if (field == 2) {
				InputHistoryEntry entry;
				// CSGOInputHistoryEntryPB: view_angles=2 render_tick_count=3 render_tick_fraction=4
				// sv_interp0=5 sv_interp1=6 cl_interp=7 player_tick_count=8.
				ProtoReader history(payload, length);
				while (!history.Eof()) {
					u64 innerTag = 0;
					if (!history.Varint(innerTag)) {
						break;
					}
					const u32 innerField = static_cast<u32>(innerTag >> 3);
					const u32 innerWire = static_cast<u32>(innerTag & 0x7);
					if (innerWire == 2 && (innerField == 2 || innerField == 5 || innerField == 6 || innerField == 7)) {
						const uint8_t* nestedPayload = nullptr;
						size_t nestedLength = 0;
						if (!history.Bytes(nestedPayload, nestedLength)) {
							break;
						}
						if (innerField == 2) {
							QAngle angles;
							if (ParseQAngle(nestedPayload, nestedLength, angles)) {
								entry.hasViewAngles = true;
								entry.viewAngles = angles;
							}
						} else {
							InterpInfo interp;
							if (ParseInterpInfo(nestedPayload, nestedLength, interp)) {
								if (innerField == 5) {
									entry.hasSvInterp0 = true;
									entry.svInterp0 = interp;
								} else if (innerField == 6) {
									entry.hasSvInterp1 = true;
									entry.svInterp1 = interp;
								} else {
									entry.hasClInterp = true;
									entry.clInterp = interp;
								}
								view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenTickIntegrity;
							}
						}
					} else if (innerWire == 0) {
						u64 value = 0;
						if (!history.Varint(value)) {
							break;
						}
						if (innerField == 3) {
							entry.hasRenderTickCount = true;
							entry.renderTickCount = static_cast<i32>(value);
							view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenTickIntegrity;
						} else if (innerField == 8) {
							entry.hasPlayerTickCount = true;
							entry.playerTickCount = static_cast<i32>(value);
							view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenTickIntegrity;
						}
					} else if (innerWire == 5) {
						f32 value = 0.0f;
						if (!history.Float(value)) {
							break;
						}
						if (innerField == 4) {
							entry.hasRenderTickFraction = true;
							entry.renderTickFraction = value;
							view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenTickIntegrity;
						}
					} else if (!history.Skip(innerWire)) {
						break;
					}
				}
				view.inputHistory.push_back(entry);
				view.fieldsSeen |= kSeenHistory;
			}
		} else if (!reader.Skip(wireType)) {
			break;
		}
	}
	return view.hasBase;
}

namespace cvar {

bool IsValidHandle(u64 handle)
{
	if (handle == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	if (handle == std::numeric_limits<u64>::max()) {
		return false;
	}
	// The engine's ConVarRef is a 32-bit handle; 0xFFFFFFFF means "no convar" whichever way it was
	// widened into the 64-bit value s2sdk passes around.
	if (static_cast<u32>(handle) == static_cast<u32>(kInvalidHandle)) {
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

bool BoolFromString(const char* value)
{
	// The engine's own truth spellings (convars accept these for a bool cvar).
	return value != nullptr
		   && (std::strcmp(value, "1") == 0 || EqualsIgnoreCase(value, "true") || EqualsIgnoreCase(value, "yes"));
}

} // namespace cvar

namespace engine {

bool PlausibleUserId(i64 value)
{
	// 0 means "no player" in the engine's events; real user ids are small positive integers
	// (CS2 counts them up per connection and they are what `kick #<userid>` accepts).
	return value >= 1 && value <= 0xFFFF;
}

} // namespace engine

namespace usercmd {

bool IsPlausibleCommandNumber(i32 number)
{
	return number >= 0 && number <= kMaxCommandNumber;
}

bool IsStrictlyIncreasing(const std::vector<i32>& numbers)
{
	for (std::size_t index = 1; index < numbers.size(); ++index) {
		if (numbers[index] <= numbers[index - 1]) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

} // namespace usercmd

namespace movement {

f32 JumpEventTime(i32 tick, f32 fraction)
{
	return static_cast<f32>(tick) + fraction;
}

bool IsFramePerfectJump(i32 pressTick, f32 pressFraction, i32 landTick, f32 landFraction)
{
	return JumpEventTime(pressTick, pressFraction) < JumpEventTime(landTick, landFraction);
}

} // namespace movement

namespace detection {

namespace {
// detection_system.cpp cachedTeammatesAreEnemies: set from mp_teammates_are_enemies by the plugin
// layer (the core stays engine-free).
bool s_teammatesAreEnemies {};
} // namespace

void SetTeammatesAreEnemies(bool value)
{
	s_teammatesAreEnemies = value;
}

bool TeammatesAreEnemies()
{
	return s_teammatesAreEnemies;
}

bool AreOpponents(int firstTeam, int secondTeam)
{
	const bool firstIsPlaying = firstTeam == CS_TEAM_T || firstTeam == CS_TEAM_CT;
	const bool secondIsPlaying = secondTeam == CS_TEAM_T || secondTeam == CS_TEAM_CT;
	return firstIsPlaying && secondIsPlaying && (firstTeam != secondTeam || s_teammatesAreEnemies);
}

std::string_view NormalizeWeapon(std::string_view weapon)
{
	if (weapon.rfind("weapon_", 0) == 0) {
		weapon.remove_prefix(7);
	}
	return weapon;
}

bool IsBallisticWeapon(std::string_view weapon)
{
	weapon = NormalizeWeapon(weapon);
	static constexpr std::string_view weapons[] = {
		"ak47",    "aug",      "awp",      "bizon",         "cz75a", "deagle", "elite", "famas", "fiveseven", "g3sg1",        "galilar", "glock",
		"hkp2000", "m249",     "m4a1",     "m4a1_silencer", "mac10", "mag7",   "mp5sd", "mp7",   "mp9",       "negev",        "nova",    "p250",
		"p90",     "revolver", "sawedoff", "scar20",        "sg556", "ssg08",  "taser", "tec9",  "ump45",     "usp_silencer", "xm1014",
	};
	return std::find(std::begin(weapons), std::end(weapons), weapon) != std::end(weapons);
}

bool IsFinite(const QAngle& angles)
{
	return std::isfinite(angles.x) && std::isfinite(angles.y) && std::isfinite(angles.z);
}

bool IsFinite(const Vector& vector)
{
	return std::isfinite(vector.x) && std::isfinite(vector.y) && std::isfinite(vector.z);
}

Vector AimForward(const QAngle& angles)
{
	constexpr float degreesToRadians = static_cast<float>(M_PI / 180.0);
	const float pitch = angles.x * degreesToRadians;
	const float yaw = angles.y * degreesToRadians;
	const float cosinePitch = std::cos(pitch);
	return {cosinePitch * std::cos(yaw), cosinePitch * std::sin(yaw), -std::sin(pitch)};
}

f32 AngularDistance(const QAngle& first, const QAngle& second)
{
	if (!IsFinite(first) || !IsFinite(second)) {
		return std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN();
	}
	const float dot = std::clamp(DotProduct(AimForward(first), AimForward(second)), -1.0f, 1.0f);
	return static_cast<float>(std::acos(dot) * (180.0 / M_PI));
}

f32 YawDelta(f32 from, f32 to)
{
	return std::remainder(to - from, 360.0f);
}

f32 LerpF(f32 t, f32 minimum, f32 maximum)
{
	return minimum + (maximum - minimum) * t;
}

u32 LerpU32(f32 t, u32 minimum, u32 maximum)
{
	return static_cast<u32>(static_cast<f32>(minimum) + (static_cast<f32>(maximum) - static_cast<f32>(minimum)) * t);
}

// network_safety.cpp ShouldVeto
bool ShouldVeto(f32 ping, f32 jitter, f32 incomingLoss, f32 outgoingLoss, f32 incomingChoke, f32 outgoingChoke, int unavailableSamples)
{
	constexpr f32 maximumPingMilliseconds = 150.0f;
	constexpr f32 maximumJitterMilliseconds = 25.0f;
	constexpr f32 maximumLoss = 0.02f;
	constexpr f32 maximumChoke = 0.02f;
	return ping >= maximumPingMilliseconds || jitter >= maximumJitterMilliseconds || incomingLoss >= maximumLoss || outgoingLoss >= maximumLoss
		   || incomingChoke >= maximumChoke || outgoingChoke >= maximumChoke || unavailableSamples > 0;
}

// nulls.cpp required-perfect-cstrafes scaling.
namespace {
constexpr f32 kFpsForMinimumSuspicion = 64.0f;
constexpr f32 kFpsForMaximumSuspicion = 256.0f;
constexpr u32 kConsecutiveMinimum = 128;
constexpr u32 kConsecutiveMaximum = 640;
constexpr f32 kUnderlapMedianForgivenessThreshold = 0.02f;
constexpr f32 kUnderlapPercentageThreshold = 0.1f;
} // namespace

u32 NullsRequiredPerfectCstrafes(const NullsTiming& timing, std::size_t eventCount)
{
	if (eventCount == 0) {
		return kConsecutiveMaximum;
	}
	f32 medianFramerate = timing.medianFramerate;
	if (timing.maxFps != 0.0f) {
		medianFramerate = (std::max)(medianFramerate, 1.0f / timing.maxFps);
	}
	if (medianFramerate == 0.0f) {
		medianFramerate = ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_INTERVAL;
	}
	const f32 ratio = std::clamp((1.0f / medianFramerate - kFpsForMinimumSuspicion) / (kFpsForMaximumSuspicion - kFpsForMinimumSuspicion), 0.0f, 1.0f);
	return LerpU32(1.0f - ratio, kConsecutiveMinimum, kConsecutiveMaximum);
}

bool NullsUnderlapForgiven(const NullsTiming& timing)
{
	if (timing.total == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	return timing.underlapMedian >= kUnderlapMedianForgivenessThreshold
		   && (static_cast<f32>(timing.underlapCount) / static_cast<f32>(timing.total)) >= kUnderlapPercentageThreshold;
}

u32 NullsAdjustedRequiredPerfectCstrafes(u32 required, f32 underlapMedian)
{
	const f32 underlapRatio = std::clamp(underlapMedian / kUnderlapMedianForgivenessThreshold, 0.0f, 1.0f);
	return LerpU32(underlapRatio * underlapRatio, required, kConsecutiveMaximum);
}

// cvars.cpp integrity-check cadence.
f64 CvarCycleInterval(int playerIndex)
{
	// The deterministic stand-in for the original's RandomFloat(1.0f, 5.0f) pick: every player gets
	// a value in [1.0, 5.0) and consecutive slots are spread across the range.
	return 1.0 + (static_cast<double>(playerIndex * 37 % 40) / 10.0);
}

f64 CvarQueryDelay(f64 cvarCycleInterval)
{
	return cvarCycleInterval / static_cast<double>(kCvarQueryCount);
}

localization::Text AddNetworkSafetyDetails(localization::Text details, const NetworkSafetyEvidence& evidence)
{
	const auto network = localization::Format("evidence.network_check",
											  "The five-second network check was not stable enough for punishment. It measured {ping} ms ping, "
											  "{jitter} ms jitter, {incoming_loss}/{outgoing_loss}% incoming/outgoing loss, "
											  "{incoming_choke}/{outgoing_choke}% incoming/outgoing choke, {gaps} command gaps, and "
											  "{unavailable} unavailable samples.",
											  {{"ping", FormatString("%.1f", static_cast<double>(evidence.pingMilliseconds))},
											   {"jitter", FormatString("%.1f", static_cast<double>(evidence.jitterMilliseconds))},
											   {"incoming_loss", FormatString("%.1f", static_cast<double>(evidence.incomingLoss * 100.0f))},
											   {"outgoing_loss", FormatString("%.1f", static_cast<double>(evidence.outgoingLoss * 100.0f))},
											   {"incoming_choke", FormatString("%.1f", static_cast<double>(evidence.incomingChoke * 100.0f))},
											   {"outgoing_choke", FormatString("%.1f", static_cast<double>(evidence.outgoingChoke * 100.0f))},
											   {"gaps", FormatString("%d", evidence.commandGaps)},
											   {"unavailable", FormatString("%d", evidence.unavailableSamples)}});
	return {details.english + " " + network.english, details.localized + " " + network.localized};
}

} // namespace detection
} // namespace cs2ac
```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/core.hpp`:

```hpp
// cs2ac — shared declarations.
//
// This header is the port's "common.h": types, constants, the engine-free data structures the
// detectors consume (usercmd view, move data, shot records) and the declarations of the pieces
// that live in core.cpp. Nothing here may reference s2sdk/polyhook so that cs2ac_core stays
// linkable by the unit tests (tests/cs2ac_tests.cpp); the engine side is cs2ac.hpp.
//
// Everything is ported from the original cs2ac sources; comments marked "original:" point at the
// file the logic comes from.

#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <deque>

#include <limits>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>

// The original's integer aliases (common.h).
typedef int8_t i8;
typedef int16_t i16;
typedef int32_t i32;
typedef int64_t i64;
typedef uint8_t u8;
typedef uint16_t u16;
typedef uint32_t u32;
typedef uint64_t u64;
typedef float f32;
typedef double f64;

#define MAXPLAYERS 64

// common.h: the engine's fixed tick rate and the epsilon used across the detectors.
#define ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_INTERVAL 0.015625f
#define ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE     (1.0f / ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_INTERVAL)
#define EPSILON                    0.000001f

#define CS_TEAM_NONE      0
#define CS_TEAM_SPECTATOR 1
#define CS_TEAM_T         2
#define CS_TEAM_CT        3

// sdk/datatypes.h InputBitMask_t (the bits the detectors look at).
#define IN_NONE      0x0ULL
#define IN_ATTACK    0x1ULL
#define IN_JUMP      0x2ULL
#define IN_DUCK      0x4ULL
#define IN_FORWARD   0x8ULL
#define IN_BACK      0x10ULL
#define IN_USE       0x20ULL
#define IN_TURNLEFT  0x80ULL
#define IN_TURNRIGHT 0x100ULL
#define IN_MOVELEFT  0x200ULL

// bspflags.h

#define HITGROUP_LEFTARM 4

#define HITGROUP_RIGHTLEG 7

#define MASK_SHOT 0x400000B1

namespace cs2ac {

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Math
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

struct Vector {
	f32 x {};
	f32 y {};
	f32 z {};

	constexpr Vector() = default;
	constexpr Vector(f32 ix, f32 iy, f32 iz) : x(ix), y(iy), z(iz) {}

	constexpr Vector operator+(const Vector& other) const { return {x + other.x, y + other.y, z + other.z}; }
	constexpr Vector operator-(const Vector& other) const { return {x - other.x, y - other.y, z - other.z}; }
	constexpr Vector operator*(f32 scale) const { return {x * scale, y * scale, z * scale}; }
	constexpr Vector& operator+=(const Vector& other) { x += other.x; y += other.y; z += other.z; return *this; }
	constexpr bool operator==(const Vector& other) const { return x == other.x && y == other.y && z == other.z; }
	constexpr bool operator!=(const Vector& other) const { return !(*this == other); }

	[[nodiscard]] constexpr f32 LengthSqr() const { return x * x + y * y + z * z; }
	[[nodiscard]] f32 Length() const { return std::sqrt(LengthSqr()); }
	[[nodiscard]] f32 Length2D() const { return std::sqrt(x * x + y * y); }
	void NormalizeInPlace()
	{
		const f32 length = Length();
		if (length > EPSILON) {
			x /= length;
			y /= length;
			z /= length;
		}
	}
};

struct QAngle {
	f32 x {};
	f32 y {};
	f32 z {};

	constexpr QAngle() = default;
	constexpr QAngle(f32 ix, f32 iy, f32 iz) : x(ix), y(iy), z(iz) {}
	constexpr bool operator==(const QAngle& o) const { return x == o.x && y == o.y && z == o.z; }
};

inline f32 DotProduct(const Vector& a, const Vector& b)
{
	return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
}

// CInButtonState::GetButtonState (sdk/cinbuttonstate.h): the three 64-bit words are the bits of a
// three-bit down/up history per button.
constexpr u32 InButtonState(u64 state1, u64 state2, u64 state3, u64 button)
{
	return static_cast<u32>(!!(state1 & button)) + static_cast<u32>(!!(state2 & button)) * 2u
		   + static_cast<u32>(!!(state3 & button)) * 4u;
}
constexpr u32 kInButtonDownUp = 2;
constexpr u32 kInButtonUpDown = 3;
constexpr u32 kInButtonUpDownUp = 4;
constexpr u32 kInButtonDownUpDownUp = 6;

// core.cpp: protobuf wire reader for CSGOUserCmdPB (the message sits at PlayerCommand+16).
// Explicit field numbers are the CS2 wire constants for the current message layout.
// `available` is the number of readable bytes at `message` (the object's remaining bytes); the
// reader never reads past it, so a message that is shorter than the buffer cannot walk out of the
// object it is embedded in.
bool ParseUserCmdMessage(const void* message, size_t available, UsercmdView& view);

namespace cvar {
// The cvar system's invalid ConVarRef handle. s2sdk's FindConVar returns it for a name it cannot
// resolve (s2sdk logs "Invalid ConVar handle: 4294967295" for it), and passing it to any
// s2sdk cvar function makes s2sdk print that warning on every call. The engine's ConVarRef is a
// 32-bit handle, so both the zero-extended and the sign-extended spellings are rejected.
constexpr u64 kInvalidHandle = 0xFFFFFFFFull;
bool IsValidHandle(u64 handle);
// The engine's own truth spellings for a bool cvar ("1"/"true"/"yes", case-insensitive): used both
// for the defaults in the convar table and for reading cvars whose engine type is a string.
bool BoolFromString(const char* value);
} // namespace cvar

// Entity HANDLES are int32 views of the engine's uint32 CEntityHandle (index | serial << 15):
// valid <=> h != INVALID_EHANDLE_INDEX (-1) && h != 0 (index 0 is the world; the engine-side
// PawnHandle() answers -1 for "no pawn"). The sign means nothing - once the engine's serial
// counter passes 65535 bit 31 is set and a valid handle is a negative int; a `handle >= 0` test
// then silently takes the pointer fallback for a pawn whose handle is perfectly usable. Not to be
// confused with cvar::IsValidHandle above, which is about ConVar handles.
inline bool IsValidHandle(i32 h) { return h != -1 && h != 0; }

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Per-frame memo (engine.cpp's player snapshot)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// One player-state value that is fetched at most once per server frame and reused by every reader
// of that frame. The plugin's frame loop (Plugin::OnGameFrame) reads the same fields in several
// passes - the teleport sampler, the shot correlator's position frame, the network sampler, five
// detector modules and the movement sampler - and every one of those reads is a cross-plugin
// s2sdk call. The plugin changes no engine state while it runs, so the value cannot change between
// those passes: fetching it once and handing the same value to every reader passes each detector
// exactly the input a fresh read would have returned.
//
// `filled` is what makes the sharing observable to the tests: the fetch functor runs only on the
// first Get() after the memo was cleared (the engine clears the whole per-slot record once per
// frame by assigning {}) and never for a reader that only finds the value already there.
template <typename T>
struct FrameMemo {
	T value {};
	bool filled {};

	template <typename Fetch>
	const T& Get(Fetch&& fetch)
	{
		if (!filled) {
			filled = true;
			value = fetch();
		}
		return value;
	}
};

namespace engine {
// An engine user id is a small positive integer (CS2 assigns them per connection; 0 means
// "no player", e.g. in the game events). Used to sanity-check both the userids events report and
// the raw read of CServerSideClientBase::m_UserID, so a wrong gamedata offset cannot feed a random
// number into a punishment command.
bool PlausibleUserId(i64 value);
} // namespace engine

namespace usercmd {
// Plausibility gates of the ProcessUsercmds detour (hooks.cpp). The engine hands over a contiguous
// PlayerCommand array whose stride (sizeof(PlayerCommand) = 144 on Linux) is a layout assumption;
// a wrong stride/offset produces command numbers that are out of range or not strictly increasing
// within one batch. Such a batch is dropped (fail soft) instead of being fed to the detectors.
constexpr i32 kMaxCommandNumber = 1 << 24;
bool IsPlausibleCommandNumber(i32 number);
bool IsStrictlyIncreasing(const std::vector<i32>& numbers);
} // namespace usercmd

//   mightBeModernPerf   = lastUsableJumpPress < modernLandTime
// The data comes from the pawn's movement services (engine::PlayerFramePerfectJump); this helper is
// the pure part so the comparison and its edge cases (equal times, negative fractions) are unit
// tested without an engine.
f32 JumpEventTime(i32 tick, f32 fraction);
bool IsFramePerfectJump(i32 pressTick, f32 pressFraction, i32 landTick, f32 landFraction);
} // namespace movement

// Triggerbot's reaction scoring (triggerbot_module.cpp) — pure, unit-tested.
struct ReactionScore {
	int score {};
	int oneTickCount {};
	int twoTickCount {};
	int normalCount {};
};
constexpr int kTriggerbotDetectionThreshold = 10;
template<size_t N>
constexpr ReactionScore ScoreReactions(const std::array<int, N>& ticks, size_t count)
{
	ReactionScore result;
	for (size_t index = 0; index < count && index < N; ++index) {
		const int tick = ticks[index];
		if (tick >= 0 && tick <= 1) {
			++result.oneTickCount;
			result.score += 2;
		} else if (tick == 2) {
			++result.twoTickCount;
			result.score = (std::max)(0, result.score - 3);
		} else if (tick >= 3) {
			++result.normalCount;
			result.score = (std::max)(0, result.score - 3);
		}
	}
	return result;
}

// Aimbot's smoothed-aim envelope (aimbot_module.cpp) — pure, unit-tested.
struct SmoothThresholds {
	f32 movement {};
	f32 improvement {};
	f32 finalError {};
	f32 efficiency {};
	int steps {};
	bool shrinking {};
};
constexpr bool MeetsSmoothThresholds(f32 movement, f32 improvement, f32 finalError, f32 efficiency, int steps, bool shrinking)
{
	return movement >= 13.0f && improvement >= 0.94f && finalError <= 1.0f && efficiency >= 0.94f && steps >= 3 && shrinking;
}

{
	return samples > 0 && onTarget * 20 >= samples * 19;
}

u32 LerpU32(f32 t, u32 minimum, u32 maximum);
```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/cs2ac.hpp`:

```hpp
// cs2ac — the plugin-facing half of the port: engine accessors (s2sdk), hooks (polyhook + s2sdk
// listeners), announcements, the webhook queue and the plugin object that ties the detection

//

// only linked into the plugin (never into the tests).

// happened at or before the last landing (MovementEventService::mightBeModernPerf) — the engine
// consumed the press in the same tick as the landing, which is what the BHOP detector scores.
bool PlayerFramePerfectJump(int index);

// hook. Here the frame sampler records position discontinuities and exposes "teleported within the
// last X seconds" with the same thresholds.
bool PlayerJustTeleported(int index, f32 thresholdSeconds);

// Network quality. ping/jitter are always available; loss/choke would need net-channel offsets that
// no code here resolves (ClientNetStats fills only the ping), so lossChokeAvailable is always false
// until a net-channel source is ported.
struct NetStats {
	f32 pingSeconds {};
	f32 incomingLoss {};
	f32 outgoingLoss {};
	f32 incomingChoke {};
	f32 outgoingChoke {};
	f32 remoteFrametime {-1.0f};
	bool pingAvailable {};
	bool lossChokeAvailable {};
};
NetStats ClientNetStats(int index);

// Client console variables: the userinfo-style value (the original's GetClientConVarValue) and the
// asynchronous query service (the original's IClientCvarValue, which s2sdk implements).
const char* ClientCvarValue(int index, const char* name);
using ClientCvarCallback = void (*)(int slot, int status, const char* name, const char* value, void* user);
bool QueryClientCvar(int index, const char* name, ClientCvarCallback callback, void* user);

// Server console variables (the original's ConVarRefAbstract reads). Missing cvars and invalid
// handles (s2sdk's FindConVar returns 0xFFFFFFFF for a name it cannot resolve) are cached as
// "absent" and logged once - calling an s2sdk cvar function with such a handle makes s2sdk print
// "Invalid ConVar handle" on every call, which spammed the console at per-frame rates.
bool ServerCvarBool(const char* name, bool defaultValue);
f32 ServerCvarFloat(const char* name, f32 defaultValue);
int ServerCvarInt(const char* name, int defaultValue);
bool ServerCvarExists(const char* name);
// Per-frame cached views of the two cvars the detectors poll on hot paths.
bool SvCheatsEnabled();
bool SvCheatsAvailable();
bool TeammatesAreEnemiesCvar();
// Invalidates the per-frame cvar cache (called once per server frame by the plugin).
void OnFrameRefresh();
// The per-frame player snapshot: constructed once at the top of Plugin::OnGameFrame, it makes the
// player-state getters above answer from one shared per-slot record for the duration of that call
// (each value fetched at most once per slot per frame) and turns itself off on destruction. Every
// path outside OnGameFrame - the usercmd/setup-move hooks, the game events, the commands - runs
// with no scope alive and reads the engine live, exactly as before.
struct FrameSnapshotScope {
	FrameSnapshotScope();
	~FrameSnapshotScope();
	FrameSnapshotScope(const FrameSnapshotScope&) = delete;
	FrameSnapshotScope& operator=(const FrameSnapshotScope&) = delete;
};
// Hands queued client-cvar replies to their handlers (called from the frame pump, never from inside
// the engine's cvar dispatch).
void DrainCvarReplies();
// Re-resolves every cached cvar name (called when the plugin's configuration is reloaded).
void InvalidateConVarCache();
// The raw registered value ("" when the cvar does not exist); used to resync the plugin's settings
// when an admin changes a cs2ac_* ConVar at runtime, exactly like the original's ConVar callbacks.
std::string ServerCvarString(const char* name);
// Registered by the plugin (the original's ConVar_Register). The types match the original's
// declarations: RegisterConVar is a CConVar<bool>, RegisterStringConVar a CConVar<CUtlString>
// (the port's own cs2ac_allow_sv_cheats_testing is a bool as well). The `protectedValue` argument
// is the FCVAR_PROTECTED flag the original put on the Discord webhook URL only.
bool RegisterConVar(const char* name, const char* defaultValue, const char* description);
bool RegisterStringConVar(const char* name, const char* defaultValue, const char* description, bool protectedValue);
// Fork settings that are CConVar<int>/<float> in the Metamod original.
bool RegisterIntConVar(const char* name, int defaultValue, const char* description);
bool RegisterFloatConVar(const char* name, f32 defaultValue, const char* description);
bool SetCvarValue(const char* name, const char* value);

void ServerCommand(const char* command);

// Counters for the schema reads the movement detectors depend on, printed by cs2ac_hooks: the
// movement services pointer used to be read through the entity-handle accessor (invalid for a
// pointer field), which left every movement detector silently dead with no other symptom.
struct SchemaStats {
	u64 servicesResolved {};
	u64 servicesMissing {};
	u64 offsetMisses {};
	u64 jumpDataReads {};
};
SchemaStats SchemaStatistics();

// Gamedata-driven offsets (assets/gamedata.jsonc). The hook layer reads them once and registers
// them here; a missing entry only disables the feature that needs it.
void RegisterGamedataOffset(const char* name, i32 offset);
// One line describing where the {userid} placeholder gets its value from (cs2ac_check_config).
std::string ClientUserIdStatus();
// Once per frame per connected player: records teleport-scale position discontinuities (the
// original's CBaseEntity::Teleport hook) for that player.
void UpdateTeleportTrackingFor(int index);
void ForgetTeleportTracking(int index);
// A spawn/respawn counts as a teleport for the detectors' grace windows.
void MarkSpawned(int index);

// Crosshair trace for the Triggerbot detector (the original's INavPhysicsInterface::TraceLine).
struct TraceResult {

	int hitEntityIndex {0};
	Vector endPosition;
};
bool TraceLine(const Vector& start, const Vector& end, int ignoreEntityIndex, TraceResult& result);

// The game's own event manager: only the DLL Injection detector needs it (vtable call, gated by
// gamedata; see PORT_PLAN.md §3 #6).
bool LegacyListenerSubscribes(int index, const char* eventName, bool& subscribed);

// Recoil-control statistics (fork v4): CCSPlayerPawn::m_iShotsFired plus the aim-punch component
// CCSPlayer_AimPunchServices (m_predictableBaseAngle / m_unpredictableBaseAngle and their ticks).
struct RecoilData {
	f32 punchPitch {};

	f32 randomYaw {};

	i32 unpredictableTick {};

};

bool ReadRecoilData(int index, RecoilData& out);
// True when every RCS schema field resolves. Only call while a map is up (GetSchemaOffset is not
// safe in the loading window).
bool RecoilSchemaAvailable();

// Position frame sampling support: the original's Player::GetEyeOrigin.

struct HookState {
	std::string name;
	bool resolved {};
	bool hooked {};
	std::string note;
	// Teardown bookkeeping: polyhook keeps ONE detour per target function shared by every plugin,
	// so Shutdown() removes only this plugin's callback and unhooks the target only when no callback
	// is left on it (unhooking unconditionally would tear down s2sdk's/another plugin's hook too).
	void* address {};

	polyhook::CallbackHandler handler {};

class MovementDetectionService {
public:
	struct Infraction {
		enum class Type : u8 {
			Other = 0,

			BhopHack,
			Hyperscroll,

			InvalidInput,
			Nulls,

	void Reset();

	struct InputEvent {
		i32 cmdNum;
		f32 fraction;
		f32 framerate;
		u64 button;
		bool pressed;
		bool analog = false;
		f32 airSpeed = -1.0f;
	};

	std::deque<InputEvent> recentForwardBackwardEvents;
	std::deque<InputEvent> recentLeftRightEvents;
	i32 lastNullsCmdNum {-1};
	// Every command number is processed once: the movement hooks can observe the same idle command
	// more than once, and counting a replay inflates all time-windowed evidence (fork import).
	i32 lastSubtickCmdNum {-1};

	bool leftRightNullsDirty {};

		bool pendingPerf = true;
		bool hasPerfectBhop {};
		bool shouldCountTowardsPerfChains {};
		u32 numJumpBefore {};
		u32 numJumpAfter {};
	};

	f32 lastValidMoveTypeTime = -1.0f;
	std::deque<LandingEvent> recentLandingEvents;
	bool bhopDirty {};
	// The command number the per-command detectors treat as "now". The original's OnSetupMove
	// assigned it once per command before it ran any of them (CheckSubtickAbuse, ParseCommandForJump,
	// DetectOptimization); the port's ProcessUsercmds loop does the same via this setter.
	void SetCurrentCmdNum(i32 cmdNum);

	void OnGroundFrame(PlayerRef* player, bool onGround, bool wasOnGround, f64 curtime);

	std::deque<f32> suspiciousSubtickMoveTimes;

	// cvarCycleInterval / the number of queried cvars (the delay the original's timer callback

class Plugin {
public:
	enum class PunishmentLevel : std::uint8_t {
		None,
		Report,
		Kick,
		Ban,
	};

	void OnStart();  // OnPluginStart body
	void OnUpdate(); // OnPluginUpdate body (config + webhook + watermark pump)
	void OnEnd();

	bool IsLoaded() const { return loaded; }
	bool SimulatingPhysics() const { return simulatingPhysics; }
	void SetSimulatingPhysics(bool value) { simulatingPhysics = value; }

	void OnMapInit();
	void OnMapShutdown();
	void OnProcessUsercmds(int playerIndex, const std::vector<UsercmdView>& commands);
	void OnSetupMove(int playerIndex, const UsercmdView& command);
	void OnGameFrame(bool simulating);
	void OnGameEvent(const detection::GameEventData& event, int playerIndex);
	void OnFireBullets(int playerIndex, int currentTick, f32 inaccuracy, f32 spread, u32 weaponId, bool missingField, const std::string& missing);
	void HandleDetection(const char* detection, PlayerRef* player, const localization::Text& evidence, bool kickOnly = false,
						 bool networkVetoed = false);
	void ProcessJoinWatermarks();

	void OnClientActive(int slot, u64 xuid);
	void OnClientFullyConnect(int slot);
	void OnClientSettingsChanged(int slot);
	void OnClientDisconnect(int slot);

	void PrintStatus();
	void PrintHelp();
	void PrintUsercmdDump();
	void NoteUsercmd(const UsercmdView& view);
	// The registered cs2ac_* commands (identical names and behaviour to the original's CON_COMMANDs).
	static s2sdk::ResultType OnCommand(int32_t playerSlot, s2sdk::ConCommandContext context, const plg::vector<plg::string>& args);
	void ReloadConfig();
	void CheckConfig();
	void TestAnnouncement();
	void TestWebhook();
	void ReportConfigLoadTimeout();
	void ApplyConfigLine(const std::string& name, const std::string& value);
	void FinishConfigLoad();
	void OnConfigLoaded();

	detection::DetectionSystem& Detection() { return detectionSystem; }
	WebhookService& Webhook() { return *webhook; }
	bool HasWebhook() const { return webhook != nullptr; }

private:
	void Activate();
	void ResetRuntime();
	void CleanupRuntime();
	void PrintConfigSummary(bool reloaded);
	void LoadConfigFile();   // reads cs2ac.cfg and applies it
	void RegisterCommands();
	void UnregisterCommands();
	// Resyncs the plugin's settings from the registered (possibly console-changed) ConVars.
	void SyncSettingsFromConVars();

	// Fork v8-v11 punishment policy (cs2ac.cpp).
	// Kick/fallback commands are queued and executed from OnPluginUpdate, never inside the
	// per-client hook that produced the finding. A command that carries {userid} is re-validated
	// against the slot's SteamID64 at execution time, so a reused slot cannot be kicked for the
	// previous occupant.
	struct PendingServerCommand {
		std::string commandTemplate; // unexpanded: {userid} is resolved again at execution time
		std::string detection;       // substitution for {detection}
		int slot {-1};
		u64 steamId {};
		bool requiresSlot {};
	};
	bool QueueServerCommand(std::string commandTemplate, int slot, u64 steamId, bool requiresSlot, const std::string& detection);
	void ProcessServerCommands();

	bool StreamKickDue(int index, const char* detection, const char* list, int threshold, int seconds, const char* prefix);
	bool ComboKickDue(int index, const char* detection);
	void NoteFinding(u64 steamId, const char* detection);
	bool RepeatBanDue(u64 steamId, const char* detection);
	void NoteKick(u64 steamId, const char* detection);
	void PruneRepeatRecords(bool all);
	bool MassGuardDemotes(const char* detection, u64 steamId);

	// Times are seconds since the steady-clock epoch so the pure window helpers can be unit-tested.
	struct RepeatRecord {
		std::unordered_map<std::string, std::deque<i64>> kicks;
		std::unordered_map<std::string, i64> findings;
		i64 lastSeen {};
	};
	// Report times per player and stream/burst-kick detection (cs2ac_stream_kick_* / burst_*).
	std::array<std::unordered_map<std::string, std::deque<i64>>, MAXPLAYERS + 1> streamReports {};
	// Different report-only detections per player in this connection (cs2ac_combo_kick_types).
	std::array<std::set<std::string>, MAXPLAYERS + 1> reportedKinds {};
	// v10: kicks and findings per SteamID64 for the repeat ban; kept across reconnects and map
	// changes, cleared by a server restart.
	std::unordered_map<u64, RepeatRecord> repeatRecords;
	// v11 mass guard: recent players per guarded detection, and the detections switched to reports
	// for the rest of this plugin load.
	std::unordered_map<std::string, std::deque<detection::MassGuardHit>> massGuardHits;
	std::set<std::string> massGuardTripped;
	// Kick / fallback-ban commands waiting for the next OnPluginUpdate (never run inside a hook).
	std::deque<PendingServerCommand> pendingServerCommands;

	// Per-player frame bookkeeping (the original's MovementEventService::timeSpentInServer and the
	// Invalid CVar cycle timer).
	std::array<f64, MAXPLAYERS + 1> playerTime {};
	f64 lastFrameTime {};
	std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point lastCvarCycle {};
	// Diagnostic: the last usercmd the hook parsed (cs2ac_usercmd_dump).
	UsercmdView lastUsercmd;
	bool lastUsercmdValid {};

	bool loaded {};
	bool convarsRegistered {};
	bool svCheatsWatcherInstalled {};
	bool configLoaded {};
	bool configReloadPending {};
	bool configLoadFailed {};
	bool simulatingPhysics {};
	std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point lastConfigLoad {};
	std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point configLoadDeadline {};
	std::string activationError;
	detection::DetectionSystem detectionSystem;
	WebhookService* webhook {};
	struct JoinWatermarkState {
		std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point showAt;
		std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point expires;
		std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point nextCenterSend;
		int centerBroadcasts {};
		bool pending {};
		bool shown {};
		bool centerPending {};
		bool centerActive {};
	};
	std::array<JoinWatermarkState, MAXPLAYERS + 1> joinWatermarks {};
	std::array<PunishmentLevel, MAXPLAYERS + 1> punishmentLevels {};
};
```
