```cpp
// --- game events --------------------------------------------------------------

// Reads the subset of the event's fields the detectors use (the original read them off IGameEvent
// in the modules; reading once here keeps the modules engine-free). Each event only pays for the
// fields its detectors look at - weapon_fire is by far the most frequent game event.
detection::GameEventData ReadEvent(const plg::string& name, void* event)
{
	detection::GameEventData data;
	data.name = name.c_str();
	if (!event) {
		return data;
	}
	const std::string_view eventName(name.c_str());
	auto getInt = [&](const char* key, int fallback) {
		try {
			return static_cast<int>(s2sdk::GetEventInt(event, key));
		} catch (...) {
			return fallback;
		}
	};
	auto getBool = [&](const char* key) {
		try {
			return s2sdk::GetEventBool(event, key);
		} catch (...) {
			return false;
		}
	};
	auto getFloat = [&](const char* key) {
		try {
			return s2sdk::GetEventFloat(event, key);
		} catch (...) {
			return 0.0f;
		}
	};
	auto getString = [&](const char* key) {
		try {
			return std::string(s2sdk::GetEventString(event, key).c_str());
		} catch (...) {
			return std::string {};
		}
	};

	// The detector-side indexes are controller indexes (slot + 1); the engine's event "userid" is
	// not guaranteed to equal them, so the slot is resolved through s2sdk. A non-player victim or
	// attacker (world damage) yields -1 and is ignored.
	auto getPlayerIndex = [&](const char* key) {
		try {
			const int32_t slot = s2sdk::GetEventPlayerSlot(event, key);
			return slot >= 0 ? static_cast<int>(slot) + 1 : -1;
		} catch (...) {
			return -1;
		}
	};
	data.userid = getPlayerIndex("userid");
	// The same event field in its raw form is the engine's user id (what the {userid} punishment
	// placeholder needs, and the reference engine::PlayerUserId validates the gamedata offset
	// against). Cheap enough for the most frequent event (one int read off the event).
	if (data.userid >= 1 && data.userid <= MAXPLAYERS) {
		try {
			engine::RememberClientUserId(data.userid, static_cast<int>(s2sdk::GetEventInt(event, "userid")));
		} catch (...) {
		}
	}
	if (eventName == "weapon_fire") {
		data.weapon = getString("weapon");
		return data; // the Doubletap detector only compares weapon and tick
	}
	if (eventName == "player_spawn") {
		return data; // the AntiAim module only needs the subject
	}
	if (eventName == "smokegrenade_detonate" || eventName == "hegrenade_detonate") {
		data.smokeEntityId = getInt("entityid", -1);
		data.smokeX = getFloat("x");
		data.smokeY = getFloat("y");
		data.smokeZ = getFloat("z");
		return data;
	}
	if (eventName == "smokegrenade_expired") {
		data.smokeEntityId = getInt("entityid", -1);
		return data;
	}
	if (eventName == "round_start") {
		return data;
	}

	// player_hurt / player_death share the shot outcome fields.
	data.attacker = getPlayerIndex("attacker");
	data.hitgroup = getInt("hitgroup", HITGROUP_GENERIC);
	data.dmgHealth = getInt("dmg_health", 0);
	data.penetrated = getInt("penetrated", 0) > 0;
	data.thrusmoke = getBool("thrusmoke");
	if (eventName == "player_death") {
		data.weapon = getString("weapon");
		data.attackerinair = getBool("attackerinair");
		data.attackerblind = getBool("attackerblind");
		data.noscope = getBool("noscope");
		data.headshot = getBool("headshot");
		data.distance = getFloat("distance");
	}
	return data;
}

struct ConsumedEvent {
	const char* name;
};

constexpr ConsumedEvent kConsumedEvents[] = {
	{"weapon_fire"},      {"player_hurt"},          {"player_death"},         {"player_spawn"},
	{"smokegrenade_detonate"}, {"smokegrenade_expired"}, {"hegrenade_detonate"}, {"round_start"},
};

s2sdk::ResultType OnGameEvent(const plg::string& name, void* event, bool /*dontBroadcast*/)
{
	try {
		const std::string_view eventName(name.c_str());
		for (const auto& consumed : kConsumedEvents) {
			if (eventName == consumed.name) {
				g_plugin.OnGameEvent(ReadEvent(name, event), 0);
				break;
			}
		}
	} catch (...) {
	}
	return s2sdk::ResultType::Continue;
}

// --- FireBullets net message --------------------------------------------------

// The user message id of CMsgTEFireBullets, resolved once from its name.
//
// This listener runs for EVERY net message the server sends to a real client (s2sdk's detour on
// CServerSideClientBase::SendNetMessage), and s2sdk::UserMessageGetMessageName answers by value
// (plg::string, one allocation per call) - so the name is resolved once here and every message is
// filtered by the cheap message id instead. -2 = not resolved yet, 0 = not resolvable on this build
// (the fallback below then keeps the name comparison).
int16_t g_fireBulletsMessageId {-2};

int16_t FireBulletsMessageId()
{
	if (g_fireBulletsMessageId == -2) {
		g_fireBulletsMessageId = __s2sdk_UserMessageFindMessageIdByName
									 ? s2sdk::UserMessageFindMessageIdByName(plg::string("CMsgTEFireBullets"))
									 : 0;
	}
	return g_fireBulletsMessageId;
}

void OnNetMessage(int32_t playerSlot, void* message)
{
	try {
		if (!message) {
			return;
		}
		const int16_t fireBulletsId = FireBulletsMessageId();
		if (fireBulletsId > 0 && __s2sdk_UserMessageGetMessageID) {
			if (s2sdk::UserMessageGetMessageID(message) != fireBulletsId) {
				return;
			}
		} else {
			if (!__s2sdk_UserMessageGetMessageName) {
				return;
			}
			// The id could not be resolved (or the binding is missing): compare the name. It must be
			// an owning string - the export returns its plg::string by value, so a string_view over
			// its c_str() would dangle in the next statement.
			const plg::string name = s2sdk::UserMessageGetMessageName(message);
			if (std::string_view(name.c_str()) != "CMsgTEFireBullets") {
				return;
			}
		}
		(void)playerSlot;
		// The fields the Silentaim detector needs, read through the s2sdk protobuf accessors.
		bool missingField = false;
		std::string missing;
		const auto require = [&](bool present, const char* field) {
			if (!present) {
				missingField = true;
				missing += missing.empty() ? field : std::string(", ") + field;
			}
		};
		const bool hasPlayer = s2sdk::UserMessageHasField(message, "player");
		const bool hasInaccuracy = s2sdk::UserMessageHasField(message, "inaccuracy");
		const bool hasSpread = s2sdk::UserMessageHasField(message, "spread");
		const bool hasWeaponId = s2sdk::UserMessageHasField(message, "weapon_id");
		require(hasPlayer, "player");
		require(hasInaccuracy, "inaccuracy");
		require(hasSpread, "spread");
		require(hasWeaponId, "weapon_id");
		const f32 inaccuracy = hasInaccuracy ? s2sdk::PbReadFloat(message, "inaccuracy", -1) : 0.0f;
		const f32 spread = hasSpread ? s2sdk::PbReadFloat(message, "spread", -1) : 0.0f;
		const u32 weaponId = hasWeaponId ? static_cast<u32>(s2sdk::PbReadUInt32(message, "weapon_id", -1)) : 0;
		// The engine packs the shooter as CEntityIndex (index | (serial & 0x3FF) << 14); the
		// controller index the player manager uses is the entity index itself.
		const int packed = hasPlayer ? static_cast<int>(s2sdk::PbReadUInt32(message, "player", -1)) : -1;
		const int playerIndex = packed >= 0 ? (packed & 0x3FFF) : -1;
		g_plugin.OnFireBullets(playerIndex, engine::CurrentTick(), inaccuracy, spread, weaponId, missingField, missing);
	} catch (...) {
		// No exception may escape into the engine's message dispatch.
	}
}

// --- installation -------------------------------------------------------------

void* ResolveSignature(const char* name, HookState& state)
{
	if (g_config == 0) {
		state.note = "no gamedata loaded";
		return nullptr;
	}
	void* address = s2sdk::GetGameConfigSignature(g_config, name);
	if (!address) {
		state.note = "signature not found in the loaded gamedata (or it did not match this build)";
		return nullptr;
	}
	state.resolved = true;
	return address;
}

bool InstallDetour(const char* name, void* address, polyhook::DataType returnType, const plg::vector<polyhook::DataType>& arguments,
				   polyhook::CallbackHandler handler, HookState& state)
{
	if (address == nullptr) {
		return false;
	}
	if (!__polyhook_HookDetour || !__polyhook_AddCallback) {
		state.note = "polyhook bindings are not available";
		return false;
	}
	try {
		const polyhook::HookHandle hook = polyhook::HookDetour(address, returnType, arguments, -1, name);
		if (!hook) {
			state.note = "polyhook could not hook the address";
			return false;
		}
		if (!polyhook::AddCallback(hook, polyhook::CallbackType::Pre, handler)) {
			state.note = "polyhook could not attach the callback";
			return false;
		}
		state.hooked = true;
		state.address = address;
		state.hook = hook;
		state.handler = handler;
		return true;
	} catch (const std::exception& error) {
		state.note = error.what();
		return false;
	} catch (...) {
		state.note = "unknown polyhook error";
		return false;
	}
}

bool LoadGamedata()
{
	if (!__s2sdk_LoadGameConfigFile) {
		LogError("The s2sdk LoadGameConfigFile binding is missing; cs2ac cannot load its gamedata.");
		return false;
	}
	std::string location;
	if (plg::plugin::GetLocation && plg::plugin::handle != nullptr) {
		location = std::string(plg::plugin::GetLocation(plg::plugin::handle).c_str());
	}
	std::vector<std::filesystem::path> candidates;
	candidates.emplace_back(GamedataDirectory() + "/gamedata.jsonc");
	if (!location.empty()) {
		const std::filesystem::path loc(location);
		candidates.push_back(loc / "gamedata.jsonc");
		candidates.push_back(loc.parent_path() / "gamedata.jsonc");
		candidates.push_back(loc.parent_path().parent_path() / "gamedata.jsonc");
	}
	plg::vector<plg::string> paths;
	std::string checked;
	for (const std::filesystem::path& candidate : candidates) {
		if (checked.size() < 512) {
			checked += (checked.empty() ? "" : ", ") + candidate.string();
		}
		std::error_code error;
		if (std::filesystem::exists(candidate, error)) {
			paths.push_back(candidate.string().c_str());
		}
	}
	if (paths.empty()) {
		LogError("cs2ac gamedata.jsonc was not found (looked for: %s); the movement detections stay disabled.", checked.c_str());
		return false;
	}
	g_config = s2sdk::LoadGameConfigFile(paths);
	if (g_config == 0) {
		LogError("cs2ac could not load its gamedata; the movement detections stay disabled.");
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

} // namespace

bool Initialize()
{
	if (g_initialized) {
		return true;
	}
	// Shutdown() deliberately leaves the report entries in place (cs2ac_hooks still works after a
	// stop), so a re-init must start from an empty vector: otherwise every reload appends another
	// full set of states on top of the stale ones and the report/teardown walk mixed data.
	g_states.clear();

	engine::SetBindingsAvailable(__s2sdk_GetGameTickCount != nullptr && __s2sdk_GetClientName != nullptr);
	if (!engine::BindingsAvailable()) {
		LogError("The s2sdk bindings are not available; cs2ac stays inert.");
		return false;
	}
	if (!__polyhook_HookDetour || !__polyhook_AddCallback) {
		LogError("The polyhook bindings are not available; the usercmd detections stay disabled.");
	}

	LoadGamedata();

	// Gamedata offsets (all optional).
	if (g_config != 0) {
		engine::RegisterGamedataOffset("ClientUserIdOffset", s2sdk::GetGameConfigOffset(g_config, "ClientUserIdOffset"));
	}

	// --- detours ---
	{
		HookState state {"ProcessUsercmds", false, false, ""};
		void* address = ResolveSignature("ProcessUsercmds", state);
		if (address) {
			// Slots map onto RDI, RSI, RDX, RCX, XMM0 - the original's signature (its first
			// parameter is what the engine keeps in RDI; see the enum comment above).
			plg::vector<polyhook::DataType> arguments {
				polyhook::DataType::Pointer, // RDI: CCSPlayerController*
				polyhook::DataType::Pointer, // RSI: PlayerCommand*
				polyhook::DataType::Int32,   // RDX: numcmds
				polyhook::DataType::Bool,    // RCX: paused
				polyhook::DataType::Float,   // XMM0: margin
			};
			InstallDetour("cs2ac_ProcessUsercmds", address, polyhook::DataType::Int32, arguments, &OnProcessUsercmds, state);
		}
		if (!state.note.empty() && !state.hooked) {
			LogWarning("The ProcessUsercmds hook is unavailable (%s); usercmd-based detections stay disabled.", state.note.c_str());
		}
		g_states.push_back(std::move(state));
	}
	{
		HookState state {"SetupMove", false, false, ""};
		void* address = ResolveSignature("SetupMove", state);
		if (address) {
			// Slots map onto RDI, RSI, RDX: services (the object the method is called on), command
			// and move data. There is no separate `this` slot - the original's first parameter is
			// the movement services pointer itself (member function or free function, the register
			// layout is the same).
			plg::vector<polyhook::DataType> arguments {
				polyhook::DataType::Pointer, // RDI: CCSPlayer_MovementServices*
				polyhook::DataType::Pointer, // RSI: PlayerCommand*
				polyhook::DataType::Pointer, // RDX: CMoveData*
			};
			InstallDetour("cs2ac_SetupMove", address, polyhook::DataType::Void, arguments, &OnSetupMove, state);
		}
		if (!state.note.empty() && !state.hooked) {
			LogWarning("The SetupMove hook is unavailable (%s); the SetupMove-based detections stay disabled.", state.note.c_str());
		}
		g_states.push_back(std::move(state));
	}
	// The remaining original signatures are reported for diagnostics (cs2ac_hooks) even when the
	// port does not hook them (their data is sampled per frame instead).
	for (const char* name : {"ProcessMovement", "Duck", "LadderMove", "OnJumpLegacy", "OnJumpModern", "AirMove", "AirAccelerate", "WalkMove",
							 "TryPlayerMove", "CategorizePosition", "PhysicsSimulate", "GameEventManager", "GetLegacyGameEventListener"}) {
		HookState state {name, false, false, "sampled per frame (not hooked by this port)"};
		ResolveSignature(name, state);
		state.hooked = false;
		g_states.push_back(std::move(state));
	}
	if (g_config != 0) {
		HookState state {"ClientUserIdOffset", false, false, ""};
		const i32 offset = s2sdk::GetGameConfigOffset(g_config, "ClientUserIdOffset");
		state.resolved = offset >= 0;
		// The offset is only a shortcut: the {userid} placeholder is filled from the engine userid
		// the game events carry (see engine::PlayerUserId), and the offset is trusted only after it
		// agreed with one of them.
		state.note = offset >= 0 ? FormatString("offset %d (validated against the event userid before use)", offset)
								 : "missing (user ids still come from the game events)";
		g_states.push_back(std::move(state));
	}

	// --- s2sdk listeners (the binding globals are null when s2sdk is absent) ---
	if (__s2sdk_OnGameFrame_Register) {
		s2sdk::OnGameFrame_Register(&OnGameFrameListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnMapStart_Register) {
		s2sdk::OnMapStart_Register(&OnMapStartListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnMapEnd_Register) {
		s2sdk::OnMapEnd_Register(&OnMapEndListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnClientActive_Register) {
		s2sdk::OnClientActive_Register(&OnClientActiveListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnClientFullyConnect_Register) {
		s2sdk::OnClientFullyConnect_Register(&OnClientFullyConnectListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnClientDisconnect_Register) {
		s2sdk::OnClientDisconnect_Register(&OnClientDisconnectListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnClientSettingsChanged_Register) {
		s2sdk::OnClientSettingsChanged_Register(&OnClientSettingsChangedListener);
	}

	// --- game events (the original hooked FireEvent pre+post; the pre hook is where it dispatched) ---
	if (__s2sdk_HookEvent) {
		for (const auto& consumed : kConsumedEvents) {
			s2sdk::HookEvent(consumed.name, &OnGameEvent, s2sdk::HookMode::Pre);
		}
	}

	// --- FireBullets ---
	if (__s2sdk_OnSendNetMessage_Register) {
		s2sdk::OnSendNetMessage_Register(&OnNetMessage);
	}

	g_initialized = true;
	Log("Hooks installed (%zu gamedata entries checked).", g_states.size());
	return true;
}

void Shutdown()
{
	if (!g_initialized) {
		return;
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnGameFrame_Unregister) {
		s2sdk::OnGameFrame_Unregister(&OnGameFrameListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnMapStart_Unregister) {
		s2sdk::OnMapStart_Unregister(&OnMapStartListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnMapEnd_Unregister) {
		s2sdk::OnMapEnd_Unregister(&OnMapEndListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnClientActive_Unregister) {
		s2sdk::OnClientActive_Unregister(&OnClientActiveListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnClientFullyConnect_Unregister) {
		s2sdk::OnClientFullyConnect_Unregister(&OnClientFullyConnectListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnClientDisconnect_Unregister) {
		s2sdk::OnClientDisconnect_Unregister(&OnClientDisconnectListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnClientSettingsChanged_Unregister) {
		s2sdk::OnClientSettingsChanged_Unregister(&OnClientSettingsChangedListener);
	}
	if (__s2sdk_UnhookEvent) {
		for (const auto& consumed : kConsumedEvents) {
			s2sdk::UnhookEvent(consumed.name, &OnGameEvent, s2sdk::HookMode::Pre);
		}
	}
	if (__s2sdk_OnSendNetMessage_Unregister) {
		s2sdk::OnSendNetMessage_Unregister(&OnNetMessage);
	}
	// Teardown in the order polyhook 2.5.6 requires: drop *our*
	// callback first, then unhook the target only when no callback is left on it. There is exactly
	// one detour per target function, shared with every other plugin (s2sdk hooks some of the same
	// functions), so unhooking while someone else's callback is still registered would tear down
	// their hook as well - and passing the trampoline (GetOriginalAddr) as the key would find
	// nothing and leave the engine calling freed code after this module is unloaded.
	for (auto& state : g_states) {
		if (!state.hooked || state.hook == nullptr) {
			continue;
		}
		try {
			if (state.handler != nullptr && __polyhook_RemoveCallback) {
				polyhook::RemoveCallback(state.hook, polyhook::CallbackType::Pre, state.handler);
			}
			bool remaining = false;
			if (__polyhook_AreCallbacksRegistered) {
				remaining = polyhook::AreCallbacksRegistered(state.hook);
			}
			if (!remaining && state.address != nullptr && __polyhook_UnhookDetour) {
				if (polyhook::UnhookDetour(state.address)) {
					state.hooked = false;
				} else {
					LogWarning("The %s detour could not be removed; it stays installed until the server restarts.", state.name.c_str());
				}
			} else {
				// Another plugin still owns a callback on this target: our detour object goes away
				// with the module, but the shared detour must stay.
				state.hooked = false;
			}
		} catch (...) {
			LogWarning("Removing the %s detour failed with an error; it stays installed until the server restarts.", state.name.c_str());
		}
	}
	// The official s2sdk gamedata guidance: always close gamedata files - use CloseGameConfigFile()
	// in OnPluginEnd() to prevent memory leaks. Shutdown is the plugin-end path (a reload loads the
	// file again in Initialize).
	if (g_config != 0 && __s2sdk_CloseGameConfigFile) {
		s2sdk::CloseGameConfigFile(g_config);
		g_config = 0;
	}
	g_initialized = false;
}

const std::vector<HookState>& States()
{
	return g_states;
}

void PrintReport()
{
	ConsoleMessage("Hook report (%zu entries):", g_states.size());
	for (const auto& state : g_states) {
		const char* status = state.hooked ? "hooked" : state.resolved ? "resolved" : "missing";
		if (!state.note.empty()) {
			ConsoleMessage("  %-26s %-9s %s", state.name.c_str(), status, state.note.c_str());
		} else {
			ConsoleMessage("  %-26s %s", state.name.c_str(), status);
		}
	}
	ConsoleMessage("  ProcessUsercmds: %llu calls, %llu accepted command batches; SetupMove: %llu calls (%s).",
				   static_cast<unsigned long long>(g_usercmdHookCalls), static_cast<unsigned long long>(g_usercmdBatches),
				   static_cast<unsigned long long>(g_setupMoveCalls), g_setupMoveSeen ? "command parsed" : "no command parsed yet");
	if (g_usercmdHookCalls > 0 && g_usercmdBatches == 0) {
		ConsoleMessage("  WARNING: the ProcessUsercmds hook fires but no batch was accepted - the captured argument layout does not match this "
					   "build; usercmd detections are effectively off.");
	}
	const engine::SchemaStats schema = engine::SchemaStatistics();
	ConsoleMessage("  schema: movement services resolved %llu times, missing %llu times, %llu offset misses, %llu jump-data reads.",
				   static_cast<unsigned long long>(schema.servicesResolved), static_cast<unsigned long long>(schema.servicesMissing),
				   static_cast<unsigned long long>(schema.offsetMisses), static_cast<unsigned long long>(schema.jumpDataReads));
	if (schema.servicesMissing > 0 && schema.servicesResolved == 0) {
		ConsoleMessage("  WARNING: the movement services pointer never resolved - the BHOP/hyperscroll/null subtick/destubticking gates that need it "
					   "are dead (check CBasePlayerPawn::m_pMovementServices in the schema).");
	}
	// {userid}: where the engine user id comes from (the game events are the always-correct source;
	// the gamedata offset is trusted only after it agreed with one of them).
	ConsoleMessage("  client userid: %s", engine::ClientUserIdStatus().c_str());
}

} // namespace hooks
} // namespace cs2ac
```

```cpp
//
// Same file names, same KeyValues "Phrases" content and the same fallback rules as the original:
// a phrase is only used when it exists *and* has the same placeholder set as the English text;
// otherwise the English text is used and the one-time fallback warning is printed.

void WarnFallback()
{
	if (!fallbackWarningPrinted) {
		fallbackWarningPrinted = true;
		if (warningSink) {
			warningSink(FormatString("Some phrases for language '%s' are missing or invalid. English will be used for them.", currentLanguage.c_str()));
		}
	}
}

// localization.cpp NormalizeLanguage
std::string NormalizeLanguage(const char* language)
{
	std::string result = language ? language : "";
	if (result.empty() || result.size() > 16) {
		return {};
	}
	for (char& character : result) {
		if (character == '_') {
			character = '-';
		} else if (std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(character))) {
			character = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(character)));
		} else if (character != '-') {
			return {};
		}
	}
	return result;
}

std::set<std::string> Placeholders(std::string_view text)
{
	std::set<std::string> result;
	for (std::size_t start = text.find('{'); start != std::string_view::npos; start = text.find('{', start + 1)) {
		const std::size_t end = text.find('}', start + 1);
		if (end == std::string_view::npos) {
			break;
		}
		const std::string_view name = text.substr(start + 1, end - start - 1);
		if (!name.empty() && std::all_of(name.begin(), name.end(), [](unsigned char character) {
				return std::isalnum(character) || character == '_' || character == '.';
			})) {
			result.emplace(name);
		}
	}
	return result;
}

std::string Apply(std::string_view text, Arguments arguments)
{
	std::string result;
	result.reserve(text.size() + 32);
	for (std::size_t index = 0; index < text.size();) {
		if (text[index] != '{') {
			result += text[index++];
			continue;
		}
		const std::size_t end = text.find('}', index + 1);
		if (end == std::string_view::npos) {
			result.append(text.substr(index));
			break;
		}
		const std::string_view name = text.substr(index + 1, end - index - 1);
		const auto found = std::find_if(arguments.begin(), arguments.end(), [name](const Argument& argument) { return argument.name == name; });
		if (found == arguments.end()) {
			result.append(text.substr(index, end - index + 1));
		} else {
			result += found->value;
		}
		index = end + 1;
	}
	return result;
}

// Minimal reader for the original phrase files: `"Phrases" { "key" "value" ... }` with optional
// // comments and the usual KV escapes (\n, \t, \r, \", \\). Only the first (Phrases) block is
// read; keys and values are taken verbatim otherwise.
bool LoadPhraseFile(const std::string& path, std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string>& out)
{
	std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary);
	if (!file) {
		return false;
	}
	std::stringstream buffer;
	buffer << file.rdbuf();
	const std::string contents = buffer.str();

	std::size_t cursor = 0;
	const auto skipSpace = [&]() {
		while (cursor < contents.size()) {
			const char character = contents[cursor];
			if (std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(character))) {
				++cursor;
			} else if (character == '/' && cursor + 1 < contents.size() && contents[cursor + 1] == '/') {
				while (cursor < contents.size() && contents[cursor] != '\n') {
					++cursor;
				}
			} else {
				break;
			}
		}
	};
	const auto readString = [&](std::string& out) {
		skipSpace();
		if (cursor >= contents.size() || contents[cursor] != '"') {
			return false;
		}
		++cursor;
		out.clear();
		while (cursor < contents.size() && contents[cursor] != '"') {
			char character = contents[cursor++];
			if (character == '\\' && cursor < contents.size()) {
				const char escaped = contents[cursor++];
				switch (escaped) {
				case 'n': character = '\n'; break;
				case 't': character = '\t'; break;
				case 'r': character = '\r'; break;
				default: character = escaped; break;
				}
			}
			out += character;
		}
		if (cursor >= contents.size()) {
			return false;
		}
		++cursor; // closing quote
		return true;
	};

	std::string blockName;
	if (!readString(blockName)) {
		return false;
	}
	skipSpace();
	if (cursor >= contents.size() || contents[cursor] != '{') {
		return false;
	}
	++cursor;
	while (true) {
		skipSpace();
		if (cursor >= contents.size() || contents[cursor] == '}') {
			break;
		}
		std::string key;
		if (!readString(key)) {
			// A stray token (an unquoted key, a brace inside a value) must not discard the whole
			// file: skip to the next quote or the closing brace and continue.
			const std::size_t next = contents.find_first_of("\"}", cursor);
			if (next == std::string::npos) {
				break;
			}
			cursor = next;
			continue;
		}
		std::string value;
		skipSpace();
		if (cursor < contents.size() && contents[cursor] == '{') {
			// Nested block in a phrase file: skip it (the original flattening would too).
			int depth = 1;
			++cursor;
			while (cursor < contents.size() && depth > 0) {
				if (contents[cursor] == '{') {
					++depth;
				} else if (contents[cursor] == '}') {
					--depth;
				}
				++cursor;
			}
			continue;
		}
		if (!readString(value)) {
			return false;
		}
		if (!value.empty()) {
			out[key] = value;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

} // namespace

void Reload(const char* language, const std::string& translationsDir)
{
	phrases.clear();
	fallbackWarningPrinted = false;
	currentLanguage = NormalizeLanguage(language);
	if (currentLanguage.empty()) {
		currentLanguage = "en";
		WarnFallback();
		return;
	}
	const std::string path = translationsDir + "/" + currentLanguage + ".txt";
	if (!LoadPhraseFile(path, phrases)) {
		WarnFallback();
	}
}

void Shutdown()
{
	phrases.clear();
	currentLanguage = "en";
	fallbackWarningPrinted = false;
}

const char* CurrentLanguage() { return currentLanguage.c_str(); }

std::string Get(const char* key, const char* english)
{
	const std::string fallback = english ? english : "";
	const auto found = key ? phrases.find(key) : phrases.end();
	if (found == phrases.end() || Placeholders(found->second) != Placeholders(fallback)) {
		if (found == phrases.end() || found->second != fallback) {
			WarnFallback();
		}
		return fallback;
	}
	return found->second;
}

Text Format(const char* key, const char* english, Arguments arguments)
{
	return {Apply(english ? english : "", arguments), Apply(Get(key, english), arguments)};
}

Text Watermark(Arguments arguments)
{
	constexpr std::string_view english = "This server is protected by {author}'s anti-cheat.";
	const auto found =
		std::find_if(std::begin(watermarkPhrases), std::end(watermarkPhrases), [](const auto& phrase) { return phrase.first == currentLanguage; });
	const std::string_view localized = found == std::end(watermarkPhrases) ? english : found->second;
	return {Apply(english, arguments), Apply(localized, arguments)};
}

std::size_t LoadedPhraseCount() { return phrases.size(); }

bool HasPhrase(const char* key) { return key && phrases.find(key) != phrases.end(); }

// Test/diagnostic seam: where the one-time fallback warning goes (the plugin points it at the log).
void SetWarningSink(std::function<void(const std::string&)> sink)
{
	warningSink = std::move(sink);
}

} // namespace localization
} // namespace cs2ac

```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/mod_aim.cpp`:

```cpp
// cs2ac — the Aimbot detector (detection/aimbot_module.cpp).
//
// All thresholds, windows, rules and debug lines are the original's; only the data sources changed
// (UsercmdView instead of the hl2sdk protobuf accessors, the engine:: accessors instead of the SDK
// entity reads). Aimlock and AntiAim live in mod_aimlock.cpp / mod_antiaim.cpp so that each module
// keeps its own constant block, exactly like the original's separate translation units.

#include "cs2ac.hpp"

#include <numeric>

namespace cs2ac {
namespace detection {

namespace {
bool AimbotDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_aimbot_debug"); }

constexpr size_t commandHistorySize = 128;
constexpr int snapWindowTicks = static_cast<int>(ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE * 0.5f);
constexpr f32 minimumDistance = 64.0f;
constexpr f32 closeRangeDistance = 100.0f;
constexpr int snapDetectionThreshold = 3;
constexpr int smoothDetectionThreshold = 3;
constexpr auto evidenceWindow = std::chrono::minutes(5);
// A confirmed smoothed-aimbot demo produced 12 damaging curves inside this envelope: 13.66-29.69 degrees of travel,
// 94.9-99.5% error removal, 0.12-0.85 degrees of final error, 94.6-100% path efficiency, and 3-5 shrinking steps.
constexpr f32 smoothMinimumMovement = 13.0f;
constexpr f32 smoothMinimumImprovement = 0.94f;
constexpr f32 smoothMaximumFinalError = 1.0f;
constexpr f32 smoothMinimumPathEfficiency = 0.94f;
constexpr f32 smoothMinimumStep = 0.15f;
constexpr f32 smoothRelativeStep = 0.10f;
constexpr int smoothMinimumSteps = 3;
constexpr f32 bodyHeights[] = {8.0f, 46.0f, 64.0f};

static_assert(MeetsSmoothThresholds(13.66f, 0.949f, 0.85f, 0.946f, 3, true), "the smooth envelope must accept the confirmed demo");
static_assert(!MeetsSmoothThresholds(6.31f, 0.934f, 0.41f, 1.0f, 3, true), "the smooth envelope must reject the confirmed negative");

enum class AimbotRule {
	None,
	Convergence,
	SnapReturn,
	SmoothConvergence,
};

f32 AimError(const Vector& eye, const QAngle& angles, const Vector& target)
{
	Vector direction = target - eye;
	if (!IsFinite(direction) || direction.LengthSqr() < EPSILON) {
		return 0.0f;
	}
	direction.NormalizeInPlace();
	const f32 dot = std::clamp(DotProduct(AimForward(angles), direction), -1.0f, 1.0f);
	return static_cast<f32>(std::acos(dot) * (180.0 / M_PI));
}

f32 NearestBodyAimError(const Vector& eye, const QAngle& angles, const Vector& feet)
{
	f32 best = 180.0f;
	for (f32 height : bodyHeights) {
		best = (std::min)(best, AimError(eye, angles, feet + Vector(0.0f, 0.0f, height)));
	}
	return best;
}
} // namespace

void AimbotModule::Load(AnnounceCallback announceCallback, ShotCorrelator* shotCorrelator)
{
	announce = std::move(announceCallback);
	shots = shotCorrelator;
}

void AimbotModule::Unload()
{
	Reset();
	shots = nullptr;
	announce = nullptr;
}

void AimbotModule::Reset()
{
	playerData = {};
	snapEvidence = {};
	smoothEvidence = {};
}

void AimbotModule::OnProcessUsercmds(PlayerRef* player, const std::vector<UsercmdView>& commands)
{
	if (!IsEligibleHuman(player) || commands.empty()) {
		return;
	}

	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)];
	for (const UsercmdView& command : commands) {
		if (!command.hasBase || !command.hasViewAngles) {
			continue;
		}
		if (std::any_of(data.commands.rbegin(), data.commands.rend(),
						[&](const AimCommand& stored) { return stored.commandNumber == command.commandNumber; })) {
			continue;
		}

		QAngle angles = command.viewAngles;
		const int attackIndex = command.attack1StartHistoryIndex;
		if (attackIndex >= 0 && attackIndex < static_cast<int>(command.inputHistory.size())
			&& command.inputHistory[static_cast<size_t>(attackIndex)].hasViewAngles) {
			const QAngle firingAngles = command.inputHistory[static_cast<size_t>(attackIndex)].viewAngles;
			if (IsFinite(firingAngles)) {
				angles = firingAngles;
			}
		}
		if (!IsFinite(angles)) {
			continue;
		}

		AimCommand captured {};
		captured.commandNumber = command.commandNumber;
		captured.clientTick = command.clientTick;
		captured.serverTick = -1;
		captured.angles = angles;
		data.commands.push_back(captured);
		while (data.commands.size() > commandHistorySize) {
			data.commands.pop_front();
		}
	}
}

void AimbotModule::OnSetupMove(PlayerRef* player, const UsercmdView& command, int currentTick)
{
	if (!IsEligibleHuman(player) || !command.hasBase) {
		return;
	}
	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)];
	auto found = std::find_if(data.commands.rbegin(), data.commands.rend(),
							  [&](const AimCommand& stored) { return stored.commandNumber == command.commandNumber; });
	if (found == data.commands.rend()) {
		return;
	}
	Vector eye;
	if (!engine::ReadEyeOrigin(player->index, eye) || !IsFinite(eye)) {
		return;
	}
	found->serverTick = currentTick;
	found->eyePosition = eye;
	found->simulated = true;
	if (!data.pending.empty()) {
		Evaluate(player, data, currentTick);
	}
}

void AimbotModule::OnGameFrame(int currentTick)
{
	for (int index = 1; index <= MAXPLAYERS; ++index) {
		if (playerData[static_cast<size_t>(index)].pending.empty()) {
			continue;
		}
		auto* player = g_pPlayerManager ? g_pPlayerManager->ToPlayer(index) : nullptr;
		if (!IsEligibleHuman(player)) {
			playerData[static_cast<size_t>(index)] = {};
			continue;
		}
		Evaluate(player, playerData[static_cast<size_t>(index)], currentTick);
	}
}

void AimbotModule::OnPlayerHurt(PlayerRef* attacker, PlayerRef* victim, ShotRecord& shot)
{
	if (!IsEligibleHuman(attacker) || !victim || attacker == victim || shot.playerIndex != attacker->index || shot.aimbotConsumed) {
		return;
	}
	shot.aimbotConsumed = true;
	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(attacker->index)];
	if (!data.pending.empty()) {
		Evaluate(attacker, data, shot.fireTick);
	}
	data.pending.push_back({shot.commandNumber, victim->index});
	while (data.pending.size() > 8) {
		data.pending.pop_front();
	}
	if (AimbotDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("Aimbot: %s matched damaging shot command %d at server tick %d.", attacker->GetName(), shot.commandNumber, shot.serverTick);
	}
	Evaluate(attacker, data, shot.fireTick);
}

bool AimbotModule::Evaluate(PlayerRef* attacker, AimbotPlayerData& data, int currentTick)
{
	if (data.pending.empty() || !shots) {
		return true;
	}
	const int pendingShot = data.pending.front().commandNumber;
	const int victimIndex = data.pending.front().victimIndex;
	auto clearPending = [&]() {
		if (!data.pending.empty()) {
			data.pending.pop_front();
		}
	};

	auto shot = std::find_if(data.commands.begin(), data.commands.end(),
							 [&](const AimCommand& command) { return command.commandNumber == pendingShot; });
	if (shot == data.commands.end() || !shot->simulated || victimIndex < 1 || victimIndex > MAXPLAYERS) {
		clearPending();
		return true;
	}

	const TrackedPosition* shotTarget = shots->FindPosition(shot->serverTick, victimIndex);
	const TrackedPosition* shotAttacker = shots->FindPosition(shot->serverTick, attacker->index);
	if (!shotTarget || !shotAttacker) {
		if (currentTick <= shot->serverTick) {
			return false;
		}
		if (AimbotDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Aimbot: %s rejected because target history is missing for server tick %d.", attacker->GetName(), shot->serverTick);
		}
		clearPending();
		return true;
	}
	if (shotTarget->teleported || shotAttacker->teleported) {
		if (AimbotDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Aimbot: %s rejected because a player teleported inside the snap window.", attacker->GetName());
		}
		clearPending();
		return true;
	}
	if (!AreOpponents(shotAttacker->team, shotTarget->team)) {
		if (AimbotDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Aimbot: %s rejected because the damaging shot was not against an enemy.", attacker->GetName());
		}
		clearPending();
		return true;
	}
	const f32 distance = (shotTarget->origin - shotAttacker->eyePosition).Length();
	if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance < minimumDistance) {
		if (AimbotDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Aimbot: %s rejected because target distance %.1f is below %.0f.", attacker->GetName(), static_cast<double>(distance),
						   static_cast<double>(minimumDistance));
		}
		clearPending();
		return true;
	}
	// Close-range aim snaps cover a much larger angular change for the same physical movement, so a
	// valid target position is not enough on its own. Require a tighter convergence and a clearer
	// snap-return at close range (fork import).
	const bool closeRange = distance < closeRangeDistance;

	bool suspicious = false;
	f32 largestSnap = 0.0f;
	f32 bestBefore = 0.0f;
	f32 bestAfter = 0.0f;
	f32 largestMeasuredSnap = -1.0f;
	f32 measuredBefore = 0.0f;
	f32 measuredAfter = 0.0f;
	int measuredMovements = 0;
	const char* measurementFailure = "no continuous adjacent command history was available";
	bool reusedSnap = false;
	bool commandDiscontinuity = false;
	AimbotRule matchedRule = AimbotRule::None;

	struct SmoothPoint {
		AimCommand* command;
		f32 error;
	};

	int smoothBodyPoint = 0;
	f32 smoothShotError = 180.0f;
	for (int bodyPoint = 0; bodyPoint < static_cast<int>(std::size(bodyHeights)); ++bodyPoint) {
		const f32 error = AimError(shotAttacker->eyePosition, shot->angles, shotTarget->origin + Vector(0.0f, 0.0f, bodyHeights[bodyPoint]));
		if (error < smoothShotError) {
			smoothShotError = error;
			smoothBodyPoint = bodyPoint;
		}
	}
	std::vector<SmoothPoint> smoothPoints {{&*shot, smoothShotError}};
	f32 smoothMovement = 0.0f;
	f32 smoothBefore = 0.0f;
	f32 smoothAfter = 0.0f;
	f32 smoothEfficiency = 0.0f;
	int smoothSteps = 0;
	auto findCommand = [&](int commandNumber) -> AimCommand* {
		auto found = std::find_if(data.commands.begin(), data.commands.end(),
								  [&](AimCommand& command) { return command.commandNumber == commandNumber && command.simulated; });
		return found == data.commands.end() ? nullptr : &*found;
	};
	AimCommand* newer = &*shot;
	while (newer->commandNumber > (std::numeric_limits<int>::min)()) {
		AimCommand* older = findCommand(newer->commandNumber - 1);
		if (!older) {
			measurementFailure = "the previous simulated command was missing";
			break;
		}
		const i64 serverGap = static_cast<i64>(newer->serverTick) - older->serverTick;
		if (static_cast<i64>(newer->clientTick) - older->clientTick != 1 || serverGap < 0 || serverGap > 1) {
			// A dropped, batched or replayed command makes this one pair unmeasurable. Skip only that
			// pair and keep walking through the continuously simulated history; discontinuity is
			// supporting context and must never be the only reason for a ban.
			commandDiscontinuity = true;
			newer = older;
			continue;
		}
		if (static_cast<i64>(shot->serverTick) - older->serverTick > snapWindowTicks) {
			measurementFailure = "the preceding command was outside the 0.5-second snap window";
			break;
		}

		const TrackedPosition* olderTarget = shots->FindPosition(older->serverTick, victimIndex);
		const TrackedPosition* newerTarget = shots->FindPosition(newer->serverTick, victimIndex);
		const TrackedPosition* olderAttacker = shots->FindPosition(older->serverTick, attacker->index);
		const TrackedPosition* newerAttacker = shots->FindPosition(newer->serverTick, attacker->index);
		if (!olderTarget || !newerTarget || !olderAttacker || !newerAttacker || olderTarget->teleported || newerTarget->teleported
			|| olderAttacker->teleported || newerAttacker->teleported) {
			measurementFailure = "matching historical player positions were missing or interrupted by a teleport";
			break;
		}
		const f32 snap = AngularDistance(older->angles, newer->angles);
		const f32 before = NearestBodyAimError(olderAttacker->eyePosition, older->angles, olderTarget->origin);
		const f32 after = NearestBodyAimError(newerAttacker->eyePosition, newer->angles, newerTarget->origin);
		if (!std::isfinite(snap) || !std::isfinite(before) || !std::isfinite(after)) {
			measurementFailure = "an angle or target-error measurement was invalid";
			break;
		}
		const f32 smoothError =
			AimError(olderAttacker->eyePosition, older->angles, olderTarget->origin + Vector(0.0f, 0.0f, bodyHeights[smoothBodyPoint]));
		if (!std::isfinite(smoothError)) {
			measurementFailure = "a fixed-body target-error measurement was invalid";
			break;
		}
		smoothPoints.push_back({older, smoothError});
		++measuredMovements;
		if (snap > largestMeasuredSnap) {
			largestMeasuredSnap = snap;
			measuredBefore = before;
			measuredAfter = after;
		}
		const bool converged = closeRange ? (before >= 30.0f && snap > 12.0f && after < before * 0.1f)
										  : ((before >= 20.0f && snap > 10.0f && after < before * 0.2f)
											 || (before >= 30.0f && snap > 5.0f && after < before * 0.1f));
		const bool fresh = !data.hasCountedIncident || newer->commandNumber > data.lastCountedIncidentCommand;
		if (converged && fresh) {
			suspicious = true;
			matchedRule = AimbotRule::Convergence;
			if (snap > largestSnap) {
				largestSnap = snap;
				bestBefore = before;
				bestAfter = after;
			}
		} else if (converged) {
			reusedSnap = true;
		}
		newer = older;
	}

	AimCommand* previous = pendingShot > (std::numeric_limits<int>::min)() ? findCommand(pendingShot - 1) : nullptr;
	AimCommand* next = pendingShot < (std::numeric_limits<int>::max)() ? findCommand(pendingShot + 1) : nullptr;
	if (!suspicious && !next && static_cast<i64>(currentTick) - shot->serverTick <= 1) {
		return false;
	}
	if (previous && next && shot->commandNumber - previous->commandNumber == 1 && next->commandNumber - shot->commandNumber == 1
		&& static_cast<i64>(shot->clientTick) - previous->clientTick == 1
		&& static_cast<i64>(next->clientTick) - shot->clientTick == 1
		&& static_cast<i64>(shot->serverTick) - previous->serverTick >= 0
		&& static_cast<i64>(shot->serverTick) - previous->serverTick <= 1
		&& static_cast<i64>(next->serverTick) - shot->serverTick >= 0
		&& static_cast<i64>(next->serverTick) - shot->serverTick <= 1) {
		const f32 surrounding = AngularDistance(previous->angles, next->angles);
		const f32 snap = AngularDistance(previous->angles, shot->angles);
		const bool fresh = !data.hasCountedIncident || shot->commandNumber > data.lastCountedIncidentCommand;
		const f32 surroundingLimit = closeRange ? 8.0f : 10.0f;
		const f32 snapMinimum = closeRange ? 12.0f : 5.0f;
		if (fresh && std::isfinite(surrounding) && std::isfinite(snap) && surrounding < surroundingLimit && snap > snapMinimum
			&& snap > surrounding * 5.0f) {
			if (!suspicious) {
				matchedRule = AimbotRule::SnapReturn;
				largestSnap = snap;
			}
			suspicious = true;
		}
	}

	// The smooth-curve rule compares consecutive points, so a command gap would make two
	// non-adjacent commands look like one step. Disable it when the history was discontinuous; the
	// pairwise convergence rule stays valid.
	if (!suspicious && !commandDiscontinuity && smoothPoints.size() >= static_cast<size_t>(smoothMinimumSteps + 1)) {
		std::reverse(smoothPoints.begin(), smoothPoints.end());
		std::vector<f32> movements;
		movements.reserve(smoothPoints.size() - 1);
		for (size_t index = 1; index < smoothPoints.size(); ++index) {
			movements.push_back(AngularDistance(smoothPoints[index - 1].command->angles, smoothPoints[index].command->angles));
		}
		const auto largest = std::max_element(movements.begin(), movements.end());
		const size_t start = static_cast<size_t>(std::distance(movements.begin(), largest));
		const f32 path = std::accumulate(movements.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(start), movements.end(), 0.0f);
		smoothMovement = AngularDistance(smoothPoints[start].command->angles, smoothPoints.back().command->angles);
		smoothBefore = smoothPoints[start].error;
		smoothAfter = smoothPoints.back().error;
		smoothEfficiency = path > EPSILON ? smoothMovement / path : 0.0f;
		const f32 meaningfulMinimum = (std::max)(smoothMinimumStep, *largest * smoothRelativeStep);
		f32 previousMeaningful = std::numeric_limits<f32>::infinity();
		bool shrinking = true;
		for (size_t index = start; index < movements.size(); ++index) {
			if (movements[index] < meaningfulMinimum) {
				continue;
			}
			if (movements[index] >= previousMeaningful) {
				shrinking = false;
			}
			previousMeaningful = movements[index];
			++smoothSteps;
		}
		const f32 improvement = smoothBefore > EPSILON ? 1.0f - smoothAfter / smoothBefore : 0.0f;
		const bool fresh = !data.hasCountedIncident || shot->commandNumber > data.lastCountedIncidentCommand;
		if (fresh && MeetsSmoothThresholds(smoothMovement, improvement, smoothAfter, smoothEfficiency, smoothSteps, shrinking)) {
			suspicious = true;
			matchedRule = AimbotRule::SmoothConvergence;
			largestSnap = smoothMovement;
			bestBefore = smoothBefore;
			bestAfter = smoothAfter;
		} else if (AimbotDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Aimbot: %s smooth curve rejected: movement %.2f/%.2f, target error %.2f -> %.2f/%.2f (%.1f%%/%.0f%% closer), "
						   "path %.1f%%/%.0f%%, steps %d/%d, shrinking %s.",
						   attacker->GetName(), static_cast<double>(smoothMovement), static_cast<double>(smoothMinimumMovement),
						   static_cast<double>(smoothBefore), static_cast<double>(smoothAfter), static_cast<double>(smoothMaximumFinalError),
						   static_cast<double>(improvement * 100.0f), static_cast<double>(smoothMinimumImprovement * 100.0f),
						   static_cast<double>(smoothEfficiency * 100.0f), static_cast<double>(smoothMinimumPathEfficiency * 100.0f), smoothSteps,
						   smoothMinimumSteps, shrinking ? "yes" : "no");
		}
	}

	const int incidentCommand = shot->commandNumber;
	clearPending();
	if (!suspicious) {
		if (reusedSnap) {
			if (AimbotDebug()) {
				ConsoleMessage("Aimbot: %s ignored a snap that already counted for an earlier damaging shot.", attacker->GetName());
			}
		} else if (AimbotDebug()) {
			if (commandDiscontinuity) {
				ConsoleMessage("Aimbot: %s noted a command discontinuity while scanning; it is context only and was not scored.",
							   attacker->GetName());
			}
			if (measuredMovements == 0) {
				ConsoleMessage("Aimbot: %s damaging shot rejected because %s.", attacker->GetName(), measurementFailure);
			} else {
				const f32 improvement = measuredBefore > EPSILON ? (1.0f - measuredAfter / measuredBefore) * 100.0f : 0.0f;
				const f32 requiredImprovement = largestMeasuredSnap > 10.0f ? 80.0f : 90.0f;
				ConsoleMessage("Aimbot: %s damaging shot rejected after checking %d adjacent movements: the largest one-command movement was %.2f "
							   "degrees with target error %.2f -> %.2f (%.1f%% closer); this movement requires more than %.0f%% improvement.",
							   attacker->GetName(), measuredMovements, static_cast<double>(largestMeasuredSnap), static_cast<double>(measuredBefore),
							   static_cast<double>(measuredAfter), static_cast<double>(improvement), static_cast<double>(requiredImprovement));
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	data.lastCountedIncidentCommand = incidentCommand;
	data.hasCountedIncident = true;
	const auto now = Clock::now();
	auto purge = [&](std::deque<Clock::time_point>& incidents) {
		while (!incidents.empty() && now - incidents.front() >= evidenceWindow) {
			incidents.pop_front();
		}
	};
	auto& snapIncidents = snapEvidence[static_cast<size_t>(attacker->index)];
	auto& smoothIncidents = smoothEvidence[static_cast<size_t>(attacker->index)];
	purge(snapIncidents);
	purge(smoothIncidents);
	auto& incidents = matchedRule == AimbotRule::SmoothConvergence ? smoothIncidents : snapIncidents;
	incidents.push_back(now);
	const int threshold = matchedRule == AimbotRule::SmoothConvergence ? smoothDetectionThreshold : snapDetectionThreshold;
	if (AimbotDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("Aimbot: %s counted rule %d evidence %d/%d (snap %.2f, target error %.2f -> %.2f).", attacker->GetName(),
					   static_cast<int>(matchedRule), static_cast<int>(incidents.size()), threshold, static_cast<double>(largestSnap),
					   static_cast<double>(bestBefore), static_cast<double>(bestAfter));
	}
	if (incidents.size() >= static_cast<size_t>(threshold)) {
		if (announce) {
			const auto values = localization::Arguments {{"incidents", FormatString("%zu", incidents.size())},
														 {"snap", FormatString("%.2f", static_cast<double>(largestSnap))},
														 {"before", FormatString("%.2f", static_cast<double>(bestBefore))},
														 {"after", FormatString("%.2f", static_cast<double>(bestAfter))}};
			const localization::Text details =
				matchedRule == AimbotRule::SnapReturn
					? localization::Format("evidence.aimbot.snap_return",
										   "CS2AC found {incidents} damaging shots where the aim jumped during the shot and immediately returned. "
										   "The latest jump was {snap} degrees.",
										   values)
				: matchedRule == AimbotRule::SmoothConvergence
					? localization::Format("evidence.aimbot.smooth",
										   "CS2AC found {incidents} damaging shots where the aim followed an unusually clean curve onto the enemy. "
										   "On the latest shot, the aim moved {snap} degrees and its distance from the enemy fell from {before} to "
										   "{after} degrees.",
										   values)
					: localization::Format("evidence.aimbot.convergence",
										   "CS2AC found {incidents} damaging shots where the aim moved onto the enemy in one sudden step. On the "
										   "latest shot, the aim moved {snap} degrees and its distance from the enemy fell from {before} to {after} "
										   "degrees.",
										   values);
			announce("AIMBOT", attacker, details);
		}
		snapIncidents.clear();
		smoothIncidents.clear();
	}
	return true;
}

void AimbotModule::OnClientDisconnect(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (player && player->index >= 1 && player->index <= MAXPLAYERS) {
		playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)] = {};
		snapEvidence[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)].clear();
		smoothEvidence[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)].clear();
	}
}

} // namespace detection
} // namespace cs2ac

```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/mod_aimlock.cpp`:

```cpp
// cs2ac — the Aimlock detector (detection/aimlock_module.cpp).
//
// Identical thresholds and rules; the visual-lag estimate reads s2sdk's latency plus the client's
// cl_interp_ratio cvar (the original read INetChannelInfo::GetEngineLatency and the engine's
// GetClientConVarValue).

#include "cs2ac.hpp"

namespace cs2ac {
namespace detection {

namespace {
bool AimlockDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_aimlock_debug"); }

constexpr int trackingTicks = static_cast<int>(ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE * 2.0f);
constexpr int rearmTicks = static_cast<int>(ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE * 0.5f);
constexpr int lagSearchRadius = 2;
constexpr f32 playerHalfWidth = 16.0f; // The CS2 player hull is 32 units wide; aim is measured from its center.
constexpr f32 aimlockMinimumDistance = 200.0f;
constexpr f32 minimumTargetTravel = 128.0f; // Four player widths, converted to degrees at the episode's starting distance.
constexpr f32 maximumInterpolationTicks = 19.0f;
constexpr int aimlockDetectionThreshold = 3;
constexpr auto aimlockEvidenceWindow = std::chrono::minutes(5);
constexpr f32 aimlockBodyHeights[] = {8.0f, 46.0f, 64.0f};

static_assert(MeetsCoverage(123, 129), "the 19/20 coverage rule must accept 123 of 129");
static_assert(!MeetsCoverage(122, 129), "the 19/20 coverage rule must reject 122 of 129");
static_assert(std::tuple_size<decltype(AimlockTrack::hypotheses)>::value == lagSearchRadius * 2 + 1, "one hypothesis per fixed delay");

struct Candidate {
	QAngle bearing;
	f32 error {180.0f};
	int targetIndex {-1};
	int bodyPoint {-1};
	int lagTicks {};
	bool valid {};
};

struct LagEstimate {
	int ticks {};
	f32 roundTripMilliseconds {};
	f32 interpolationTicks {};
	bool valid {};
};

QAngle Bearing(const Vector& eye, const Vector& target)
{
	const Vector delta = target - eye;
	constexpr f32 radiansToDegrees = static_cast<f32>(180.0 / M_PI);
	const f32 horizontal = std::sqrt(delta.x * delta.x + delta.y * delta.y);
	return {-std::atan2(delta.z, horizontal) * radiansToDegrees, std::atan2(delta.y, delta.x) * radiansToDegrees, 0.0f};
}

void ClearTrack(AimlockPlayerData& data)
{
	data.track = {};
}

void ClearRuntime(AimlockPlayerData& data)
{
	data = {};
}

// Whether the record holds anything ClearRuntime() would have to erase. Every field that any write
// in this file can set to a non-default value is listed; a record that answers false is the
// default record, and assigning {} over the default record writes nothing observable - which is
// why the frame loop may skip the clear (and the eligibility checks that decide it) for the slots
// that never held aimlock state, i.e. every empty slot and every bot.
bool HasRuntimeState(const AimlockPlayerData& data)
{
	return data.pending.valid || data.latched || data.latchedTarget >= 0 || data.latchedBodyPoint >= 0 || data.breakStartTick >= 0
		   || data.lastProcessedTick >= 0 || data.track.targetIndex >= 0 || data.track.bodyPoint >= 0 || data.track.startServerTick >= 0
		   || data.track.lastServerTick >= 0 || data.track.hypothesisCount != 0 || data.track.samples != 0;
}

// aimlock_module.cpp EstimateVisualLag, on the port's data sources.
LagEstimate EstimateVisualLag(PlayerRef* player)
{
	LagEstimate estimate;
	if (!player) {
		return estimate;
	}
	const engine::NetStats stats = engine::ClientNetStats(player->index);
	if (!stats.pingAvailable) {
		return estimate;
	}
	const char* interpolationValue = engine::ClientCvarValue(player->index, "cl_interp_ratio");
	if (!IsNumeric(interpolationValue)) {
		return estimate;
	}

	const f32 roundTripSeconds = stats.pingSeconds;
	f32 interpolationTicks = static_cast<f32>(std::strtod(interpolationValue, nullptr));
	if (!std::isfinite(roundTripSeconds) || roundTripSeconds < 0.0f || roundTripSeconds > 2.0f || !std::isfinite(interpolationTicks)
		|| interpolationTicks < 0.0f || interpolationTicks > maximumInterpolationTicks) {
		return estimate;
	}
	if (interpolationTicks == 0.0f) {
		interpolationTicks = 1.0f;
	}

	// The target snapshot travelled to the client before this aim command travelled back to the server, so use the full RTT.
	estimate.ticks = (std::max)(0, static_cast<int>(std::lround(roundTripSeconds * ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE + interpolationTicks)));
	estimate.roundTripMilliseconds = roundTripSeconds * 1000.0f;
	estimate.interpolationTicks = interpolationTicks;
	estimate.valid = true;
	return estimate;
}

const AimlockLagHypothesis* BestHypothesis(const AimlockTrack& track, bool requireEvidence)
{
	const AimlockLagHypothesis* best = nullptr;
	for (int index = 0; index < track.hypothesisCount; ++index) {
		const auto& hypothesis = track.hypotheses[static_cast<size_t>(index)];
		if (!hypothesis.valid
			|| (requireEvidence
				&& (!MeetsCoverage(hypothesis.onTargetSamples, track.samples)
					|| hypothesis.maximumTargetDisplacement < hypothesis.requiredTargetDisplacement))) {
			continue;
		}
		if (!best || hypothesis.onTargetSamples > best->onTargetSamples) {
			best = &hypothesis;
		}
	}
	return best;
}

bool MeasureTarget(const AimlockSample& sample, const TrackedPosition& target, int bodyPoint, const Vector& aimForward, QAngle& bearing, f32& error,
				   f32& maximumError, f32* requiredTargetDisplacement)
{
	if (bodyPoint < 0 || bodyPoint >= static_cast<int>(std::size(aimlockBodyHeights))) {
		return false;
	}

	const Vector targetPoint = target.origin + Vector(0.0f, 0.0f, aimlockBodyHeights[bodyPoint]);
	Vector direction = targetPoint - sample.eyePosition;
	const f32 targetDistance = direction.Length();
	if (!IsFinite(targetPoint) || !IsFinite(direction) || !std::isfinite(targetDistance) || targetDistance < EPSILON) {
		return false;
	}
	direction.NormalizeInPlace();
	const f32 dot = std::clamp(DotProduct(aimForward, direction), -1.0f, 1.0f);
	error = static_cast<f32>(std::acos(dot) * (180.0 / M_PI));
	maximumError = static_cast<f32>(std::atan2(playerHalfWidth, targetDistance) * (180.0 / M_PI));
	if (requiredTargetDisplacement) {
		*requiredTargetDisplacement = static_cast<f32>(std::atan2(minimumTargetTravel, targetDistance) * (180.0 / M_PI));
	}
	bearing = Bearing(sample.eyePosition, targetPoint);
	return std::isfinite(error) && std::isfinite(maximumError) && (!requiredTargetDisplacement || std::isfinite(*requiredTargetDisplacement))
		   && IsFinite(bearing);
}

bool EvaluateTarget(const AimlockSample& sample, const PositionFrame& currentFrame, const PositionFrame& historicalFrame, int observerIndex,
					int targetIndex, int bodyPoint, const Vector& aimForward, QAngle& bearing, f32& error, f32& maximumError,
					f32* requiredTargetDisplacement)
{
	if (observerIndex < 1 || observerIndex > MAXPLAYERS || targetIndex < 1 || targetIndex > MAXPLAYERS || !IsFinite(sample.eyePosition)
		|| !IsFinite(sample.angles)) {
		return false;
	}

	const auto& observer = currentFrame.players[static_cast<size_t>(observerIndex)];
	const auto& currentTarget = currentFrame.players[static_cast<size_t>(targetIndex)];
	const auto& target = historicalFrame.players[static_cast<size_t>(targetIndex)];
	if (!observer.valid || !observer.alive || observer.teleported || !currentTarget.valid || !currentTarget.alive || currentTarget.teleported
		|| !AreOpponents(observer.team, currentTarget.team) || !target.valid || !target.alive || target.teleported
		|| !AreOpponents(observer.team, target.team) || (target.origin - sample.eyePosition).Length() < aimlockMinimumDistance) {
		return false;
	}

	return MeasureTarget(sample, target, bodyPoint, aimForward, bearing, error, maximumError, requiredTargetDisplacement);
}

Candidate FindCandidate(const ShotCorrelator* shots, const AimlockSample& sample, const PositionFrame& currentFrame, int observerIndex,
						const LagEstimate& estimate)
{
	Candidate best;
	if (!shots || !estimate.valid || observerIndex < 1 || observerIndex > MAXPLAYERS || !IsFinite(sample.eyePosition) || !IsFinite(sample.angles)) {
		return best;
	}

	const auto& observer = currentFrame.players[static_cast<size_t>(observerIndex)];
	if (!observer.valid || !observer.alive || observer.teleported) {
		return best;
	}
	const Vector aimForward = AimForward(sample.angles);
	int matchedTarget = -1;
	bool ambiguous = false;
	const int firstLag = (std::max)(0, estimate.ticks - lagSearchRadius);
	const int lastLag = estimate.ticks + lagSearchRadius;
	for (int lagTicks = firstLag; lagTicks <= lastLag; ++lagTicks) {
		const PositionFrame* historicalFrame = shots->FindFrame(sample.serverTick - lagTicks);
		if (!historicalFrame) {
			continue;
		}
		for (int targetIndex = 1; targetIndex <= MAXPLAYERS; ++targetIndex) {
			if (targetIndex == observerIndex) {
				continue;
			}
			const auto& currentTarget = currentFrame.players[static_cast<size_t>(targetIndex)];
			const auto& target = historicalFrame->players[static_cast<size_t>(targetIndex)];
			if (!currentTarget.valid || !currentTarget.alive || currentTarget.teleported || !AreOpponents(observer.team, currentTarget.team)
				|| !target.valid || !target.alive || target.teleported || !AreOpponents(observer.team, target.team)
				|| (target.origin - sample.eyePosition).Length() < aimlockMinimumDistance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (int bodyPoint = 0; bodyPoint < static_cast<int>(std::size(aimlockBodyHeights)); ++bodyPoint) {
				QAngle bearing;
				f32 error = 180.0f;
				f32 maximumError = 0.0f;
				if (!MeasureTarget(sample, target, bodyPoint, aimForward, bearing, error, maximumError, nullptr) || error > maximumError) {
					continue;
				}

				if (matchedTarget < 0) {
					matchedTarget = targetIndex;
				} else if (matchedTarget != targetIndex) {
					ambiguous = true;
				}
				if (error < best.error) {
					best = {bearing, error, targetIndex, bodyPoint, lagTicks, true};
				}
			}
		}
	}

	best.valid = best.valid && !ambiguous;
	return best;
}
} // namespace

void AimlockModule::Load(AnnounceCallback announceCallback, ShotCorrelator* shotCorrelator)
{
	announce = std::move(announceCallback);
	shots = shotCorrelator;
}

void AimlockModule::Unload()
{
	Reset();
	shots = nullptr;
	announce = nullptr;
}

void AimlockModule::Reset()
{
	playerData = {};
	evidence = {};
}

void AimlockModule::OnSetupMove(PlayerRef* player, const UsercmdView& command, int currentTick)
{
	if (!IsEligibleHuman(player) || !command.hasBase) {
		return;
	}

	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)];
	if (currentTick == data.lastProcessedTick) {
		return;
	}
	if (!command.hasViewAngles) {
		ClearTrack(data);
		data.pending = {};
		return;
	}

	const QAngle angles = command.viewAngles;
	Vector eye;
	if (!IsFinite(angles) || !engine::ReadEyeOrigin(player->index, eye) || !IsFinite(eye)) {
		ClearTrack(data);
		data.pending = {};
		return;
	}

	// SetupMove is the authoritative gate: this is the last command the server will actually simulate for this tick.
	data.pending = {currentTick, angles, eye, true};
}

void AimlockModule::OnGameFrame(int currentTick)
{
	if (!shots) {
		return;
	}

	for (int index = 1; index <= MAXPLAYERS; ++index) {
		auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(index)];
		// A record with no runtime state is left alone: the original's ClearRuntime() over an
		// already-default record writes nothing, and the `!pending.valid` test below would have
		// skipped the slot anyway. That is every empty slot and every bot, so the player reads
		// below are only paid for (and only read in the order the detectors need) the slots that
		// actually hold aimlock state.
		if (!HasRuntimeState(data)) {
			continue;
		}
		auto* player = g_pPlayerManager ? g_pPlayerManager->ToPlayer(index) : nullptr;
		if (!player || !player->IsAlive() || !IsEligibleHuman(player)) {
			ClearRuntime(data);
			continue;
		}
		if (!data.pending.valid) {
			continue;
		}

		const AimlockSample sample = data.pending;
		data.pending = {};
		if (sample.serverTick != currentTick || sample.serverTick == data.lastProcessedTick || !shots->FindFrame(sample.serverTick)) {
			if (AimlockDebug()) {
				ConsoleMessage("Aimlock: %s tracking reset because the simulated command and world snapshot did not share one new tick.",
							   player->GetName());
			}
			ClearTrack(data);
			continue;
		}
		data.lastProcessedTick = sample.serverTick;
		Evaluate(player, data, sample);
	}
}

void AimlockModule::Evaluate(PlayerRef* player, AimlockPlayerData& data, const AimlockSample& sample)
{
	const PositionFrame* currentFrame = shots ? shots->FindFrame(sample.serverTick) : nullptr;
	if (!currentFrame || !IsFinite(sample.angles) || !IsFinite(sample.eyePosition)) {
		ClearTrack(data);
		return;
	}
	const Vector aimForward = AimForward(sample.angles);

	if (data.latched) {
		bool stillLocked = false;
		const LagEstimate estimate = EstimateVisualLag(player);
		if (estimate.valid) {
			const int firstLag = (std::max)(0, estimate.ticks - lagSearchRadius);
			const int lastLag = estimate.ticks + lagSearchRadius;
			for (int lagTicks = firstLag; lagTicks <= lastLag; ++lagTicks) {
				const PositionFrame* historicalFrame = shots->FindFrame(sample.serverTick - lagTicks);
				if (!historicalFrame) {
					continue;
				}
				QAngle bearing;
				f32 error = 180.0f;
				f32 maximumError = 0.0f;
				if (EvaluateTarget(sample, *currentFrame, *historicalFrame, player->index, data.latchedTarget, data.latchedBodyPoint, aimForward,
								   bearing, error, maximumError, nullptr)
					&& error <= maximumError) {
					stillLocked = true;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		if (stillLocked) {
			data.breakStartTick = -1;
			return;
		}
		if (data.breakStartTick < 0) {
			data.breakStartTick = sample.serverTick;
		}
		if (static_cast<i64>(sample.serverTick) - data.breakStartTick < rearmTicks) {
			return;
		}
		data.latched = false;
		data.latchedTarget = -1;
		data.latchedBodyPoint = -1;
		data.breakStartTick = -1;
		if (AimlockDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Aimlock: %s rearmed after a half-second break.", player->GetName());
		}
	}

	auto startTrack = [&]() {
		const LagEstimate estimate = EstimateVisualLag(player);
		const Candidate candidate = FindCandidate(shots, sample, *currentFrame, player->index, estimate);
		if (!candidate.valid) {
			return;
		}

		data.track = {};
		data.track.targetIndex = candidate.targetIndex;
		data.track.bodyPoint = candidate.bodyPoint;
		data.track.startServerTick = sample.serverTick;
		data.track.lastServerTick = sample.serverTick;
		data.track.samples = 1;
		const int firstLag = (std::max)(0, estimate.ticks - lagSearchRadius);
		const int lastLag = estimate.ticks + lagSearchRadius;
		for (int lagTicks = firstLag;
			 lagTicks <= lastLag && data.track.hypothesisCount < static_cast<int>(data.track.hypotheses.size()); ++lagTicks) {
			const PositionFrame* historicalFrame = shots->FindFrame(sample.serverTick - lagTicks);
			if (!historicalFrame) {
				continue;
			}
			QAngle bearing;
			f32 error = 180.0f;
			f32 maximumError = 0.0f;
			f32 requiredTargetDisplacement = 0.0f;
			if (!EvaluateTarget(sample, *currentFrame, *historicalFrame, player->index, candidate.targetIndex, candidate.bodyPoint, aimForward,
								bearing, error, maximumError, &requiredTargetDisplacement)) {
				continue;
			}
			data.track.hypotheses[static_cast<size_t>(data.track.hypothesisCount++)] = {bearing, 0.0f, requiredTargetDisplacement, lagTicks,
																						error <= maximumError, true};
		}
		if (data.track.hypothesisCount == 0) {
			ClearTrack(data);
			return;
		}
		if (AimlockDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Aimlock: %s started tracking target %d body point %d across %d fixed visual-delay candidates (%d-%d ticks) at %.3f "
						   "degrees (RTT %.1f ms, interpolation %.1f ticks).",
						   player->GetName(), candidate.targetIndex, candidate.bodyPoint, data.track.hypothesisCount,
						   data.track.hypotheses.front().lagTicks, data.track.hypotheses[static_cast<size_t>(data.track.hypothesisCount - 1)].lagTicks,
						   static_cast<double>(candidate.error), static_cast<double>(estimate.roundTripMilliseconds),
						   static_cast<double>(estimate.interpolationTicks));
		}
	};

	if (data.track.targetIndex < 0) {
		startTrack();
		return;
	}

	const i64 serverTickDelta = static_cast<i64>(sample.serverTick) - data.track.lastServerTick;
	if (serverTickDelta != 1) {
		if (AimlockDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Aimlock: %s tracking reset because the simulated server ticks were not consecutive (%lld).", player->GetName(),
						   static_cast<long long>(serverTickDelta));
		}
		ClearTrack(data);
		startTrack();
		return;
	}

	++data.track.samples;
	int validHypotheses = 0;
	for (int index = 0; index < data.track.hypothesisCount; ++index) {
		auto& hypothesis = data.track.hypotheses[static_cast<size_t>(index)];
		if (!hypothesis.valid) {
			continue;
		}

		QAngle bearing;
		f32 error = 180.0f;
		f32 maximumError = 0.0f;
		const PositionFrame* historicalFrame = shots->FindFrame(sample.serverTick - hypothesis.lagTicks);
		if (!historicalFrame
			|| !EvaluateTarget(sample, *currentFrame, *historicalFrame, player->index, data.track.targetIndex, data.track.bodyPoint, aimForward,
							   bearing, error, maximumError, nullptr)) {
			hypothesis.valid = false;
			continue;
		}
		const f32 displacement = AngularDistance(hypothesis.startBearing, bearing);
		if (!std::isfinite(displacement)) {
			hypothesis.valid = false;
			continue;
		}

		++validHypotheses;
		hypothesis.onTargetSamples += error <= maximumError;
		hypothesis.maximumTargetDisplacement = (std::max)(hypothesis.maximumTargetDisplacement, displacement);
	}
	if (validHypotheses == 0) {
		if (AimlockDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Aimlock: %s tracking reset because the fixed target history was no longer trustworthy.", player->GetName());
		}
		ClearTrack(data);
		startTrack();
		return;
	}

	data.track.lastServerTick = sample.serverTick;

	const int elapsedTicks = sample.serverTick - data.track.startServerTick;
	if (elapsedTicks > 0 && elapsedTicks < trackingTicks && elapsedTicks % rearmTicks == 0 && AimlockDebug()) {
		const AimlockLagHypothesis* best = BestHypothesis(data.track, false);
		if (best) {
			ConsoleMessage("Aimlock: %s episode: %.1f/2.0 seconds, best fixed delay %d ticks kept %d/%d samples within the target width; target moved "
						   "%.1f/%.1f required degrees.",
						   player->GetName(), static_cast<double>(static_cast<f32>(elapsedTicks) / ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE), best->lagTicks,
						   best->onTargetSamples, data.track.samples, static_cast<double>(best->maximumTargetDisplacement),
						   static_cast<double>(best->requiredTargetDisplacement));
		}
	}
	if (elapsedTicks < trackingTicks) {
		return;
	}

	const AimlockLagHypothesis* passing = BestHypothesis(data.track, true);
	if (!passing) {
		if (AimlockDebug()) {
			const AimlockLagHypothesis* best = BestHypothesis(data.track, false);
			if (best) {
				ConsoleMessage("Aimlock: %s episode ended without evidence: best fixed delay %d ticks kept %d/%d samples within the target width; "
							   "target moved %.1f/%.1f required degrees.",
							   player->GetName(), best->lagTicks, best->onTargetSamples, data.track.samples,
							   static_cast<double>(best->maximumTargetDisplacement), static_cast<double>(best->requiredTargetDisplacement));
			}
		}
		ClearTrack(data);
		return;
	}
	AddIncident(player, data, *passing);
}

void AimlockModule::AddIncident(PlayerRef* player, AimlockPlayerData& data, const AimlockLagHypothesis& hypothesis)
{
	const auto now = Clock::now();
	auto& incidents = evidence[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)];
	while (!incidents.empty() && now - incidents.front() >= aimlockEvidenceWindow) {
		incidents.pop_front();
	}
	incidents.push_back(now);
	if (AimlockDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("Aimlock: %s added evidence %d/%d after fixed delay %d ticks kept %d/%d precise samples and %.1f/%.1f required degrees of "
					   "target movement.",
					   player->GetName(), static_cast<int>(incidents.size()), aimlockDetectionThreshold, hypothesis.lagTicks,
					   hypothesis.onTargetSamples, data.track.samples, static_cast<double>(hypothesis.maximumTargetDisplacement),
					   static_cast<double>(hypothesis.requiredTargetDisplacement));
	}
	const bool detected = incidents.size() >= aimlockDetectionThreshold;
	if (detected) {
		if (announce) {
			announce("AIMLOCK", player,
					 localization::Format("evidence.aimlock",
										  "CS2AC found {incidents} separate periods of near-perfect enemy tracking. During the latest two-second "
										  "period, the aim stayed inside the enemy's body width for {precise} of {samples} checks while the enemy moved "
										  "far enough across the player's view. The enemy moved {movement} degrees across the view; {required} "
										  "degrees was required at that distance.",
										  {{"incidents", FormatString("%zu", incidents.size())},
										   {"precise", FormatString("%d", hypothesis.onTargetSamples)},
										   {"samples", FormatString("%d", data.track.samples)},
										   {"movement", FormatString("%.1f", static_cast<double>(hypothesis.maximumTargetDisplacement))},
										   {"required", FormatString("%.1f", static_cast<double>(hypothesis.requiredTargetDisplacement))}}));
		}
		incidents.clear();
		data.latched = true;
		data.latchedTarget = data.track.targetIndex;
		data.latchedBodyPoint = data.track.bodyPoint;
		data.breakStartTick = -1;
	}

	ClearTrack(data);
}

void AimlockModule::OnClientDisconnect(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (player && player->index >= 1 && player->index <= MAXPLAYERS) {
		playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)] = {};
		evidence[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)].clear();
	}
}

} // namespace detection
} // namespace cs2ac

```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/mod_antiaim.cpp`:

```cpp
// cs2ac — the AntiAim detector (detection/antiaim_module.cpp).
//
// Identical weights, thresholds, decay rates and rules.

#include "cs2ac.hpp"

namespace cs2ac {
namespace detection {

namespace {
bool AntiAimDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_antiaim_debug"); }

constexpr int antiaimCommandHistorySize = 96;
constexpr int spinSamples = 16;
constexpr f32 invalidPitch = 89.01f;
constexpr f32 invalidRoll = 50.01f;
constexpr f32 minimumSpinRate = 320.0f;
constexpr f32 mediumSpinRate = 1000.0f;
constexpr f32 fastSpinRate = 2200.0f;
constexpr f32 slowSpinSeconds = 15.0f;
constexpr f32 mediumSpinSeconds = 10.0f;
constexpr f32 fastSpinSeconds = 10.0f;
constexpr f32 spinBreakAllowance = 1.0f;
constexpr f32 spinConsistency = 0.85f;
constexpr f32 jitterTolerance = 0.25f;
constexpr f32 minimumJitterSpan = 10.0f;
constexpr f32 requiredJitterSeconds = 10.0f;
constexpr f32 commandYawMismatchAngle = 120.0f;
constexpr f32 minimumAttackReturnAngle = 30.0f;
constexpr int commandMismatchSpacing = 4;
constexpr f32 antiaimDetectionThreshold = 100.0f;
constexpr f32 scoreDecayPerSecond = 2.0f;
constexpr f32 mismatchScoreDecayPerSecond = 5.0f;

enum CommandProblem : u32 {
	NonFiniteBaseAngles = 1 << 0,
	InvalidAttackHistory = 1 << 1,
	NonFiniteHistoryAngles = 1 << 2,
	NonFiniteSubtickAngles = 1 << 3,
};

const char* ProblemName(u32 problems)
{
	if (problems & NonFiniteBaseAngles) {
		return "the base view angle is not finite";
	}
	if (problems & InvalidAttackHistory) {
		return "the firing history index is invalid";
	}
	if (problems & NonFiniteHistoryAngles) {
		return "an input-history angle is not finite";
	}
	return "a subtick angle delta is not finite";
}
} // namespace

void AntiAimModule::Load(AnnounceCallback announceCallback, AnnounceCallback networkVetoCallback, NetworkSafetyMonitor* networkSafetyMonitor)
{
	announce = std::move(announceCallback);
	announceNetworkVeto = std::move(networkVetoCallback);
	networkSafety = networkSafetyMonitor;
}

void AntiAimModule::Unload()
{
	Reset();
	announce = nullptr;
	announceNetworkVeto = nullptr;
	networkSafety = nullptr;
}

void AntiAimModule::Reset()
{
	playerData = {};
}

void AntiAimModule::ResetMotion(AntiAimPlayerData& data)
{
	data.spinSeconds = {};
	data.spinBreakSeconds = {};
	data.jitterSeconds = 0.0f;
	data.jitterBreakSeconds = 0.0f;
	data.spinDebugBucket = -1;
	data.jitterDebugBucket = -1;
	data.lastMotionServerTick = -1;
	data.spinActive = false;
	data.jitterActive = false;
}

void AntiAimModule::ApplyDecay(PlayerRef* player, AntiAimPlayerData& data)
{
	auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
	if (data.scoreTime.time_since_epoch().count() == 0) {
		data.scoreTime = now;
		return;
	}
	const f32 elapsed = std::chrono::duration<f32>(now - data.scoreTime).count();
	data.scoreTime = now;
	if (elapsed <= 0.0f || (data.score <= 0.0f && data.mismatchScore <= 0.0f)) {
		return;
	}
	const int before = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(data.score + data.mismatchScore - 0.0001f));
	data.score = (std::max)(0.0f, data.score - elapsed * scoreDecayPerSecond);
	data.mismatchScore = (std::max)(0.0f, data.mismatchScore - elapsed * mismatchScoreDecayPerSecond);
	const f32 total = data.score + data.mismatchScore;
	const int after = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(total - 0.0001f));
	if (player && after < before && AntiAimDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s score decayed to %.1f/%.0f (regular %.1f, mismatch %.1f).", player->GetName(), static_cast<double>(total),
					   static_cast<double>(antiaimDetectionThreshold), static_cast<double>(data.score), static_cast<double>(data.mismatchScore));
	}
}

void AntiAimModule::AddEvidence(PlayerRef* player, AntiAimPlayerData& data, f32 weight, const char* reasonKey, const char* reason, bool continuous,
								bool mismatch)
{
	if (!player || data.suppressContinuous) {
		return;
	}
	ApplyDecay(player, data);
	(mismatch ? data.mismatchScore : data.score) += weight;
	const f32 total = data.score + data.mismatchScore;
	if (AntiAimDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s added %.1f for %s; score %.1f/%.0f (regular %.1f, mismatch %.1f).", player->GetName(), static_cast<double>(weight),
					   reason, static_cast<double>(total), static_cast<double>(antiaimDetectionThreshold), static_cast<double>(data.score),
					   static_cast<double>(data.mismatchScore));
	}
	if (total < antiaimDetectionThreshold) {
		return;
	}

	const bool mismatchRequired = data.mismatchScore > 0.0f && data.score < antiaimDetectionThreshold;
	NetworkSafetyEvidence network;
	if (mismatchRequired) {
		if (networkSafety) {
			network = networkSafety->Evaluate(player);
		} else {
			network.unavailableSamples = 1;
			network.vetoed = true;
		}
	}
	const bool networkVetoed = mismatchRequired && network.vetoed;
	const AnnounceCallback& callback = networkVetoed ? announceNetworkVeto : announce;
	if (callback) {
		const std::string localizedReason = localization::Get(reasonKey, reason);
		localization::Text details {
			FormatString("The final piece of evidence was %s. It added %.1f points, bringing the combined AntiAim score to %.1f/%.0f.", reason,
						 static_cast<double>(weight), static_cast<double>(total), static_cast<double>(antiaimDetectionThreshold)),
			localization::Format("evidence.antiaim",
								 "The final piece of evidence was {reason}. It added {points} points, bringing the combined AntiAim score to "
								 "{score}/{threshold}.",
								 {{"reason", localizedReason},
								  {"points", FormatString("%.1f", static_cast<double>(weight))},
								  {"score", FormatString("%.1f", static_cast<double>(total))},
								  {"threshold", FormatString("%.0f", static_cast<double>(antiaimDetectionThreshold))}})
				.localized,
		};
		// m_yaw is evidence-only context for reviewing high-value turn binds; it never changes the score or punishment.
		const char* mYaw = engine::ClientCvarValue(player->index, "m_yaw");
		if (IsNumeric(mYaw)) {
			const auto yaw = localization::Format("evidence.antiaim.m_yaw", "The player's m_yaw value was {value} at the time.",
												  {{"value", FormatString("%.6g", std::strtod(mYaw, nullptr))}});
			details = {details.english + " " + yaw.english, details.localized + " " + yaw.localized};
		}
		callback("ANTIAIM", player, networkVetoed ? AddNetworkSafetyDetails(details, network) : details);
	}
	data.score = 0.0f;
	data.mismatchScore = 0.0f;
	data.scoreTime = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
	data.suppressContinuous = continuous;
	if (AntiAimDebug()) {
		if (networkVetoed) {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s reached the threshold through mismatch evidence, but punishment was withheld: %.1f ms ping, %.1f ms jitter, "
						   "%.1f/%.1f%% loss, %.1f/%.1f%% choke, %d command gaps, and %d unavailable samples.",
						   player->GetName(), static_cast<double>(network.pingMilliseconds), static_cast<double>(network.jitterMilliseconds),
						   static_cast<double>(network.incomingLoss * 100.0f), static_cast<double>(network.outgoingLoss * 100.0f),
						   static_cast<double>(network.incomingChoke * 100.0f), static_cast<double>(network.outgoingChoke * 100.0f),
						   network.commandGaps, network.unavailableSamples);
		} else {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s reached the threshold; evidence was cleared%s.", player->GetName(),
						   continuous ? " until this continuous episode ends" : "");
		}
	}
}

void AntiAimModule::OnProcessUsercmds(PlayerRef* player, const std::vector<UsercmdView>& commands)
{
	if (!player || player->index < 1 || player->index > MAXPLAYERS || commands.empty() || !player->IsInGame() || player->IsFakeClient()
		|| player->IsCSTV()) {
		return;
	}

	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)];
	for (const UsercmdView& command : commands) {
		if (!command.hasBase || !command.hasViewAngles) {
			continue;
		}
		if (std::any_of(data.commands.rbegin(), data.commands.rend(),
						[&](const AntiAimCommand& stored) { return stored.commandNumber == command.commandNumber; })) {
			continue;
		}

		AntiAimCommand captured;
		captured.commandNumber = command.commandNumber;
		captured.clientTick = command.clientTick;
		captured.baseAngles = command.viewAngles;
		captured.mouseX = command.mouseDx;
		captured.mouseY = command.mouseDy;
		if (!IsFinite(captured.baseAngles)) {
			captured.problems |= NonFiniteBaseAngles;
		}

		const int attackIndex = command.attack1StartHistoryIndex;
		captured.attack = attackIndex >= 0;
		if (attackIndex < -1 || attackIndex >= static_cast<int>(command.inputHistory.size())) {
			captured.problems |= InvalidAttackHistory;
		}
```
