```cpp
		for (int historyIndex = 0; historyIndex < static_cast<int>(command.inputHistory.size()); ++historyIndex) {
			const InputHistoryEntry& history = command.inputHistory[static_cast<size_t>(historyIndex)];
			if (!history.hasViewAngles) {
				continue;
			}
			const QAngle historyAngles = history.viewAngles;
			if (!IsFinite(historyAngles)) {
				captured.problems |= NonFiniteHistoryAngles;
				continue;
			}
			captured.hasHistoryAngles = true;
			const f32 yawDifference = std::abs(YawDelta(captured.baseAngles.y, historyAngles.y));
			captured.historyYawDifference = (std::max)(captured.historyYawDifference, yawDifference);
			if (historyIndex == attackIndex) {
				captured.shotAngles = historyAngles;
				captured.hasShotAngles = true;
			}
		}
		for (const SubtickMove& move : command.subtickMoves) {
			if ((move.hasPitchDelta && !std::isfinite(move.pitchDelta)) || (move.hasYawDelta && !std::isfinite(move.yawDelta))) {
				captured.problems |= NonFiniteSubtickAngles;
				continue;
			}
			if (move.hasPitchDelta) {
				captured.subtickPitch += move.pitchDelta;
			}
			if (move.hasYawDelta) {
				captured.subtickYaw += move.yawDelta;
			}
		}
		if (!std::isfinite(captured.subtickPitch) || !std::isfinite(captured.subtickYaw)) {
			captured.problems |= NonFiniteSubtickAngles;
			captured.subtickPitch = 0.0f;
			captured.subtickYaw = 0.0f;
		}

		data.commands.push_back(captured);
		while (data.commands.size() > static_cast<size_t>(antiaimCommandHistorySize)) {
			data.commands.pop_front();
		}
	}
}

void AntiAimModule::EvaluateMotion(PlayerRef* player, AntiAimPlayerData& data, AntiAimCommand& command)
{
	// A stationary player holding a turn bind can produce a long, perfectly regular angle stream
	// without any anti-aim behaviour. Continuous spin and jitter evidence requires movement;
	// shot-based attack-return evidence is evaluated separately (fork import).
	const Vector velocity = engine::PlayerVelocity(player->index);
	const bool hasActiveMovement = std::isfinite(velocity.x) && std::isfinite(velocity.y) && velocity.Length2D() >= 8.0f;
	if (!hasActiveMovement && !command.attack) {
		ResetMotion(data);
		return;
	}
	if (command.serverTick == data.lastMotionServerTick) {
		return;
	}
	const i64 serverGap = data.lastMotionServerTick < 0 ? 1 : static_cast<i64>(command.serverTick) - data.lastMotionServerTick;
	if (serverGap <= 0) {
		ResetMotion(data);
		return;
	}
	if (serverGap > ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE) {
		ResetMotion(data);
	}
	data.lastMotionServerTick = command.serverTick;

	std::array<AntiAimCommand*, 20> history {};
	size_t historyCount = 0;
	i64 wantedTick = command.serverTick;
	for (auto candidate = data.commands.rbegin(); candidate != data.commands.rend() && historyCount < history.size(); ++candidate) {
		if (!candidate->simulated || !IsFinite(candidate->baseAngles) || candidate->serverTick > wantedTick) {
			continue;
		}
		if (candidate->serverTick < wantedTick) {
			break;
		}
		history[historyCount++] = &*candidate;
		--wantedTick;
	}

	bool spinMatches = false;
	f32 spinRate = 0.0f;
	f32 spinDirectionConsistency = 0.0f;
	if (historyCount >= static_cast<size_t>(spinSamples)) {
		f32 total = 0.0f;
		f32 net = 0.0f;
		for (int i = 0; i < spinSamples - 1; ++i) {
			const f32 delta = YawDelta(history[static_cast<size_t>(i + 1)]->baseAngles.y, history[static_cast<size_t>(i)]->baseAngles.y);
			total += std::abs(delta);
			net += delta;
		}
		const f32 elapsed = static_cast<f32>(static_cast<i64>(history[0]->serverTick) - history[static_cast<size_t>(spinSamples - 1)]->serverTick)
							/ ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE;
		spinRate = elapsed > 0.0f ? total / elapsed : 0.0f;
		spinDirectionConsistency = total > 0.0f ? std::abs(net) / total : 0.0f;
		const f32 latestRate = std::abs(YawDelta(history[1]->baseAngles.y, history[0]->baseAngles.y)) * ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE;
		spinMatches = spinRate >= minimumSpinRate && latestRate >= minimumSpinRate && spinDirectionConsistency >= spinConsistency;
	}

	const f32 commandSeconds = static_cast<f32>(serverGap) / ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE;
	static constexpr f32 tierRates[] = {minimumSpinRate, mediumSpinRate, fastSpinRate};
	static constexpr f32 tierSeconds[] = {slowSpinSeconds, mediumSpinSeconds, fastSpinSeconds};
	bool spinDetected = false;
	bool spinEpisodeActive = false;
	f32 bestProgress = 0.0f;
	for (size_t tier = 0; tier < std::size(tierRates); ++tier) {
		if (spinMatches && spinRate >= tierRates[tier] && serverGap == 1) {
			data.spinBreakSeconds[tier] = 0.0f;
			if (!data.suppressContinuous) {
				data.spinSeconds[tier] += 1.0f / ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE;
			}
			spinEpisodeActive = true;
		} else if (data.spinSeconds[tier] > 0.0f || data.spinBreakSeconds[tier] > 0.0f) {
			data.spinBreakSeconds[tier] += commandSeconds;
			if (data.spinBreakSeconds[tier] > spinBreakAllowance) {
				data.spinSeconds[tier] = 0.0f;
				data.spinBreakSeconds[tier] = 0.0f;
			} else {
				spinEpisodeActive = true;
			}
		}

		bestProgress = (std::max)(bestProgress, data.spinSeconds[tier] / tierSeconds[tier]);
		spinDetected = spinDetected || data.spinSeconds[tier] >= tierSeconds[tier];
	}
	data.spinActive = spinEpisodeActive;
	const int debugBucket = static_cast<int>(bestProgress * 10.0f);
	if (spinMatches && debugBucket > data.spinDebugBucket) {
		data.spinDebugBucket = debugBucket;
		if (AntiAimDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s sustained %.0f deg/s spin with %.2f direction consistency; progress %d%%.", player->GetName(),
						   static_cast<double>(spinRate), static_cast<double>(spinDirectionConsistency), (std::min)(debugBucket * 10, 100));
		}
	}
	if (spinDetected && !data.suppressContinuous) {
		AddEvidence(player, data, antiaimDetectionThreshold, "evidence.antiaim.reason.spin",
					"continuous spinning at a speed and consistency associated with AntiAim", true);
		data.spinActive = true;
	} else if (!spinEpisodeActive) {
		if (data.spinDebugBucket >= 0 && AntiAimDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s spin stopped; progress was reset.", player->GetName());
		}
		data.spinDebugBucket = -1;
	}

	data.jitterActive = false;
	int jitterPeriod = 0;
	for (int period : {2, 3, 5}) {
		const int required = period * 4;
		if (historyCount < static_cast<size_t>(required)) {
			continue;
		}
		bool repeats = true;
		for (int i = 0; i < required - period; ++i) {
			if (std::abs(YawDelta(history[static_cast<size_t>(i + period)]->baseAngles.y, history[static_cast<size_t>(i)]->baseAngles.y))
				> jitterTolerance) {
				repeats = false;
				break;
			}
		}
		f32 span = 0.0f;
		for (int i = 0; i < period; ++i) {
			for (int j = i + 1; j < period; ++j) {
				span = (std::max)(
					span, std::abs(YawDelta(history[static_cast<size_t>(i)]->baseAngles.y, history[static_cast<size_t>(j)]->baseAngles.y)));
			}
		}
		if (repeats && span > minimumJitterSpan) {
			jitterPeriod = period;
			break;
		}
	}
	bool jitterEpisodeActive = false;
	// Require sustained jitter instead of scoring every repeated step; legitimate 180-degree binds can briefly form the same pattern.
	if (jitterPeriod != 0 && serverGap == 1) {
		data.jitterBreakSeconds = 0.0f;
		if (!data.suppressContinuous) {
			data.jitterSeconds += 1.0f / ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE;
		}
		jitterEpisodeActive = true;
	} else if (data.jitterSeconds > 0.0f || data.jitterBreakSeconds > 0.0f) {
		data.jitterBreakSeconds += commandSeconds;
		if (data.jitterBreakSeconds > spinBreakAllowance) {
			data.jitterSeconds = 0.0f;
			data.jitterBreakSeconds = 0.0f;
		} else {
			jitterEpisodeActive = true;
		}
	}

	data.jitterActive = jitterEpisodeActive;
	const int jitterDebugBucket = static_cast<int>(data.jitterSeconds / requiredJitterSeconds * 10.0f);
	if (jitterPeriod != 0 && jitterDebugBucket > data.jitterDebugBucket) {
		data.jitterDebugBucket = jitterDebugBucket;
		if (AntiAimDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s sustained an exact %d-way yaw pattern; progress %d%%.", player->GetName(), jitterPeriod,
						   (std::min)(jitterDebugBucket * 10, 100));
		}
	}
	if (data.jitterSeconds >= requiredJitterSeconds && !data.suppressContinuous) {
		AddEvidence(player, data, antiaimDetectionThreshold, "evidence.antiaim.reason.jitter",
					"the same rapid view-angle jitter repeating continuously", true);
		data.jitterActive = true;
	} else if (!jitterEpisodeActive) {
		if (data.jitterDebugBucket >= 0 && AntiAimDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s repeating jitter stopped; progress was reset.", player->GetName());
		}
		data.jitterDebugBucket = -1;
	}
}

void AntiAimModule::EvaluatePendingShot(PlayerRef* player, AntiAimPlayerData& data, int currentTick)
{
	if (data.pendingShot < 0) {
		return;
	}
	if (data.pendingShot == (std::numeric_limits<int>::max)()) {
		data.pendingShot = -1;
		data.pendingShotTick = -1;
		return;
	}
	auto find = [&](int commandNumber) -> AntiAimCommand* {
		auto command = std::find_if(data.commands.rbegin(), data.commands.rend(),
									[&](AntiAimCommand& candidate) { return candidate.commandNumber == commandNumber && candidate.simulated; });
		return command == data.commands.rend() ? nullptr : &*command;
	};
	AntiAimCommand* previous = find(data.pendingShot - 1);
	AntiAimCommand* shot = find(data.pendingShot);
	AntiAimCommand* next = find(data.pendingShot + 1);
	if (!next) {
		if (static_cast<i64>(currentTick) - data.pendingShotTick > 1
			|| (!data.commands.empty() && static_cast<i64>(data.commands.back().commandNumber) - data.pendingShot > 1)) {
			if (AntiAimDebug()) {
				ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s attack-return expired without the next adjacent simulated command.", player->GetName());
			}
			data.pendingShot = -1;
			data.pendingShotTick = -1;
		}
		return;
	}
	data.pendingShot = -1;
	data.pendingShotTick = -1;
	if (!previous || !shot || !IsFinite(previous->baseAngles) || !IsFinite(shot->baseAngles) || !IsFinite(next->baseAngles)
		|| static_cast<i64>(shot->clientTick) - previous->clientTick != 1 || static_cast<i64>(next->clientTick) - shot->clientTick != 1
		|| static_cast<i64>(shot->serverTick) - previous->serverTick != 1 || static_cast<i64>(next->serverTick) - shot->serverTick != 1) {
		if (AntiAimDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s attack-return rejected because its surrounding simulated commands are incomplete.", player->GetName());
		}
		return;
	}

	const f32 surrounding = AngularDistance(previous->baseAngles, next->baseAngles);
	const f32 snap = AngularDistance(previous->baseAngles, shot->baseAngles);
	if (AntiAimDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s shot command %d: base/history yaw %.2f, surrounding %.2f, snap %.2f, mouse %d/%d, subtick %.2f/%.2f.",
					   player->GetName(), shot->commandNumber, static_cast<double>(shot->historyYawDifference), static_cast<double>(surrounding),
					   static_cast<double>(snap), shot->mouseX, shot->mouseY, static_cast<double>(shot->subtickPitch),
					   static_cast<double>(shot->subtickYaw));
	}
	if (std::isfinite(surrounding) && std::isfinite(snap) && surrounding < 10.0f && snap > minimumAttackReturnAngle && snap > surrounding * 5.0f) {
		AddEvidence(player, data, 20.0f, "evidence.antiaim.reason.attack_return",
					"a shot where the aim changed by at least 30 degrees for one command and immediately returned", false);
	} else if (AntiAimDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s attack-return rejected because the shot did not sharply leave and return to the surrounding angle.",
					   player->GetName());
	}
}

void AntiAimModule::OnSetupMove(PlayerRef* player, const UsercmdView& command, int currentTick)
{
	if (!player || player->index < 1 || player->index > MAXPLAYERS) {
		return;
	}
	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)];
	if (!command.hasBase || !player->IsInGame() || !player->IsAlive() || player->IsFakeClient() || player->IsCSTV()) {
		data.commands.clear();
		data.pendingShot = -1;
		data.pendingShotTick = -1;
		data.lastMismatchEvidenceCommand = -1;
		data.invalidActive = false;
		data.inconsistencyActive = false;
		data.suppressContinuous = false;
		ResetMotion(data);
		return;
	}
	ApplyDecay(player, data);
	auto found = std::find_if(data.commands.rbegin(), data.commands.rend(),
							  [&](AntiAimCommand& stored) { return stored.commandNumber == command.commandNumber; });
	if (found == data.commands.rend()) {
		data.pendingShot = -1;
		data.pendingShotTick = -1;
		ResetMotion(data);
		return;
	}
	found->simulated = true;
	found->serverTick = currentTick;

	if (engine::PlayerJustTeleported(player->index, 2.0f)) {
		if (!data.teleportGrace && AntiAimDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s is inside the two-second spawn or teleport grace period.", player->GetName());
		}
		data.teleportGrace = true;
		data.invalidActive = data.inconsistencyActive = data.spinActive = data.jitterActive = false;
		data.pendingShot = -1;
		data.pendingShotTick = -1;
		ResetMotion(data);
		return;
	}
	data.teleportGrace = false;

	const bool wasInconsistent = data.inconsistencyActive;
	const bool historyMismatch = !found->attack && found->hasHistoryAngles && std::isfinite(found->historyYawDifference)
								 && found->historyYawDifference >= commandYawMismatchAngle;
	data.inconsistencyActive = found->problems != 0 || historyMismatch;
	if (found->problems != 0 && !data.suppressContinuous) {
		if (AntiAimDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s command %d is inconsistent: %s.", player->GetName(), found->commandNumber, ProblemName(found->problems));
		}
		AddEvidence(player, data, 1.0f, "evidence.antiaim.reason.inconsistent_command", "view-angle data that a normal client should not send", true);
	} else if (historyMismatch && !data.suppressContinuous
			   && (data.lastMismatchEvidenceCommand < 0
				   || static_cast<i64>(found->commandNumber) - data.lastMismatchEvidenceCommand >= commandMismatchSpacing)) {
		data.lastMismatchEvidenceCommand = found->commandNumber;
		if (AntiAimDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s command %d base/input-history yaw mismatch is %.2f degrees.", player->GetName(), found->commandNumber,
						   static_cast<double>(found->historyYawDifference));
		}
		// Fast legitimate mouse movement can create this difference, so it contributes only short-lived supporting evidence.
		AddEvidence(player, data, 1.0f, "evidence.antiaim.reason.history_mismatch",
					"two view angles in the same command repeatedly disagreeing by at least 120 degrees", true, true);
	} else if (!data.inconsistencyActive && wasInconsistent && AntiAimDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s angle commands returned to a consistent state.", player->GetName());
	}

	const bool wasInvalid = data.invalidActive;
	data.invalidActive =
		IsFinite(found->baseAngles) && (std::abs(found->baseAngles.x) > invalidPitch || std::abs(found->baseAngles.z) > invalidRoll);
	if (data.invalidActive && (!wasInvalid || !data.suppressContinuous)) {
		if (AntiAimDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s command %d has invalid pitch/roll %.2f/%.2f.", player->GetName(), found->commandNumber,
						   static_cast<double>(found->baseAngles.x), static_cast<double>(found->baseAngles.z));
		}
		AddEvidence(player, data, 2.0f, "evidence.antiaim.reason.invalid_angles", "a pitch or roll angle outside the normal CS2 range", true);
	}

	EvaluateMotion(player, data, *found);
	EvaluatePendingShot(player, data, currentTick);

	if (data.suppressContinuous && !data.invalidActive && !data.inconsistencyActive && !data.spinActive && !data.jitterActive) {
		data.suppressContinuous = false;
		if (AntiAimDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s continuous detection episode ended.", player->GetName());
		}
	}
}

void AntiAimModule::OnGameFrame(int currentTick)
{
	for (int index = 1; index <= MAXPLAYERS; ++index) {
		auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(index)];
		if (data.pendingShot < 0 || static_cast<i64>(currentTick) - data.pendingShotTick <= 1) {
			continue;
		}
		auto* player = g_pPlayerManager ? g_pPlayerManager->ToPlayer(index) : nullptr;
		if (IsEligibleHuman(player)) {
			EvaluatePendingShot(player, data, currentTick);
		} else {
			data.pendingShot = -1;
			data.pendingShotTick = -1;
		}
	}
}

void AntiAimModule::OnWeaponFire(PlayerRef* player, const ShotRecord& shot)
{
	if (!IsEligibleHuman(player) || shot.playerIndex != player->index) {
		return;
	}
	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)];
	auto command = std::find_if(data.commands.rbegin(), data.commands.rend(), [&](const AntiAimCommand& candidate) {
		return candidate.commandNumber == shot.commandNumber && candidate.attack && candidate.simulated && candidate.serverTick == shot.serverTick;
	});
	if (command == data.commands.rend()) {
		if (AntiAimDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s correlated fire did not match its captured AntiAim command.", player->GetName());
		}
		return;
	}
	data.pendingShot = shot.commandNumber;
	data.pendingShotTick = shot.serverTick;
	if (AntiAimDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("AntiAim: %s weapon_fire matched command %d.", player->GetName(), shot.commandNumber);
	}
	EvaluatePendingShot(player, data, shot.fireTick);
}

void AntiAimModule::OnGameEvent(const GameEventData& event, PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (event.name.empty()) {
		return;
	}
	if (event.name == "player_spawn" && player && player->index >= 1 && player->index <= MAXPLAYERS) {
		playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)] = {};
	}
}

void AntiAimModule::OnClientDisconnect(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (player && player->index >= 1 && player->index <= MAXPLAYERS) {
		playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)] = {};
	}
}

} // namespace detection
} // namespace cs2ac

```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/mod_integrity.cpp`:

```cpp
// Input-history time integrity: BACKTRACK, TICK MANIPULATION, INTERP BACKTRACK telemetry and
// MOUSE MISMATCH (fork v3-v9.1 tick_integrity_module.cpp).
//
// Every CS2 usercmd carries input-history entries with the client's render time and interpolation
// info. For an honest client that time only moves forward. A shot entry that dips below both
// neighbours is the lag-compensation rewrite of a backtrack cheat; a shot entry with
// player_tick_count == 0 is rapid-fire tick forgery. Both use the same tolerant protobuf reader as
// the rest of the port (UsercmdView::inputHistory).
//
// Report-only telemetry is always written (tick_stats / backtrack_shot / interp_shot / tick_forgery)
// through detection_log; the decisions themselves are pure functions in decisions.cpp.

#include "cs2ac.hpp"
#include "detection_log.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>

namespace cs2ac {
namespace detection {

namespace {

constexpr std::size_t recentCommands = 8;
constexpr int backtrackWindowTicks = 120 * 64;
constexpr int graceTicks = 5 * 64;          // ignore the first seconds after the player starts sending commands
constexpr int playerTickTolerance = 4 * 64; // |player_tick_count - server tick| above this is not a clock
constexpr int zeroTickWindowTicks = 10 * 64;
constexpr std::size_t zeroTickShotsNeeded = 3;
constexpr int interpRowsPerPlayer = 10;
constexpr auto summaryInterval = std::chrono::seconds(120);

bool DebugEnabled()
{
	return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_tick_integrity_debug");
}

f64 RenderTime(const InputHistoryEntry& entry)
{
	return TickRenderTime(entry.hasRenderTickCount, entry.renderTickCount, entry.hasRenderTickFraction, entry.renderTickFraction);
}

f64 InterpTime(const InputHistoryEntry& entry)
{
	if (!entry.hasSvInterp0) {
		return kTickNone;
	}
	return TickInterpTime(entry.svInterp0);
}

f64 Max(const std::deque<f64>& values)
{
	f64 best = kTickNone;
	for (const f64 value : values) {
		best = (std::max)(best, value);
	}
	return best;
}

template <typename T>
void Expire(std::deque<T>& values, int now, int window)
{
	while (!values.empty() && now - values.front() > window) {
		values.pop_front();
	}
}

} // namespace

void TickIntegrityModule::Load(AnnounceCallback announceCallback)
{
	announce = std::move(announceCallback);
	Reset();
}

void TickIntegrityModule::Unload()
{
	Reset();
	announce = nullptr;
}

void TickIntegrityModule::Reset()
{
	playerData = {};
}

void TickIntegrityModule::OnClientDisconnect(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (player && player->index >= 1 && player->index <= MAXPLAYERS) {
		auto& data = playerData[static_cast<std::size_t>(player->index)];
		if (data.dirty) {
			WriteSummary(player, data);
		}
		data = {};
	}
}

void TickIntegrityModule::OnSetupMove(PlayerRef* player, const UsercmdView& command, int currentTick)
{
	if (!settings::BoolSetting("cs2ac_tick_integrity_enabled", true) || !IsEligibleHuman(player)) {
		return;
	}
	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<std::size_t>(player->index)];
	if (!player->IsAlive()) {
		data.recentRender.clear();
		data.recentInterp.clear();
		data.pending = false;
		data.angleKnown = false;
		return;
	}
	if (command.commandNumber <= data.lastCommandNumber) {
		return;
	}
	data.lastCommandNumber = command.commandNumber;
	TrackAngleInput(data, command);
	CheckMouseMismatch(player, data);
	if (data.firstTick < 0) {
		data.firstTick = currentTick;
	}
	const bool graceOver = currentTick - data.firstTick > graceTicks;

	const bool hasAttack = command.hasAttack1StartHistoryIndex && command.attack1StartHistoryIndex >= 0
						   && command.attack1StartHistoryIndex < static_cast<int>(command.inputHistory.size());
	const int attackIndex = hasAttack ? command.attack1StartHistoryIndex : -1;

	f64 beforeRender = kTickNone;
	f64 beforeInterp = kTickNone;
	f64 afterRender = std::numeric_limits<f64>::max();
	f64 afterInterp = std::numeric_limits<f64>::max();
	f64 commandMaxRender = kTickNone;
	f64 commandMaxInterp = kTickNone;
	f64 commandMinRender = std::numeric_limits<f64>::max();
	f64 commandMinInterp = std::numeric_limits<f64>::max();
	bool zeroPlayerTick = false;
	bool farPlayerTick = false;
	int farDelta = 0;

	for (int index = 0; index < static_cast<int>(command.inputHistory.size()); ++index) {
		const InputHistoryEntry& entry = command.inputHistory[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
		if (graceOver && entry.hasPlayerTickCount) {
			const int playerTick = entry.playerTickCount;
			if (playerTick == 0) {
				zeroPlayerTick = true;
			} else if (std::abs(playerTick - currentTick) > playerTickTolerance) {
				farPlayerTick = true;
				farDelta = playerTick - currentTick;
			}
		}
		if (hasAttack && index == attackIndex) {
			continue;
		}
		const f64 render = RenderTime(entry);
		const f64 interp = InterpTime(entry);
		if (render > 0.0) {
			commandMaxRender = (std::max)(commandMaxRender, render);
			commandMinRender = (std::min)(commandMinRender, render);
		}
		if (interp > 0.0) {
			commandMaxInterp = (std::max)(commandMaxInterp, interp);
			commandMinInterp = (std::min)(commandMinInterp, interp);
		}
		if (hasAttack && index < attackIndex) {
			beforeRender = (std::max)(beforeRender, render);
			beforeInterp = (std::max)(beforeInterp, interp);
		} else if (hasAttack && index > attackIndex) {
			if (render > 0.0) {
				afterRender = (std::min)(afterRender, render);
			}
			if (interp > 0.0) {
				afterInterp = (std::min)(afterInterp, interp);
			}
		}
	}

	// A shot from the previous command waits for this command's entries.
	if (data.pending) {
		ResolveShot(player, data, commandMinRender < std::numeric_limits<f64>::max() ? commandMinRender : kTickNone,
					commandMinInterp < std::numeric_limits<f64>::max() ? commandMinInterp : kTickNone, currentTick);
	}

	if (hasAttack) {
		const InputHistoryEntry& shot = command.inputHistory[static_cast<std::size_t>(attackIndex)];
		data.pendingRender = RenderTime(shot);
		data.pendingInterp = InterpTime(shot);
		// Rewriting cheats set the shot entry to a whole older tick and drop its interpolation info;
		// an honest entry carries a fraction and sv_interp0.
		const bool wholeTick = shot.hasRenderTickCount && (!shot.hasRenderTickFraction || shot.renderTickFraction == 0.0f);
		data.pendingForged = TickRewriteFingerprint(wholeTick, data.pendingInterp);
		data.pendingInterpInfo = {};
		if (data.pendingRender > 0.0 && data.pendingInterp > 0.0) {
			auto& info = data.pendingInterpInfo;
			info.known = true;
			info.offset = data.pendingRender - data.pendingInterp;
			info.src0 = shot.svInterp0.srcTick;
			info.dst0 = shot.svInterp0.hasDstTick ? shot.svInterp0.dstTick : -1;
			info.frac0 = shot.svInterp0.hasFrac ? shot.svInterp0.frac : 0.0f;
			if (shot.hasSvInterp1) {
				info.src1 = shot.svInterp1.hasSrcTick ? shot.svInterp1.srcTick : -1;
				info.dst1 = shot.svInterp1.hasDstTick ? shot.svInterp1.dstTick : -1;
				info.frac1 = shot.svInterp1.hasFrac ? shot.svInterp1.frac : 0.0f;
			}
			if (shot.hasClInterp && shot.clInterp.hasFrac) {
				info.clFrac = shot.clInterp.frac;
			}
		}
		data.pendingPrevRender = (std::max)(Max(data.recentRender), beforeRender);
		data.pendingPrevInterp = (std::max)(Max(data.recentInterp), beforeInterp);
		data.pendingTick = currentTick;
		data.pending = data.pendingRender > 0.0 || data.pendingInterp > 0.0;
		if (data.pending && (afterRender < std::numeric_limits<f64>::max() || afterInterp < std::numeric_limits<f64>::max())) {
			ResolveShot(player, data, afterRender < std::numeric_limits<f64>::max() ? afterRender : kTickNone,
						afterInterp < std::numeric_limits<f64>::max() ? afterInterp : kTickNone, currentTick);
		}
	}

	if (commandMaxRender > 0.0) {
		data.recentRender.push_back(commandMaxRender);
		while (data.recentRender.size() > recentCommands) {
			data.recentRender.pop_front();
		}
	}
	if (commandMaxInterp > 0.0) {
		data.recentInterp.push_back(commandMaxInterp);
		while (data.recentInterp.size() > recentCommands) {
			data.recentInterp.pop_front();
		}
	}

	if (farPlayerTick) {
		if (data.farTicks == 0) {
			data.minTickDelta = data.maxTickDelta = farDelta;
		}
		++data.farTicks;
		data.minTickDelta = (std::min)(data.minTickDelta, farDelta);
		data.maxTickDelta = (std::max)(data.maxTickDelta, farDelta);
		data.dirty = true;
	}

	// Rapid-fire forging zeroes the tick on the commands that shoot.
	if (zeroPlayerTick && hasAttack) {
		++data.zeroTickShots;
		data.dirty = true;
		data.zeroTickCommands.push_back(currentTick);
		Expire(data.zeroTickCommands, currentTick, zeroTickWindowTicks);
		if (DebugEnabled()) {
			ConsoleMessage("[CS2AC Tick] %s shot with player_tick_count 0 at server tick %d.", player->GetName(), currentTick);
		}
		if (!data.reportedTicks && announce && static_cast<int>(data.zeroTickCommands.size()) >= static_cast<int>(zeroTickShotsNeeded)) {
			data.reportedTicks = true;
			detection_log::WriteTelemetry("tick_forgery", player,
										  ",\"zero_tick_shots\":" + std::to_string(data.zeroTickCommands.size())
											  + ",\"server_tick\":" + std::to_string(currentTick));
			announce("TICK MANIPULATION", player,
					 localization::Format("evidence.tick_manipulation",
										  "{count} shots within 10 seconds were sent with a player tick count of exactly zero. A normal client "
										  "always sends its current tick; rapid-fire cheats overwrite it with zero.",
										  {{"count", std::to_string(data.zeroTickCommands.size())}}));
		}
	}
}

void TickIntegrityModule::ResolveShot(PlayerRef* player, TickIntegrityPlayerData& data, f64 nextRender, f64 nextInterp, int currentTick)
{
	data.pending = false;
	const f64 renderDip = TickDip(data.pendingPrevRender, data.pendingRender, nextRender);
	const f64 interpDip = TickDip(data.pendingPrevInterp, data.pendingInterp, nextInterp);
	CheckInterpOffset(player, data, renderDip, nextRender, currentTick);
	if (std::isnan(renderDip) && std::isnan(interpDip)) {
		return; // not enough context around this shot
	}
	const f64 dip = std::isnan(renderDip) ? interpDip : std::isnan(interpDip) ? renderDip : (std::max)(renderDip, interpDip);
	++data.shots;
	data.dirty = true;
	const f32 dipTicks = static_cast<f32>((std::max)(0.0, dip));
	++data.dipBuckets[TickDipBucket(dipTicks)];
	data.maxDip = (std::max)(data.maxDip, dipTicks);

	const f32 minimumTicks = settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_backtrack_min_ticks", 2.0f);
	if (dipTicks < minimumTicks) {
		return;
	}
	// The client's clock must be continuous around the shot; a jump, or a step backwards, means a
	// stall, not a rewrite.
	const bool renderDipped = !std::isnan(renderDip) && renderDip >= dip - 1e-6;
	const f64 gap = renderDipped ? nextRender - data.pendingPrevRender : nextInterp - data.pendingPrevInterp;
	const f32 maximumGap = settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_backtrack_max_gap", 4.0f);
	if (gap < 0.0 || gap > maximumGap) {
		++data.hitchSkips;
		if (DebugEnabled()) {
			ConsoleMessage("[CS2AC Tick] %s: %.2f-tick dip ignored, clock moved %.2f ticks around the shot.", player->GetName(),
						   static_cast<double>(dipTicks), gap);
		}
		return;
	}
	// The rewritten shot entry is a whole tick without sv_interp0 while the entries around it keep
	// their fractions; a clock on whole ticks everywhere proves nothing.
	const bool forged = data.pendingForged && TickHasFraction(data.pendingPrevRender) && TickHasFraction(nextRender);

	char fields[384];
	std::snprintf(fields, sizeof(fields),
				  ",\"server_tick\":%d,\"dip_ticks\":%.3f,\"render_prev\":%.3f,\"render_shot\":%.3f,\"render_next\":%.3f,"
				  "\"interp_prev\":%.3f,\"interp_shot\":%.3f,\"interp_next\":%.3f,\"gap_ticks\":%.3f,\"forged\":%s",
				  data.pendingTick, static_cast<double>(dipTicks), data.pendingPrevRender, data.pendingRender, nextRender,
				  data.pendingPrevInterp, data.pendingInterp, nextInterp, gap, forged ? "true" : "false");
	detection_log::WriteTelemetry("backtrack_shot", player, fields);
	if (DebugEnabled()) {
		ConsoleMessage("[CS2AC Tick] %s: shot at tick %d dipped %.2f ticks into the past (render %.2f/%.2f/%.2f, interp %.2f/%.2f/%.2f, forged %s).",
					   player->GetName(), data.pendingTick, static_cast<double>(dipTicks), data.pendingPrevRender, data.pendingRender, nextRender,
					   data.pendingPrevInterp, data.pendingInterp, nextInterp, forged ? "yes" : "no");
	}

	if (!forged && settings::BoolSetting("cs2ac_backtrack_require_forged", true)) {
		++data.unforgedDips;
		return;
	}
	if (!BacktrackDipCounts(dipTicks, minimumTicks, gap, maximumGap, forged, settings::BoolSetting("cs2ac_backtrack_require_forged", true),
							TickHasFraction(data.pendingPrevRender), TickHasFraction(nextRender))) {
		return;
	}
	data.backtrackTicks.push_back(data.pendingTick);
	Expire(data.backtrackTicks, currentTick, backtrackWindowTicks);

	const int needed = (std::max)(1, settings::IntSetting("cs2ac_backtrack_shots", 3));
	if (data.reportedBacktrack || !announce || static_cast<int>(data.backtrackTicks.size()) < needed) {
		return;
	}
	data.reportedBacktrack = true;
	char amount[16];
	std::snprintf(amount, sizeof(amount), "%.1f", static_cast<double>(dipTicks));
	announce("BACKTRACK", player,
			 localization::Format("evidence.backtrack",
								  "{count} shots within 120 seconds were sent with a time up to {amount} ticks older than the inputs sent "
								  "immediately before and after them. A normal client's clock only moves forward; backtrack cheats rewind "
								  "the shot to hit an enemy's past position.",
								  {{"count", std::to_string(data.backtrackTicks.size())}, {"amount", amount}}));
}

void TickIntegrityModule::CheckInterpOffset(PlayerRef* player, TickIntegrityPlayerData& data, f64 renderDip, f64 nextRender, int currentTick)
{
	const ShotInterpInfo& info = data.pendingInterpInfo;
	if (!info.known || std::isnan(renderDip)) {
		return;
	}
	// Only shots on a continuous render clock: the shot entry did not dip itself and the client did
	// not stall around it.
	const f64 renderGap = nextRender - data.pendingPrevRender;
	if (renderDip >= 0.5 || renderGap < 0.0 || renderGap > settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_backtrack_max_gap", 4.0f)) {
		return;
	}
	const f32 offset = static_cast<f32>(info.offset);
	++data.interpOffsetBuckets[TickInterpOffsetBucket(offset)];
	data.maxInterpOffset = (std::max)(data.maxInterpOffset, offset);
	data.dirty = true;
	if (offset < 3.0f) {
		return;
	}

	if (data.interpRowsLogged < interpRowsPerPlayer) {
		++data.interpRowsLogged;
		char fields[384];
		std::snprintf(fields, sizeof(fields),
					  ",\"server_tick\":%d,\"offset_ticks\":%.3f,\"render_prev\":%.3f,\"render_shot\":%.3f,\"render_next\":%.3f,"
					  "\"interp_shot\":%.3f,\"interp0\":[%d,%d,%.4f],\"interp1\":[%d,%d,%.4f],\"cl_interp_frac\":%.4f",
					  data.pendingTick, static_cast<double>(offset), data.pendingPrevRender, data.pendingRender, nextRender, data.pendingInterp,
					  info.src0, info.dst0, static_cast<double>(info.frac0), info.src1, info.dst1, static_cast<double>(info.frac1),
					  static_cast<double>(info.clFrac));
		detection_log::WriteTelemetry("interp_shot", player, fields);
	}
	if (DebugEnabled()) {
		ConsoleMessage("[CS2AC Tick] %s: shot at tick %d has sv_interp0 %.2f ticks behind its render time.", player->GetName(), data.pendingTick,
					   static_cast<double>(offset));
	}

	if (offset < settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_backtrack_interp_min_ticks", 4.0f)) {
		return;
	}
	data.interpBacktrackTicks.push_back(data.pendingTick);
	Expire(data.interpBacktrackTicks, currentTick, backtrackWindowTicks);
	const int needed = (std::max)(1, settings::IntSetting("cs2ac_backtrack_shots", 3));
	if (data.reportedInterpBacktrack || !announce || !settings::BoolSetting("cs2ac_backtrack_interp_report", false)
		|| static_cast<int>(data.interpBacktrackTicks.size()) < needed) {
		return;
	}
	data.reportedInterpBacktrack = true;
	char amount[16];
	std::snprintf(amount, sizeof(amount), "%.1f", static_cast<double>(offset));
	announce("INTERP BACKTRACK", player,
			 localization::Format("evidence.interp_backtrack",
								  "{count} shots within 120 seconds carried interpolation data up to {amount} ticks older than the shot's own "
								  "render time while the client's clock stayed continuous. An honest client keeps them one or two ticks apart; "
								  "backtrack cheats move only the interpolation data of the shot.",
								  {{"count", std::to_string(data.interpBacktrackTicks.size())}, {"amount", amount}}));
}

void TickIntegrityModule::CheckMouseMismatch(PlayerRef* player, TickIntegrityPlayerData& data)
{
	const int needed = settings::IntSetting("cs2ac_mouse_mismatch_samples", 100);
	if (data.reportedMouseMismatch || !announce || needed <= 0 || data.sessionYawSamples < needed) {
		return;
	}
	const f32 agreement = static_cast<f32>(data.sessionYawAgree) / static_cast<f32>(data.sessionYawSamples);
	if (agreement >= settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_mouse_mismatch_agreement", 0.9f)) {
		return;
	}
	data.reportedMouseMismatch = true;
	char share[16];
	std::snprintf(share, sizeof(share), "%.0f", static_cast<double>(100.0f * agreement));
	announce("MOUSE MISMATCH", player,
			 localization::Format("evidence.mousemismatch",
								  "Only {agree}% of {samples} view turns went the way the mouse moved; for honest players it is 99% or "
								  "more. Cheats that write the view angles turn the camera regardless of the mouse.",
								  {{"agree", share}, {"samples", std::to_string(data.sessionYawSamples)}}));
}

void TickIntegrityModule::TrackAngleInput(TickIntegrityPlayerData& data, const UsercmdView& command)
{
	if (!command.hasBase || !command.hasViewAngles) {
		data.angleKnown = false;
		return;
	}
	const f32 pitch = command.viewAngles.x;
	const f32 yaw = command.viewAngles.y;
	if (!std::isfinite(pitch) || !std::isfinite(yaw)) {
		data.angleKnown = false;
		return;
	}
	const unsigned int serverChanges = command.hasConsumedServerAngleChanges ? command.consumedServerAngleChanges : 0;
	// Only consecutive commands, and only when the server did not set the angles in between.
	if (data.angleKnown && command.commandNumber == data.angleCommand + 1 && serverChanges == data.angleServerChanges) {
		const f32 yawChange = std::fmod(yaw - data.angleYaw + 540.0f, 360.0f) - 180.0f;
		const f32 pitchChange = pitch - data.anglePitch;
		const f32 rotation = std::sqrt(yawChange * yawChange + pitchChange * pitchChange);
		f32 subtickYaw = 0.0f;
		f32 subtickPitch = 0.0f;
		for (const SubtickMove& move : command.subtickMoves) {
			if (move.hasYawDelta && std::isfinite(move.yawDelta)) {
				subtickYaw += move.yawDelta;
			}
			if (move.hasPitchDelta && std::isfinite(move.pitchDelta)) {
				subtickPitch += move.pitchDelta;
			}
		}
		const bool noInput = command.mouseDx == 0 && command.mouseDy == 0 && std::abs(subtickYaw) < 1e-4f && std::abs(subtickPitch) < 1e-4f;
		++data.angleCommands;
		if (rotation >= 0.5f) {
			++data.rotatingCommands;
			if (noInput) {
				const std::size_t bucket = rotation < 2.0f ? 0 : rotation < 5.0f ? 1 : rotation < 15.0f ? 2 : 3;
				++data.rotationWithoutInput[bucket];
				data.maxRotationWithoutInput = (std::max)(data.maxRotationWithoutInput, rotation);
			}
		}
		if (command.mouseDx != 0 && std::abs(yawChange) >= 0.05f) {
			// Moving the mouse right (positive mousedx) turns the view right, which lowers yaw.
			++data.yawSignSamples;
			++data.sessionYawSamples;
			if ((yawChange < 0.0f) == (command.mouseDx > 0)) {
				++data.yawSignAgree;
				++data.sessionYawAgree;
			}
		}
		data.dirty = true;
	}
	data.angleKnown = true;
	data.angleCommand = command.commandNumber;
	data.angleYaw = yaw;
	data.anglePitch = pitch;
	data.angleServerChanges = serverChanges;
}

void TickIntegrityModule::OnGameFrame()
{
	if (!g_pPlayerManager) {
		return;
	}
	const auto now = Clock::now();
	for (int index = 1; index <= MAXPLAYERS; ++index) {
		auto& data = playerData[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
		if (!data.dirty || now < data.nextSummary) {
			continue;
		}
		if (auto* player = g_pPlayerManager->ToPlayer(index)) {
			WriteSummary(player, data);
		}
		data.nextSummary = now + summaryInterval;
	}
}

void TickIntegrityModule::WriteSummary(PlayerRef* player, TickIntegrityPlayerData& data)
{
	char fields[1024];
	std::snprintf(fields, sizeof(fields),
				  ",\"shots\":%d,\"dip_buckets_ticks\":\"<0.5,<1,<2,<4,4+\",\"dip_counts\":[%d,%d,%d,%d,%d],\"max_dip\":%.3f,"
				  "\"hitch_skips\":%d,\"unforged_dips\":%d,\"zero_tick_shots\":%d,\"far_ticks\":%d,\"far_delta_min\":%d,\"far_delta_max\":%d,"
				  "\"interp_offset_buckets_ticks\":\"<1,<2,<3,<4,<6,6+\",\"interp_offset_counts\":[%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d],\"max_interp_offset\":%.3f,"
				  "\"angle_cmds\":%d,\"rotating_cmds\":%d,\"no_input_rotation_buckets_deg\":\"<2,<5,<15,15+\","
				  "\"no_input_rotation_counts\":[%d,%d,%d,%d],\"max_no_input_rotation\":%.2f,\"yaw_sign_samples\":%d,\"yaw_sign_agree\":%d",
				  data.shots, data.dipBuckets[0], data.dipBuckets[1], data.dipBuckets[2], data.dipBuckets[3], data.dipBuckets[4],
				  static_cast<double>(data.maxDip), data.hitchSkips, data.unforgedDips, data.zeroTickShots, data.farTicks, data.minTickDelta,
				  data.maxTickDelta, data.interpOffsetBuckets[0], data.interpOffsetBuckets[1], data.interpOffsetBuckets[2],
				  data.interpOffsetBuckets[3], data.interpOffsetBuckets[4], data.interpOffsetBuckets[5], static_cast<double>(data.maxInterpOffset),
				  data.angleCommands, data.rotatingCommands, data.rotationWithoutInput[0], data.rotationWithoutInput[1],
				  data.rotationWithoutInput[2], data.rotationWithoutInput[3], static_cast<double>(data.maxRotationWithoutInput),
				  data.yawSignSamples, data.yawSignAgree);
	detection_log::WriteTelemetry("tick_stats", player, fields);
	data.shots = 0;
	data.dipBuckets.fill(0);
	data.maxDip = 0.0f;
	data.hitchSkips = 0;
	data.unforgedDips = 0;
	data.interpOffsetBuckets.fill(0);
	data.maxInterpOffset = 0.0f;
	data.angleCommands = 0;
	data.rotatingCommands = 0;
	data.rotationWithoutInput.fill(0);
	data.maxRotationWithoutInput = 0.0f;
	data.yawSignSamples = 0;
	data.yawSignAgree = 0;
	data.zeroTickShots = 0;
	data.farTicks = 0;
	data.minTickDelta = 0;
	data.maxTickDelta = 0;
	data.dirty = false;
}
```

```cpp
// cs2ac — the remaining detectors: Namechanger and DLL Injection.
//
// Ported from the original's detection/{namechanger,dll_injection}_module.cpp.
//
// DLL Injection check: the original resolved IGameEventManager2 through a mov signature and asked
// FindListener() for each of 117 blacklisted events on the player's legacy listener. The listener
// pointer is still resolvable here (the GetLegacyGameEventListener signature is in gamedata), but
// the FindListener vtable index can only be verified against the game binary itself, so the detector
// stays off until engine::LegacyListenerSubscribes() reports data (PORT_PLAN.md §3 #6 and §7.3).

#include "cs2ac.hpp"

namespace cs2ac {
namespace detection {

namespace {
bool NameChangerDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_namechanger_debug"); }
bool DllInjectionDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_dll_injection_debug"); }
} // namespace

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Namechanger (namechanger_module.cpp)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

namespace {
constexpr size_t nameChangerDetectionThreshold = 5;
constexpr auto nameChangerEvidenceWindow = std::chrono::seconds(60);
} // namespace

void NameChangerModule::Load(AnnounceCallback announceCallback)
{
	announce = std::move(announceCallback);
	Reset();
}

void NameChangerModule::Unload()
{
	playerData = {};
	announce = nullptr;
}

void NameChangerModule::Reset()
{
	// State only. The original re-baselined every player's name here by asking the engine for each
	// player's current name, but this runs from OnMapEnd/OnMapStart - and at map shutdown s2sdk's
	// client list is already empty, so any client query (IsFakeClient/GetClientName/...) dereferences
	// a null entry (crash: Reset -> OnClientReady -> IsEligibleHuman -> IsFakeClient ->
	// GetClientBySlot -> SIGSEGV at 0).
	//
	// Losing the eager baseline is harmless: NameChangerPlayerData::initialized is false after this
	// reset, and both entry points that follow re-baseline without counting a change -
	// OnClientReady (client join/activate) and the `!initialized` branch of OnClientSettingsChanged
	// (the first settings change after a map change). Deferring to those callbacks is exactly the
	// "re-initialise per slot from a client event, not from the map-end path" rule.
	playerData = {};
}

void NameChangerModule::OnClientReady(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (!IsEligibleHuman(player) || !player->IsInGame()) {
		return;
	}
	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)];
	data = {};
	const char* name = engine::PlayerName(player->index);
	if (name) {
		data.lastName = name;
		data.initialized = true;
		if (NameChangerDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Namechanger: %s baseline stored for player slot %d.", name, player->index);
		}
	}
}

void NameChangerModule::OnClientSettingsChanged(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (!IsEligibleHuman(player) || !player->IsInGame()) {
		return;
	}
	const char* currentName = engine::PlayerName(player->index);
	if (!currentName) {
		return;
	}

	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)];
	if (!data.initialized) {
		data.lastName = currentName;
		data.initialized = true;
		return;
	}
	if (data.lastName == currentName) {
		return;
	}
	data.lastName = currentName;

	const auto now = Clock::now();
	size_t expired = 0;
	while (!data.changes.empty() && now - data.changes.front() >= nameChangerEvidenceWindow) {
		data.changes.pop_front();
		++expired;
	}
	data.changes.push_back(now);
	if (NameChangerDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("Namechanger: %s changed names: %zu of %zu changes remain in the rolling minute%s.", currentName, data.changes.size(),
					   nameChangerDetectionThreshold, expired ? FormatString("; %zu expired", expired).c_str() : "");
	}
	if (data.changes.size() >= nameChangerDetectionThreshold) {
		if (announce) {
			announce("NAMECHANGER", player,
					 localization::Format("evidence.namechanger", "The player changed their visible name {changes} times within one minute.",
										  {{"changes", FormatString("%zu", data.changes.size())}}));
		}
		data.changes.clear();
	}
}

void NameChangerModule::OnClientDisconnect(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (player && player->index >= 1 && player->index <= MAXPLAYERS) {
		playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)] = {};
	}
}

void DllInjectionModule::Load(AnnounceCallback announceCallback)
{
	announce = std::move(announceCallback);
	Reset();
}

void DllInjectionModule::Unload()
{
	nextScans = {};
	announce = nullptr;
}

void DllInjectionModule::Reset()
{
	nextScans = {};
}

void DllInjectionModule::OnGameFrame()
{
	auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
	if (!announce || !g_pPlayerManager) {
		return;
	}

	bool scannedPlayerThisFrame = false;
	for (u32 index = 1; index <= MAXPLAYERS; ++index) {
		auto* player = g_pPlayerManager->ToPlayer(static_cast<i32>(index));
		if (!player || !player->IsConnected() || !player->IsInGame() || player->IsFakeClient() || player->IsCSTV()) {
			continue;
		}

		const int slot = player->GetPlayerSlot();
		if (slot < 0 || slot >= MAXPLAYERS) {
			continue;
		}

		auto& nextScan = nextScans[static_cast<size_t>(slot)];
		if (nextScan == Clock::time_point {}) {
			nextScan = now + initialScanDelay;
			if (DllInjectionDebug()) {
				ConsoleMessage("DLL Injection: %s will receive the first subscription scan in 10 seconds.", player->GetName());
			}
			continue;
		}
		if (now < nextScan) {
			continue;
		}
		if (scannedPlayerThisFrame) {
			continue;
		}
		scannedPlayerThisFrame = true;
		nextScan = now + scanInterval;

		std::array<bool, blacklistedEvents.size()> current {};
		size_t found = 0;
		bool available = true;
		for (size_t eventIndex = 0; eventIndex < blacklistedEvents.size(); ++eventIndex) {
			bool subscribed = false;
			if (!engine::LegacyListenerSubscribes(player->index, blacklistedEvents[eventIndex], subscribed)) {
				available = false;
				break;
			}
			current[eventIndex] = subscribed;
			found += subscribed ? 1 : 0;
		}
		if (!available) {
			// The vtable index is not verified for this build (see the file header): stay off, once.
			static bool noted = false;
			if (!noted) {
				noted = true;
				LogWarning("DLL Injection is disabled: the IGameEventManager2::FindListener vtable index is not verified in gamedata for this "
						   "server build (see PORT_PLAN.md).");
			}
			return;
		}
		if (DllInjectionDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("DLL Injection: %s scan completed: %zu of %zu blacklisted subscriptions found; next scan in 2 minutes.", player->GetName(),
						   found, blacklistedEvents.size());
		}

		if (found == 0) {
			continue;
		}

		std::string matches;
		for (size_t eventIndex = 0; eventIndex < blacklistedEvents.size(); ++eventIndex) {
			if (!current[eventIndex]) {
				continue;
			}
			if (!matches.empty()) {
				matches += ", ";
			}
			matches += blacklistedEvents[eventIndex];
			if (matches.size() > 700) {
				matches += ", ...";
				break;
			}
		}
		announce("DLL INJECTION", player,
				 localization::Format(found == 1 ? "evidence.dll_injection.one" : "evidence.dll_injection.many",
									  found == 1 ? "The player's game was listening for {count} event associated with injected cheats: {events}. This "
												   "detector checks visible event subscriptions only; it does not scan the player's memory or prove "
												   "every possible DLL injection."
												 : "The player's game was listening for {count} events associated with injected cheats: {events}. This "
												   "detector checks visible event subscriptions only; it does not scan the player's memory or prove "
												   "every possible DLL injection.",
									  {{"count", FormatString("%zu", found)}, {"events", matches}}));
	}
}

void DllInjectionModule::OnClientDisconnect(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (!player) {
		return;
	}
	const int slot = player->GetPlayerSlot();
	if (slot >= 0 && slot < MAXPLAYERS) {
		nextScans[static_cast<size_t>(slot)] = {};
	}
}
```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/mod_movement.cpp`:

```cpp
// cs2ac — the movement detectors: Bhop, Hyperscroll, Autostrafe, Nulls, Subtick Spam,
// Desubticking, Invalid Input and Invalid CVar.
//
// Ported from the original's movement_analysis/detection/movement_detection.cpp and its
// detectors (bhop.cpp, cvars.cpp, nulls.cpp, subtick.cpp, strafe_optimizer.cpp, jumps.cpp). Every
// threshold macro is kept verbatim. The data comes from the parsed usercmds, the move data of the
// movement detours and the player schema reads; the jump/landing bookkeeping the original hooked
// out of the movement functions is fed by hooks.cpp at the equivalent points
// (CategorizePosition -> OnGroundFrame, OnJumpLegacy/Modern -> OnServerJump, AirMove -> OnAirMove).

#include "cs2ac.hpp"

namespace cs2ac {
namespace detection {

namespace {
bool BhopDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_bhop_debug"); }
bool HyperscrollDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_hyperscroll_debug"); }
bool AutostrafeDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_autostrafe_debug"); }
bool NullsDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_nulls_debug"); }
bool SubtickDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_subtick_debug"); }
bool InvalidCvarDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_invalid_cvar_debug"); }

DetectionType DetectionForInfraction(MovementDetectionService::Infraction::Type type)
{
	using Type = MovementDetectionService::Infraction::Type;
	switch (type) {
	case Type::StrafeHack: return DetectionType::Autostrafe;
	case Type::BhopHack: return DetectionType::Bhop;
	case Type::Hyperscroll: return DetectionType::Hyperscroll;
	case Type::InvalidCvar: return DetectionType::InvalidCvar;
	case Type::InvalidInput: return DetectionType::InvalidInput;
	case Type::Nulls: return DetectionType::Nulls;
	case Type::SubtickSpam: return DetectionType::SubtickSpam;
	case Type::Desubtick: return DetectionType::Desubticking;
	case Type::Other:
	case Type::COUNT: return DetectionType::Count;
	}
	return DetectionType::Count;
}
} // namespace

const char* MovementDetectionService::Infraction::DisplayName(Type type)
{
	// Infraction::displayNames[] of the original.
	static const char* displayNames[] = {
		"OTHER", "AUTOSTRAFE", "BHOP", "HYPERSCROLL", "INVALID CVAR", "INVALID INPUT", "NULLS", "SUBTICK SPAM", "DESUBTICKING",
	};
	const auto index = static_cast<u8>(type);
	return index < static_cast<u8>(Type::COUNT) ? displayNames[index] : "OTHER";
}
```
