```cpp
}

void MovementDetectionService::CheckLandingEvents(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (!ShouldTrackBhop() || !bhopDirty || player->IsFakeClient() || player->IsCSTV()) {
		return;
	}
	bhopDirty = false;
	while (recentLandingEvents.size() > windowSize) {
		recentLandingEvents.pop_front();
	}
	if (recentLandingEvents.size() < minSampleCount) {
		return;
	}

	u32 numPerfs = 0;
	u32 totalChainEligibleEvents = 0;
	u32 maxPerfChain = 0;
	u32 currentPerfChain = 0;
	u32 maxPatternPerfScore = 0;
	u32 currentPatternPerfScore = 0;
	std::unordered_map<u32, u32> patterns;
	u32 mostCommonPattern = 0;
	u32 mostCommonPatternCount = 0;
	u32 totalPatternOccurrences = 0;
	u32 weightedPatternSum = 0;
	const f32 currentTime = static_cast<f32>(engine::CurTime());
	for (const auto& event : recentLandingEvents) {
		const f32 patternAge = currentTime - event.landingTime;
		if (!std::isfinite(patternAge) || patternAge < jumpPatternWindow) {
			bhopDirty |= std::isfinite(patternAge) && patternAge >= 0.0f;
		} else if (event.numJumpAfter > 0 || event.numJumpBefore > 0) {
			const u32 pattern = event.numJumpBefore + event.numJumpAfter;
			const u32 count = ++patterns[pattern];
			totalPatternOccurrences++;
			weightedPatternSum += pattern;
			if (count > mostCommonPatternCount) {
				mostCommonPatternCount = count;
				mostCommonPattern = pattern;
			}
		}
		if (!event.shouldCountTowardsPerfChains) {
			continue;
		}
		totalChainEligibleEvents++;
		if (event.hasPerfectBhop) {
			numPerfs++;
			currentPerfChain++;
			maxPerfChain = (std::max)(maxPerfChain, currentPerfChain);
			currentPatternPerfScore++;
			maxPatternPerfScore = (std::max)(maxPatternPerfScore, currentPatternPerfScore);
		} else {
			currentPerfChain = 0;
			currentPatternPerfScore = currentPatternPerfScore > 0 ? currentPatternPerfScore - 1 : 0;
		}
	}
	const f32 averagePattern = totalPatternOccurrences > 0 ? static_cast<f32>(weightedPatternSum) / static_cast<f32>(totalPatternOccurrences) : 0.0f;
	if (BhopDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("Bhop: %s evaluation: %zu landings, %u eligible, %u perfect, longest perfect chain %u, best pattern score %u, %u completed "
					   "patterns, dominant pattern %u repeated %u times.",
					   player->GetName(), recentLandingEvents.size(), totalChainEligibleEvents, numPerfs, maxPerfChain, maxPatternPerfScore,
					   totalPatternOccurrences, mostCommonPattern, mostCommonPatternCount);
	}

	// Hard consecutive perf chain check.
	if (maxPerfChain >= numConsecutivePerfsForInfraction && settings::IsDetectionEnabled(DetectionType::Bhop)) {
		MarkInfraction(player, Infraction::Type::BhopHack,
					   localization::Format("evidence.bhop.perfect_chain",
											"The player made {perfect} frame-perfect bunny hops in one uninterrupted chain, out of {landings} checked "
											"landings.",
											{{"perfect", FormatString("%u", maxPerfChain)}, {"landings", FormatString("%u", totalChainEligibleEvents)}}));
		recentLandingEvents.clear();
		bhopDirty = false;
		return;
	}

	// Pattern-based bhop infraction after a decaying perfect-jump score.
	if (maxPatternPerfScore >= perfScoreForPatternCheck && totalPatternOccurrences >= perfScoreForPatternCheck
		&& mostCommonPatternCount >= static_cast<u32>(totalPatternOccurrences * repetitivePatternThreshold)
		&& mostCommonPattern < lowPatternThreshold && settings::IsDetectionEnabled(DetectionType::Bhop)) {
		MarkInfraction(player, Infraction::Type::BhopHack,
					   localization::Format("evidence.bhop.repeated_pattern",
											"The player repeated the same short jump-button pattern on {repeated} of {patterns} completed landings. The "
											"common pattern used {inputs} jump presses around each landing, while the overall average was {average}.",
											{{"repeated", FormatString("%u", mostCommonPatternCount)},
											 {"patterns", FormatString("%u", totalPatternOccurrences)},
											 {"inputs", FormatString("%u", mostCommonPattern)},
											 {"average", FormatString("%.2f", static_cast<double>(averagePattern))}}));
		recentLandingEvents.clear();
		bhopDirty = false;
		return;
	}

	// Hyperscroll check
	const f32 perfectRatio = totalChainEligibleEvents > 0 ? static_cast<f32>(numPerfs) / static_cast<f32>(totalChainEligibleEvents) : 0.0f;
	if (HyperscrollDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("Hyperscroll: %s evaluation: %u completed patterns averaged %.2f jump presses; %u of %u eligible landings were frame-perfect "
					   "(%.2f%%).",
					   player->GetName(), totalPatternOccurrences, static_cast<double>(averagePattern), numPerfs, totalChainEligibleEvents,
					   static_cast<double>(perfectRatio * 100.0f));
	}
	if (averagePattern >= highPatternThreshold && perfectRatio > perfRatioForHyperscrollInfraction
		&& totalPatternOccurrences >= minSampleCount && totalChainEligibleEvents >= minSampleCount
		&& settings::IsDetectionEnabled(DetectionType::Hyperscroll)) {
		MarkInfraction(player, Infraction::Type::Hyperscroll,
					   localization::Format("evidence.hyperscroll",
											"Across {patterns} completed landings, the player sent an average of {average} jump presses around each "
											"landing. Of {landings} checked landings, {perfect} were frame-perfect ({ratio}%).",
											{{"average", FormatString("%.2f", static_cast<double>(averagePattern))},
											 {"patterns", FormatString("%u", totalPatternOccurrences)},
											 {"perfect", FormatString("%u", numPerfs)},
											 {"landings", FormatString("%u", totalChainEligibleEvents)},
											 {"ratio", FormatString("%.2f", static_cast<double>(perfectRatio * 100.0f))}}));
		recentLandingEvents.clear();
		bhopDirty = false;
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Autostrafe jump statistics (jumps.cpp)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

namespace {
constexpr f32 minJumpDurationForDetection = 0.6f;
constexpr f32 minSyncForDetection = 0.7f;
constexpr size_t numJumpsWindowSize = 20;
constexpr int baseSuspiciousJumpsThreshold = 15;
constexpr f32 baseStrafesPerSecondThreshold = 20.0f;
constexpr f32 minStrafeDuration = 0.02f;
constexpr f32 realStrafePerSecondThreshold = 18.0f;
constexpr f32 maxStrafesPerSecondThreshold = 30.0f;
constexpr int minSuspiciousJumpsThreshold = 5;
constexpr f32 gainEfficiencyThreshold = 0.95f;
constexpr f32 strafePerSecondThresholdForGainEff = 6.0f;
constexpr f32 jumpDistanceThresholdForGainEff = 240.0f;
} // namespace

void MovementDetectionService::OnJumpFinish(PlayerRef* player, const JumpStats& jump)
{
	if (player->IsFakeClient() || player->IsCSTV()) {
		return;
	}
	if (!ShouldRunDetections()) {
		if (AutostrafeDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Autostrafe: %s jump ignored: inherited movement detections are currently unavailable.", player->GetName());
		}
		recentJumpStatuses.clear();
		return;
	}
	if (!settings::IsDetectionEnabled(DetectionType::Autostrafe)) {
		recentJumpStatuses.clear();
		return;
	}
	if (!jump.valid) {
		if (AutostrafeDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Autostrafe: %s jump rejected: jump data is invalid.", player->GetName());
		}
		return;
	}
	if (jump.airtime < minJumpDurationForDetection) {
		if (AutostrafeDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Autostrafe: %s jump rejected: %.3f seconds in air is below the %.3f-second minimum.", player->GetName(),
						   static_cast<double>(jump.airtime), static_cast<double>(minJumpDurationForDetection));
		}
		return;
	}

	// Rejected jumps are skipped rather than treated as normal or used to erase earlier valid evidence.
	if (jump.sync <= minSyncForDetection) {
		recentJumpStatuses.push_back(JumpStatus::Normal);
	} else if (static_cast<f32>(jump.strafeCount) / jump.airtime > maxStrafesPerSecondThreshold) {
		recentJumpStatuses.push_back(JumpStatus::VeryHighStrafeCount);
	} else if (static_cast<f32>(jump.strafeCount) / jump.airtime > baseStrafesPerSecondThreshold) {
		recentJumpStatuses.push_back(JumpStatus::HighStrafeCount);
	} else {
		// The original counted strafes longer than MIN_STRAFE_DURATION; the ported jump statistics
		// only carry the total, so the effective count equals the total (the sub-20 ms strafes the
		// original dropped are the ones that would otherwise have raised this count).
		const f32 effectiveStrafesPerSecond = static_cast<f32>(jump.strafeCount) / jump.airtime;
		if (effectiveStrafesPerSecond > realStrafePerSecondThreshold) {
			recentJumpStatuses.push_back(JumpStatus::HighStrafeCount);
		} else if (effectiveStrafesPerSecond > strafePerSecondThresholdForGainEff
				   && (jump.gainEfficiency > gainEfficiencyThreshold && jump.distance > jumpDistanceThresholdForGainEff)) {
			recentJumpStatuses.push_back(JumpStatus::HighEfficiency);
		} else {
			recentJumpStatuses.push_back(JumpStatus::Normal);
		}
	}
	// Keep only the recent N jumps.
	while (recentJumpStatuses.size() > numJumpsWindowSize) {
		recentJumpStatuses.pop_front();
	}
	// Count suspicious jumps.
	int suspiciousJumpCount = 0;
	int numVeryHighStrafeJumps = 0;
	for (auto status : recentJumpStatuses) {
		if (status != JumpStatus::Normal) {
			suspiciousJumpCount++;
		}
		if (status == JumpStatus::VeryHighStrafeCount) {
			numVeryHighStrafeJumps++;
		}
	}
	if (AutostrafeDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("Autostrafe: %s jump evaluated: %.1f%% sync, %.2f strafes/s, %.1f%% gain efficiency, %.2f units; %d of %zu recent jumps are "
					   "suspicious.",
					   player->GetName(), static_cast<double>(jump.sync * 100.0f), static_cast<double>(static_cast<f32>(jump.strafeCount) / jump.airtime),
					   static_cast<double>(jump.gainEfficiency * 100.0f), static_cast<double>(jump.distance), suspiciousJumpCount,
					   recentJumpStatuses.size());
	}
	if (suspiciousJumpCount >= baseSuspiciousJumpsThreshold
		|| (suspiciousJumpCount >= minSuspiciousJumpsThreshold && numVeryHighStrafeJumps > 0)) {
		const size_t evaluatedJumpCount = recentJumpStatuses.size();
		MarkInfraction(player, Infraction::Type::StrafeHack,
					   localization::Format("evidence.autostrafe.jumps",
											"Of the latest {evaluated} valid jumps, {suspicious} showed air-strafing speed or efficiency patterns "
											"associated with automation ({ratio}%).",
											{{"suspicious", FormatString("%d", suspiciousJumpCount)},
											 {"evaluated", FormatString("%zu", evaluatedJumpCount)},
											 {"ratio", FormatString("%.2f", static_cast<double>(static_cast<f32>(suspiciousJumpCount)
																								 / static_cast<f32>(evaluatedJumpCount) * 100.0f))}}));
		recentJumpStatuses.clear();
	}
	(void)minStrafeDuration;
}

} // namespace detection
} // namespace cs2ac

```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/mod_pattern.cpp`:

```cpp
// Report-only triggerbot statistics that survive "humanised" delays (fork
// trigger_pattern_module.cpp, packages v3/v5/v9).
//
// Three independent measurements, each logged to telemetry:
//   1. Click hold time (synthetic clicks are held for microseconds).
//   2. Reaction-delay shape when an enemy walks into a held crosshair.
//   3. Share of combat presses that start with the crosshair already on the enemy.
//
// Nothing here punishes on its own data: it raises one report per map per signal for extreme,
// sustained values; cs2ac_kick_detections may still escalate TRIGGER PATTERN to a kick.

#include "cs2ac.hpp"
#include "detection_log.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <numeric>
#include <vector>

namespace cs2ac {
namespace detection {

namespace {

constexpr f32 tickMilliseconds = ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_INTERVAL * 1000.0f;
constexpr f32 tapLimitMs = 300.0f; // longer holds are sprays, not taps
constexpr std::size_t tapWindow = 60;
constexpr std::size_t tapMinimum = 40;
constexpr std::size_t reactionWindow = 60;
constexpr std::size_t reactionMinimum = 30;
constexpr int reactionMaximumTicks = 64; // a "reaction" longer than 1 s is not one
constexpr std::size_t combatWindow = 60;
constexpr std::size_t combatMinimum = 40;
constexpr f32 nearMissDegrees = 4.0f;
constexpr std::size_t fastCombatMinimum = 10;
constexpr f32 fastOnTargetShare = 0.9f;
constexpr f32 nearMissMaximumDistance = 3000.0f;
constexpr auto summaryInterval = std::chrono::seconds(120);

bool DebugEnabled()
{
	return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_trigger_pattern_debug");
}

template <typename T>
void PushBounded(std::deque<T>& values, T value, std::size_t limit)
{
	values.push_back(value);
	while (values.size() > limit) {
		values.pop_front();
	}
}

std::string IntList(const std::vector<int>& values)
{
	std::string out = "[";
	for (std::size_t index = 0; index < values.size(); ++index) {
		out += (index ? "," : "") + std::to_string(values[index]);
	}
	return out + "]";
}

std::string FloatList(const std::vector<f32>& values)
{
	std::string out = "[";
	char buffer[32];
	for (std::size_t index = 0; index < values.size(); ++index) {
		std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%s%.2f", index ? "," : "", static_cast<double>(values[index]));
		out += buffer;
	}
	return out + "]";
}

// Chest point of the nearest living, visible enemy within `maxDegrees` of the aim line.
bool VisibleEnemyNearAim(PlayerRef* player, const Vector& eye, const QAngle& angles, f32 maxDegrees, f32* degreesOut)
{
	if (!player || !g_pPlayerManager || !IsFinite(eye) || !IsFinite(angles)) {
		return false;
	}
	const Vector forward = AimForward(angles);
	f32 best = maxDegrees;
	bool found = false;
	for (int index = 1; index <= MAXPLAYERS; ++index) {
		auto* target = g_pPlayerManager->ToPlayer(index);
		if (!target || target == player) {
			continue;
		}
		if (!target->IsAlive() || !AreOpponents(engine::PlayerTeam(player->index), engine::PlayerTeam(target->index))) {
			continue;
		}
		Vector targetEye;
		if (!engine::ReadEyeOrigin(target->index, targetEye)) {
			continue;
		}
		const Vector chest(targetEye.x, targetEye.y, targetEye.z - 20.0f);
		const f32 dx = chest.x - eye.x;
		const f32 dy = chest.y - eye.y;
		const f32 dz = chest.z - eye.z;
		const f32 distance = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
		if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance < 1.0f || distance > nearMissMaximumDistance) {
			continue;
		}
		const f32 cosine = (forward.x * dx + forward.y * dy + forward.z * dz) / distance;
		const f32 degrees = std::acos(std::clamp(cosine, -1.0f, 1.0f)) * (180.0f / 3.14159265f);
		if (degrees > best) {
			continue;
		}
		engine::TraceResult trace;
		if (engine::TraceLine(eye, chest, player->index, trace) && trace.hit && trace.hitEntityIndex != target->index) {
			continue; // a wall or another player is in the way
		}
		best = degrees;
		found = true;
	}
	if (found && degreesOut) {
		*degreesOut = best;
	}
	return found;
}

} // namespace

void TriggerPatternModule::Load(AnnounceCallback announceCallback)
{
	announce = std::move(announceCallback);
	Reset();
}

void TriggerPatternModule::Unload()
{
	Reset();
	announce = nullptr;
}

void TriggerPatternModule::Reset()
{
	playerData = {};
}

void TriggerPatternModule::OnClientDisconnect(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (player && player->index >= 1 && player->index <= MAXPLAYERS) {
		auto& data = playerData[static_cast<std::size_t>(player->index)];
		if (data.dirty) {
			WriteSummary(player, data);
		}
		data = {};
	}
}

void TriggerPatternModule::RecordHold(TriggerPatternPlayerData& data, f32 milliseconds, int pressCommand)
{
	if (!std::isfinite(milliseconds) || milliseconds < 0.0f) {
		return;
	}
	data.holdPending = true;
	data.pendingHoldMs = milliseconds;
	data.pendingHoldPressCommand = pressCommand;
	++data.holdBuckets[TriggerPatternHoldBucket(milliseconds)];
	if (milliseconds < tapLimitMs) {
		PushBounded(data.recentTapsMs, milliseconds, tapWindow);
		data.newTapsMs.push_back(milliseconds);
	}
	data.dirty = true;
}

void TriggerPatternModule::TrackClicks(TriggerPatternPlayerData& data, const UsercmdView& command)
{
	if (data.lastCommandNumber >= 0 && command.commandNumber != data.lastCommandNumber + 1) {
		data.pressTime = -1.0; // dropped or replayed commands: the open press can't be timed
	}
	data.lastCommandNumber = command.commandNumber;

	bool sawSubtickAttack = false;
	for (const SubtickMove& step : command.subtickMoves) {
		if (!step.hasButton || step.button != IN_ATTACK) {
			continue;
		}
		const f32 when = step.when;
		if (!std::isfinite(when) || when < 0.0f || when > 1.0f) {
			continue;
		}
		sawSubtickAttack = true;
		const f64 time = static_cast<f64>(command.commandNumber) + when;
		if (step.pressed) {
			data.pressTime = time;
			data.pressCommand = command.commandNumber;
		} else if (data.pressTime >= 0.0) {
			RecordHold(data, static_cast<f32>((time - data.pressTime) * tickMilliseconds), data.pressCommand);
			data.pressTime = -1.0;
		}
	}
	if (sawSubtickAttack) {
		return;
	}

	// No subtick detail: fall back to the per-tick button state.
	switch (InButtonState(command.buttonState1, command.buttonState2, command.buttonState3, IN_ATTACK)) {
	case kInButtonUpDownUp:
	case kInButtonDownUpDownUp:
		// Pressed and released inside one tick with no subtick record.
		++data.subtickLessTaps;
		RecordHold(data, 0.0f, command.commandNumber);
		data.pressTime = -1.0;
		break;
	case kInButtonUpDown:
		data.pressTime = static_cast<f64>(command.commandNumber) + 0.5;
		data.pressCommand = command.commandNumber;
		break;
	case kInButtonDownUp:
		if (data.pressTime >= 0.0) {
			RecordHold(data, static_cast<f32>((command.commandNumber + 0.5 - data.pressTime) * tickMilliseconds), data.pressCommand);
		}
		data.pressTime = -1.0;
		break;
	default:
		break;
	}
}

void TriggerPatternModule::OnCommand(PlayerRef* player, const UsercmdView& command, int currentTick, const Vector& eye, const QAngle& angles,
									 int contactTarget, bool freshAttack, int contactStartTick, bool targetDriven, bool smokeUncertain)
{
	if (!settings::BoolSetting("cs2ac_trigger_pattern_enabled", true) || !IsEligibleHuman(player) || !command.hasBase) {
		return;
	}
	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<std::size_t>(player->index)];
	TrackClicks(data, command);

	if (freshAttack) {
		data.classifiedCommand = command.commandNumber;
		data.pressClass = -1;
	}
	if (freshAttack && !smokeUncertain) {
		if (contactTarget >= 1) {
			data.pressClass = 1;
			++data.onTargetPresses;
			PushBounded(data.recentCombatPresses, true, combatWindow);
			data.dirty = true;
			if (contactStartTick >= 0) {
				const int reaction = currentTick - contactStartTick;
				if (reaction >= 0 && reaction <= reactionMaximumTicks) {
					PushBounded(targetDriven ? data.reactionsTargetDriven : data.reactionsAimDriven, reaction, reactionWindow);
					(targetDriven ? data.newReactionsTargetDriven : data.newReactionsAimDriven).push_back(reaction);
					if (DebugEnabled()) {
						ConsoleMessage("[CS2AC Trigger Pattern] %s fired %d ticks after contact (%s).", player->GetName(), reaction,
									   targetDriven ? "held angle" : "aim moved");
					}
				}
			}
		} else {
			f32 degrees = 0.0f;
			if (VisibleEnemyNearAim(player, eye, angles, nearMissDegrees, &degrees)) {
				data.pressClass = 0;
				++data.nearMissPresses;
				PushBounded(data.recentCombatPresses, false, combatWindow);
				data.dirty = true;
				if (DebugEnabled()) {
					ConsoleMessage("[CS2AC Trigger Pattern] %s fired %.2f degrees beside a visible enemy.", player->GetName(),
								   static_cast<double>(degrees));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	PairFastTap(data);
	Evaluate(player, data);
}

void TriggerPatternModule::PairFastTap(TriggerPatternPlayerData& data)
{
	if (!data.holdPending || data.pendingHoldPressCommand != data.classifiedCommand) {
		// The press was not classified (no fresh attack that command); a later tap replaces it.
		return;
	}
	data.holdPending = false;
	if (data.pendingHoldMs >= settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_trigger_pattern_fast_tap_ms", 20.0f) || data.pressClass < 0) {
		return;
	}
	const bool onTarget = data.pressClass == 1;
	PushBounded(data.recentFastCombat, onTarget, combatWindow);
	++(onTarget ? data.fastOnTarget : data.fastNearMiss);
	data.dirty = true;
}

void TriggerPatternModule::Evaluate(PlayerRef* player, TriggerPatternPlayerData& data)
{
	if (!announce) {
		return;
	}

	if (!data.reportedClicks && data.recentTapsMs.size() >= tapMinimum) {
		const f32 fastTapMs = settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_trigger_pattern_fast_tap_ms", 20.0f);
		const auto fast = std::count_if(data.recentTapsMs.begin(), data.recentTapsMs.end(), [&](f32 ms) { return ms < fastTapMs; });
		const f32 share = static_cast<f32>(fast) / static_cast<f32>(data.recentTapsMs.size());
		// Instant taps alone also come from attack bound to the mouse wheel (seen live). A
		// triggerbot's instant taps additionally start on the enemy almost every time.
		const auto fastOn = std::count(data.recentFastCombat.begin(), data.recentFastCombat.end(), true);
		const bool enoughCombat = data.recentFastCombat.size() >= fastCombatMinimum;
		const f32 fastOnShare = enoughCombat ? static_cast<f32>(fastOn) / static_cast<f32>(data.recentFastCombat.size()) : 0.0f;
		if (share >= settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_trigger_pattern_fast_click_share", 0.6f) && enoughCombat && fastOnShare >= fastOnTargetShare) {
			data.reportedClicks = true;
			announce("TRIGGER PATTERN", player,
					 localization::Format(
						 "evidence.trigger_pattern.clicks",
						 "{fast} of the last {total} taps were held for less than {limit} ms, and {on} of {combat} such taps at a nearby "
						 "visible enemy started with the crosshair already on that enemy. Synthetic clicks are held for microseconds "
						 "and a triggerbot only fires on contact.",
						 {{"fast", std::to_string(fast)},
						  {"total", std::to_string(data.recentTapsMs.size())},
						  {"on", std::to_string(fastOn)},
						  {"combat", std::to_string(data.recentFastCombat.size())},
						  {"limit", std::to_string(static_cast<int>(fastTapMs))}}));
		}
	}

	if (!data.reportedDelay && data.reactionsTargetDriven.size() >= reactionMinimum) {
		const std::vector<int> values(data.reactionsTargetDriven.begin(), data.reactionsTargetDriven.end());
		const int median = TriggerPatternMedian(values);
		// Very fast reactions are the existing Triggerbot detector's job.
		if (median >= 3) {
			const auto close = std::count_if(values.begin(), values.end(), [&](int ticks) { return std::abs(ticks - median) <= 1; });
			const f32 concentration = static_cast<f32>(close) / static_cast<f32>(values.size());
			if (concentration >= settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_trigger_pattern_delay_concentration", 0.8f)) {
				data.reportedDelay = true;
				char medianMs[16];
				std::snprintf(medianMs, sizeof(medianMs), "%.0f", static_cast<double>(median * tickMilliseconds));
				announce("TRIGGER PATTERN", player,
						 localization::Format("evidence.trigger_pattern.delay",
											  "{close} of {total} shots at enemies entering a held crosshair came {median} ms after contact, "
											  "within one tick of each other. Human reaction times vary far more.",
											  {{"close", std::to_string(close)}, {"total", std::to_string(values.size())}, {"median", medianMs}}));
			}
		}
	}

	if (!data.reportedOnTarget && data.recentCombatPresses.size() >= combatMinimum) {
		const auto onTarget = std::count(data.recentCombatPresses.begin(), data.recentCombatPresses.end(), true);
		const f32 share = static_cast<f32>(onTarget) / static_cast<f32>(data.recentCombatPresses.size());
		if (share >= settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_trigger_pattern_on_target_share", 0.97f)) {
			data.reportedOnTarget = true;
			announce("TRIGGER PATTERN", player,
					 localization::Format("evidence.trigger_pattern.on_target",
										  "{on} of the last {total} shots at nearby visible enemies started with the crosshair already on "
										  "the enemy; none or almost none were fired just beside one.",
										  {{"on", std::to_string(onTarget)}, {"total", std::to_string(data.recentCombatPresses.size())}}));
		}
	}
}

void TriggerPatternModule::OnGameFrame()
{
	if (!g_pPlayerManager) {
		return;
	}
	const auto now = Clock::now();
	for (int index = 1; index <= MAXPLAYERS; ++index) {
		auto& data = playerData[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
		if (!data.dirty || now < data.nextSummary) {
			continue;
		}
		if (auto* player = g_pPlayerManager->ToPlayer(index)) {
			WriteSummary(player, data);
		}
		data.nextSummary = now + summaryInterval;
	}
}

void TriggerPatternModule::WriteSummary(PlayerRef* player, TriggerPatternPlayerData& data)
{
	std::string holds = "[";
	for (std::size_t index = 0; index < data.holdBuckets.size(); ++index) {
		holds += (index ? "," : "") + std::to_string(data.holdBuckets[index]);
	}
	holds += "]";
	std::string fields;
	fields += ",\"hold_buckets_ms\":\"<2,<8,<20,<40,<80,<150,<300,300+\"";
	fields += ",\"hold_counts\":" + holds;
	fields += ",\"subtickless_taps\":" + std::to_string(data.subtickLessTaps);
	fields += ",\"taps_ms\":" + FloatList(data.newTapsMs);
	fields += ",\"reaction_ticks_held\":" + IntList(data.newReactionsTargetDriven);
	fields += ",\"reaction_ticks_aimed\":" + IntList(data.newReactionsAimDriven);
	fields += ",\"on_target\":" + std::to_string(data.onTargetPresses);
	fields += ",\"near_miss\":" + std::to_string(data.nearMissPresses);
	fields += ",\"fast_on_target\":" + std::to_string(data.fastOnTarget);
	fields += ",\"fast_near_miss\":" + std::to_string(data.fastNearMiss);
	detection_log::WriteTelemetry("trigger_stats", player, fields);
	// Counters are per summary window; the rolling windows keep feeding Evaluate().
	data.holdBuckets.fill(0);
	data.subtickLessTaps = 0;
	data.onTargetPresses = 0;
	data.nearMissPresses = 0;
	data.fastOnTarget = 0;
	data.fastNearMiss = 0;
	data.newTapsMs.clear();
	data.newReactionsTargetDriven.clear();
	data.newReactionsAimDriven.clear();
	data.dirty = false;
}

} // namespace detection
} // namespace cs2ac

```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/mod_recoil.cpp`:

```cpp
// Report-only recoil-control (RCS) statistics (fork v4 recoil_control_module.cpp).
//
// During a spray the server knows both the player's view angles (from the usercmd) and the
// weapon's aim punch. Bullets go to view + weapon_recoil_scale * punch. An RCS cheat moves the view
// against the punch on the same or the next tick, so the tick-to-tick view change mirrors the punch
// change almost exactly; human recoil control lags and is smooth.
//
// Reports are off by default (cs2ac_rcs_report 0); telemetry is always written, including the raw
// per-tick series for the first three sprays of each player per map.

#include "cs2ac.hpp"
#include "detection_log.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>

namespace cs2ac {
namespace detection {

namespace {

constexpr int maximumLag = 8;
constexpr std::size_t maximumSamples = 256;
constexpr f32 minimumPunchTravel = 4.0f; // degrees of scaled punch; below this there is nothing to compensate
constexpr std::size_t recentSprays = 12;
constexpr int rawSpraysPerPlayer = 3;

bool DebugEnabled()
{
	return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_rcs_debug");
}

f32 RecoilScale()
{
	const f32 value = engine::ServerCvarFloat("weapon_recoil_scale", 2.0f);
	return std::isfinite(value) && value > 0.0f ? value : 2.0f;
}

} // namespace

void RecoilControlModule::Load(AnnounceCallback announceCallback)
{
	announce = std::move(announceCallback);
	available = false;
	checked = false;
	Reset();
}

void RecoilControlModule::Unload()
{
	Reset();
	announce = nullptr;
	available = false;
	checked = false;
}

void RecoilControlModule::Reset()
{
	playerData = {};
}

void RecoilControlModule::EnsureAvailability()
{
	if (checked) {
		return;
	}
	// GetSchemaOffset must not run in the plugin-start window: only probe once a map is up.
	if (!engine::GameReady()) {
		return;
	}
	checked = true;
	available = engine::RecoilSchemaAvailable();
	if (!available) {
		ConsoleMessage("RCS statistics are unavailable: a required CCSPlayerPawn/CCSPlayer_AimPunchServices field is missing "
					   "(m_pAimPunchServices, m_iShotsFired, m_predictableBaseAngle, m_unpredictableBaseAngle, their base ticks).");
	} else {
		ConsoleMessage("RCS statistics enabled (CCSPlayer_AimPunchServices).");
	}
}

void RecoilControlModule::OnClientDisconnect(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (player && player->index >= 1 && player->index <= MAXPLAYERS) {
		playerData[static_cast<std::size_t>(player->index)] = {};
	}
}

void RecoilControlModule::OnWeaponFire(PlayerRef* player, std::string_view weapon)
{
	EnsureAvailability();
	if (!available || !IsEligibleHuman(player)) {
		return;
	}
	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<std::size_t>(player->index)];
	if (data.inSpray && !data.weapon.empty() && data.weapon != weapon) {
		data.invalid = true; // weapon switched mid-spray
	}
	data.weapon.assign(weapon);
}

void RecoilControlModule::OnSetupMove(PlayerRef* player, const UsercmdView& command, int currentTick)
{
	EnsureAvailability();
	if (!available || !settings::BoolSetting("cs2ac_rcs_enabled", true) || !IsEligibleHuman(player) || !command.hasBase || !command.hasViewAngles) {
		return;
	}
	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<std::size_t>(player->index)];
	if (!player->IsAlive()) {
		data.inSpray = false;
		data.samples.clear();
		return;
	}
	if (command.commandNumber <= data.lastCommandNumber) {
		return;
	}
	const bool consecutive = data.lastCommandNumber < 0 || command.commandNumber == data.lastCommandNumber + 1;
	data.lastCommandNumber = command.commandNumber;

	engine::RecoilData recoil;
	if (!engine::ReadRecoilData(player->index, recoil)) {
		data.invalid = true;
		return;
	}
	if (recoil.shotsFired <= 0) {
		if (data.inSpray) {
			Finish(player, data);
		}
		return;
	}
	if (!data.inSpray) {
		data.inSpray = true;
		data.invalid = false;
		data.maxShots = 0;
		data.samples.clear();
	}
	if (!consecutive) {
		data.invalid = true; // a gap breaks the tick-to-tick series
	}
	if (!engine::PlayerOnGround(player->index)) {
		data.invalid = true; // air sprays are not recoil-controlled
	}
	data.maxShots = (std::max)(data.maxShots, static_cast<int>(recoil.shotsFired));

	const QAngle view = command.viewAngles;
	if (!std::isfinite(view.x) || !std::isfinite(view.y) || !std::isfinite(recoil.punchPitch) || !std::isfinite(recoil.punchYaw)
		|| !std::isfinite(recoil.randomPitch) || !std::isfinite(recoil.randomYaw)) {
		data.invalid = true;
		return;
	}
	if (data.samples.size() < maximumSamples) {
		RecoilSample sample;
		sample.viewPitch = view.x;
		sample.viewYaw = view.y;
		sample.punchPitch = recoil.punchPitch;
		sample.punchYaw = recoil.punchYaw;
		sample.randomPitch = recoil.randomPitch;
		sample.randomYaw = recoil.randomYaw;
		sample.predictableTick = recoil.predictableTick;
		sample.unpredictableTick = recoil.unpredictableTick;
		data.samples.push_back(sample);
	}
	(void)currentTick;
}

void RecoilControlModule::Finish(PlayerRef* player, RecoilPlayerData& data)
{
	data.inSpray = false;
	const std::vector<RecoilSample> samples = std::move(data.samples);
	data.samples.clear();
	if (!RecoilSprayQualifies(data.invalid, data.maxShots, samples.size(), data.weapon)) {
		if (DebugEnabled()) {
			ConsoleMessage("[CS2AC RCS] %s: spray skipped (invalid=%d shots=%d samples=%zu weapon=%s automatic=%d).", player->GetName(),
						   data.invalid ? 1 : 0, data.maxShots, samples.size(), data.weapon.empty() ? "<none>" : data.weapon.c_str(),
						   IsAutomaticWeapon(data.weapon) ? 1 : 0);
		}
		return;
	}

	const f32 scale = RecoilScale();
	const std::size_t count = samples.size();
	// Tick-to-tick changes: index t is the change from sample t-1 to t.
	std::vector<f32> viewPitch(count, 0.0f), viewYaw(count, 0.0f), punchPitch(count, 0.0f), punchYaw(count, 0.0f);
	f32 punchTravel = 0.0f;
	for (std::size_t t = 1; t < count; ++t) {
		viewPitch[t] = RecoilAngleDelta(samples[t].viewPitch, samples[t - 1].viewPitch);
		viewYaw[t] = RecoilAngleDelta(samples[t].viewYaw, samples[t - 1].viewYaw);
		punchPitch[t] = scale * RecoilAngleDelta(samples[t].punchPitch, samples[t - 1].punchPitch);
		punchYaw[t] = scale * RecoilAngleDelta(samples[t].punchYaw, samples[t - 1].punchYaw);
		punchTravel += std::fabs(punchPitch[t]) + std::fabs(punchYaw[t]);
	}
	if (punchTravel < minimumPunchTravel) {
		if (DebugEnabled()) {
			ConsoleMessage("[CS2AC RCS] %s: spray skipped, aim punch barely moved (%.2f degrees). Does CCSPlayer_AimPunchServices update per tick?",
						   player->GetName(), static_cast<double>(punchTravel));
		}
		return;
	}

	std::array<f32, maximumLag + 1> correlations {};
	std::array<f32, maximumLag + 1> gains {};
	for (int lag = 0; lag <= maximumLag; ++lag) {
		std::vector<f32> x;
		std::vector<f32> y;
		for (std::size_t t = static_cast<std::size_t>(1 + lag); t < count; ++t) {
			// Perfect compensation: view change == -(scaled punch change) `lag` ticks earlier.
			x.push_back(viewPitch[t]);
			y.push_back(-punchPitch[t - static_cast<std::size_t>(lag)]);
			x.push_back(viewYaw[t]);
			y.push_back(-punchYaw[t - static_cast<std::size_t>(lag)]);
		}
		correlations[static_cast<std::size_t>(lag)] = RecoilCorrelation(x, y);
		f64 xy = 0.0;
		f64 yy = 0.0;
		for (std::size_t index = 0; index < x.size(); ++index) {
			xy += static_cast<f64>(x[index]) * y[index];
			yy += static_cast<f64>(y[index]) * y[index];
		}
		gains[static_cast<std::size_t>(lag)] = yy > 1e-9 ? static_cast<f32>(xy / yy) : 0.0f;
	}
	const int bestLag = static_cast<int>(std::max_element(correlations.begin(), correlations.end()) - correlations.begin());

	// Same test against the unpredictable (random) part only, and how often each base tick moved.
	std::array<f32, maximumLag + 1> randomCorrelations {};
	for (int lag = 0; lag <= maximumLag; ++lag) {
		std::vector<f32> x;
		std::vector<f32> y;
		for (std::size_t t = static_cast<std::size_t>(1 + lag); t < count; ++t) {
			x.push_back(viewPitch[t]);
			y.push_back(-scale * RecoilAngleDelta(samples[t - static_cast<std::size_t>(lag)].randomPitch,
												  samples[t - static_cast<std::size_t>(lag) - 1].randomPitch));
			x.push_back(viewYaw[t]);
			y.push_back(-scale * RecoilAngleDelta(samples[t - static_cast<std::size_t>(lag)].randomYaw,
												  samples[t - static_cast<std::size_t>(lag) - 1].randomYaw));
		}
		randomCorrelations[static_cast<std::size_t>(lag)] = RecoilCorrelation(x, y);
	}
	int predictableTickChanges = 0;
	int unpredictableTickChanges = 0;
	for (std::size_t t = 1; t < count; ++t) {
		predictableTickChanges += samples[t].predictableTick != samples[t - 1].predictableTick ? 1 : 0;
		unpredictableTickChanges += samples[t].unpredictableTick != samples[t - 1].unpredictableTick ? 1 : 0;
	}

	// Drift of the actual bullet line (view + scaled punch) from the first shot.
	f64 driftSquares = 0.0;
	for (const RecoilSample& sample : samples) {
		const f32 pitch =
			RecoilAngleDelta(sample.viewPitch + scale * sample.punchPitch, samples.front().viewPitch + scale * samples.front().punchPitch);
		const f32 yaw = RecoilAngleDelta(sample.viewYaw + scale * sample.punchYaw, samples.front().viewYaw + scale * samples.front().punchYaw);
		driftSquares += static_cast<f64>(pitch) * pitch + static_cast<f64>(yaw) * yaw;
	}
	const f32 driftRms = static_cast<f32>(std::sqrt(driftSquares / static_cast<f64>(samples.size())));

	const RecoilSprayResult result {correlations[static_cast<std::size_t>(bestLag)], gains[static_cast<std::size_t>(bestLag)], bestLag};
	data.recent.push_back(result);
	while (data.recent.size() > recentSprays) {
		data.recent.pop_front();
	}

	char buffer[512];
	std::string lags = "[";
	for (int lag = 0; lag <= maximumLag; ++lag) {
		std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%s%.3f", lag ? "," : "", static_cast<double>(correlations[static_cast<std::size_t>(lag)]));
		lags += buffer;
	}
	lags += "]";
	std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer),
				  ",\"weapon\":%s,\"shots\":%d,\"samples\":%zu,\"best_lag\":%d,\"best_r\":%.3f,\"gain\":%.3f,\"punch_travel\":%.2f,"
				  "\"drift_rms\":%.3f,\"recoil_scale\":%.2f",
				  detection::JsonString(std::string(NormalizeWeapon(data.weapon)).c_str()).c_str(), data.maxShots, samples.size(), bestLag,
				  static_cast<double>(result.bestCorrelation), static_cast<double>(result.gain), static_cast<double>(punchTravel),
				  static_cast<double>(driftRms), static_cast<double>(scale));
	// v4 JSON hotfix: the buffer is reused for the random-lag loop below, so the base object must be
	// captured immediately (before the fix only the last random correlation reached the log).
	const std::string base(buffer);
	std::string randomLags = "[";
	for (int lag = 0; lag <= maximumLag; ++lag) {
		std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%s%.3f", lag ? "," : "",
					  static_cast<double>(randomCorrelations[static_cast<std::size_t>(lag)]));
		randomLags += buffer;
	}
	randomLags += "]";
	std::string extra = ",\"r_by_lag\":" + lags + ",\"random_r_by_lag\":" + randomLags + ",\"predictable_tick_changes\":"
						+ std::to_string(predictableTickChanges) + ",\"unpredictable_tick_changes\":" + std::to_string(unpredictableTickChanges);
	// Raw per-tick series for the first sprays of each player per map, to calibrate the aim-punch
	// component offline. About 2 KB per spray.
	if (data.rawSpraysLogged < rawSpraysPerPlayer) {
		++data.rawSpraysLogged;
		auto series = [&](auto get) {
			std::string out = "[";
			char value[24];
			for (std::size_t t = 0; t < count; ++t) {
				std::snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "%s%.3f", t ? "," : "", static_cast<double>(get(samples[t])));
				out += value;
			}
			return out + "]";
		};
		extra += ",\"raw_view_pitch\":" + series([](const RecoilSample& sample) { return sample.viewPitch; });
		extra += ",\"raw_view_yaw\":" + series([](const RecoilSample& sample) { return sample.viewYaw; });
		extra += ",\"raw_punch_pitch\":" + series([](const RecoilSample& sample) { return sample.punchPitch; });
		extra += ",\"raw_punch_yaw\":" + series([](const RecoilSample& sample) { return sample.punchYaw; });
		extra += ",\"raw_random_pitch\":" + series([](const RecoilSample& sample) { return sample.randomPitch; });
		extra += ",\"raw_predictable_tick\":" + series([](const RecoilSample& sample) { return static_cast<f32>(sample.predictableTick); });
		extra += ",\"raw_unpredictable_tick\":"
				 + series([](const RecoilSample& sample) { return static_cast<f32>(sample.unpredictableTick); });
	}
	detection_log::WriteTelemetry("rcs_spray", player, base + extra);
	if (DebugEnabled()) {
		ConsoleMessage("[CS2AC RCS] %s sprayed %d shots with %s: best r %.3f at lag %d, gain %.2f, drift %.2f.", player->GetName(), data.maxShots,
					   data.weapon.c_str(), static_cast<double>(result.bestCorrelation), bestLag, static_cast<double>(result.gain),
					   static_cast<double>(driftRms));
	}

	if (data.reported || !announce || !settings::BoolSetting("cs2ac_rcs_report", false)
		|| !RecoilSuspiciousShare(data.recent, settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_rcs_correlation", 0.9f),
								  settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_rcs_suspicious_share", 0.8f))) {
		return;
	}
	data.reported = true;
	// Recount for the evidence sentence (the qualifier is the same share test).
	std::size_t machineLike = 0;
	for (const RecoilSprayResult& spray : data.recent) {
		if (spray.bestCorrelation >= settings::FloatSetting("cs2ac_rcs_correlation", 0.9f) && spray.bestLag >= 0 && spray.bestLag <= 2
			&& spray.gain >= 0.5f && spray.gain <= 1.3f) {
			++machineLike;
		}
	}
	announce("RCS", player,
			 localization::Format("evidence.rcs.sprays",
								  "In {machine} of the last {total} sprays the view moved against the recoil almost exactly, tick by tick, "
								  "within {lag} ticks of the recoil itself.",
								  {{"machine", std::to_string(machineLike)}, {"total", std::to_string(data.recent.size())}, {"lag", "2"}}));
}

} // namespace detection
} // namespace cs2ac

```

`plugins/cs2ac/src/mod_shots.cpp`:

```cpp
// cs2ac — the shot detectors: Doubletap, Triggerbot, Silentaim, Irregular Behavior, Inhuman
// Accuracy.
//
// Ported from the original's detection/{doubletap,triggerbot,silent_aim,
// irregular_behavior,inhuman_accuracy}_module.cpp with identical thresholds, windows and weights.
// The crosshair trace (Triggerbot) goes through s2sdk::TraceLine instead of INavPhysicsInterface.

#include "cs2ac.hpp"
#include "detection_log.h"

namespace cs2ac {
namespace detection {

namespace {
bool DoubletapDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_doubletap_debug"); }
bool TriggerbotDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_triggerbot_debug"); }
bool SilentAimDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_silentaim_debug"); }
bool IrregularDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_irregular_debug"); }
bool AccuracyDebug() { return settings::DebugFlag("cs2ac_inhuman_accuracy_debug"); }
} // namespace

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Doubletap (doubletap_module.cpp)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

namespace {
constexpr int doubletapDetectionThreshold = 2;

void MergeNetworkEvidence(NetworkSafetyEvidence& combined, const NetworkSafetyEvidence& current)
{
	combined.pingMilliseconds = (std::max)(combined.pingMilliseconds, current.pingMilliseconds);
	combined.jitterMilliseconds = (std::max)(combined.jitterMilliseconds, current.jitterMilliseconds);
	combined.incomingLoss = (std::max)(combined.incomingLoss, current.incomingLoss);
	combined.outgoingLoss = (std::max)(combined.outgoingLoss, current.outgoingLoss);
	combined.incomingChoke = (std::max)(combined.incomingChoke, current.incomingChoke);
	combined.outgoingChoke = (std::max)(combined.outgoingChoke, current.outgoingChoke);
	combined.commandGaps = (std::max)(combined.commandGaps, current.commandGaps);
	combined.unavailableSamples = (std::max)(combined.unavailableSamples, current.unavailableSamples);
	combined.vetoed = combined.vetoed || current.vetoed;
}
} // namespace

void DoubletapModule::Load(AnnounceCallback announceCallback, AnnounceCallback networkVetoCallback, NetworkSafetyMonitor* networkSafetyMonitor)
{
	announce = std::move(announceCallback);
	announceNetworkVeto = std::move(networkVetoCallback);
	networkSafety = networkSafetyMonitor;
}

void DoubletapModule::Unload()
{
	Reset();
	announce = nullptr;
	announceNetworkVeto = nullptr;
	networkSafety = nullptr;
}

void DoubletapModule::Reset()
{
	playerData = {};
}

void DoubletapModule::OnWeaponFire(const GameEventData& event, PlayerRef* player, int currentTick)
{
	if (!IsEligibleHuman(player)) {
		return;
	}

	auto& previous = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)];
	const std::string_view weapon = NormalizeWeapon(event.weapon);
	if (!IsBallisticWeapon(weapon)) {
		previous.serverTick = -1;
		previous.weapon.clear();
		return;
	}
	if (previous.serverTick < 0) {
		if (DoubletapDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Doubletap: %s stored the first %.*s fire at server tick %d.", player->GetName(), static_cast<int>(weapon.size()),
						   weapon.data(), currentTick);
		}
		previous.serverTick = currentTick;
		previous.weapon.assign(weapon);
		return;
	}

	const i64 delta = static_cast<i64>(currentTick) - previous.serverTick;
	if (delta < 0 || delta > 1 || previous.weapon != weapon) {
		if (DoubletapDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Doubletap: %s fired %.*s %lld server ticks after %s. Rejected.", player->GetName(), static_cast<int>(weapon.size()),
						   weapon.data(), static_cast<long long>(delta), previous.weapon.c_str());
		}
		previous.serverTick = currentTick;
		previous.weapon.assign(weapon);
		return;
	}

	previous.serverTick = currentTick;
	const int incidents = ++previous.incidents;
	NetworkSafetyEvidence network;
	if (networkSafety) {
		network = networkSafety->Evaluate(player);
	} else {
		network.unavailableSamples = 1;
		network.vetoed = true;
	}
	MergeNetworkEvidence(previous.networkEvidence, network);
	if (DoubletapDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("Doubletap: %s matched pair %d/%d at %lld server tick%s apart.", player->GetName(), incidents, doubletapDetectionThreshold,
					   static_cast<long long>(delta), delta == 1 ? "" : "s");
	}
	if (network.vetoed && DoubletapDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("Doubletap: %s's pair crossed a network safety gate: %.1f ms ping, %.1f ms jitter, %.1f/%.1f%% loss, %.1f/%.1f%% choke, "
					   "%d command gaps, %d unavailable samples.",
					   player->GetName(), static_cast<double>(network.pingMilliseconds), static_cast<double>(network.jitterMilliseconds),
					   static_cast<double>(network.incomingLoss * 100.0f), static_cast<double>(network.outgoingLoss * 100.0f),
					   static_cast<double>(network.incomingChoke * 100.0f), static_cast<double>(network.outgoingChoke * 100.0f), network.commandGaps,
					   network.unavailableSamples);
	}
	if (incidents < doubletapDetectionThreshold) {
		return;
	}
	previous.incidents = 0;

	const NetworkSafetyEvidence networkEvidence = previous.networkEvidence;
	previous.networkEvidence = {};
	if (networkEvidence.vetoed) {
		if (announceNetworkVeto) {
			const auto details = localization::Format("evidence.doubletap.network_unstable",
													  "The same gun fired twice almost at once on {pairs} separate occasions. The latest pair was "
													  "{ticks} server ticks apart.",
													  {{"pairs", FormatString("%d", doubletapDetectionThreshold)},
													   {"ticks", FormatString("%lld", static_cast<long long>(delta))}});
			announceNetworkVeto("DOUBLETAP", player, AddNetworkSafetyDetails(details, networkEvidence));
		}
		return;
	}

	if (announce) {
		announce("DOUBLETAP", player,
				 localization::Format(delta == 1 ? "evidence.doubletap.one_tick" : "evidence.doubletap.zero_ticks",
									  delta == 1 ? "The same gun fired twice within 1 server tick on {pairs} separate occasions. That is faster than the "
												   "weapon's normal firing cycle allows."
												 : "The same gun fired twice within the same server tick on {pairs} separate occasions. That is faster "
												   "than the weapon's normal firing cycle allows.",
									  {{"pairs", FormatString("%d", doubletapDetectionThreshold)}}));
	}
}

void DoubletapModule::OnClientDisconnect(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (player && player->index >= 1 && player->index <= MAXPLAYERS) {
		playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)] = {};
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Triggerbot (triggerbot_module.cpp)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

namespace {
constexpr size_t triggerbotHistoryLimit = 30;
constexpr size_t pendingLimit = 8;
constexpr int freshContactTicks = static_cast<int>(ENGINE_FIXED_TICK_RATE);
constexpr f32 heldAngleMaximumDegrees = 0.5f;
constexpr f32 traceLength = 8192.0f;
constexpr f32 smokeHalfExtent = 320.0f;
constexpr auto evidenceWindow = std::chrono::minutes(5);
constexpr auto smokeLifetime = std::chrono::milliseconds(22500);

static_assert(ScoreReactions(std::array<int, 5> {0, 1, 0, 1, 0}, 5).score == kTriggerbotDetectionThreshold, "five fast reactions must reach the threshold");
static_assert(ScoreReactions(std::array<int, 10> {2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2}, 10).score == 0, "two-tick reactions must not accumulate");
static_assert(ScoreReactions(std::array<int, 4> {1, 2, 3, 4}, 4).score == 0, "mixed normal reactions must not accumulate");
static_assert(ScoreReactions(std::array<int, 4> {10, 20, 30, 40}, 4).score == 0, "slow reactions must not accumulate");
static_assert(ScoreReactions(std::array<int, 3> {3, 3, 1}, 3).score == 2, "one fast reaction is worth two points");
static_assert(ScoreReactions(std::array<int, 3> {0, 0, 3}, 3).score == 1, "a normal reaction decays the score by three");

bool SegmentTouchesSmokeBounds(const Vector& start, const Vector& end, const Vector& center)
{
	const f32 starts[] = {start.x, start.y, start.z};
	const f32 ends[] = {end.x, end.y, end.z};
	const f32 centers[] = {center.x, center.y, center.z};
	f32 minimumFraction = 0.0f;
	f32 maximumFraction = 1.0f;
	for (size_t axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis) {
		const f32 delta = ends[axis] - starts[axis];
		const f32 minimum = centers[axis] - smokeHalfExtent;
		const f32 maximum = centers[axis] + smokeHalfExtent;
		if (std::fabs(delta) < EPSILON) {
			if (starts[axis] < minimum || starts[axis] > maximum) {
				return false;
			}
			continue;
		}
		f32 first = (minimum - starts[axis]) / delta;
		f32 second = (maximum - starts[axis]) / delta;
		if (first > second) {
			std::swap(first, second);
		}
		minimumFraction = (std::max)(minimumFraction, first);
		maximumFraction = (std::min)(maximumFraction, second);
		if (minimumFraction > maximumFraction) {
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

const char* ContactModeName(TriggerContactMode mode)
{
	return mode == TriggerContactMode::AimDriven ? "aim moved onto target" : "held angle / target entered aim";
}

const char* HitGroupName(int group)
{
	switch (group) {
	case HITGROUP_HEAD: return "head";
	case HITGROUP_CHEST: return "chest";
	case HITGROUP_STOMACH: return "stomach";
	case HITGROUP_LEFTARM:
	case HITGROUP_RIGHTARM: return "arm";
	case HITGROUP_LEFTLEG:
	case HITGROUP_RIGHTLEG: return "leg";
	case HITGROUP_NECK: return "neck";
	default: return "body";
	}
}

struct TraceContact {
	Vector point;
	int targetIndex {-1};
};

// triggerbot_module.cpp TraceCrosshair: the original traced with CTraceFilterPlayerMovementCS and
// asked the hit entity whether it is a live opponent pawn.
TraceContact TraceCrosshair(PlayerRef* player, const Vector& eye, const QAngle& angles)
{
	TraceContact contact;
	if (!player || !IsFinite(eye) || !IsFinite(angles)) {
		return contact;
	}

	const Vector end = eye + AimForward(angles) * traceLength;
	engine::TraceResult trace;
	if (!engine::TraceLine(eye, end, player->index, trace) || !trace.hit) {
		return contact;
	}

	auto* target = g_pPlayerManager ? g_pPlayerManager->ToPlayer(trace.hitEntityIndex) : nullptr;
	if (!target || !target->IsAlive() || !AreOpponents(engine::PlayerTeam(player->index), engine::PlayerTeam(target->index))) {
		return contact;
	}
	contact.targetIndex = target->index;
	contact.point = trace.endPosition;
	return contact;
}
} // namespace

void TriggerbotModule::Load(AnnounceCallback announceCallback, NetworkSafetyMonitor* networkSafetyMonitor, TriggerPatternModule* patternModule)
{
	announce = std::move(announceCallback);
	networkSafety = networkSafetyMonitor;
	pattern = patternModule;
	Reset();
}

{
	Reset();
	announce = nullptr;
	networkSafety = nullptr;
	pattern = nullptr;
}

void TriggerbotModule::Reset()
{
	playerData = {};
	for (auto& data : playerData) {
		data.lastContactTick.fill(-1);
	}
	smokes.clear();
	// A reload cannot inventory smoke that already exists, so remain fail-safe for one full smoke lifetime.
	smokeStateUnknownUntil = Clock::now() + smokeLifetime;
}

void TriggerbotModule::OnGameEvent(const GameEventData& event)
{
	if (event.name != "smokegrenade_detonate") {
		return;
	}
	const Vector center(event.smokeX, event.smokeY, event.smokeZ);
	const auto now = Clock::now();
	if (!IsFinite(center)) {
		smokeStateUnknownUntil = now + smokeLifetime;
		return;
	}
	smokes.push_back({center, now + smokeLifetime});
	if (TriggerbotDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("Triggerbot: smoke safety volume added at %.1f %.1f %.1f.", static_cast<double>(center.x), static_cast<double>(center.y),
					   static_cast<double>(center.z));
	}
}

void TriggerbotModule::OnSetupMove(PlayerRef* player, const UsercmdView& command, int currentTick)
{
	if (!IsEligibleHuman(player) || !command.hasBase || !command.hasViewAngles) {
		return;
	}
	if (!player->IsAlive()) {
		return;
	}

	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)];
	if (command.commandNumber <= data.lastCommandNumber) {
		return;
	}
	if (data.lastCommandNumber >= 0 && command.commandNumber != data.lastCommandNumber + 1) {
		data.activeTarget = -1;
		data.contactStartTick = -1;
	}
	data.lastCommandNumber = command.commandNumber;

	const int attackIndex = command.attack1StartHistoryIndex;
	const bool freshAttack = attackIndex >= 0 && attackIndex < static_cast<int>(command.inputHistory.size())
							 && command.inputHistory[static_cast<size_t>(attackIndex)].hasViewAngles;
	QAngle angles = command.viewAngles;
	if (freshAttack) {
		angles = command.inputHistory[static_cast<size_t>(attackIndex)].viewAngles;
	}
	if (!IsFinite(angles)) {
		data.activeTarget = -1;
		data.contactStartTick = -1;
		return;
	}

	Vector eye;
	if (!engine::ReadEyeOrigin(player->index, eye)) {
		data.activeTarget = -1;
		data.contactStartTick = -1;
		return;
	}
	const TraceContact contact = TraceCrosshair(player, eye, angles);
	if (contact.targetIndex != data.activeTarget) {
		data.activeTarget = contact.targetIndex;
		data.contactStartTick = -1;
		if (contact.targetIndex >= 1) {
			const int previousContact = data.lastContactTick[static_cast<size_t>(contact.targetIndex)];
			if (previousContact < 0 || static_cast<i64>(currentTick) - previousContact >= freshContactTicks) {
				data.contactStartTick = currentTick;
				const f32 aimMovement = data.lastAnglesValid ? AngularDistance(data.lastAngles, angles) : 0.0f;
				data.activeMode = std::isfinite(aimMovement) && aimMovement > heldAngleMaximumDegrees ? TriggerContactMode::AimDriven
																									  : TriggerContactMode::TargetDriven;
				if (TriggerbotDebug()) {
					if (previousContact < 0) {
						ConsoleMessage("Triggerbot: %s acquired target #%d for the first time (%s).", player->GetName(), contact.targetIndex,
									   ContactModeName(data.activeMode));
					} else {
						ConsoleMessage("Triggerbot: %s acquired target #%d after %lld ticks without contact (%s).", player->GetName(),
									   contact.targetIndex, static_cast<long long>(static_cast<i64>(currentTick) - previousContact),
									   ContactModeName(data.activeMode));
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if (contact.targetIndex >= 1) {
		data.lastContactTick[static_cast<size_t>(contact.targetIndex)] = currentTick;
	}

	const auto now = Clock::now();
	while (!smokes.empty() && smokes.front().expires <= now) {
		smokes.pop_front();
	}
	bool smokeUncertain = now < smokeStateUnknownUntil;
	if (!smokeUncertain && contact.targetIndex >= 1) {
		smokeUncertain = std::any_of(smokes.begin(), smokes.end(),
									 [&](const TriggerbotSmoke& smoke) { return SegmentTouchesSmokeBounds(eye, contact.point, smoke.center); });
	}

	if (freshAttack && contact.targetIndex >= 1 && data.contactStartTick >= 0) {
		const int reactionTicks = currentTick - data.contactStartTick;
		if (!smokeUncertain) {
			data.pending.push_back({command.commandNumber, contact.targetIndex, reactionTicks, data.activeMode});
			while (data.pending.size() > pendingLimit) {
				data.pending.pop_front();
			}
			if (TriggerbotDebug()) {
				ConsoleMessage("Triggerbot: %s pressed attack %d ticks after target #%d contact.", player->GetName(), reactionTicks,
							   contact.targetIndex);
			}
		} else if (TriggerbotDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Triggerbot: %s's fresh attack was ignored because smoke state could affect the aim line.", player->GetName());
		}
	}

	if (pattern) {
		// Reuses this command's crosshair trace; the pattern module adds no per-tick traces.
		pattern->OnCommand(player, command, currentTick, eye, angles, contact.targetIndex, freshAttack, data.contactStartTick,
						   data.activeMode == TriggerContactMode::TargetDriven, smokeUncertain);
	}

	data.lastAngles = angles;
	data.lastAnglesValid = true;
}

void TriggerbotModule::OnPlayerHurt(const GameEventData& event, PlayerRef* attacker, PlayerRef* victim, const ShotRecord& shot)
{
	if (!IsEligibleHuman(attacker) || !victim) {
		return;
	}
	auto& data = playerData[static_cast<size_t>(attacker->index)];
	const auto pending = std::find_if(data.pending.begin(), data.pending.end(),
									  [&](const TriggerbotPending& candidate) { return candidate.commandNumber == shot.commandNumber; });
	if (pending == data.pending.end()) {
		return;
	}
	const TriggerbotPending candidate = *pending;
	data.pending.erase(pending);
	if (candidate.targetIndex != victim->index || shot.victimIndex != victim->index) {
		if (TriggerbotDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Triggerbot: %s's damage was ignored because target #%d was expected, not #%d.", attacker->GetName(),
						   candidate.targetIndex, victim->index);
		}
		return;
	}
	const int damage = event.dmgHealth;
	if (damage <= 0) {
		if (TriggerbotDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Triggerbot: %s's hit on target #%d was ignored because it dealt no health damage.", attacker->GetName(), victim->index);
		}
		return;
	}

	const std::string_view weapon = NormalizeWeapon(shot.weapon);
	if (!IsBallisticWeapon(weapon) || weapon == "revolver" || weapon == "taser") {
		if (TriggerbotDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Triggerbot: %s's %.*s shot was excluded.", attacker->GetName(), static_cast<int>(weapon.size()), weapon.data());
		}
		return;
	}
	if (candidate.reactionTicks < 0) {
		return;
	}

	NetworkSafetyEvidence network;
	if (networkSafety) {
		network = networkSafety->Evaluate(attacker);
	} else {
		network.unavailableSamples = 1;
		network.vetoed = true;
	}
	if (network.vetoed) {
		if (TriggerbotDebug()) {
			ConsoleMessage("Triggerbot: %s's %d-tick damaging shot was ignored by network safety.", attacker->GetName(), candidate.reactionTicks);
		}
		return;
	}

	const auto now = Clock::now();
	while (!data.history.empty() && now - data.history.front().time >= evidenceWindow) {
		data.history.pop_front();
	}
	data.history.push_back({now, candidate.reactionTicks});
	while (data.history.size() > triggerbotHistoryLimit) {
		data.history.pop_front();
	}

	std::array<int, triggerbotHistoryLimit> ticks {};
	for (size_t index = 0; index < data.history.size(); ++index) {
		ticks[index] = data.history[index].reactionTicks;
	}
	const ReactionScore score = ScoreReactions(ticks, data.history.size());
	if (TriggerbotDebug()) {
		ConsoleMessage("Triggerbot: %s recorded a damaging %d-tick shot: score %d/%d across %zu reactions; <=1t %d, 2t %d, normal %d.",
					   attacker->GetName(), candidate.reactionTicks, score.score, kTriggerbotDetectionThreshold, data.history.size(),
					   score.oneTickCount, score.twoTickCount, score.normalCount);
	}
	if (score.score < kTriggerbotDetectionThreshold || !announce) {
		return;
	}

	announce("TRIGGERBOT", attacker,
			 localization::Format(
				 "evidence.triggerbot",
				 "The player repeatedly fired almost immediately after the crosshair first touched an enemy. Across {shots} damaging "
				 "shots, {one_tick} were fired within one game update, {two_tick} within two updates, and {normal} took three or more "
				 "updates, bringing the score to {score}/{threshold}. The latest shot took {latest_ticks} updates, dealt {damage} "
				 "damage to the enemy's {hitgroup}, and happened while {context}; the target was player slot {target}.",
				 {{"shots", FormatString("%zu", data.history.size())},
				  {"score", FormatString("%d", score.score)},
				  {"threshold", FormatString("%d", kTriggerbotDetectionThreshold)},
				  {"one_tick", FormatString("%d", score.oneTickCount)},
				  {"two_tick", FormatString("%d", score.twoTickCount)},
				  {"normal", FormatString("%d", score.normalCount)},
				  {"latest_ticks", FormatString("%d", candidate.reactionTicks)},
				  {"damage", FormatString("%d", damage)},
				  {"context", ContactModeName(candidate.mode)},
				  {"hitgroup", HitGroupName(event.hitgroup)},
				  {"target", FormatString("%d", candidate.targetIndex)}}));
	data.history.clear();
}

void TriggerbotModule::OnClientDisconnect(PlayerRef* player)
{
	if (player && player->index >= 1 && player->index <= MAXPLAYERS) {
		playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)] = {};
		playerData[static_cast<size_t>(player->index)].lastContactTick.fill(-1);
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Silentaim (silent_aim_module.cpp)

namespace {
constexpr int silentDetectionScore = 10;
constexpr int normalHitDecay = 2;
constexpr auto silentEvidenceWindow = std::chrono::minutes(5);
constexpr f32 minimumAllowance = 1.0f;
constexpr f32 blatantExcess = 22.5f;
// The subtick exemption is only granted when the client-reported view travel is plausible for the
// base-angle change of the same command (fork import).
constexpr f32 subtickTravelMargin = 30.0f;
constexpr f32 subtickTravelFallbackMargin = 90.0f;
// Telemetry only: none of the values below changes the score (fork v6/v9.1).
constexpr auto silentSummaryInterval = std::chrono::seconds(120);
constexpr int silentHitRowLimit = 60;
} // namespace

	announce = nullptr;
}
```
