```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
// Generated from polyhook.pplugin

namespace polyhook {

  // Enum representing different data types in the system.
  enum class DataType : uint8_t {
    Void = 0, // Represents no data type (void).
    Bool = 1, // Represents a boolean data type (true or false).
    Int8 = 2, // Represents an 8-bit signed integer.
    UInt8 = 3, // Represents an 8-bit unsigned integer.
    Int16 = 4, // Represents a 16-bit signed integer.
    UInt16 = 5, // Represents a 16-bit unsigned integer.
    Int32 = 6, // Represents a 32-bit signed integer.
    UInt32 = 7, // Represents a 32-bit unsigned integer.
    Int64 = 8, // Represents a 64-bit signed integer.
    UInt64 = 9, // Represents a 64-bit unsigned integer.
    Float = 10, // Represents a 32-bit floating point number.
    Double = 11, // Represents a 64-bit double precision floating point number.
    Pointer = 12, // Represents a pointer to any type of data.
    String = 13, // Represents a string data type.
  };

  // Enum representing the type of callback.
  enum class CallbackType : uint8_t {
    Pre = 0, // Callback will be executed before the original function
    Post = 1, // Callback will be executed after the original function
  };

  // Enum representing the possible results of an operation.
  enum class ResultType : int32_t {
    Ignored = 0, // Handler didn't take any action.
    Handled = 1, // We did something, but real function should still be called.
    Override = 2, // Call real function, but use my return value.
    Supercede = 3, // Skip real function; use my return value.
  };

  // Enum representing register storage offsets based on RegisterType layout (x64)
  enum class RegisterType : uint64_t {
    XMM0 = 0, // XMM register 0.
    XMM1 = 2, // XMM register 1.
    XMM2 = 4, // XMM register 2.
    XMM3 = 6, // XMM register 3.
    XMM4 = 8, // XMM register 4.
    XMM5 = 10, // XMM register 5.
    XMM6 = 12, // XMM register 6.
    XMM7 = 14, // XMM register 7.
    XMM8 = 16, // XMM register 8.
    XMM9 = 18, // XMM register 9.
    XMM10 = 20, // XMM register 10.
    XMM11 = 22, // XMM register 11.
    XMM12 = 24, // XMM register 12.
    XMM13 = 26, // XMM register 13.
    XMM14 = 28, // XMM register 14.
    XMM15 = 30, // XMM register 15.
    R15 = 32, // General-purpose register R15.
    R14 = 33, // General-purpose register R14.
    R13 = 34, // General-purpose register R13.
    R12 = 35, // General-purpose register R12.
    R11 = 36, // General-purpose register R11.
    R10 = 37, // General-purpose register R10.
    R9 = 38, // General-purpose register R9.
    R8 = 39, // General-purpose register R8.
    RDI = 40, // Destination Index register.
    RSI = 41, // Source Index register.
    RBP = 42, // Base Pointer register.
    RBX = 43, // Base register.
    RDX = 44, // Data register.
    RCX = 45, // Counter register.
    RAX = 46, // Accumulator register.
    RFLAGS = 47, // CPU flags register.
    COUNT = 48, // Number of register entries.
  };


  /// Ownership type for RAII wrappers
  enum class Ownership : bool { Borrowed, Owned };

} // namespace polyhook
```

```hpp
    return __s2sdk_SetConVarValue(conVarHandle, value, replicate, notify);

  /**
   * @brief RAII wrapper for ConVar handle.
   * @return 
   */
  class ConVar final {
  public:
    ConVar() = default;

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (any): The default value of the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A description of the console variable's purpose.
     * @param flags (int64): Additional flags for the console variable.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, const plg::any& defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags)
      : ConVar(CreateConVar(name, defaultValue, description, flags), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new boolean console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (bool): The default value for the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A brief description of the console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): Flags that define the behavior of the console variable.
     * @param hasMin (bool): Indicates if a minimum value is provided.
     * @param min (bool): The minimum value if hasMin is true.
     * @param hasMax (bool): Indicates if a maximum value is provided.
     * @param max (bool): The maximum value if hasMax is true.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, bool defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags, bool hasMin, bool min, bool hasMax, bool max)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarBool(name, defaultValue, description, flags, hasMin, min, hasMax, max), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new 16-bit signed integer console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (int16): The default value for the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A brief description of the console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): Flags that define the behavior of the console variable.
     * @param hasMin (bool): Indicates if a minimum value is provided.
     * @param min (int16): The minimum value if hasMin is true.
     * @param hasMax (bool): Indicates if a maximum value is provided.
     * @param max (int16): The maximum value if hasMax is true.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, int16_t defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags, bool hasMin, int16_t min, bool hasMax, int16_t max)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarInt16(name, defaultValue, description, flags, hasMin, min, hasMax, max), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new 16-bit unsigned integer console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (uint16): The default value for the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A brief description of the console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): Flags that define the behavior of the console variable.
     * @param hasMin (bool): Indicates if a minimum value is provided.
     * @param min (uint16): The minimum value if hasMin is true.
     * @param hasMax (bool): Indicates if a maximum value is provided.
     * @param max (uint16): The maximum value if hasMax is true.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, uint16_t defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags, bool hasMin, uint16_t min, bool hasMax, uint16_t max)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarUInt16(name, defaultValue, description, flags, hasMin, min, hasMax, max), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new 32-bit signed integer console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (int32): The default value for the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A brief description of the console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): Flags that define the behavior of the console variable.
     * @param hasMin (bool): Indicates if a minimum value is provided.
     * @param min (int32): The minimum value if hasMin is true.
     * @param hasMax (bool): Indicates if a maximum value is provided.
     * @param max (int32): The maximum value if hasMax is true.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, int32_t defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags, bool hasMin, int32_t min, bool hasMax, int32_t max)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarInt32(name, defaultValue, description, flags, hasMin, min, hasMax, max), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new 32-bit unsigned integer console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (uint32): The default value for the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A brief description of the console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): Flags that define the behavior of the console variable.
     * @param hasMin (bool): Indicates if a minimum value is provided.
     * @param min (uint32): The minimum value if hasMin is true.
     * @param hasMax (bool): Indicates if a maximum value is provided.
     * @param max (uint32): The maximum value if hasMax is true.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, uint32_t defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags, bool hasMin, uint32_t min, bool hasMax, uint32_t max)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarUInt32(name, defaultValue, description, flags, hasMin, min, hasMax, max), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new 64-bit signed integer console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (int64): The default value for the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A brief description of the console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): Flags that define the behavior of the console variable.
     * @param hasMin (bool): Indicates if a minimum value is provided.
     * @param min (int64): The minimum value if hasMin is true.
     * @param hasMax (bool): Indicates if a maximum value is provided.
     * @param max (int64): The maximum value if hasMax is true.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, int64_t defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags, bool hasMin, int64_t min, bool hasMax, int64_t max)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarInt64(name, defaultValue, description, flags, hasMin, min, hasMax, max), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new 64-bit unsigned integer console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (uint64): The default value for the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A brief description of the console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): Flags that define the behavior of the console variable.
     * @param hasMin (bool): Indicates if a minimum value is provided.
     * @param min (uint64): The minimum value if hasMin is true.
     * @param hasMax (bool): Indicates if a maximum value is provided.
     * @param max (uint64): The maximum value if hasMax is true.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, uint64_t defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags, bool hasMin, uint64_t min, bool hasMax, uint64_t max)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarUInt64(name, defaultValue, description, flags, hasMin, min, hasMax, max), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new floating-point console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (float): The default value for the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A brief description of the console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): Flags that define the behavior of the console variable.
     * @param hasMin (bool): Indicates if a minimum value is provided.
     * @param min (float): The minimum value if hasMin is true.
     * @param hasMax (bool): Indicates if a maximum value is provided.
     * @param max (float): The maximum value if hasMax is true.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, float defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags, bool hasMin, float min, bool hasMax, float max)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarFloat(name, defaultValue, description, flags, hasMin, min, hasMax, max), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new double-precision console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (double): The default value for the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A brief description of the console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): Flags that define the behavior of the console variable.
     * @param hasMin (bool): Indicates if a minimum value is provided.
     * @param min (double): The minimum value if hasMin is true.
     * @param hasMax (bool): Indicates if a maximum value is provided.
     * @param max (double): The maximum value if hasMax is true.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, double defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags, bool hasMin, double min, bool hasMax, double max)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarDouble(name, defaultValue, description, flags, hasMin, min, hasMax, max), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new 2D vector console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (vec2): The default value for the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A brief description of the console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): Flags that define the behavior of the console variable.
     * @param hasMin (bool): Indicates if a minimum value is provided.
     * @param min (vec2): The minimum value if hasMin is true.
     * @param hasMax (bool): Indicates if a maximum value is provided.
     * @param max (vec2): The maximum value if hasMax is true.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, const plg::vec2& defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags, bool hasMin, const plg::vec2& min, bool hasMax, const plg::vec2& max)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarVector2(name, defaultValue, description, flags, hasMin, min, hasMax, max), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new 3D vector console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (vec3): The default value for the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A brief description of the console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): Flags that define the behavior of the console variable.
     * @param hasMin (bool): Indicates if a minimum value is provided.
     * @param min (vec3): The minimum value if hasMin is true.
     * @param hasMax (bool): Indicates if a maximum value is provided.
     * @param max (vec3): The maximum value if hasMax is true.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, const plg::vec3& defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags, bool hasMin, const plg::vec3& min, bool hasMax, const plg::vec3& max)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarVector3(name, defaultValue, description, flags, hasMin, min, hasMax, max), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new 4D vector console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (vec4): The default value for the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A brief description of the console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): Flags that define the behavior of the console variable.
     * @param hasMin (bool): Indicates if a minimum value is provided.
     * @param min (vec4): The minimum value if hasMin is true.
     * @param hasMax (bool): Indicates if a maximum value is provided.
     * @param max (vec4): The maximum value if hasMax is true.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, const plg::vec4& defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags, bool hasMin, const plg::vec4& min, bool hasMax, const plg::vec4& max)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarVector4(name, defaultValue, description, flags, hasMin, min, hasMax, max), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new string console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable.
     * @param defaultValue (string): The default value of the console variable.
     * @param description (string): A description of the console variable's purpose.
     * @param flags (int64): Additional flags for the console variable.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit ConVar(const plg::string& name, const plg::string& defaultValue, const plg::string& description, ConVarFlag flags)
      : ConVar(CreateConVarString(name, defaultValue, description, flags), Ownership::Owned) {}

    ConVar(const ConVar&) = default;
    ConVar& operator=(const ConVar&) = default;
    ConVar(ConVar&&) noexcept = default;
    ConVar& operator=(ConVar&&) noexcept = default;
    ~ConVar() = default;

    explicit ConVar(uint64_t handle, [[maybe_unused]] Ownership ownership = Ownership::Borrowed) : _handle(handle) {}

    [[nodiscard]] auto get() const noexcept { return _handle; }

    [[nodiscard]] auto release() noexcept {
      auto handle = _handle;
      _handle = 0;
      return handle;
    }

    void reset() noexcept {
      _handle = 0;
    }

    void swap(ConVar& other) noexcept {
      using std::swap;
      swap(_handle, other._handle);
    }

    friend void swap(ConVar& lhs, ConVar& rhs) noexcept { lhs.swap(rhs); }

    explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return _handle != 0; }
    [[nodiscard]] auto operator<=>(const ConVar& other) const noexcept { return _handle <=> other._handle; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const ConVar& other) const noexcept { return _handle == other._handle; }

    /**
     * @brief Searches for a console variable.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable to search for.
     * @return ConVar: A handle to the console variable data if found; otherwise, nullptr.
     */
    static ConVar Find(const plg::string& name) {
      return ConVar(s2sdk::FindConVar(name));
    }

    /**
     * @brief Searches for a console variable of a specific type.
     * @param name (string): The name of the console variable to search for.
     * @param type (int16): The type of the console variable to search for.
     * @return ConVar: A handle to the console variable data if found; otherwise, nullptr.
     */
    static ConVar Find2(const plg::string& name, ConVarType type) {
      return ConVar(s2sdk::FindConVar2(name, type));
    }

    /**
     * @brief Creates a hook for when a console variable's value is changed.
     * @param callback (function): The callback function to be executed when the variable's value changes.
     */
    void HookChange(ConVarCallback callback) {
      if (_handle == 0) throw std::runtime_error("ConVar: empty handle");
      s2sdk::HookConVarChange(_handle, callback);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Removes a hook for when a console variable's value is changed.
     * @param callback (function): The callback function to be removed.
     */
    void UnhookChange(ConVarCallback callback) {
      if (_handle == 0) throw std::runtime_error("ConVar: empty handle");
      s2sdk::UnhookConVarChange(_handle, callback);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Checks if a specific flag is set for a console variable.
     * @param flag (int64): The flag to check against the console variable.
     * @return bool: True if the flag is set; otherwise, false.
     */
    bool IsFlagSet(int64_t flag) {
      if (_handle == 0) throw std::runtime_error("ConVar: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::IsConVarFlagSet(_handle, flag);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Adds flags to a console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): The flags to be added.
     */
    void AddFlags(ConVarFlag flags) {
      if (_handle == 0) throw std::runtime_error("ConVar: empty handle");
      s2sdk::AddConVarFlags(_handle, flags);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Removes flags from a console variable.
     * @param flags (int64): The flags to be removed.
     */
    void RemoveFlags(ConVarFlag flags) {
      if (_handle == 0) throw std::runtime_error("ConVar: empty handle");
      s2sdk::RemoveConVarFlags(_handle, flags);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Retrieves the current flags of a console variable.
     * @return int64: The current flags set on the console variable.
     */
    ConVarFlag GetFlags() {
      if (_handle == 0) throw std::runtime_error("ConVar: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::GetConVarFlags(_handle);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Gets the specified bound (max or min) of a console variable and stores it in the output string.
     * @param max (bool): Indicates whether to get the maximum (true) or minimum (false) bound.
     * @return string: The bound value.
     */
    plg::string GetBounds(bool max) {
      if (_handle == 0) throw std::runtime_error("ConVar: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::GetConVarBounds(_handle, max);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Sets the specified bound (max or min) for a console variable.
     * @param max (bool): Indicates whether to set the maximum (true) or minimum (false) bound.
```

```hpp
    Protected = 32, // Server cvar; data is not sent since it's sensitive (e.g., passwords).
    SpOnly = 64, // This cvar cannot be changed by clients connected to a multiplayer server.
    Archive = 128, // Saved to vars.rc.
    Notify = 256, // Notifies players when changed.
    UserInfo = 512, // Changes the client's info string.
    Missing0 = 1024, // Hides the cvar from lookups.
    Unlogged = 2048, // If this is a server cvar, changes are not logged to the file or console.
    Missing1 = 4096, // Hides the cvar from lookups.
    Replicated = 8192, // Server-enforced setting on clients.
    Cheat = 16384, // Only usable in singleplayer/debug or multiplayer with sv_cheats.
    PerUser = 32768, // Causes auto-generated varnameN for splitscreen slots.
    Demo = 65536, // Records this cvar when starting a demo file.
    DontRecord = 131072, // Excluded from demo files.
    Missing2 = 262144, // Reserved for future use.
    Release = 524288, // Cvars tagged with this are available to customers.
    MenuBarItem = 1048576, // Marks the cvar as a menu bar item.
    Missing3 = 2097152, // Reserved for future use.
    NotConnected = 4194304, // Cannot be changed by a client connected to a server.
    VconsoleFuzzyMatching = 8388608, // Enables fuzzy matching for vconsole.
    ServerCanExecute = 16777216, // The server can execute this command on clients.
    ClientCanExecute = 33554432, // Allows clients to execute this command.
    ServerCannotQuery = 67108864, // The server cannot query this cvar's value.
    VconsoleSetFocus = 134217728, // Sets focus in the vconsole.
    ClientCmdCanExecute = 268435456, // IVEngineClient::ClientCmd can execute this command.
    ExecutePerTick = 536870912, // Executes the cvar every tick.
  };

  // Enum representing the possible results of an operation.
```

```hpp
  /**
   * @brief RAII wrapper for EventInfo pointer.
   * @return 
   */
  class EventInfo final {
  public:
    EventInfo() = default;

    /**
     * @brief Creates a game event to be fired later.
     * @param name (string): The name of the event to create.
     * @param force (bool): A boolean indicating whether to force the creation of the event.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit EventInfo(const plg::string& name, bool force)
      : EventInfo(CreateEvent(name, force), Ownership::Owned) {}

    EventInfo(const EventInfo&) = default;
    EventInfo& operator=(const EventInfo&) = default;
    EventInfo(EventInfo&&) noexcept = default;
    EventInfo& operator=(EventInfo&&) noexcept = default;
    ~EventInfo() = default;

    explicit EventInfo(void* handle, [[maybe_unused]] Ownership ownership = Ownership::Borrowed) : _handle(handle) {}

    [[nodiscard]] auto get() const noexcept { return _handle; }

    [[nodiscard]] auto release() noexcept {
      auto handle = _handle;
      _handle = nullptr;
      return handle;
    }

    void reset() noexcept {
      _handle = nullptr;
    }

    void swap(EventInfo& other) noexcept {
      using std::swap;
      swap(_handle, other._handle);
    }

    friend void swap(EventInfo& lhs, EventInfo& rhs) noexcept { lhs.swap(rhs); }

    explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return _handle != nullptr; }
    [[nodiscard]] auto operator<=>(const EventInfo& other) const noexcept { return _handle <=> other._handle; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const EventInfo& other) const noexcept { return _handle == other._handle; }

    /**
     * @brief Fires a game event.
     * @param dontBroadcast (bool): A boolean indicating whether to broadcast the event.
     */
    void Fire(bool dontBroadcast) {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("EventInfo: empty handle");
      s2sdk::FireEvent(_handle, dontBroadcast);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Fires a game event to a specific client.
     * @param playerSlot (int32): The index of the client to fire the event to.
     */
    void FireToClient(int32_t playerSlot) {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("EventInfo: empty handle");
      s2sdk::FireEventToClient(_handle, playerSlot);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Cancels a previously created game event that has not been fired.
```

```hpp
  /**
   * @brief RAII wrapper for GameConfig handle.
   * @return 
   */
  class GameConfig final {
  public:
    GameConfig() = default;

    /**
     * @brief Loads a game configuration file.
     * @param paths (string[]): The paths to the game configuration file to be loaded.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit GameConfig(const plg::vector<plg::string>& paths)
      : GameConfig(LoadGameConfigFile(paths), Ownership::Owned) {}

    ~GameConfig() {
      destroy();
    }

    GameConfig(const GameConfig&) = delete;
    GameConfig& operator=(const GameConfig&) = delete;

    GameConfig(GameConfig&& other) noexcept
      : _handle(other._handle)
      , _ownership(other._ownership) {
      other.nullify();
    }

    GameConfig& operator=(GameConfig&& other) noexcept {
      if (this != &other) {
        destroy();
        _handle = other._handle;
        _ownership = other._ownership;
        other.nullify();
      }
      return *this;
    }

    GameConfig(ConfigId handle, Ownership ownership = Ownership::Borrowed) : _handle(handle), _ownership(ownership) {}

    [[nodiscard]] auto get() const noexcept { return _handle; }

    [[nodiscard]] auto release() noexcept {
      auto handle = _handle;
      nullify();
      return handle;
    }

    void reset() noexcept {
      destroy();
      nullify();
    }

    void swap(GameConfig& other) noexcept {
      using std::swap;
      swap(_handle, other._handle);
      swap(_ownership, other._ownership);
    }

    friend void swap(GameConfig& lhs, GameConfig& rhs) noexcept { lhs.swap(rhs); }

    explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return _handle != 0; }
    [[nodiscard]] auto operator<=>(const GameConfig& other) const noexcept { return _handle <=> other._handle; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const GameConfig& other) const noexcept { return _handle == other._handle; }

    /**
     * @brief Retrieves a patch associated with the game configuration.
     * @param name (string): The name of the patch to be retrieved.
     * @return string: A string where the patch will be stored.
     */
    plg::string GetPatch(const plg::string& name) {
      if (_handle == 0) throw std::runtime_error("GameConfig: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::GetGameConfigPatch(_handle, name);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Retrieves the offset associated with a name from the game configuration.
     * @param name (string): The name whose offset is to be retrieved.
     * @return int32: The offset associated with the specified name.
     */
    int32_t GetOffset(const plg::string& name) {
      if (_handle == 0) throw std::runtime_error("GameConfig: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::GetGameConfigOffset(_handle, name);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Retrieves the address associated with a name from the game configuration.
     * @param name (string): The name whose address is to be retrieved.
     * @return ptr64: A pointer to the address associated with the specified name.
     */
    void* GetAddress(const plg::string& name) {
      if (_handle == 0) throw std::runtime_error("GameConfig: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::GetGameConfigAddress(_handle, name);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Retrieves a vtable associated with the game configuration.
     * @param name (string): The name of the vtable to be retrieved.
     * @return ptr64: A pointer to the vtable associated with the specified name
     */
    void* GetVTable(const plg::string& name) {
      if (_handle == 0) throw std::runtime_error("GameConfig: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::GetGameConfigVTable(_handle, name);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Retrieves the signature associated with a name from the game configuration.
     * @param name (string): The name whose signature is to be resolved and retrieved.
     * @return ptr64: A pointer to the signature associated with the specified name.
     */
    void* GetSignature(const plg::string& name) {
      if (_handle == 0) throw std::runtime_error("GameConfig: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::GetGameConfigSignature(_handle, name);
    }

  private:
    void destroy() const noexcept {
      if (_handle != 0 && _ownership == Ownership::Owned) {
        CloseGameConfigFile(_handle);
      }
    }

    void nullify() noexcept {
      _handle = 0;
      _ownership = Ownership::Borrowed;
    }

    ConfigId _handle{0};
    Ownership _ownership{Ownership::Borrowed};
  };


} // namespace s2sdk
```

```hpp
  class KeyValues3 final {
  public:
    KeyValues3() = default;

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new KeyValues3 object with specified type and subtype
     * @param type (int32): The KV3 type enumeration value
     * @param subtype (int32): The KV3 subtype enumeration value
     * @return 
     */
    explicit KeyValues3(int32_t type, int32_t subtype)
      : KeyValues3(Kv3Create(type, subtype), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new KeyValues3 object with cluster element, type, and subtype
     * @param cluster_elem (int32): The cluster element index
     * @param type (int32): The KV3 type enumeration value
     * @param subtype (int32): The KV3 subtype enumeration value
     * @return 
     */

      : KeyValues3(Kv3CreateWithCluster(cluster_elem, type, subtype), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a copy of an existing KeyValues3 object
     * @param other (ptr64): Pointer to the KeyValues3 object to copy
     * @return 
     */
    explicit KeyValues3(void* other)
      : KeyValues3(Kv3CreateCopy(other), Ownership::Owned) {}

    ~KeyValues3() {
      destroy();
    }

    KeyValues3(const KeyValues3&) = delete;
    KeyValues3& operator=(const KeyValues3&) = delete;

    KeyValues3(KeyValues3&& other) noexcept
      : _handle(other._handle)
      , _ownership(other._ownership) {
      other.nullify();
    }

    KeyValues3& operator=(KeyValues3&& other) noexcept {
      if (this != &other) {
        destroy();
        _handle = other._handle;
        _ownership = other._ownership;
        other.nullify();
      }
      return *this;
    }

    KeyValues3(void* handle, Ownership ownership) : _handle(handle), _ownership(ownership) {}

    [[nodiscard]] auto get() const noexcept { return _handle; }

    [[nodiscard]] auto release() noexcept {
      auto handle = _handle;
      nullify();
      return handle;
    }

    void reset() noexcept {
      destroy();
      nullify();
    }

    void swap(KeyValues3& other) noexcept {
      using std::swap;
      swap(_handle, other._handle);
      swap(_ownership, other._ownership);
    }

    friend void swap(KeyValues3& lhs, KeyValues3& rhs) noexcept { lhs.swap(rhs); }

    explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return _handle != nullptr; }
    [[nodiscard]] auto operator<=>(const KeyValues3& other) const noexcept { return _handle <=> other._handle; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const KeyValues3& other) const noexcept { return _handle == other._handle; }

     * @param error (string&): Output string for error messages
     * @param output (string&): String to store the text output
     * @param flags (uint32): Saving flags
     * @return bool: true if successful, false otherwise
     */
    bool SaveTextToString(plg::string& error, plg::string& output, uint32_t flags) {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("KeyValues3: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::Kv3SaveTextToString(_handle, error, output, flags);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Saves KeyValues3 data to a file
     * @param error (string&): Output string for error messages
     * @param filename (string): Name of the file to save
     * @param path (string): Path to save the file
     * @param flags (uint32): Saving flags
     * @return bool: true if successful, false otherwise
     */
    bool SaveToFile(plg::string& error, const plg::string& filename, const plg::string& path, uint32_t flags) {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("KeyValues3: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::Kv3SaveToFile(_handle, error, filename, path, flags);
    }

  private:
    void destroy() const noexcept {
      if (_handle != nullptr && _ownership == Ownership::Owned) {
        Kv3Destroy(_handle);
      }
    }

    void nullify() noexcept {
      _handle = nullptr;
      _ownership = Ownership::Borrowed;
    }

    void* _handle{nullptr};
    Ownership _ownership{Ownership::Borrowed};
  };


} // namespace s2sdk
```

```hpp
  /**
   * @brief RAII wrapper for Menu handle.
   * @return 
   */
  class Menu final {
  public:
    Menu() = default;

    /**
     * @brief Creates a new menu.
     * @param title (string): The title shown at the top of the menu.
     * @param handler (function): Callback invoked with Start/Select/Cancel/End actions as the menu is displayed and interacted with.
     * @param menuType (string): The name of the menu type backend to render with. Empty uses the current default menu type.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit Menu(const plg::string& title, MenuHandlerCallback handler, const plg::string& menuType)
      : Menu(CreateMenu(title, handler, menuType), Ownership::Owned) {}

    Menu(const Menu&) = default;
    Menu& operator=(const Menu&) = default;
    Menu(Menu&&) noexcept = default;
    Menu& operator=(Menu&&) noexcept = default;
    ~Menu() = default;

    explicit Menu(MenuId handle, [[maybe_unused]] Ownership ownership = Ownership::Borrowed) : _handle(handle) {}

    [[nodiscard]] auto get() const noexcept { return _handle; }

    [[nodiscard]] auto release() noexcept {
      auto handle = _handle;
      _handle = 0;
      return handle;
    }

    void reset() noexcept {
      _handle = 0;
    }

    void swap(Menu& other) noexcept {
      using std::swap;
      swap(_handle, other._handle);
    }

    friend void swap(Menu& lhs, Menu& rhs) noexcept { lhs.swap(rhs); }

    explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return _handle != 0; }
    [[nodiscard]] auto operator<=>(const Menu& other) const noexcept { return _handle <=> other._handle; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const Menu& other) const noexcept { return _handle == other._handle; }

    /**
     * @brief Destroys a menu. Any client currently viewing it is cancelled first (MenuCancelReason::Destroyed).
     * @return bool: True if the menu existed and was destroyed.
```

```hpp
  /**
   * @brief RAII wrapper for UserMessage pointer.
   * @return 
   */
  class UserMessage final {
  public:
    UserMessage() = default;

    /**
     * @brief Creates a UserMessage from a serializable message.
     * @param msgSerializable (ptr64): The serializable message.
     * @param message (ptr64): The network message.
     * @param recipientMask (uint64): The recipient mask.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit UserMessage(void* msgSerializable, void* message, uint64_t recipientMask)
      : UserMessage(UserMessageCreateFromSerializable(msgSerializable, message, recipientMask), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a UserMessage from a message name.
     * @param messageName (string): The name of the message.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit UserMessage(const plg::string& messageName)
      : UserMessage(UserMessageCreateFromName(messageName), Ownership::Owned) {}

    /**
     * @brief Creates a UserMessage from a message ID.
     * @param messageId (int16): The ID of the message.
     * @return 
     */
    explicit UserMessage(int16_t messageId)
      : UserMessage(UserMessageCreateFromId(messageId), Ownership::Owned) {}

    ~UserMessage() {
      destroy();
    }

    UserMessage(const UserMessage&) = delete;
    UserMessage& operator=(const UserMessage&) = delete;

    UserMessage(UserMessage&& other) noexcept
      : _handle(other._handle)
      , _ownership(other._ownership) {
      other.nullify();
    }

    UserMessage& operator=(UserMessage&& other) noexcept {
      if (this != &other) {
        destroy();
        _handle = other._handle;
        _ownership = other._ownership;
        other.nullify();
      }
      return *this;
    }

    UserMessage(void* handle, Ownership ownership = Ownership::Borrowed) : _handle(handle), _ownership(ownership) {}

    [[nodiscard]] auto get() const noexcept { return _handle; }

    [[nodiscard]] auto release() noexcept {
      auto handle = _handle;
      nullify();
      return handle;
    }

    void reset() noexcept {
      destroy();
      nullify();
    }

    void swap(UserMessage& other) noexcept {
      using std::swap;
      swap(_handle, other._handle);
      swap(_ownership, other._ownership);
    }

    friend void swap(UserMessage& lhs, UserMessage& rhs) noexcept { lhs.swap(rhs); }

    explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return _handle != nullptr; }
    [[nodiscard]] auto operator<=>(const UserMessage& other) const noexcept { return _handle <=> other._handle; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const UserMessage& other) const noexcept { return _handle == other._handle; }

    /**
     * @brief Sends a UserMessage to the specified recipients.
     */
    void Send() {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("UserMessage: empty handle");
      s2sdk::UserMessageSend(_handle);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Gets the name of the message.
     * @return string: The name of the message as a string.
     */
    plg::string GetMessageName() {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("UserMessage: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::UserMessageGetMessageName(_handle);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Gets the ID of the message.
     * @return int16: The ID of the message.
     */
    int16_t GetMessageID() {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("UserMessage: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::UserMessageGetMessageID(_handle);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Checks if the message has a specific field.
     * @param fieldName (string): The name of the field to check.
     * @return bool: True if the field exists, false otherwise.
     */
    bool HasField(const plg::string& fieldName) {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("UserMessage: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::UserMessageHasField(_handle, fieldName);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Gets the protobuf message associated with the UserMessage.
     * @return ptr64: A pointer to the protobuf message.
     */
    void* GetProtobufMessage() {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("UserMessage: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::UserMessageGetProtobufMessage(_handle);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Gets the serializable message associated with the UserMessage.
     * @return ptr64: A pointer to the serializable message.
     */
    void* GetSerializableMessage() {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("UserMessage: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::UserMessageGetSerializableMessage(_handle);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Finds a message ID by its name.
     * @param messageName (string): The name of the message.
     * @return int16: The ID of the message, or 0 if the message was not found.
     */
    static int16_t FindMessageIdByName(const plg::string& messageName) {
      return s2sdk::UserMessageFindMessageIdByName(messageName);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Gets the recipient mask for the UserMessage.
     * @return uint64: The recipient mask.
     */
    uint64_t GetRecipientMask() {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("UserMessage: empty handle");
      return s2sdk::UserMessageGetRecipientMask(_handle);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Adds a single recipient (player) to the UserMessage.
     * @param playerSlot (int32): The slot index of the player to add as a recipient.
     */
    void AddRecipient(int32_t playerSlot) {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("UserMessage: empty handle");
      s2sdk::UserMessageAddRecipient(_handle, playerSlot);
    }

    /**

      s2sdk::UserMessageAddAllPlayers(_handle);
    }

    /**
```

```hpp
  /**
   * @brief RAII wrapper for CheckTransmitInfo pointer.
   * @return 
   */
  class CheckTransmitInfo final {
  public:
    CheckTransmitInfo() = default;

    CheckTransmitInfo(const CheckTransmitInfo&) = default;
    CheckTransmitInfo& operator=(const CheckTransmitInfo&) = default;
    CheckTransmitInfo(CheckTransmitInfo&&) noexcept = default;
    CheckTransmitInfo& operator=(CheckTransmitInfo&&) noexcept = default;
    ~CheckTransmitInfo() = default;

    explicit CheckTransmitInfo(void* handle) : _handle(handle) {}

    [[nodiscard]] auto get() const noexcept { return _handle; }

    [[nodiscard]] auto release() noexcept {
      auto handle = _handle;
      _handle = nullptr;
      return handle;
    }

    void reset() noexcept {
      _handle = nullptr;
    }

    void swap(CheckTransmitInfo& other) noexcept {
      using std::swap;
      swap(_handle, other._handle);
    }

    friend void swap(CheckTransmitInfo& lhs, CheckTransmitInfo& rhs) noexcept { lhs.swap(rhs); }

    explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return _handle != nullptr; }
    [[nodiscard]] auto operator<=>(const CheckTransmitInfo& other) const noexcept { return _handle <=> other._handle; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const CheckTransmitInfo& other) const noexcept { return _handle == other._handle; }

    /**
     * @brief Sets a bit in the TransmitEntity bitvec, marking an entity as transmittable.
     * @param entityHandle (int32): The handle of the entity to mark as transmittable.
     */
    void SetEntity(int32_t entityHandle) {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("CheckTransmitInfo: empty handle");
      s2sdk::SetTransmitInfoEntity(_handle, entityHandle);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Clears a bit in the TransmitEntity bitvec, marking an entity as not transmittable.
     * @param entityHandle (int32): The handle of the entity to mark as not transmittable.
     */
    void ClearEntity(int32_t entityHandle) {
      if (_handle == nullptr) throw std::runtime_error("CheckTransmitInfo: empty handle");
      s2sdk::ClearTransmitInfoEntity(_handle, entityHandle);
    }
```
